# Files

## File: backend/app/Console/Commands/DetectInventoryAnomalies.php
````php
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: declare(strict_types=1);
  4: 
  5: namespace App\Console\Commands;
  6: 
  7: use App\Enums\StockMovementType;
  8: use App\Models\Stocktake;
  9: use App\Notifications\InventoryAnomalyDigestNotification;
 10: use App\Notifications\StaffRecipients;
 11: use App\Services\SettingService;
 12: use Illuminate\Console\Command;
 13: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
 14: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Notification;
 15: 
 16: /**
 17:  * 5.3: كشف الأنماط الغريبة أسبوعيًا — ملاحظات للمراجعة تظهر للي معاه
 18:  * ai_agent.logs.view بس، مش اتهامات.
 19:  */
 20: class DetectInventoryAnomalies extends Command
 21: {
 22:     protected $signature = 'inventory:detect-anomalies';
 23: 
 24:     protected $description = 'Flag unusual inventory patterns for review (adjustment rates, repeat shortages).';
 25: 
 26:     public function handle(SettingService $settings): int
 27:     {
 28:         // entry point للتشخيص: المجدول يعمل بلا tty، والتشغيل اليدوي بـ tty.
 29:         $source = function_exists('posix_isatty') && @posix_isatty(STDOUT) ? 'cli-manual' : 'scheduler';
 30:         logger()->info('inventory.anomalies.run', ['entry_point' => $source]);
 31:         if (! $settings->getBool('ai_inventory_proactive_enabled', false)) {
 32:             $this->info('Proactive inventory engine is disabled.');
 33: 
 34:             return self::SUCCESS;
 35:         }
 36: 
 37:         $notes = [];
 38:         $since = now()->subDays(30);
 39: 
 40:         // مستخدم نسبة تسويات الخصم بتاعته أعلى من غيره بكتير.
 41:         $rates = DB::table('stock_movements')
 42:             ->selectRaw('created_by, COUNT(*) AS c')
 43:             ->where('created_at', '>=', $since)
 44:             ->whereIn('type', [StockMovementType::AdjustmentOut->value, StockMovementType::DamageWriteOff->value])
 45:             ->whereNotNull('created_by')
 46:             ->groupBy('created_by')
 47:             ->havingRaw('COUNT(*) >= 5')
 48:             ->orderByDesc('c')->get();
 49:         if ($rates->count() >= 3) {
 50:             $sorted = $rates->pluck('c')->sort()->values();
 51:             $median = (float) $sorted[(int) floor($sorted->count() / 2)];
 52:             foreach ($rates as $row) {
 53:                 if ($median > 0 && (float) $row->c > $median * 3) {
 54:                     $notes[] = [
 55:                         'title' => 'معدل تسويات خصم مرتفع',
 56:                         'detail' => "المستخدم #{$row->created_by} سجّل {$row->c} تسوية خصم آخر 30 يوم (الوسيط {$median}). راجع الأسباب قبل أي استنتاج.",
 57:                     ];
 58:                 }
 59:             }
 60:         }
 61: 
 62:         // موقع العجز بيتكرر فيه (جرود معتمدة آخر 90 يوم).
 63:         $locs = DB::table('stocktake_items as si')
 64:             ->join('stocktakes as s', 's.id', '=', 'si.stocktake_id')
 65:             ->selectRaw('s.location_id, COUNT(*) AS c')
 66:             ->where('s.status', 'approved')
 67:             ->where('s.created_at', '>=', now()->subDays(90))
 68:             ->whereNotNull('s.location_id')
 69:             ->whereRaw('(si.counted_qty - si.system_qty) < 0')
 70:             ->groupBy('s.location_id')
 71:             ->havingRaw('COUNT(*) >= 3')
 72:             ->orderByDesc('c')->limit(5)->get();
 73:         foreach ($locs as $row) {
 74:             $notes[] = [
 75:                 'title' => 'عجز متكرر في موقع',
 76:                 'detail' => "الموقع #{$row->location_id} ظهر فيه عجز {$row->c} مرات آخر 90 يوم. احتمال خطأ ترتيب أو تسجيل.",
 77:             ];
 78:         }
 79: 
 80:         // استلامات تحويل بعجز متكرر من نفس المصدر.
 81:         $srcs = DB::table('stock_movements')
 82:             ->selectRaw('branch_id, COUNT(*) AS c')
 83:             ->where('type', StockMovementType::TransferShortage->value)
 84:             ->where('created_at', '>=', now()->subDays(90))
 85:             ->groupBy('branch_id')
 86:             ->havingRaw('COUNT(*) >= 3')
 87:             ->orderByDesc('c')->limit(5)->get();
 88:         foreach ($srcs as $row) {
 89:             $notes[] = [
 90:                 'title' => 'عجز استلام متكرر',
 91:                 'detail' => "الفرع #{$row->branch_id} سجّل عجز استلام {$row->c} مرات آخر 90 يوم. راجع التغليف والعد عند الشحن.",
 92:             ];
 93:         }
 94: 
 95:         if ($notes === []) {
 96:             $this->info('No unusual patterns detected.');
 97: 
 98:             return self::SUCCESS;
 99:         }
100: 
101:         $recipients = StaffRecipients::withAnyPermission(['ai_agent.logs.view']);
102:         if ($recipients->isEmpty()) {
103:             $this->warn('Anomalies found but nobody holds ai_agent.logs.view.');
104: 
105:             return self::SUCCESS;
106:         }
107: 
108:         Notification::sendNow($recipients, new InventoryAnomalyDigestNotification($notes), ['database']);
109:         $this->info('Flagged '.count($notes).' notes for review.');
110: 
111:         return self::SUCCESS;
112:     }
113: }
````

````php
 17: final class EvaluateAiAgent extends Command

 32:                 $this->error('Invalid evaluation dataset.');

 34:                 return self::FAILURE;
 35:             }

 40: 
 41:             return self::FAILURE;
 42:         }

 45: 
 46:             return self::SUCCESS;

 50:             $cases = array_values(array_filter($cases, fn ($case) => in_array($case['id'], $selected, true)));
 51:             if (count($cases) !== count(array_unique($selected))) {
 52:                 $this->error('Unknown case ID.');
 53: 
 54:                 return self::FAILURE;
 55:             }
 56:             $ids = array_column($cases, 'id');
 57:         }
 58:         $minimum = (float) $this->option('min-accuracy');
 59:         if (! ctype_digit((string) $this->option('rpm')) || (int) $this->option('rpm') < 1) {
 60:             $this->error('rpm must be a positive integer.');
 61: 
 62:             return self::FAILURE;
 63:         }
 64:         if ($minimum < 0 || $minimum > 1) {
 65:             $this->error('min-accuracy must be between 0 and 1.');
 66: 
 67:             return self::FAILURE;
 68:         }
 69:         $actor = $this->option('actor') ? User::findOrFail($this->option('actor')) : User::role(StaffRole::SuperAdmin->value, 'staff')->where('is_active', true)->firstOrFail();
 70:         $declarations = $registry->declarationsFor($actor);
 71:         $system = $orchestrator->systemPrompt($actor)."\nبيانات محاكاة مرجعية موثوقة لاختبار اختيار الأدوات. يمكنك طلب أدوات البحث قبل اقتراح التعديل؛ لا تؤكد تنفيذ أي تعديل: ".json_encode($dataset['context'], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
 72:         $passed = 0;
 73:         $errors = 0;
 74:         foreach ($cases as $case) {
 75:             try {
 76:                 $observed = [];
 77:                 $match = $this->evaluateCase($gemini, $registry, $declarations, $system, $dataset['context'], $case, $observed);
 78:                 $passed += $match ? 1 : 0;

 80:             } catch (\Throwable $exception) {

 89:         if ($errors) {

 96:     private function evaluateCase(GeminiClient $gemini, ToolRegistry $registry, array $declarations, string $system, array $context, array $case, array &$observed): bool
 97:     {
 98:         $history = [['role' => 'user', 'parts' => [['text' => $case['text']]]]];
 99:         for ($step = 0; $step < 6; $step++) {
100:             $interval = 60 / (int) $this->option('rpm');

102:             if ($delay > 0) {
103:                 usleep((int) ($delay * 1000000));
104:             }
105:             $this->lastRequestAt = microtime(true);
106:             $response = $gemini->converse($history, $declarations, $system, $this->option('model') ?: null);
107:             if (! $response['calls']) {
108:                 return $case['tool'] === null;
109:             }
110:             $history[] = ['role' => 'model', 'parts' => $response['parts']];
111:             $responses = [];
112:             $matched = false;
113:             foreach ($response['calls'] as $call) {
114:                 $observed[] = $call['name'];
115:                 $args = $call['args'];
116:                 if ($call['name'] === 'set_branch_status' && ! isset($args['branch_id']) && isset($args['branch_query'])) {
117:                     $results = $this->fixtureResponse($context, ['name' => 'find_entities', 'args' => ['type' => 'branch', 'query' => $args['branch_query']]])['results'];
118:                     if (count($results) === 1) {

121:                 }
122:                 if (in_array($call['name'], ['list_locations', 'create_location']) && ! isset($args['branch_id']) && isset($args['branch_query'])) {
123:                     $results = $this->fixtureResponse($context, ['name' => 'find_entities', 'args' => ['type' => 'branch', 'query' => $args['branch_query']]])['results'];

127:                 }

130:                 if ($registry->isWrite($call['name']) && ! $correct) {

132:                 }
133:                 $matched = $matched || $correct;
134:                 $responses = array_merge($responses, ToolOutcome::data($this->fixtureResponse($context, $call))->asFunctionResponse($call)['parts']);
135:             }
136:             if ($matched) {

145:     private function fixtureResponse(array $context, array $call): array

151:         $key = match ($call['name']) {
152:             'list_branches' => 'branches', 'list_staff' => 'users', 'list_roles' => 'roles',
153:             'list_customers' => 'customers', 'list_customer_groups' => 'customer_groups',
154:             'list_categories' => 'categories', 'search_products' => 'products',
155:             'get_stock_levels' => 'levels', 'stock_matrix' => 'levels', 'explain_balance' => 'levels',
156:             'low_stock_list' => 'levels', 'dead_stock' => 'levels', 'inventory_valuation' => 'levels',
157:             'inventory_health' => 'levels', 'list_production_receipts' => 'levels',
158:             'list_movements' => 'movements',
159:             'list_transfers' => 'transfers', 'get_transfer' => 'transfers',
160:             'list_stocktakes' => 'stocktakes', 'get_stocktake' => 'stocktakes',
161:             'find_entities' => match ($call['args']['type'] ?? '') {
162:                 'branch' => 'branches', 'user' => 'users', 'role' => 'roles', 'location' => 'locations', 'customer' => 'customers', 'customer_group' => 'customer_groups', 'category' => 'categories', 'product' => 'products', 'variant' => 'variants', 'transfer' => 'transfers', 'stocktake' => 'stocktakes', default => ''
163:             },
164:             'list_locations' => 'locations',
165:             default => '',
166:         };
167:         if ($call['name'] === 'view_settings' || $call['name'] === 'update_settings') {
168:             return ['settings' => ['tax_rate' => '15', 'tax_name' => 'ضريبة القيمة المضافة', 'tax_included' => 'true', 'return_window_days' => '14'], 'executed' => $call['name'] === 'update_settings'];
169:         }
170:         if ($call['name'] === 'view_document_numbering' || $call['name'] === 'update_document_numbering') {
171:             $type = $call['args']['type'] ?? 'invoice';
172:             return ['numbering' => ['type' => $type, 'prefix' => 'INV-', 'next_number' => 1, 'padding' => 5], 'executed' => $call['name'] === 'update_document_numbering'];
173:         }
174:         if (in_array($call['name'], ['create_location', 'set_location_status', 'delete_location'])) {
175:             return ['executed' => false, 'message' => 'يحتاج تأكيد'];
176:         }
177:         if (! $key) {
178:             return ['context' => $context, 'executed' => false];
179:         }
180:         $query = $normalize($call['args']['query'] ?? '');
181:         $items = $context[$key] ?? [];
182:         // For locations, filter by branch_id if provided
183:         if ($key === 'locations' && isset($call['args']['branch_id'])) {

185:         }
186:         // أرقام الموبايل العربية تتحوّل لإنجليزي قبل المطابقة (زي Customer::normalizePhone في الإنتاج).
187:         $digits = preg_replace('/\D+/', '', strtr((string) ($call['args']['query'] ?? ''), ['٠' => '0', '١' => '1', '٢' => '2', '٣' => '3', '٤' => '4', '٥' => '5', '٦' => '6', '٧' => '7', '٨' => '8', '٩' => '9']));

190:             || ($digits !== '' && isset($item['phone']) && str_starts_with((string) $item['phone'], $digits))));

192:         $items = array_map(fn ($item) => ['id' => $item['id'], 'label' => isset($item['company_name']) ? $item['name'].' — '.$item['company_name'] : $item['name'], 'meta' => $item['code'] ?? ''], $items);
193: 
194:         return [$call['name'] === 'find_entities' ? 'results' : $key => $items];
195:     }
196: 
197:     private function containsArgs(array $actual, array $expected): bool
198:     {
199:         foreach ($expected as $key => $value) {
200:             if (! array_key_exists($key, $actual)) {
201:                 return false;
202:             }
203:             if (is_array($value)) {
204:                 if (array_is_list($value)) {
205:                     if (! is_array($actual[$key])) {
206:                         return false;
207:                     }
208:                     $left = $actual[$key];
209:                     $right = $value;
210:                     sort($left);
211:                     sort($right);
212:                     if ($left !== $right) {
213:                         return false;
214:                     }
215: 
216:                     continue;
217:                 }
218:                 if (! is_array($actual[$key]) || ! $this->containsArgs($actual[$key], $value)) {
219:                     return false;
220:                 }
221:             } elseif ($actual[$key] !== $value) {
222:                 return false;
223:             }
224:         }
225: 
226:         return true;
227:     }
````

````php
 5: namespace App\Console\Commands;

10: /**
11:  * تنظيف مفاتيح عدم التكرار القديمة (L-2): المفتاح وظيفته تغطية نافذة إعادة
12:  * المحاولة، فالاحتفاظ به أكثر من 7 أيام تراكم بلا فائدة. يُجدول يوميًا.

15: {
16:     protected $signature = 'inventory:prune-idempotency-keys';
17: 
18:     protected $description = 'حذف مفاتيح عدم تكرار المخزون الأقدم من 7 أيام';
19: 
20:     public function handle(): int
21:     {
22:         $deleted = 0;
23:         $cutoff = now()->subDays(7);
24:         do {
25:             $ids = InventoryIdempotencyKey::query()->where('created_at', '<', $cutoff)
26:                 ->orderBy('id')->limit(1000)->pluck('id');
27:             $deleted += InventoryIdempotencyKey::query()->whereIn('id', $ids)->delete();
28:         } while ($ids->count() === 1000);
29: 
30:         $this->info("تم حذف {$deleted} مفتاح عدم تكرار قديم.");
31: 
32:         return self::SUCCESS;
33:     }
34: }
````

## File: backend/app/Console/Commands/ReconcileInventory.php
````php
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: declare(strict_types=1);
  4: 
  5: namespace App\Console\Commands;
  6: 
  7: use App\Models\InventoryReconcileRun;

  9: use Illuminate\Console\Command;

 13: /**
 14:  * مطابقة دورية بين الدفتر والأرصدة (M-8): القاعدة تضمن صحة كل حركة على حدة،
 15:  * والكتابة المباشرة التي تتجاوز حماية الموديل تحتاج مطابقة مستقلة.
 16:  * الفحص يتحقق لكل وعاء من أمرين:
 17:  * 1. رصيد stock_levels يساوي آخر balance_after في الدفتر لنفس الوعاء.
 18:  * 2. تسلسل الدفتر متصل: balance_before لكل حركة يساوي balance_after لسابقتها.
 19:  * يُشغَّل دوريًا (جدولة ليلية) ويُرجع كود فشل عند وجود أي فرق للتنبيه.
 20:  */
 21: class ReconcileInventory extends Command
 22: {
 23:     protected $signature = 'inventory:reconcile {--branch_id= : قصر الفحص على فرع واحد} {--incremental : فحص المفاتيح المتغيرة فقط} {--limit=1000 : أقصى عدد مفاتيح في الدفعة التراكمية}';
 24: 
 25:     protected $description = 'مطابقة أرصدة المخزون مع دفتر الحركات وكشف أي كتابة مباشرة';
 26: 
 27:     public function handle(): int
 28:     {
 29:         return StatementBudget::run(300000, fn (): int => $this->reconcile());
 30:     }
 31: 
 32:     private function reconcile(): int
 33:     {
 34:         $branch = $this->option('branch_id');
 35:         if ($branch !== null && filter_var($branch, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT, ['options' => ['min_range' => 1]]) === false) {
 36:             $this->error('branch_id يجب أن يكون عددًا صحيحًا موجبًا.');
 37: 
 38:             return self::INVALID;
 39:         }
 40: 
 41:         $incremental = (bool) $this->option('incremental');
 42:         $limit = filter_var($this->option('limit'), FILTER_VALIDATE_INT, ['options' => ['min_range' => 1, 'max_range' => 10000]]);
 43:         if ($limit === false) {
 44:             $this->error('limit يجب أن يكون بين 1 و10000.');
 45: 
 46:             return self::INVALID;
 47:         }
 48:         // One SQL statement sees one committed snapshot, even while sales continue.
 49:         // Window functions also catch broken chains and movements without a stock row.
 50:         $sql = <<<'SQL'
 51: WITH levels AS (
 52:     SELECT * FROM stock_levels WHERE (?::bigint IS NULL OR branch_id = ?::bigint)
 53: ), ledger AS (
 54:     SELECT *,
 55:         LAG(balance_after, 1, 0::numeric) OVER (
 56:             PARTITION BY branch_id, location_id, product_variant_id, affected_bucket ORDER BY id
 57:         ) AS previous_balance,
 58:         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
 59:             PARTITION BY branch_id, location_id, product_variant_id, affected_bucket ORDER BY id DESC
 60:         ) AS recency
 61:     FROM stock_movements WHERE (?::bigint IS NULL OR branch_id = ?::bigint)
 62: ), buckets AS (
 63:     SELECT l.id, l.branch_id, l.location_id, l.product_variant_id, b.bucket, b.balance
 64:     FROM levels l CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
 65:         ('on_hand', l.on_hand), ('reserved', l.reserved),
 66:         ('damaged', l.damaged), ('in_transit', l.in_transit)
 67:     ) b(bucket, balance)
 68: ), problems AS (
 69:     SELECT 'chain' AS issue, id, branch_id, location_id, product_variant_id, affected_bucket AS bucket,
 70:         previous_balance AS expected, balance_before AS actual
 71:     FROM ledger WHERE balance_before <> previous_balance
 72:     UNION ALL
 73:     SELECT 'balance', b.id, b.branch_id, b.location_id, b.product_variant_id, b.bucket,
 74:         COALESCE(m.balance_after, 0), b.balance
 75:     FROM buckets b LEFT JOIN ledger m ON m.recency = 1
 76:         AND m.branch_id = b.branch_id AND m.product_variant_id = b.product_variant_id
 77:         AND m.location_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.location_id AND m.affected_bucket = b.bucket
 78:     WHERE b.balance <> COALESCE(m.balance_after, 0)
 79:     UNION ALL
 80:     SELECT 'missing_level', m.id, m.branch_id, m.location_id, m.product_variant_id,
 81:         m.affected_bucket, m.balance_after, NULL::numeric
 82:     FROM ledger m LEFT JOIN levels l ON l.branch_id = m.branch_id
 83:         AND l.product_variant_id = m.product_variant_id AND l.location_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM m.location_id
 84:     WHERE m.recency = 1 AND l.id IS NULL
 85: )
 86: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM levels) AS checked, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM problems) AS problem_count,
 87:     COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(p) FROM (SELECT * FROM problems ORDER BY branch_id, product_variant_id, id LIMIT 100) p), '[]'::json) AS samples
 88: SQL;
 89:         if ($incremental) {
 90:             // Revision comparison survives concurrent commits. A simple MAX(id) cursor
 91:             // would skip a lower sequence ID committed after the reconciliation snapshot.
 92:             $matches = fn (string $alias): string => "EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chosen c WHERE c.branch_id = {$alias}.branch_id AND c.product_variant_id = {$alias}.product_variant_id AND c.location_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM {$alias}.location_id)";
 93:             $sql = str_replace('WITH levels AS (', "WITH chosen AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM inventory_reconcile_work WHERE (?::bigint IS NULL OR branch_id = ?::bigint) ORDER BY key LIMIT {$limit}), levels AS (", $sql);
 94:             $sql = str_replace('SELECT * FROM stock_levels WHERE', 'SELECT * FROM stock_levels WHERE '.$matches('stock_levels').' AND', $sql);
 95:             $sql = str_replace('FROM stock_movements WHERE', 'FROM stock_movements WHERE '.$matches('stock_movements').' AND', $sql);
 96:             $sql = str_replace("\nSELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM levels)", <<<'SQL'
 97: , cleaned AS (
 98:     DELETE FROM inventory_reconcile_work w USING chosen c
 99:     WHERE w.key = c.key AND w.revision = c.revision
100:         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM problems p WHERE p.branch_id = c.branch_id
101:             AND p.product_variant_id = c.product_variant_id AND p.location_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.location_id)
102:     RETURNING w.key
103: )
104: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM levels)
105: SQL, $sql);
106:         }
107:         $bindings = array_fill(0, $incremental ? 6 : 4, $branch);
108:         $result = DB::selectOne($sql, $bindings);
109: 
110:         // آخر نتيجة محفوظة لأداة inventory_health (المطابقة الكاملة أثقل من
111:         // حد زمن الأدوات، فالأداة تقرأ آخر تشغيل مجدول بدل تشغيل الفحص).
112:         InventoryReconcileRun::query()->create([
113:             'branch_id' => $branch !== null ? (int) $branch : null,
114:             'checked' => (int) $result->checked,
115:             'problem_count' => (int) $result->problem_count,
116:             'samples' => json_decode((string) $result->samples, true) ?? [],
117:         ]);
118: 
119:         if ((int) $result->problem_count > 0) {
120:             $samples = json_decode($result->samples, true, flags: JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
121:             foreach ($samples as $problem) {
122:                 $this->error(json_encode($problem, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR));
123:             }
124:             Log::error('Inventory reconciliation failed', ['problem_count' => (int) $result->problem_count, 'samples' => $samples]);
125:             $this->error("المطابقة فشلت: {$result->problem_count} فرق في {$result->checked} صف رصيد.");
126: 
127:             return self::FAILURE;
128:         }
129: 
130:         $this->info("المطابقة سليمة: {$result->checked} صف رصيد مطابق للدفتر.");
131: 
132:         return self::SUCCESS;
133:     }
134: }
````

## File: backend/app/Exceptions/BusinessException.php
````php
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: declare(strict_types=1);
 4: 
 5: namespace App\Exceptions;
 6: 
 7: use Exception;
 8: use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
 9: 
10: // الاستثناء اللي بنرميه لما قاعدة من قواعد البيزنس تتكسر، وبيرجّع 422.
11: class BusinessException extends Exception
12: {
13:     public function __construct(
14:         string $message,
15:         public array $errors = [],
16:         public int $status = 422,
17:         public ?string $errorCode = null,
18:     ) {
19:         parent::__construct($message);
20:     }
21: 
22:     public function render(): JsonResponse
23:     {
24:         $payload = ['message' => $this->getMessage(), 'errors' => $this->errors];
25:         if ($this->errorCode !== null) {
26:             // رمز خطأ مميز تتصرف الواجهة على أساسه (مثل coupon_invalid)
27:             $payload['code'] = $this->errorCode;
28:         }
29: 
30:         $response = response()->json($payload, $this->status);
31:         if ($this->status === 503) {
32:             $response->headers->set('Retry-After', '1');
33:         }
34: 
35:         return $response;
36:     }
37: }
````

````php
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: declare(strict_types=1);
 4: 
 5: namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1\Admin\Ai;
 6: 
 7: use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
 8: use App\Models\AiConversation;
 9: use App\Services\Ai\AgentOrchestrator;
10: use App\Services\Ai\GeminiException;
11: use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
12: use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
13: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
14: use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
15: use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
16: use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;
17: use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\HttpExceptionInterface;
18: 
19: class AiMessageController extends Controller
20: {
21:     public function stream(Request $request, AiConversation $conversation, AgentOrchestrator $orchestrator): StreamedResponse
22:     {
23:         abort_unless($conversation->user_id === $request->user('staff')->id, 403);
24:         $data = $this->validated($request);
25:         $orchestrator->guard($request->user('staff'));
26: 
27:         return response()->stream(function () use ($request, $conversation, $orchestrator, $data): void {
28:             $emit = static function (string $event, array $payload): void {
29:                 echo 'event: '.$event."\n".'data: '.json_encode($payload, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR)."\n\n";
30:                 if (ob_get_level() > 0) {
31:                     ob_flush();
32:                 }
33:                 flush();
34:             };
35:             try {
36:                 $reply = $orchestrator->handle($request->user('staff'), $conversation, $data, fn ($status) => $emit('status', ['message' => $status]));
37:                 $emit('reply', ['text' => $reply->text, 'ui_blocks' => $reply->blocks, 'message_id' => $reply->messageId]);
38:             } catch (\Throwable $e) {
39:                 // L-9: AuthorizationException وValidationException ليستا
40:                 // HttpExceptionInterface، فكانتا تُعرضان كـ 502 مع report().
41:                 // صنّفهما لرمزيهما الصحيحين بلا تقرير.
42:                 $status = match (true) {
43:                     $e instanceof HttpExceptionInterface => $e->getStatusCode(),
44:                     $e instanceof AuthorizationException => 403,
45:                     $e instanceof ValidationException => 422,
46:                     default => 502,
47:                 };
48:                 if ($status >= 500) {
49:                     report($e);
50:                 }
51:                 $emit('error', ['message' => $status < 500 ? $e->getMessage() : 'تعذر إتمام طلب المساعد. حاول مرة تانية.', 'status' => $status]);
52:             }
53:         }, 200, ['Content-Type' => 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control' => 'no-cache, no-store', 'X-Accel-Buffering' => 'no']);
54:     }
55: 
56:     public function store(Request $request, AiConversation $conversation, AgentOrchestrator $orchestrator): JsonResponse
57:     {
58:         abort_unless($conversation->user_id === $request->user('staff')->id, 403);
59:         $data = $this->validated($request);
60:         try {
61:             $reply = $orchestrator->handle($request->user('staff'), $conversation, $data);
62:         } catch (GeminiException $e) {
63:             return response()->json(['message' => $e->getMessage()], 502);
64:         }
65: 
66:         return response()->json(['data' => ['text' => $reply->text, 'ui_blocks' => $reply->blocks, 'message_id' => $reply->messageId]]);
67:     }
68: 
69:     private function validated(Request $request): array
70:     {
71:         return $request->validate([
72:             'text' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:8000'],
73:             'selection' => ['nullable', 'array:entity,id,label'], 'selection.entity' => ['required_with:selection', 'in:branch,user,role,permission,location,customer,customer_group,category,product,variant,transfer,stocktake,production_receipt'], 'selection.id' => ['required_with:selection', Rule::when($request->input('selection.entity') !== 'permission', ['integer', 'min:1'], ['string', 'max:255'])], 'selection.label' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
74:             'mentions' => ['nullable', 'array', 'max:25'], 'mentions.*.entity' => ['required', 'in:branch,user,role,location,customer,category,product,variant,transfer,stocktake,production_receipt'], 'mentions.*.id' => ['required', 'integer', 'min:1'],
75:             'attachments' => ['nullable', 'array', 'max:4'], 'attachments.*' => ['required', 'string', 'ulid', 'distinct'],
76:         ]);
77:     }
78: }
````

## File: backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/Admin/BranchController.php
````php
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: declare(strict_types=1);
  4: 
  5: namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1\Admin;
  6: 
  7: use App\Actions\Branches\CreateBranch;
  8: use App\Actions\Branches\DeleteBranch;
  9: use App\Actions\Branches\UpdateBranch;
 10: use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
 11: use App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Admin\StoreBranchRequest;
 12: use App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Admin\UpdateBranchRequest;
 13: use App\Http\Resources\Api\V1\Admin\BranchResource;
 14: use App\Models\Branch;
 15: use App\Services\BranchAccess;
 16: use App\Services\StaffAdministration;
 17: use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
 18: use Illuminate\Database\UniqueConstraintViolationException;
 19: use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
 20: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
 21: use Illuminate\Http\Resources\Json\AnonymousResourceCollection;
 22: use Illuminate\Http\Response;
 23: 
 24: class BranchController extends Controller
 25: {
 26:     public function index(Request $request): AnonymousResourceCollection
 27:     {
 28:         StaffAdministration::authorize($request->user('staff'), ['branches.view', 'branches.manage']);
 29:         $restricted = app(BranchAccess::class)->restrictedBranch($request->user('staff'));
 30:         $validated = $request->validate(['per_page' => ['sometimes', 'integer', 'min:1', 'max:100']]);
 31:         $branches = Branch::query()->when($restricted !== null, fn ($query) => $query->whereKey($restricted))->withCount(['locations', 'users'])->orderBy('id')->paginate($validated['per_page'] ?? 15)->withQueryString();
 32: 
 33:         return BranchResource::collection($branches);
 34:     }
 35: 
 36:     public function store(StoreBranchRequest $request, CreateBranch $action): JsonResponse
 37:     {
 38:         try {
 39:             $branch = $action($request->user(), $request->validated());
 40:         } catch (UniqueConstraintViolationException) {
 41:             return response()->json(['message' => 'كود الفرع مستخدم بالفعل.'], 422);
 42:         }
 43: 
 44:         return $this->branchResource($branch)->response()->setStatusCode(201);
 45:     }
 46: 
 47:     public function show(Request $request, Branch $branch): BranchResource
 48:     {
 49:         StaffAdministration::authorize($request->user('staff'), ['branches.view', 'branches.manage']);
 50:         $restricted = app(BranchAccess::class)->restrictedBranch($request->user('staff'));
 51:         abort_if($restricted !== null && (int) $branch->id !== $restricted, 403);
 52: 
 53:         return $this->branchResource($branch);
 54:     }
 55: 
 56:     public function update(UpdateBranchRequest $request, Branch $branch, UpdateBranch $action): BranchResource
 57:     {
 58:         try {
 59:             $branch = $action($request->user(), $branch, $request->validated());
 60:         } catch (UniqueConstraintViolationException) {
 61:             abort(422, 'كود الفرع مستخدم بالفعل.');
 62:         }
 63: 
 64:         return $this->branchResource($branch);
 65:     }
 66: 
 67:     private function branchResource(Branch $branch): BranchResource
 68:     {
 69:         return BranchResource::make($branch->loadCount(['locations', 'users']));
 70:     }
 71: 
 72:     public function destroy(Request $request, Branch $branch, DeleteBranch $action): JsonResponse|Response
 73:     {
 74:         try {
 75:             $deleted = $action($request->user(), $branch);
 76:         } catch (QueryException $exception) {
 77:             if (! $this->isIntegrityConstraintViolation($exception)) {
 78:                 throw $exception;
 79:             }
 80: 
 81:             return $this->conflictResponse();
 82:         }
 83:         if (! $deleted) {
 84:             return $this->conflictResponse();
 85:         }
 86: 
 87:         return response()->noContent();
 88:     }
 89: 
 90:     private function isIntegrityConstraintViolation(QueryException $exception): bool
 91:     {
 92:         $sqlState = (string) ($exception->errorInfo[0] ?? $exception->getCode());
 93: 
 94:         return in_array($sqlState, ['23000', '23503'], true);
 95:     }
 96: 
 97:     private function conflictResponse(): JsonResponse
 98:     {
 99:         return response()->json(['message' => 'لا يمكن حذف الفرع لارتباطه بموظفين أو حركات مخزنية.'], 409);
100:     }
101: }
````

## File: backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/Admin/InventoryController.php
````php
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: declare(strict_types=1);
  4: 
  5: namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1\Admin;
  6: 
  7: use App\Enums\StockMovementType;
  8: use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
  9: use App\Http\Requests\Admin\Inventory\StoreAdjustmentRequest;
 10: use App\Http\Resources\Admin\StockLevelResource;
 11: use App\Http\Resources\Admin\StockMovementResource;
 12: use App\Models\StockLevel;
 13: use App\Models\StockMovement;
 14: use App\Services\BranchAccess;
 15: use App\Services\InventoryService;
 16: use Carbon\Carbon;
 17: use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection as EloquentCollection;
 18: use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
 19: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
 20: use Illuminate\Http\Resources\Json\AnonymousResourceCollection;
 21: use Illuminate\Routing\Controllers\HasMiddleware;
 22: use Illuminate\Routing\Controllers\Middleware;
 23: use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
 24: 
 25: class InventoryController extends Controller implements HasMiddleware
 26: {
 27:     public function __construct(
 28:         private readonly InventoryService $inventory,
 29:         private readonly BranchAccess $branchAccess,
 30:     ) {}
 31: 
 32:     public static function middleware(): array
 33:     {
 34:         return [
 35:             new Middleware('can:inventory.view', only: ['index', 'movements']),
 36:             new Middleware('can:inventory.adjust', only: ['adjustments']),
 37:         ];
 38:     }
 39: 
 40:     /** قائمة أرصدة المخزون الحالية مع الفلاتر والمتاح المحسوب. */
 41:     public function index(Request $request): AnonymousResourceCollection
 42:     {
 43:         $filters = $request->validate([
 44:             'branch_id' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:1'],
 45:             'location_id' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:1'],
 46:             'product_id' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:1'],
 47:             'product_variant_id' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:1'],
 48:             'low_stock' => ['nullable', 'boolean'],
 49:             'per_page' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:1', 'max:100'],
 50:         ]);
 51: 
 52:         $levels = StockLevel::query()
 53:             ->when($this->branchAccess->restrictedBranch($request->user()), fn ($q, $branch) => $q->where('stock_levels.branch_id', $branch))
 54:             ->with(['variant.product', 'branch', 'location'])
 55:             ->when($filters['branch_id'] ?? null, fn ($q, $v) => $q->where('stock_levels.branch_id', $v))
 56:             ->when($filters['location_id'] ?? null, fn ($q, $v) => $q->where('stock_levels.location_id', $v))
 57:             ->when($filters['product_variant_id'] ?? null, fn ($q, $v) => $q->where('stock_levels.product_variant_id', $v))
 58:             ->when($filters['product_id'] ?? null, fn ($q, $v) => $q->whereHas('variant', fn ($vq) => $vq->where('product_id', $v)))
 59:             // حد إعادة الطلب الفعّال: مستوى الصف إن ضُبط (> 0)، وإلا مستوى المتغير نفسه
 60:             ->when($filters['low_stock'] ?? null, fn ($q) => $q
 61:                 ->join('product_variants', 'product_variants.id', '=', 'stock_levels.product_variant_id')
 62:                 ->whereRaw('stock_levels.available <= COALESCE(NULLIF(stock_levels.reorder_level, 0), product_variants.reorder_level, 0)')
 63:                 // صف بلا حد إعادة طلب فعّال ليس "منخفضًا": صفوف صفرية ينشئها
 64:                 // lockLevels كأثر جانبي كانت تملأ الفلتر وهميًا (L-4).
 65:                 ->whereRaw('COALESCE(NULLIF(stock_levels.reorder_level, 0), product_variants.reorder_level, 0) > 0')
 66:                 ->select('stock_levels.*'))
 67:             ->orderBy('stock_levels.branch_id')
 68:             ->orderBy('stock_levels.product_variant_id')
 69:             ->orderBy('stock_levels.id')
 70:             ->paginate($filters['per_page'] ?? 15);
 71: 
 72:         return StockLevelResource::collection($levels);
 73:     }
 74: 
 75:     /** سجل حركات دفتر الأستاذ من الأحدث للأقدم مع الفلاتر. */
 76:     public function movements(Request $request): AnonymousResourceCollection
 77:     {
 78:         $filters = $request->validate([
 79:             'branch_id' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:1'],
 80:             'location_id' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:1'],
 81:             'product_id' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:1'],
 82:             'product_variant_id' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:1'],
 83:             'type' => ['nullable', Rule::in(array_column(StockMovementType::cases(), 'value'))],
 84:             'from_date' => ['nullable', 'date_format:Y-m-d'],
 85:             'to_date' => ['nullable', 'date_format:Y-m-d', Rule::when($request->filled('from_date'), 'after_or_equal:from_date')],
 86:             'per_page' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:1', 'max:100'],
 87:         ]);
 88: 
 89:         $movements = StockMovement::query()
 90:             ->when($this->branchAccess->restrictedBranch($request->user()), fn ($q, $branch) => $q->where('branch_id', $branch))
 91:             ->with(['variant', 'branch', 'location', 'creator'])
 92:             ->when($filters['branch_id'] ?? null, fn ($q, $v) => $q->where('branch_id', $v))
 93:             ->when($filters['location_id'] ?? null, fn ($q, $v) => $q->where('location_id', $v))
 94:             ->when($filters['product_variant_id'] ?? null, fn ($q, $v) => $q->where('product_variant_id', $v))
 95:             ->when($filters['product_id'] ?? null, fn ($q, $v) => $q->whereHas('variant', fn ($vq) => $vq->where('product_id', $v)))
 96:             ->when($filters['type'] ?? null, fn ($q, $v) => $q->where('type', $v))
 97:             // حدود الأيام بأيام العمل (business_timezone) لا UTC، والتخزين يظل UTC
 98:             ->when($filters['from_date'] ?? null, fn ($q, $v) => $q->where('created_at', '>=', Carbon::parse($v, config('app.business_timezone'))->startOfDay()->utc()))
 99:             ->when($filters['to_date'] ?? null, fn ($q, $v) => $q->where('created_at', '<', Carbon::parse($v, config('app.business_timezone'))->addDay()->startOfDay()->utc()))
100:             ->orderByDesc('id')
101:             // الدفتر append-only وسيكبر لملايين الصفوف: بلا COUNT(*) وبلا OFFSET —
102:             // ترقيم بالمؤشر على (branch_id, id DESC) يجعل الصفحات العميقة بنفس
103:             // تكلفة الأولى (M-7). المقايضة: لا قفز لرقم صفحة محدد.
104:             ->cursorPaginate($filters['per_page'] ?? 15);
105: 
106:         return StockMovementResource::collection($movements);
107:     }
108: 
109:     /** تسوية يدوية: كل العناصر في transaction واحدة عبر InventoryService فقط. */
110:     public function adjustments(StoreAdjustmentRequest $request): JsonResponse
111:     {
112:         $movements = $this->inventory->applyAdjustments($request->validated(), $request->user()->id, $this->requiredIdempotencyKey($request));
113: 
114:         return response()->json([
115:             'message' => 'تم تنفيذ التسوية بنجاح',
116:             'data' => StockMovementResource::collection((new EloquentCollection($movements))->load(['variant', 'branch', 'location'])),
117:         ], 201);
118:     }
119: }
````

````php
 12: use App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Admin\UpdateLocationRequest;
 13: use App\Http\Resources\Api\V1\Admin\LocationResource;
 14: use App\Models\Branch;

 16: use App\Models\StockLevel;
 17: use App\Services\BranchAccess;
 18: use App\Services\StaffAdministration;
 19: use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;

 26: 
 27: class LocationController extends Controller
 28: {
 29:     public function __construct(private readonly BranchAccess $branchAccess) {}
 30: 
 31:     public function index(Request $request, Branch $branch): AnonymousResourceCollection
 32:     {
 33:         // M4: موظف الفرع A لا يعطّل مواقع الفرع B (كان يعلّق تحويلاتها مع H3).
 34:         $this->branchAccess->assertBranch($request->user()->id, $branch->id);
 35:         $validated = $request->validate([
 36:             'per_page' => ['sometimes', 'integer', 'min:1', 'max:100'],
 37:         ]);
 38: 
 39:         $locations = $branch->locations()
 40:             ->orderBy('id')
 41:             ->paginate($validated['per_page'] ?? 15)
 42:             ->withQueryString();
 43:

 45:     }
 46: 
 47:     public function store(StoreLocationRequest $request, Branch $branch): JsonResponse
 48:     {
 49:         $this->branchAccess->assertBranch($request->user()->id, $branch->id);
 50:         // Creating a location inside an inactive branch is rejected.
 51:         abort_unless((bool) $branch->fresh()->is_active, 422, 'لا يمكن إنشاء موقع داخل فرع متوقف.');
 52:         try {
 53:             $location = DB::transaction(function () use ($request, $branch): Location {
 54:                 $created = $branch->locations()->create($request->validated());
 55:                 $created->refresh();
 56:                 // M5: تدقيق الإنشاء زي ما المساعد بيعمل — داخل المعاملة حتى لا
 57:                 // يُنشأ موقع بلا سجل تدقيق.
 58:                 StaffAdministration::audit($request->user('staff'), 'location.created', 'location', $created->getKey(),
 59:                     ['name', 'code', 'type'], [], ['name' => $created->name, 'code' => $created->code, 'type' => $created->type->value, 'branch' => $branch->name],
 60:                     via: ['channel' => 'rest']);
 61: 
 62:                 return $created;
 63:             });
 64:         } catch (UniqueConstraintViolationException) {
 65:             return response()->json(['message' => 'كود الموقع مستخدم بالفعل في هذا الفرع.'], 422);
 66:         }
 67: 
 68:         return LocationResource::make($location)->response()->setStatusCode(201);
 69:     }
 70: 
 71:     public function show(Request $request, Branch $branch, Location $location): LocationResource
 72:     {
 73:         $this->authorizeLocation((int) $request->user()->id, $branch, $location);
 74: 
 75:         return LocationResource::make($location);
 76:     }
 77: 
 78:     public function update(UpdateLocationRequest $request, Branch $branch, Location $location, SetLocationStatus $setStatus): LocationResource
 79:     {
 80:         $this->authorizeLocation((int) $request->user()->id, $branch, $location);
 81:         $validated = $request->validated();
 82:         if (array_key_exists('is_active', $validated) && count($validated) === 1) {
 83:             $updated = $setStatus($request->user('staff'), $location, (bool) $validated['is_active'], ['channel' => 'rest']);
 84: 
 85:             return LocationResource::make($updated);
 86:         }
 87:         // M5: قفل توافقي على الصف، ورفض تغيير النوع/التعطيل لموقع عليه
 88:         // أرصدة — تغيير المعنى من غير تحذير أو سجل تدقيق.
 89:         // M-1: سباق قيد فريد متزامن يُرجع 422 بدل 500.
 90:         try {
 91:             $updated = DB::transaction(function () use ($request, $location, $validated): Location {
 92:                 $locked = Location::query()->whereKey($location->getKey())->lockForUpdate()->firstOrFail();
 93:                 $before = ['name' => $locked->name, 'code' => $locked->code, 'type' => $locked->type->value, 'is_active' => (bool) $locked->is_active];
 94:                 $after = $before;
 95:                 foreach (['name' => null, 'code' => null, 'is_active' => null] as $field => $_) {
 96:                     if (array_key_exists($field, $validated)) {
 97:                         $after[$field] = $field === 'is_active' ? (bool) $validated[$field] : $validated[$field];
 98:                     }
 99:                 }
100:                 if (isset($validated['type'])) {
101:                     $after['type'] = $validated['type'] instanceof LocationType ? $validated['type']->value : (string) $validated['type'];
102:                     if ($after['type'] !== $before['type']) {
103:                         $hasBalances = StockLevel::query()->where('location_id', $locked->getKey())->hasNonZeroBalance()->exists();
104:                         abort_unless(! $hasBalances, 422, 'لا يمكن تغيير نوع الموقع وهو عليه أرصدة غير صفرية؛ صفّرها أولًا.');
105:                     }
106:                 }
107:                 if (array_key_exists('is_active', $validated) && ! (bool) $validated['is_active']) {
108:                     $hasBalances = StockLevel::query()->where('location_id', $locked->getKey())->hasNonZeroBalance()->exists();
109:                     abort_unless(! $hasBalances, 422, 'لا يمكن تعطيل الموقع وهو عليه أرصدة غير صفرية.');
110:                 }
111:                 if (array_key_exists('is_active', $validated) && (bool) $validated['is_active']
112:                     && ! (bool) Branch::query()->find($locked->branch_id)?->is_active) {
113:                     abort(422, 'لا يمكن تفعيل موقع داخل فرع متوقف.');
114:                 }
115:                 $locked->update($validated);
116:                 StaffAdministration::audit($request->user('staff'), 'location.updated', 'location', $locked->getKey(),
117:                     array_keys($validated), $before, $after, via: ['channel' => 'rest']);
118: 
119:                 return $locked;
120:             });
121:         } catch (UniqueConstraintViolationException) {
122:             abort(422, 'كود الموقع مستخدم بالفعل في هذا الفرع.');
123:         }
124: 
125:         return LocationResource::make($updated);
126:     }
127: 
128:     public function destroy(Request $request, Branch $branch, Location $location): JsonResponse|Response
129:     {
130:         $this->authorizeLocation((int) $request->user()->id, $branch, $location);
131: 
132:         try {
133:             $deleted = DB::transaction(function () use ($request, $branch, $location): bool {
134:                 // L-6: ترتيب القفل موحّد مع lockLevels (أرصدة أولًا ثم
135:                 // موقع بـ SHARE) — انظر DeleteBranch.
136:                 StockLevel::query()->where('location_id', $location->getKey())
137:                     ->orderBy('branch_id')
138:                     ->orderByRaw('location_id ASC NULLS FIRST')
139:                     ->orderBy('product_variant_id')
140:                     ->lockForUpdate()
141:                     ->get();
142:                 $lockedLocation = Location::query()
143:                     ->whereKey($location->getKey())
144:                     ->lockForUpdate()
145:                     ->firstOrFail();
146:                 $this->ensureLocationBelongsToBranch($branch, $lockedLocation);
147: 
148:                 // L3: ضمان الـ FK يكفي للدفتر — بلا مسح Schema في كل طلب.
149:                 if (DB::table('stock_movements')->where('location_id', $lockedLocation->getKey())->exists()) {
150:                     return false;
151:                 }
152: 
153:                 // L3: صفوف الرصيد الصفرية (أثر جانبي لـ lockLevels) تُنظَّف بدل
154:                 // منع الحذف الدائم؛ وغير الصفرية تُرفض برسالة مفهومة.
155:                 $hasBalances = StockLevel::query()->where('location_id', $lockedLocation->getKey())
156:                     ->hasNonZeroBalance()
157:                     ->exists();
158:                 if ($hasBalances) {
159:                     throw new BusinessException('لا يمكن حذف الموقع وفيه أرصدة (متاح/محجوز/تالف/في الطريق)؛ صفّرها أولًا.');
160:                 }
161:                 StockLevel::query()->where('location_id', $lockedLocation->getKey())->delete();
162: 
163:                 // M5: تدقيق حذف الموقع زي بقية عمليات الإدارة.
164:                 StaffAdministration::audit($request->user('staff'), 'location.deleted', 'location', $lockedLocation->getKey(),
165:                     ['name', 'code', 'type'],
166:                     ['name' => $lockedLocation->name, 'code' => $lockedLocation->code, 'type' => $lockedLocation->type->value], [],
167:                     via: ['channel' => 'rest']);
168: 
169:                 $lockedLocation->delete();
170: 
171:                 return true;
172:             });
173:         } catch (QueryException $exception) {
174:             if (! $this->isIntegrityConstraintViolation($exception)) {
175:                 throw $exception;
176:             }
177: 
178:             return $this->conflictResponse();
179:         }
180: 
181:         if (! $deleted) {
182:             return $this->conflictResponse();
183:         }
184: 
185:         return response()->noContent();
186:     }
187: 
188:     private function isIntegrityConstraintViolation(QueryException $exception): bool
189:     {
190:         $sqlState = (string) ($exception->errorInfo[0] ?? $exception->getCode());
191: 
192:         return in_array($sqlState, ['23000', '23503'], true);
193:     }
194: 
195:     private function conflictResponse(): JsonResponse
196:     {
197:         return response()->json([
198:             'message' => 'لا يمكن حذف الموقع لارتباطه بحركات مخزنية.',
199:         ], 409);
200:     }
201: 
202:     private function ensureLocationBelongsToBranch(Branch $branch, Location $location): void
203:     {
204:         abort_unless($location->branch_id === $branch->getKey(), 404);
205:     }
206: 
207:     private function authorizeLocation(int $userId, Branch $branch, Location $location): void
208:     {
209:         $this->branchAccess->assertBranch($userId, $branch->id);
210:         $this->ensureLocationBelongsToBranch($branch, $location);
211:     }
212: }
````

````php
21: class ProductionReceiptController extends Controller implements HasMiddleware
22: {

24:     {

26:             new Middleware('can:inventory.view', only: ['options', 'index']),

30:     public function __construct(
31:         private readonly BranchAccess $branchAccess,

35:     public function options(Request $request): JsonResponse
36:     {

45:                     ->orWhereHas('product', fn ($p) => $p->whereLike('name_ar', $pattern)->orWhereLike('name_en', $pattern)));
46:             })->orderBy('id')->limit(50)->get();
47: 
48:         return response()->json(['data' => [

50:                 'locations' => $b->locations->map(fn ($l) => ['id' => $l->id, 'name' => $l->name])]),
51:             'variants' => $variants->map(fn ($v) => ['id' => $v->id, 'label' => $v->product->name_ar.' / '.$v->sku]),
52:         ]]);

59:         $receipts = ProductionReceipt::query()->when($branch, fn ($q) => $q->where('branch_id', $branch))
60:             ->orderByDesc('id')->paginate($filters['per_page'] ?? 15);

66:                     return $item;

70: 
71:         return response()->json($receipts);
````

````php
 29:

 33:         $to = $validated['to'] ?? $businessNow->toDateString();
 34: 
 35:         if (Carbon::parse($from)->diffInDays(Carbon::parse($to)) > 365) {
 36:             throw new BusinessException('المدى الزمني للتقارير لا يتجاوز 366 يومًا شاملة البداية والنهاية.');

 38:
````

````php
17: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
18: use Illuminate\Http\Resources\Json\AnonymousResourceCollection;
19: use Illuminate\Routing\Controllers\HasMiddleware;
20: use Illuminate\Routing\Controllers\Middleware;
21: use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
22: 
23: class StocktakeController extends Controller implements HasMiddleware
24: {
25:     public function __construct(
26:         private readonly StocktakeService $stocktakes,
27:         private readonly BranchAccess $branchAccess,
28:     ) {}
29: 
30:     public static function middleware(): array
31:     {
32:         return [
33:             new Middleware('can:stocktakes.view', only: ['index', 'show']),
34:             new Middleware('can:stocktakes.create', only: ['store']),
35:             new Middleware('can:stocktakes.update', only: ['update', 'updateItems']),
36:             new Middleware('can:stocktakes.delete', only: ['destroy']),
37:             new Middleware('can:stocktakes.approve', only: ['approve']),
38:         ];
39:     }
40: 
41:     public function index(Request $request): AnonymousResourceCollection
42:     {
43:         $filters = $request->validate([
44:             'branch_id' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:1'],
45:             'status' => ['nullable', Rule::in(array_column(StocktakeStatus::cases(), 'value'))],
46:             'per_page' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:1', 'max:100'],
47:         ]);
48: 
49:         $filters['staff_branch_id'] = $this->branchAccess->restrictedBranch($request->user());
50: 
51:         return StocktakeResource::collection($this->stocktakes->paginate($filters));
52:     }
53: 
54:     public function store(StoreStocktakeRequest $request): JsonResponse
55:     {
56:         $stocktake = $this->stocktakes->create($request->validated(), $request->user()->id, $this->requiredIdempotencyKey($request));
57: 
58:         return StocktakeResource::make($stocktake)
59:             ->additional(['message' => 'تم إنشاء جلسة الجرد بنجاح'])
60:             ->response()
61:             ->setStatusCode(201);
62:     }
63: 
64:     public function show(Request $request, Stocktake $stocktake): StocktakeResource
65:     {
66:         $this->branchAccess->assertBranch($request->user()->id, $stocktake->branch_id);
67: 
68:         return StocktakeResource::make($this->stocktakes->find($stocktake->id));
69:     }
70: 
71:     public function update(UpdateStocktakeRequest $request, Stocktake $stocktake): StocktakeResource
72:     {
73:         return StocktakeResource::make($this->stocktakes->update($stocktake, $request->validated(), $request->user()->id));
74:     }
75: 
76:     /** تحديث جزئي للعناصر: upsert للمرسلة فقط دون حذف الغائبة (M-4). */
77:     public function updateItems(UpdateStocktakeItemsRequest $request, Stocktake $stocktake): StocktakeResource
78:     {
79:         return StocktakeResource::make($this->stocktakes->upsertSomeItems($stocktake, $request->validated()['items'], $request->user()->id));
80:     }
81: 
82:     public function destroy(Request $request, Stocktake $stocktake): JsonResponse
83:     {
84:         $this->stocktakes->delete($stocktake, $request->user()->id);
85: 
86:         return response()->json(['message' => 'تم حذف جلسة الجرد بنجاح']);
87:     }
88: 
89:     public function approve(Request $request, Stocktake $stocktake): StocktakeResource
90:     {
91:         $stocktake = $this->stocktakes->approve($stocktake, $request->user()->id);
92: 
93:         return StocktakeResource::make($stocktake)->additional(['message' => 'تم اعتماد الجرد وتسوية الفروق']);
94:     }
95: }
````

## File: backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/Pos/PosStockController.php
````php
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: declare(strict_types=1);
  4: 
  5: namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1\Pos;
  6: 
  7: use App\Enums\StocktakeStatus;
  8: use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
  9: use App\Http\Resources\Admin\StockLevelResource;
 10: use App\Models\ProductVariant;
 11: use App\Models\StockLevel;
 12: use App\Models\Stocktake;
 13: use App\Models\StockTransfer;
 14: use App\Models\User;
 15: use App\Services\BranchAccess;
 16: use App\Services\SearchTerm;
 17: use App\Services\StocktakeService;
 18: use App\Services\TransferService;
 19: use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
 20: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
 21: use Illuminate\Http\Resources\Json\AnonymousResourceCollection;
 22: use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
 23: 
 24: /**
 25:  * Handles POS terminal inventory queries, branch transfer requests, incoming receipts, and barcode stocktake scans.
 26:  */
 27: class PosStockController extends Controller
 28: {
 29:     public function __construct(
 30:         private readonly TransferService $transfers,
 31:         private readonly StocktakeService $stocktakes,
 32:     ) {}
 33: 
 34:     /**
 35:      * Lists current branch inventory stock levels with search and low-stock filters.
 36:      *
 37:      * @param Request $request Filter query request
 38:      * @return AnonymousResourceCollection Paginated stock level resources
 39:      */
 40:     public function index(Request $request): AnonymousResourceCollection
 41:     {
 42:         $filters = $request->validate([
 43:             'product_variant_id' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:1'],
 44:             'q' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:100'],
 45:             'low_stock' => ['nullable', 'boolean'],
 46:             'per_page' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:1', 'max:100'],
 47:         ]);
 48: 
 49:         /** @var User $user */
 50:         $user = $request->user('staff');
 51: 
 52:         $levels = StockLevel::query()
 53:             ->where('branch_id', $user->branch_id)
 54:             ->with(['variant.product', 'location'])
 55:             ->when($filters['product_variant_id'] ?? null, fn ($q, $v) => $q->where('product_variant_id', $v))
 56:             ->when($filters['q'] ?? null, function ($q, $v): void {
 57:                 // Escape LIKE wildcard characters to avoid malformed patterns and unintentional wildcards.
 58:                 $like = SearchTerm::pattern((string) $v);
 59:                 $q->whereHas('variant', fn ($vq) => $vq->where('sku', $v)
 60:                     ->orWhere('barcode', $v)
 61:                     ->orWhereHas('product', fn ($pq) => $pq
 62:                         ->where('name_ar', 'LIKE', $like)
 63:                         ->orWhere('name_en', 'LIKE', $like)));
 64:             })
 65:             ->when($filters['low_stock'] ?? null, fn ($q) => $q
 66:                 ->join('product_variants', 'product_variants.id', '=', 'stock_levels.product_variant_id')
 67:                 ->whereRaw('stock_levels.available <= COALESCE(NULLIF(stock_levels.reorder_level, 0), product_variants.reorder_level, 0)')
 68:                 ->whereRaw('COALESCE(NULLIF(stock_levels.reorder_level, 0), product_variants.reorder_level, 0) > 0')
 69:                 ->select('stock_levels.*')
 70:             )
 71:             ->orderBy('product_variant_id')
 72:             ->paginate($filters['per_page'] ?? 15);
 73: 
 74:         return StockLevelResource::collection($levels);
 75:     }
 76: 
 77:     /**
 78:      * Requests stock transfer from another active branch into the cashier's branch.
 79:      *
 80:      * @param Request $request Transfer request payload
 81:      * @return JsonResponse Created transfer response
 82:      */
 83:     public function requestTransfer(Request $request): JsonResponse
 84:     {
 85:         /** @var User $user */
 86:         $user = $request->user('staff');
 87:         abort_unless($user->can('transfers.create'), 403);
 88: 
 89:         $data = $request->validate([
 90:             'from_branch_id' => ['required', 'integer', 'min:1',
 91:                 Rule::exists('branches', 'id')->where('is_active', true),
 92:                 Rule::notIn([$user->branch_id]),
 93:             ],
 94:             'items' => ['required', 'array', 'min:1', 'max:100'],
 95:             'items.*.product_variant_id' => ['required', 'integer', 'min:1', 'distinct', Rule::exists('product_variants', 'id')],
 96:             'items.*.from_location_id' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:1',
 97:                 Rule::exists('locations', 'id')->where('branch_id', (int) $request->input('from_branch_id')),
 98:             ],
 99:             'items.*.to_location_id' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:1',
100:                 Rule::exists('locations', 'id')->where('branch_id', (int) $user->branch_id),
101:             ],
102:             'items.*.requested_qty' => ['required', 'numeric', 'decimal:0,4', 'gt:0', 'max:99999999.9999'],
103:             'notes' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:500'],
104:         ]);
105: 
106:         $data['to_branch_id'] = $user->branch_id;
107: 
108:         $transfer = $this->transfers->create($data, $user->id, $this->requiredIdempotencyKey($request));
109: 
110:         return response()->json([
111:             'message' => 'تم إرسال طلب التحويل بنجاح وهو في انتظار الاعتماد.',
112:             'transfer_number' => $transfer->transfer_number,
113:             'id' => $transfer->id,
114:         ], 201);
115:     }
116: 
117:     /**
118:      * Confirms receipt of an incoming transfer at the cashier's branch.
119:      *
120:      * @param Request $request Receipt request payload
121:      * @param StockTransfer $transfer Target transfer model
122:      * @return JsonResponse Receipt confirmation response
123:      */
124:     public function receiveTransfer(Request $request, StockTransfer $transfer): JsonResponse
125:     {
126:         /** @var User $user */
127:         $user = $request->user('staff');
128:         abort_unless($user->can('transfers.receive'), 403);
129: 
130:         if ((int) $transfer->to_branch_id !== (int) $user->branch_id) {
131:             return response()->json(['message' => 'هذه التحويلة ليست موجهة لفرعك.'], 403);
132:         }
133: 
134:         $data = $request->validate([
135:             'items' => ['required', 'array', 'min:1', 'max:500'],
136:             'items.*.id' => ['required', 'integer', 'min:1', 'distinct',
137:                 Rule::exists('stock_transfer_items', 'id')->where('stock_transfer_id', $transfer->id),
138:             ],
139:             'items.*.received_qty' => ['required', 'numeric', 'decimal:0,4', 'min:0', 'max:99999999.9999'],
140:         ]);
141: 
142:         $quantities = [];
143:         foreach ($data['items'] as $item) {
144:             $quantities[(int) $item['id']] = (float) $item['received_qty'];
145:         }
146: 
147:         $transfer = $this->transfers->receive($transfer, $quantities, $user->id);
148: 
149:         return response()->json([
150:             'message' => 'تم تأكيد استلام التحويلة بنجاح وتم رفع المخزون.',
151:             'id' => $transfer->id,
152:             'status' => $transfer->status->value,
153:         ]);
154:     }
155: 
156:     /**
157:      * Records barcode scan count against an open stocktake session.
158:      *
159:      * @param Request $request Scan request containing barcode and optional quantity
160:      * @param Stocktake $stocktake Target stocktake session
161:      * @return JsonResponse Scan registration response
162:      */
163:     public function scan(Request $request, Stocktake $stocktake): JsonResponse
164:     {
165:         /** @var User $user */
166:         $user = $request->user('staff');
167:         abort_unless($user->can('stocktakes.update'), 403);
168: 
169:         if ((int) $stocktake->branch_id !== (int) $user->branch_id) {
170:             return response()->json(['message' => 'جلسة الجرد لا تتبع فرعك.'], 403);
171:         }
172:         app(BranchAccess::class)->assertBranch($user->id, $stocktake->branch_id);
173: 
174:         if (! in_array($stocktake->status, [StocktakeStatus::Draft, StocktakeStatus::InProgress], true)) {
175:             return response()->json(['message' => 'جلسة الجرد ليست مفتوحة.'], 422);
176:         }
177: 
178:         $data = $request->validate([
179:             'barcode' => ['required', 'string', 'max:100'],
180:             'qty' => ['nullable', 'numeric', 'decimal:0,4', 'min:0.0001', 'max:99999'],
181:             'qty_words' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:50'],
182:         ]);
183: 
184:         // وضع العد الصوتي: الموظف يمسح الباركود ويقول الرقم ("اتنين وعشرين").
185:         // system_qty يفضل محجوبًا عن غير المصرح لهم بالاعتماد (نفس القاعدة أدناه).
186:         $qty = isset($data['qty']) ? (float) $data['qty'] : 1;
187:         if (! isset($data['qty']) && isset($data['qty_words'])) {
188:             $spoken = \App\Services\SpokenQuantity::parse($data['qty_words']);
189:             if ($spoken === null || $spoken < 1) {
190:                 return response()->json(['message' => 'العدد المنطوق مش واضح؛ قوله تاني أو اكتبه رقمًا.'], 422);
191:             }
192:             $qty = $spoken;
193:         }
194: 
195:         $variant = ProductVariant::query()
196:             ->where('barcode', $data['barcode'])
197:             ->where('is_active', true)
198:             ->first();
199: 
200:         if ($variant === null) {
201:             return response()->json([
202:                 'message' => 'لم يُعثر على صنف بهذا الباركود.',
203:                 'barcode' => $data['barcode'],
204:             ], 404);
205:         }
206: 
207:         $stocktake = $this->stocktakes->incrementItemCount($stocktake, $variant->id, $qty, $user->id);
208: 
209:         $item = $stocktake->items->firstWhere('product_variant_id', $variant->id);
210: 
211:         $response = [
212:             'message' => 'تم تسجيل المسح بنجاح.',
213:             'product_variant_id' => $variant->id,
214:             'sku' => $variant->sku,
215:             'counted_qty' => $item?->counted_qty,
216:         ];
217:         if ($user->can('stocktakes.approve')) {
218:             $response['system_qty'] = $item?->system_qty;
219:         }
220: 
221:         return response()->json($response);
222:     }
223: }
````

````php
 5: namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin\Inventory;
 6: 
 7: use App\Http\Requests\Admin\Concerns\BulkVariantExists;
 8: use App\Services\CostAccess;
 9: use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
10: use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
11: use Illuminate\Validation\Validator;
12: 
13: class StoreProductionReceiptRequest extends FormRequest
14: {
15:     use BulkVariantExists;
16: 
17:     public function withValidator(Validator $validator): void
18:     {
19:         $this->addBulkVariantExistsCheck($validator, activeOnly: true);
20:     }
21: 
22:     public function authorize(): bool
23:     {
24:         return $this->user()->can('inventory.adjust') && CostAccess::canView($this->user());
25:     }
26: 
27:     protected function prepareForValidation(): void
28:     {
29:         // L3: batch numbers are compared/unique-matched — trim whitespace.
30:         if (is_string($batch = $this->input('batch_number'))) {
31:             $this->merge(['batch_number' => mb_strtoupper(trim($batch))]);
32:         }
33:     }
34: 
35:     public function rules(): array
36:     {
37:         return [
38:             'batch_number' => ['required', 'string', 'max:100'],
39:             'branch_id' => ['required', 'integer', Rule::exists('branches', 'id')->where('is_active', true)],
40:             'location_id' => ['nullable', 'integer', Rule::exists('locations', 'id')->where('branch_id', (int) $this->input('branch_id'))->where('is_active', true)],
41:             'notes' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:1000'],
42:             'items' => ['required', 'array', 'min:1', 'max:50'],
43:             'items.*' => ['array:product_variant_id,quantity,unit_cost'],
44:             'items.*.product_variant_id' => ['required', 'integer', 'distinct'],
45:             'items.*.quantity' => ['required', 'integer', 'min:1', 'max:99999999'],
46:             'items.*.unit_cost' => ['required', 'numeric', 'decimal:0,4', 'min:0', 'max:99999999.9999'],
47:         ];
48:     }
````

## File: backend/app/Http/Requests/Admin/Transfer/TransferItemsQtyRequest.php
````php
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: declare(strict_types=1);
 4: 
 5: namespace App\Http\Requests\Admin\Transfer;
 6: 
 7: use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
 8: use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
 9: 
10: /**
11:  * طلبات مراحل التحويل (اعتماد/شحن/استلام): كميات اختيارية لكل عنصر،
12:  * وغياب عنصر يعني استخدام الكمية الافتراضية للمرحلة السابقة.
13:  */
14: class TransferItemsQtyRequest extends FormRequest
15: {
16:     public function authorize(): bool
17:     {
18:         return true;
19:     }
20: 
21:     /** حقل الكمية الخاص بالمرحلة الحالية — بيتحدد في الكلاس الفرعي. */
22:     protected string $qtyField = 'approved_qty';
23: 
24:     /**
25:      * @return array<string, mixed>
26:      */
27:     public function rules(): array
28:     {
29:         $transferId = $this->route('transfer')?->id;
30: 
31:         return [
32:             'expected_version' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:1'],
33:             'expected_updated_at' => ['nullable', 'date'],
34:             'items' => ['nullable', 'array', 'max:100'],
35:             'items.*.id' => [
36:                 'required', 'bail', 'integer', 'min:1', 'distinct',
37:                 Rule::exists('stock_transfer_items', 'id')->where('stock_transfer_id', $transferId),
38:             ],
39:             "items.*.{$this->qtyField}" => ['required', 'numeric', 'decimal:0,4', 'min:0', 'max:99999999.9999'],
40:         ];
41:     }
42: 
43:     /**
44:      * خريطة [معرّف العنصر => الكمية] جاهزة للخدمة.
45:      *
46:      * @return array<int, float>
47:      */
48:     public function quantitiesByItemId(): array
49:     {
50:         $map = [];
51: 
52:         foreach ($this->validated('items', []) ?? [] as $item) {
53:             $map[(int) $item['id']] = (float) $item[$this->qtyField];
54:         }
55: 
56:         return $map;
57:     }
58: 
59:     public function expectedVersion(): ?int
60:     {
61:         return $this->filled('expected_version') ? (int) $this->validated('expected_version') : null;
62:     }
63: 
64:     public function expectedUpdatedAt(): ?string
65:     {
66:         return $this->validated('expected_updated_at');
67:     }
68: }
````

## File: backend/app/Http/Requests/Api/V1/Admin/UpdateSettingsRequest.php
````php
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: declare(strict_types=1);
  4: 
  5: namespace App\Http\Requests\Api\V1\Admin;
  6: 
  7: use App\Services\Ai\ToolRegistry;
  8: use App\Services\BranchAccess;
  9: use Illuminate\Contracts\Validation\ValidationRule;
 10: use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;
 11: use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
 12: use Illuminate\Validation\Validator;
 13: 
 14: class UpdateSettingsRequest extends FormRequest
 15: {
 16:     public function authorize(BranchAccess $branchAccess): bool
 17:     {
 18:         if ($this->user('staff') === null) {
 19:             return false;
 20:         }
 21:         $branchAccess->assertCentralAccess($this->user('staff'));
 22:         foreach (array_keys($this->validationData()) as $key) {
 23:             if (str_starts_with($key, 'ai_')) {
 24:                 abort_unless($this->user('staff')->can('ai_agent.settings'), 403);
 25:             }
 26:         }
 27: 
 28:         return true;
 29:     }
 30: 
 31:     /** @return array<string, mixed> */
 32:     public function validationData(): array
 33:     {
 34:         return $this->isJson() ? $this->json()->all() : $this->request->all();
 35:     }
 36: 
 37:     /**
 38:      * @return array<string, array<mixed>|string|ValidationRule>
 39:      */
 40:     public function rules(): array
 41:     {
 42:         $rules = [
 43:             'company_name' => ['sometimes', 'nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
 44:             'company_email' => ['sometimes', 'nullable', 'string', 'email', 'max:255'],
 45:             'company_phone' => ['sometimes', 'nullable', 'string', 'max:50'],
 46:             'company_address' => ['sometimes', 'nullable', 'string', 'max:1000'],
 47:             'company_logo' => ['sometimes', 'nullable', 'string', 'url:https', 'max:2048'],
 48:             'commercial_register' => ['sometimes', 'nullable', 'string', 'max:100'],
 49: 
 50:             'tax_enabled' => ['sometimes', 'boolean'],
 51:             'tax_number' => ['sometimes', 'nullable', 'string', 'max:100'],
 52:             'default_tax_rate' => ['sometimes', 'required', 'numeric', 'between:0,100'],
 53:             'prices_include_tax' => ['sometimes', 'boolean'],
 54:             // 0 = الإرجاع متوقف، -1 = بلا حد زمني، قيمة موجبة = أيام من التسليم
 55:             'return_window_days' => ['sometimes', 'integer', 'min:-1', 'max:3650'],
 56:             'allow_self_approve_purchases' => ['sometimes', 'boolean'],
 57:             'ai_enabled' => ['sometimes', 'boolean'],
 58:             'ai_daily_token_budget_per_user' => ['sometimes', 'integer', 'min:0', 'max:10000000'],
 59:             'ai_disabled_tools' => ['sometimes', 'array'],
 60:             // L12: الأداة مقفولة مش تنسيق حر — الاسم لازم يكون في الـ registry
 61:             // فعلًا، وإلا الغلطة الإملائية تعدي إعدادًا ميؤثر بلا سؤال.
 62:             'ai_disabled_tools.*' => ['string', 'max:100', Rule::in(array_keys(app(ToolRegistry::class)->definitions()))],
 63:             'ai_action_ttl_minutes' => ['sometimes', 'integer', 'min:1', 'max:1440'],
 64:             'ai_retention_days' => ['sometimes', 'integer', 'min:1', 'max:3650'],
 65:             'ai_bulk_max_items' => ['sometimes', 'integer', 'min:1', 'max:100'],
 66:             'ai_max_tokens_per_cycle' => ['sometimes', 'integer', 'min:1000', 'max:10000000'],
 67:             'ai_tool_result_max_chars' => ['sometimes', 'integer', 'min:1024', 'max:200000'],
 68:             'ai_max_concurrent_sessions' => ['sometimes', 'integer', 'min:1', 'max:'.max(1, (int) config('services.gemini.max_concurrent_sessions_cap', 20))],
 69:             'ai_credit_limit_confirm_threshold' => ['sometimes', 'integer', 'min:0', 'max:9999999999'],
 70:             'ai_dealer_review_sla_hours' => ['sometimes', 'integer', 'min:1', 'max:720'],
 71:             'ai_customer_tools_enabled' => ['sometimes', 'boolean'],
 72:             'ai_document_analysis_enabled' => ['sometimes', 'boolean'],
 73:             'ai_catalog_tools_enabled' => ['sometimes', 'boolean'],
 74:             'ai_catalog_vision_enabled' => ['sometimes', 'boolean'],
 75:             'ai_catalog_bulk_price_max_items' => ['sometimes', 'integer', 'min:1', 'max:1000'],
 76:             'ai_catalog_copywriting_enabled' => ['sometimes', 'boolean'],
 77:             'ai_inventory_tools_enabled' => ['sometimes', 'boolean'],
 78:             'ai_inventory_vision_enabled' => ['sometimes', 'boolean'],
 79:             'ai_inventory_share_cost_with_model' => ['sometimes', 'boolean'],
 80:             'ai_inventory_high_risk_value' => ['sometimes', 'integer', 'min:0', 'max:9999999999'],
 81:             'ai_inventory_proactive_enabled' => ['sometimes', 'boolean'],
 82:             'ai_max_steps' => ['sometimes', 'integer', 'min:1', 'max:10'],
 83:         ];
 84: 
 85:         $sequenceTypes = [
 86:             'invoice',
 87:             'order',
 88:             'purchase_order',
 89:             'quotation',
 90:             'movement',
 91:             'transfer',
 92:             'stocktake',
 93:             'return',
 94:             'purchase_request',
 95:             'delivery',
 96:             'supplier_invoice',
 97:             'supplier_payment',
 98:             // H1: أنواع كان الوكيل يقدر يعدّلها من update_document_numbering
 99:             // والـ REST لأ — توحيد مصدر القواعد بين المسارين.
100:             'shift',
101:             'pos_invoice',
102:             'expense',
103:             'treasury_transfer',
104:             'payment_notice',
105:         ];
106:         foreach ($sequenceTypes as $type) {
107:             $rules["{$type}_prefix"] = ['sometimes', 'nullable', 'string', 'max:30'];
108:             $rules["{$type}_next_number"] = ['sometimes', 'integer', 'min:1', 'max:999999999'];
109:             $rules["{$type}_padding"] = ['sometimes', 'integer', 'min:1', 'max:20'];
110:         }
111: 
112:         $expectedRules = ['expected' => ['required', 'array']];
113:         foreach ($rules as $key => $keyRules) {
114:             $type = in_array('boolean', $keyRules, true) ? 'boolean'
115:                 : (in_array('integer', $keyRules, true) ? 'integer' : (in_array('numeric', $keyRules, true) ? 'numeric' : (in_array('array', $keyRules, true) ? 'array' : 'string')));
116:             $expectedRules['expected.'.$key] = ['sometimes', 'nullable', $type];
117:         }
118: 
119:         return $rules + $expectedRules;
120:     }
121: 
122:     public function withValidator(Validator $validator): void
123:     {
124:         $allowedKeys = array_values(array_filter(array_keys($this->rules()), fn ($key) => ! str_starts_with($key, 'expected.')));
125:         $body = $this->validationData();
126:         $unknownKeys = array_diff(array_keys($body), $allowedKeys, ['_method', '_token']);
127: 
128:         $validator->after(function (Validator $validator) use ($unknownKeys, $body): void {
129:             $changed = array_diff(array_keys($body), ['expected', '_method', '_token']);
130:             $expected = is_array($body['expected'] ?? null) ? $body['expected'] : [];
131:             foreach (array_diff($changed, array_keys($expected)) as $key) {
132:                 $validator->errors()->add('expected.'.$key, 'القيمة الأصلية مطلوبة لهذا الإعداد.');
133:             }
134:             foreach (array_diff(array_keys($expected), $changed) as $key) {
135:                 $validator->errors()->add('expected.'.$key, 'قيمة أصلية غير مرتبطة بإعداد معدل.');
136:             }
137:             foreach ($unknownKeys as $unknownKey) {
138:                 $validator->errors()->add($unknownKey, 'إعداد غير معروف.');
139:             }
140:         });
141:     }
142: }
````

````php
30:             ] : null),
31:             'status' => $this->status,
32:             'items_count' => $this->whenCounted('items'),
33:             'created_by' => $this->created_by,
34:             'creator_name' => $this->whenLoaded('creator', fn () => $this->creator?->name),
35:             'approved_by' => $this->approved_by,
36:             'approved_at' => $this->approved_at,

40:             'items' => $this->whenLoaded('items', function () use ($request) {

42:                     || $request->user()?->can('stocktakes.approve');
43: 
44:                 return $this->items->map(function ($item) use ($reveal) {
45:                     $row = [
46:                         'id' => $item->id,
47:                         'product_variant_id' => $item->product_variant_id,
48:                         'sku' => $item->relationLoaded('variant') ? $item->variant?->sku : null,
49:                     ];
50:                     if ($reveal) {
51:                         $row['system_qty'] = $item->system_qty;
52:                     }
53:                     $row['counted_qty'] = $item->counted_qty;
54:                     if ($reveal) {
55:                         $row['difference'] = $item->difference;
56:                     }
57: 
58:                     return $row;
59:                 })->all();
60:             }),
````

````php
15: /** تنبيه مديري المشتريات (purchases.view) ومديري الفرع بانخفاض المخزون. */
16: class SendLowStockAlert implements ShouldQueue
17: {
18:     public function handle(StockLowDetected $event): void
19:     {
20:         $recipients = StaffRecipients::withAnyPermission(['purchases.view'], [$event->branchId])
21:             ->merge(StaffRecipients::branchManagers($event->branchId))
22:             ->unique('id');
23: 
24:         if ($recipients->isEmpty()) {
25:             return;
26:         }
27: 
28:         $sku = ProductVariant::query()->whereKey($event->productVariantId)->value('sku');
29: 
30:         DB::transaction(fn () => Notification::sendNow($recipients, new LowStockAlertNotification(
31:             $event->productVariantId,
32:             $sku !== null ? (string) $sku : null,
33:             $event->branchId,
34:             $event->available,
35:             $event->reorderLevel,
36:         ), ['database']));
37:     }
38: }
````
