````php
 70:                     'branch_query' => ['type' => 'STRING'],
 71:                     'location_id' => ['type' => 'INTEGER'],
 72:                     'batch_number' => ['type' => 'STRING'],
 73:                     'notes' => ['type' => 'STRING'],
 74:                     'items' => ['type' => 'ARRAY', 'items' => [
 75:                         'type' => 'OBJECT',
 76:                         'required' => ['quantity', 'unit_cost'],
 77:                         'properties' => (object) [
 78:                             'product_variant_id' => ['type' => 'INTEGER'],
 79:                             'variant_id' => ['type' => 'INTEGER'],
 80:                             'sku' => ['type' => 'STRING'],
 81:                             'quantity' => ['type' => 'INTEGER'],
 82:                             'unit_cost' => ['type' => 'NUMBER'],
 83:                         ],
 84:                     ]],
 85:                 ],
 86:             ],
 87:         ];
 88:     }
 89: 
 90:     public function prepare(User $actor, array $args): ToolOutcome
 91:     {
 92:         // التكلفة مخفية: الأداة ترفض من الأول زي الـ endpoint نفسه.
 93:         if (! CostAccess::canView($actor)) {
 94:             return ToolOutcome::denied('استلام الإنتاج محتاج صلاحية رؤية التكلفة.', auditable: false);
 95:         }
 96:         $args = InventoryArgs::normalize($args);
 97:         $scope = InventoryArgs::scopeBranch($actor, $this->branches, $args);
 98:         if ($scope instanceof ToolOutcome) {
 99:             return $scope;
100:         }
101:         if ($scope['branch'] === null) {
102:             return ToolOutcome::denied('حدد الفرع بـ branch_id.', auditable: false);
103:         }
104:         $batch = mb_strtoupper(trim((string) ($args['batch_number'] ?? '')));
105:         if ($batch === '') {
106:             return ToolOutcome::denied('رقم الدفعة مطلوب.', auditable: false);
107:         }
108:         // رقم الدفعة مكرر: نتأكد قبل الاقتراح بدل المفاجأة بعد التأكيد.
109:         if (ProductionReceipt::whereRaw('LOWER(batch_number) = ?', [mb_strtolower($batch)])->exists()) {
110:             return ToolOutcome::denied('رقم الدفعة مسجل بالفعل؛ راجع سجل الاستلام.', auditable: false);
111:         }
112:         $rawItems = $args['items'] ?? null;
113:         if (! is_array($rawItems) || $rawItems === [] || count($rawItems) > 50) {
114:             return ToolOutcome::denied('حدد بندًا واحدًا على الأقل (بحد أقصى 50).', auditable: false);
115:         }
116: 
117:         // حل المتغيرات ودمج المكرر في سطر واحد.
118:         $grouped = [];
119:         foreach ($rawItems as $i => $raw) {
120:             if (! is_array($raw)) {
121:                 return ToolOutcome::denied('بند رقم '.($i + 1).' غير سليم.', auditable: false);
122:             }
123:             $cand = ['variant_id' => $raw['product_variant_id'] ?? $raw['variant_id'] ?? null, 'sku' => $raw['sku'] ?? null, 'query' => $raw['query'] ?? null];
124:             $resolved = InventoryArgs::resolveVariant($actor, $this->resolver, $cand);
125:             if ($resolved instanceof ToolOutcome) {
126:                 return $resolved;
127:             }
128:             $variant = $resolved['variant'];
129:             if (! $variant->is_active) {
130:                 return ToolOutcome::denied("المتغير {$variant->sku} معطّل.", auditable: false);
131:             }
132:             try {
133:                 DiscreteQuantity::assert($raw['quantity'] ?? null);
134:             } catch (BusinessException $e) {
135:                 return ToolOutcome::denied($e->getMessage(), auditable: false);
136:             }
137:             $unit = $raw['unit_cost'] ?? null;
138:             if (! is_numeric($unit) || (float) $unit < 0 || (float) $unit > 99999999.9999) {
139:                 return ToolOutcome::denied("تكلفة البند {$variant->sku} غير سليمة.", auditable: false);
140:             }
141:             $grouped[$variant->id]['variant'] = $variant;
142:             $grouped[$variant->id]['quantity'] = ($grouped[$variant->id]['quantity'] ?? 0) + (int) $raw['quantity'];
143:             // متوسط مرجح لو نفس المتغير اتكرر بتكلفة مختلفة.
144:             $prev = $grouped[$variant->id]['unit_cost'] ?? null;
145:             $grouped[$variant->id]['unit_cost'] = $prev === null || abs($prev - (float) $unit) < 1e-9
146:                 ? (float) $unit
147:                 : round(($prev * ($grouped[$variant->id]['quantity'] - (int) $raw['quantity']) + (float) $unit * (int) $raw['quantity']) / $grouped[$variant->id]['quantity'], 4);
148:         }
149: 
150:         $warnings = [];
151:         if (count($grouped) < count($rawItems)) {
152:             $warnings[] = 'بند مكرر اتدمج في سطر واحد قبل الاقتراح.';
153:         }
154: 
155:         $rows = [];
156:         $totalValue = 0.0;
157:         foreach ($grouped as $g) {
158:             /** @var ProductVariant $variant */
159:             $variant = $g['variant'];
160:             $qty = $g['quantity'];
161:             $unit = $g['unit_cost'];
162:             $totalValue += $qty * $unit;
163: 
164:             $onHand = (string) StockLevel::where('product_variant_id', $variant->id)->sum(DB::raw('on_hand + in_transit'));
165:             $onHand = bccomp($onHand, '0', 4) < 0 ? '0' : $onHand;
166:             $costStr = (string) $variant->cost_price;
167:             $total = bcadd(bcmul($onHand, $costStr, 8), bcmul((string) $qty, (string) $unit, 8), 8);
168:             $denominator = bcadd($onHand, (string) $qty, 4);
169:             $newAvg = bccomp($denominator, '0', 4) === 0 ? $costStr : bcadd(bcdiv($total, $denominator, 5), '0.00005', 4);
170:             $pct = $variant->cost_price > 0 ? round(((float) $newAvg - (float) $variant->cost_price) / (float) $variant->cost_price * 100, 1) : null;
171: 
172:             // تكلفة شاذة خارج ±30% من آخر تكلفة.
173:             $reference = $variant->last_cost_price ?? $variant->cost_price;
174:             if ($reference !== null && (float) $reference > 0) {
175:                 $drift = abs($unit - (float) $reference) / (float) $reference;
176:                 if ($drift > 0.3) {
177:                     $last = (float) $reference;
178:                     $warnings[] = "تكلفة الوحدة في الدفعة دي ({$unit}) بعيدة ".round($drift * 100, 1)."% عن آخر استلام ({$last}) للصنف {$variant->sku} — اتأكد من الأصفار.";
179:                 }
180:             } else {
181:                 $warnings[] = "مفيش تكلفة مرجعية للصنف {$variant->sku}.";
182:             }
183: 
184:             $rows[] = [
185:                 'variant_id' => $variant->id,
186:                 'sku' => $variant->sku,
187:                 'quantity' => $qty,
188:                 'unit_cost' => $unit,
189:                 'cost_before' => (float) $variant->cost_price,
190:                 'cost_after' => (float) $newAvg,
191:                 'change_pct' => $pct,
192:                 'on_hand_before' => (float) $onHand,
193:             ];
194:         }
195: 
196:         $threshold = (float) $this->settings->get('ai_inventory_high_risk_value', 50000);
197:         $highValue = $totalValue > $threshold;
198:         if ($highValue) {
199:             $warnings[] = "قيمة الدفعة {$totalValue} فوق العتبة {$threshold} — التأكيد بكتابة رقم الدفعة.";
200:         }
201: 
202:         $expected = [];
203:         foreach ($grouped as $id => $g) {
204:             $expected['variant:'.$id] = (int) $g['variant']->lock_version;
205:         }
206: 
207:         // قبل/بعد نسبية للنموذج، والأرقام الفعلية في كارت العرض فقط.
208:         $relative = array_map(fn ($r) => $r['sku'].': '.$r['cost_before'].' ← '.$r['cost_after'].($r['change_pct'] !== null ? ' ('.($r['change_pct'] >= 0 ? '+' : '').$r['change_pct'].'%)' : ''), $rows);
209: 
210:         return $this->proposals->make(
211:             $actor,
212:             $this->name(),
213:             [
214:                 'branch_id' => $scope['branch']->id,
215:                 'location_id' => $args['location_id'] ?? null,
216:                 'batch_number' => $batch,
217:                 'notes' => $args['notes'] ?? null,
218:                 'items' => array_map(fn ($r) => ['product_variant_id' => $r['variant_id'], 'quantity' => $r['quantity'], 'unit_cost' => $r['unit_cost']], $rows),
219:             ],
220:             risk: $highValue ? 'high' : 'medium',
221:             title: "استلام دفعة إنتاج {$batch}",
222:             before: ['batches' => [], 'note' => 'لا يوجد استلام بعد'],
223:             after: ['batches' => [$batch], 'changes' => $relative],
224:             warnings: $warnings,
225:             expectedVersions: $expected,
226:             typedConfirmation: $batch,
227:             typedConfirmationHint: 'رقم الدفعة',
228:             extraPreview: ['block_type' => 'cost_impact', 'rows' => $rows, 'batch_number' => $batch, 'total_value' => $totalValue],
229:         );
230:     }
231: 
232:     public function lockTargets(AiPendingAction $action): void
233:     {
234:         $ids = array_column($action->args['items'] ?? [], 'product_variant_id');
235:         sort($ids);
236:         ProductVariant::whereIn('id', array_unique($ids))->orderBy('id')->lockForUpdate()->get();
237:         Branch::whereKey((int) $action->args['branch_id'])->sharedLock()->first();
238:     }
239: 
240:     public function execute(User $actor, AiPendingAction $action): ToolOutcome
241:     {
242:         $a = $action->args;
243:         foreach ($a['items'] as $item) {
244:             $variant = ProductVariant::find((int) $item['product_variant_id']);
245:             if (! $variant) {
246:                 throw new BusinessException('أحد أصناف الدفعة لم يعد متاحًا.', [], 409);
247:             }
248:             if ((int) $variant->lock_version !== (int) ($action->expected_versions['variant:'.$variant->id] ?? -1)) {
249:                 throw new BusinessException('حد عدّل بيانات صنف بعد الاقتراح. اطلب اقتراحًا جديدًا.', [], 409);
250:             }
251:         }
252:         if (ProductionReceipt::whereRaw('LOWER(batch_number) = ?', [mb_strtolower((string) $a['batch_number'])])->exists()) {
253:             throw new BusinessException('رقم الدفعة اتسجل في أثناء المراجعة؛ راجع سجل الاستلام.', [], 409);
254:         }
255: 
256:         $receipt = $this->receipts->receive([
257:             'branch_id' => (int) $a['branch_id'],
258:             'location_id' => $a['location_id'] ?? null,
259:             'batch_number' => (string) $a['batch_number'],
260:             'notes' => $a['notes'] ?? null,
261:             'items' => array_map(fn ($i) => [
262:                 'product_variant_id' => (int) $i['product_variant_id'],
263:                 'quantity' => (int) $i['quantity'],
264:                 'unit_cost' => $i['unit_cost'],
265:             ], $a['items']),
266:         ], $actor->id, 'ai-'.$action->id);
267: 
268:         return ToolOutcome::result(true, "تم استلام دفعة الإنتاج {$receipt->batch_number}.", [
269:             'receipt_id' => $receipt->id,
270:             'batch_number' => $receipt->batch_number,
271:             'deep_link' => '#/production/'.$receipt->id,
272:         ]);
273:     }
274: }
````

````php
 43:             'description' => 'شحن تحويل معتمد. المشحون لا يُلغى.',
 44:             'parameters' => [
 45:                 'type' => 'OBJECT',
 46:                 'properties' => (object) [
 47:                     'transfer_id' => ['type' => 'INTEGER'],
 48:                     'transfer_number' => ['type' => 'STRING'],
 49:                     'query' => ['type' => 'STRING'],
 50:                     'items' => ['type' => 'ARRAY', 'items' => [
 51:                         'type' => 'OBJECT',
 52:                         'required' => ['item_id', 'quantity'],
 53:                         'properties' => (object) [
 54:                             'item_id' => ['type' => 'INTEGER'],
 55:                             'quantity' => ['type' => 'NUMBER'],
 56:                         ],
 57:                     ]],
 58:                 ],
 59:             ],
 60:         ];
 61:     }
 62: 
 63:     public function prepare(User $actor, array $args): ToolOutcome
 64:     {
 65:         $args = InventoryArgs::normalize($args);
 66:         $resolved = $this->resolveTransfer($actor, $args);
 67:         if ($resolved instanceof ToolOutcome) {
 68:             return $resolved;
 69:         }
 70:         $transfer = $resolved['transfer'];
 71:         if ($transfer->status !== TransferStatus::Approved) {
 72:             return ToolOutcome::denied('الشحن من المعتمد بس (الحالة: '.$transfer->status->value.').', auditable: false);
 73:         }
 74:         $payload = $this->itemsPayload($transfer, $args['items'] ?? null, 'approved_qty');
 75:         if ($payload instanceof ToolOutcome) {
 76:             return $payload;
 77:         }
 78:         if (array_sum($payload) <= 0) {
 79:             return ToolOutcome::denied('اشحن كمية موجبة على الأقل، أو ألغِ التحويل لفك الحجز.', auditable: false);
 80:         }
 81: 
 82:         return $this->proposals->make(
 83:             $actor,
 84:             $this->name(),
 85:             ['transfer_id' => $transfer->id, 'items' => array_map(fn ($id, $q) => ['item_id' => $id, 'quantity' => $q], array_keys($payload), $payload)],
 86:             risk: $this->risk(),
 87:             title: "شحن {$transfer->transfer_number}",
 88:             before: ['status' => TransferStatus::Approved->value] + $this->itemsView($transfer),
 89:             after: ['status' => TransferStatus::Shipped->value, 'shipped' => $payload],
 90:             warnings: ['الشحنة اللي اتشحنت مابتتلغيش.'],
 91:             expectedVersions: [$this->versionKey($transfer) => $transfer->version],
 92:             extraPreview: ['block_type' => 'transfer_timeline'] + $this->timeline($transfer),
 93:         );
 94:     }
 95: 
 96:     public function execute(User $actor, AiPendingAction $action): ToolOutcome
 97:     {
 98:         $a = $action->args;
 99:         $transfer = StockTransfer::findOrFail((int) $a['transfer_id']);
100:         $payload = [];
101:         foreach ($a['items'] as $item) {
102:             $payload[(int) $item['item_id']] = $item['quantity'];
103:         }
104:         $updated = $this->transfers->ship($transfer, $payload, $actor->id, null, (int) ($action->expected_versions[$this->versionKey($transfer)] ?? 0));
105: 
106:         return ToolOutcome::result(true, "اتشحن {$updated->transfer_number}.", [
107:             'transfer_id' => $updated->id,
108:             'transfer_number' => $updated->transfer_number,
109:             'deep_link' => '#/transfers/'.$updated->id,
110:         ]);
111:     }
112: }
````

````php
  1: <?php
  2:
````

````php
  4: 
  5: namespace App\Services\Ai\Inventory\Tools;
  6: 
  7: use App\Enums\StockMovementType;
  8: use App\Enums\StocktakeStatus;
  9: use App\Models\StockMovement;
 10: use App\Models\Stocktake;
 11: use App\Models\User;
 12: use App\Services\Ai\AgentTool;
 13: use App\Services\Ai\Inventory\InventoryArgs;
 14: use App\Services\Ai\Inventory\InventoryPresenter;
 15: use App\Services\Ai\ToolKind;
 16: use App\Services\Ai\ToolOutcome;
 17: 
 18: final class StocktakeVarianceTool extends StocktakeToolBase implements AgentTool
 19: {
 20:     public function __construct(
 21:         \App\Services\Ai\EntityResolver $resolver,
 22:         \App\Services\BranchAccess $branches,
 23:         \App\Services\StocktakeService $stocktakes,
 24:         \App\Services\Ai\ProposalBuilder $proposals,
 25:         private InventoryPresenter $presenter,
 26:     ) {
 27:         parent::__construct($resolver, $branches, $stocktakes, $proposals);
 28:     }
 29: 
 30:     public function name(): string
 31:     {
 32:         return 'stocktake_variance';
 33:     }
 34: 
 35:     public function kind(): ToolKind
 36:     {
 37:         return ToolKind::Read;
 38:     }
 39: 
 40:     public function risk(): string
 41:     {
 42:         return 'low';
 43:     }
 44: 
 45:     public function permissions(): array
 46:     {
 47:         return ['stocktakes.view'];
 48:     }
 49: 
 50:     public function declaration(): array
 51:     {
 52:         return [
 53:             'name' => $this->name(),
 54:             'description' => 'فروقات الجرد قبل الاعتماد: أكبر 10 فروق بالقيمة، والفروق المشبوهة، والأصناف المتعدّة صفر مع بيع أمس.',
 55:             'parameters' => [
 56:                 'type' => 'OBJECT',
 57:                 'properties' => (object) [
 58:                     'stocktake_id' => ['type' => 'INTEGER'],
 59:                     'stocktake_number' => ['type' => 'STRING'],
 60:                     'query' => ['type' => 'STRING'],
 61:                 ],
 62:             ],
 63:         ];
 64:     }
 65: 
 66:     public function handle(User $actor, array $args): ToolOutcome
 67:     {
 68:         $args = InventoryArgs::normalize($args);
 69:         $resolved = $this->resolveStocktake($actor, $args);
 70:         if ($resolved instanceof ToolOutcome) {
 71:             return $resolved;
 72:         }
 73:         $stocktake = $this->stocktakes->find($resolved['stocktake']->id);
 74:         $stocktake->loadMissing(['items.variant']);
 75: 
 76:         $rows = [];
 77:         foreach ($stocktake->items as $item) {
 78:             $diff = $item->difference !== null ? (float) $item->difference : ($item->counted_qty !== null ? (float) $item->counted_qty - (float) $item->system_qty : null);
 79:             if ($diff === null || $diff == 0) {
 80:                 continue;
 81:             }
 82:             $cost = $item->variant?->cost_price !== null ? (float) $item->variant->cost_price : 0.0;
 83:             $rows[] = [
 84:                 'variant_id' => $item->product_variant_id,
 85:                 'sku' => $item->variant?->sku,
 86:                 'system_qty' => $item->system_qty !== null ? (float) $item->system_qty : null,
 87:                 'counted_qty' => $item->counted_qty !== null ? (float) $item->counted_qty : null,
 88:                 'difference' => $diff,
 89:                 'value_impact' => round(abs($diff) * $cost, 2),
 90:             ];
 91:         }
 92:         usort($rows, fn ($a, $b) => $b['value_impact'] <=> $a['value_impact']);
 93:         $top = array_slice($rows, 0, 10);
 94: 
 95:         // فروق مشبوهة: عجز نفس الصنف في آخر 3 جرود معتمدة بنفس الموقع.
 96:         $prior = Stocktake::query()->where('branch_id', $stocktake->branch_id)
 97:             ->where('location_id', $stocktake->location_id)
 98:             ->where('status', StocktakeStatus::Approved)
 99:             ->orderByDesc('id')->limit(3)->with('items')->get();
100:         $shortCounts = [];
101:         foreach ($prior as $s) {
102:             foreach ($s->items as $item) {
103:                 $d = $item->difference !== null ? (float) $item->difference : 0.0;
104:                 if ($d < 0) {
105:                     $shortCounts[$item->product_variant_id] = ($shortCounts[$item->product_variant_id] ?? 0) + 1;
106:                 }
107:             }
108:         }
109:         $suspicious = [];
110:         foreach ($rows as $r) {
111:             if ($r['difference'] < 0 && ($shortCounts[$r['variant_id']] ?? 0) >= 2) {
112:                 $suspicious[] = ['variant_id' => $r['variant_id'], 'sku' => $r['sku'], 'prior_shortages' => $shortCounts[$r['variant_id']]];
113:             }
114:         }
115: 
116:         // اتعد صفر وليه بيع امبارح → احتمال خطأ عد.
117:         $zeroSuspicious = [];
118:         $zeroIds = array_values(array_filter(array_map(fn ($r) => $r['counted_qty'] === 0.0 ? $r['variant_id'] : null, $rows)));
119:         if ($zeroIds !== []) {
120:             $soldYesterday = StockMovement::query()->where('branch_id', $stocktake->branch_id)
121:                 ->whereIn('product_variant_id', $zeroIds)
122:                 ->where('type', StockMovementType::Sale)
123:                 ->whereDate('created_at', today()->subDay())
124:                 ->distinct()->pluck('product_variant_id')->all();
125:             foreach ($rows as $r) {
126:                 if ($r['counted_qty'] === 0.0 && in_array($r['variant_id'], $soldYesterday, true)) {
127:                     $zeroSuspicious[] = ['variant_id' => $r['variant_id'], 'sku' => $r['sku']];
128:                 }
129:             }
130:         }
131: 
132:         $table = array_map(fn ($r) => [
133:             $r['sku'] ?? (string) $r['variant_id'],
134:             $r['system_qty'] !== null ? (string) $r['system_qty'] : '—',
135:             $r['counted_qty'] !== null ? (string) $r['counted_qty'] : '—',
136:             (string) $r['difference'],
137:         ], $top);
138: 
139:         return $this->presenter->present($actor, [
140:             'stocktake' => ['id' => $stocktake->id, 'stocktake_number' => $stocktake->stocktake_number],
141:             'top_by_value' => $top,
142:             'suspicious_repeat_shortage' => $suspicious,
143:             'zero_with_yesterday_sale' => $zeroSuspicious,
144:             'deep_link' => '#/stocktakes/'.$stocktake->id,
145:         ], ['type' => 'table', 'columns' => ['الصنف', 'النظام', 'العد', 'الفرق'], 'rows' => $table]);
146:     }
147: }
````

## File: backend/app/Services/Ai/Inventory/Tools/TransferToolBase.php
````php
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: declare(strict_types=1);
  4: 
  5: namespace App\Services\Ai\Inventory\Tools;
  6: 
  7: use App\Exceptions\BusinessException;
  8: use App\Models\StockTransfer;
  9: use App\Models\User;
 10: use App\Services\Ai\EntityResolver;
 11: use App\Services\Ai\Inventory\InventoryArgs;
 12: use App\Services\Ai\ProposalBuilder;
 13: use App\Services\Ai\Contracts\LocksTargets;
 14: use App\Services\Ai\ToolOutcome;
 15: use App\Services\BranchAccess;
 16: use App\Services\DiscreteQuantity;
 17: use App\Services\TransferService;
 18: 
 19: abstract class TransferToolBase implements LocksTargets
 20: {
 21:     public function __construct(
 22:         protected EntityResolver $resolver,
 23:         protected BranchAccess $branches,
 24:         protected TransferService $transfers,
 25:         protected ProposalBuilder $proposals,
 26:     ) {}
 27: 
 28:     /**
 29:      * @param  array<string,mixed>  $args
 30:      * @return array{transfer: StockTransfer}|ToolOutcome
 31:      */
 32:     protected function resolveTransfer(User $actor, array $args): array|ToolOutcome
 33:     {
 34:         $transfer = null;
 35:         if (! empty($args['transfer_id'])) {
 36:             $transfer = StockTransfer::find((int) $args['transfer_id']);
 37:         } elseif (! empty($args['transfer_number'])) {
 38:             $transfer = StockTransfer::whereRaw('LOWER(transfer_number) = LOWER(?)', [trim((string) $args['transfer_number'])])->first();
 39:         } else {
 40:             $options = $this->resolver->transfers($actor, (string) ($args['query'] ?? ''));
 41:             if (count($options) !== 1) {
 42:                 return ToolOutcome::denied('حدد التحويل برقمه. استخدم find_entities ثم ask_user_to_choose.', auditable: false);
 43:             }
 44:             $transfer = StockTransfer::find($options[0]['id']);
 45:         }
 46:         if (! $transfer) {
 47:             return ToolOutcome::denied('التحويل مش موجود.', auditable: false);
 48:         }
 49:         try {
 50:             $restricted = $this->branches->restrictedBranch($actor);
 51:         } catch (\Throwable) {
 52:             return ToolOutcome::denied('النطاق غير مسموح.', auditable: false);
 53:         }
 54:         if ($restricted !== null && (int) $transfer->from_branch_id !== $restricted && (int) $transfer->to_branch_id !== $restricted) {
 55:             return ToolOutcome::denied('التحويل خارج نطاق فرعك.', auditable: false);
 56:         }
 57: 
 58:         return ['transfer' => $transfer->loadMissing(['items.variant', 'fromBranch', 'toBranch'])];
 59:     }
 60: 
 61:     /**
 62:      * @param  list<array{item_id?:int,quantity?:mixed}>  $rawItems
 63:      * @return array<int,float>|ToolOutcome  item_id => quantity
 64:      */
 65:     protected function itemsPayload(StockTransfer $transfer, ?array $rawItems, string $capField): array|ToolOutcome
 66:     {
 67:         $byId = $transfer->items->keyBy('id');
 68:         if ($rawItems === null) {
 69:             $out = [];
 70:             foreach ($byId as $id => $item) {
 71:                 $out[$id] = (float) $item->{$capField};
 72:             }
 73: 
 74:             return $out;
 75:         }
 76:         if ($rawItems === [] || count($rawItems) > 200) {
 77:             return ToolOutcome::denied('حدد بندًا واحدًا على الأقل.', auditable: false);
 78:         }
 79:         $out = [];
 80:         foreach ($rawItems as $raw) {
 81:             $id = (int) ($raw['item_id'] ?? 0);
 82:             $item = $byId->get($id);
 83:             if (! $item) {
 84:                 return ToolOutcome::denied("البند {$id} مش تابع للتحويل ده.", auditable: false);
 85:             }
 86:             try {
 87:                 DiscreteQuantity::assert($raw['quantity'] ?? null, allowZero: true);
 88:             } catch (BusinessException $e) {
 89:                 return ToolOutcome::denied($e->getMessage(), auditable: false);
 90:             }
 91:             $qty = (float) $raw['quantity'];
 92:             $cap = (float) $item->{$capField};
 93:             if ($qty < 0 || $qty > $cap) {
 94:                 return ToolOutcome::denied("كمية البند {$id} لازم تكون بين صفر و{$cap}.", auditable: false);
 95:             }
 96:             $out[$id] = $qty;
 97:         }
 98: 
 99:         return $out;
100:     }
101: 
102:     /**
103:      * @param  list<array{variant_id?:int,sku?:string,query?:string,quantity?:mixed,from_location_id?:int,to_location_id?:int}>  $rawItems
104:      * @return list<array{product_variant_id:int,quantity:float,from_location_id:?int,to_location_id:?int}>|ToolOutcome
105:      */
106:     protected function draftItems(User $actor, ?array $rawItems): array|ToolOutcome
107:     {
108:         if (! is_array($rawItems) || $rawItems === [] || count($rawItems) > 100) {
109:             return ToolOutcome::denied('حدد بندًا واحدًا على الأقل (بحد أقصى 100).', auditable: false);
110:         }
111:         $out = [];
112:         $seen = [];
113:         foreach ($rawItems as $i => $raw) {
114:             if (! is_array($raw)) {
115:                 return ToolOutcome::denied('بند رقم '.($i + 1).' غير سليم.', auditable: false);
116:             }
117:             $resolved = InventoryArgs::resolveVariant($actor, $this->resolver, [
118:                 'variant_id' => $raw['product_variant_id'] ?? $raw['variant_id'] ?? null,
119:                 'sku' => $raw['sku'] ?? null,
120:                 'query' => $raw['query'] ?? null,
121:             ]);
122:             if ($resolved instanceof ToolOutcome) {
123:                 return $resolved;
124:             }
125:             try {
126:                 DiscreteQuantity::assert($raw['quantity'] ?? null);
127:             } catch (BusinessException $e) {
128:                 return ToolOutcome::denied($e->getMessage(), auditable: false);
129:             }
130:             $item = [
131:                 'product_variant_id' => $resolved['variant']->id,
132:                 'quantity' => (float) $raw['quantity'],
133:                 'from_location_id' => isset($raw['from_location_id']) ? (int) $raw['from_location_id'] : null,
134:                 'to_location_id' => isset($raw['to_location_id']) ? (int) $raw['to_location_id'] : null,
135:             ];
136:             $dup = $item['product_variant_id'].':'.($item['from_location_id'] ?? 0).':'.($item['to_location_id'] ?? 0);
137:             if (isset($seen[$dup])) {
138:                 return ToolOutcome::denied('بند مكرر في نفس التحويل.', auditable: false);
139:             }
140:             $seen[$dup] = true;
141:             $out[] = $item;
142:         }
143: 
144:         return $out;
145:     }
146: 
147:     protected function versionKey(StockTransfer $transfer): string
148:     {
149:         return 'transfer:'.$transfer->id;
150:     }
151: 
152:     /** @return array{stages:list<array<string,mixed>>} */
153:     protected function timeline(StockTransfer $transfer): array
154:     {
155:         $rank = ['draft' => 0, 'approved' => 1, 'shipped' => 2, 'received' => 3, 'cancelled' => -1];
156:         $stage = $rank[$transfer->status->value] ?? 0;
157: 
158:         return ['stages' => [
159:             ['stage' => 'draft', 'done' => true, 'at' => $transfer->created_at?->toIso8601String()],
160:             ['stage' => 'approved', 'done' => $stage >= 1, 'at' => null],
161:             ['stage' => 'shipped', 'done' => $stage >= 2, 'at' => $transfer->shipped_at?->toIso8601String()],
162:             ['stage' => 'received', 'done' => $stage >= 3, 'at' => $transfer->received_at?->toIso8601String()],
163:         ]];
164:     }
165: 
166:     /** @return array{items:list<array<string,mixed>>} */
167:     protected function itemsView(StockTransfer $transfer): array
168:     {
169:         return ['items' => $transfer->items->map(fn ($i) => [
170:             'item_id' => $i->id,
171:             'variant_id' => $i->product_variant_id,
172:             'sku' => $i->variant?->sku,
173:             'requested_qty' => (float) $i->requested_qty,
174:             'approved_qty' => $i->approved_qty !== null ? (float) $i->approved_qty : null,
175:             'shipped_qty' => $i->shipped_qty !== null ? (float) $i->shipped_qty : null,
176:             'received_qty' => $i->received_qty !== null ? (float) $i->received_qty : null,
177:         ])->values()->all()];
178:     }
179: 
180:     public function lockTargets(\App\Models\AiPendingAction $action): void
181:     {
182:         StockTransfer::query()->whereKey((int) ($action->args['transfer_id'] ?? 0))->lockForUpdate()->first();
183:     }
184: }
````

## File: backend/app/Services/Ai/Inventory/Tools/WhatIfProductionCostTool.php
````php
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: declare(strict_types=1);
  4: 
  5: namespace App\Services\Ai\Inventory\Tools;
  6: 
  7: use App\Models\ProductVariant;

 16: use App\Services\CostAccess;
 17: use App\Services\DiscreteQuantity;
 18: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
 19: 
 20: final class WhatIfProductionCostTool implements AgentTool
 21: {
 22:     public function __construct(
 23:         private EntityResolver $resolver,
 24:     ) {}
 25: 
 26:     public function name(): string
 27:     {
 28:         return 'what_if_production_cost';
 29:     }
 30: 
 31:     public function kind(): ToolKind
 32:     {
 33:         return ToolKind::Read;
 34:     }
 35: 
 36:     public function risk(): string
 37:     {
 38:         return 'low';
 39:     }
 40: 
 41:     public function permissions(): array
 42:     {
 43:         return ['inventory.view'];
 44:     }
 45: 
 46:     public function declaration(): array
 47:     {
 48:         return [
 49:             'name' => $this->name(),
 50:             'description' => 'يحسب متوسط التكلفة المرجح لو استلمت كمية بسعر معين — من غير ما يكتب حاجة.',
 51:             'parameters' => [
 52:                 'type' => 'OBJECT',
 53:                 'required' => ['quantity', 'unit_cost'],
 54:                 'properties' => (object) [
 55:                     'variant_id' => ['type' => 'INTEGER'],
 56:                     'sku' => ['type' => 'STRING'],
 57:                     'barcode' => ['type' => 'STRING'],
 58:                     'query' => ['type' => 'STRING'],
 59:                     'quantity' => ['type' => 'INTEGER'],
 60:                     'unit_cost' => ['type' => 'NUMBER'],
 61:                 ],
 62:             ],
 63:         ];
 64:     }
 65: 
 66:     public function handle(User $actor, array $args): ToolOutcome
 67:     {
 68:         // سؤال مباشر عن التكلفة + رقم جاي من نتيجة أداة = مسموح يظهر في الرد.
 69:         if (! CostAccess::canView($actor)) {
 70:             return ToolOutcome::denied('السؤال عن التكلفة محتاج صلاحية رؤية التكلفة.', auditable: false);
 71:         }
 72:         $args = InventoryArgs::normalize($args);
 73:         $resolved = InventoryArgs::resolveVariant($actor, $this->resolver, $args);
 74:         if ($resolved instanceof ToolOutcome) {
 75:             return $resolved;
 76:         }
 77:         try {
 78:             DiscreteQuantity::assert($args['quantity'] ?? null);
 79:         } catch (\App\Exceptions\BusinessException $e) {
 80:             return ToolOutcome::denied($e->getMessage(), auditable: false);
 81:         }
 82:         $unit = $args['unit_cost'] ?? null;
 83:         if (! is_numeric($unit) || (float) $unit < 0) {
 84:             return ToolOutcome::denied('تكلفة الوحدة غير سليمة.', auditable: false);
 85:         }
 86:         $variant = ProductVariant::find($resolved['variant']->id);
 87:         $qty = (int) $args['quantity'];
 88: 
 89:         $onHand = (string) StockLevel::where('product_variant_id', $variant->id)->sum(DB::raw('on_hand + in_transit'));
 90:         $onHand = bccomp($onHand, '0', 4) < 0 ? '0' : $onHand;
 91:         $costStr = (string) $variant->cost_price;
 92:         $total = bcadd(bcmul($onHand, $costStr, 8), bcmul((string) $qty, (string) $unit, 8), 8);
 93:         $denominator = bcadd($onHand, (string) $qty, 4);
 94:         $newAvg = bccomp($denominator, '0', 4) === 0 ? $costStr : bcadd(bcdiv($total, $denominator, 5), '0.00005', 4);
 95:         $pct = $variant->cost_price > 0 ? round(((float) $newAvg - (float) $variant->cost_price) / (float) $variant->cost_price * 100, 1) : null;
 96: 
 97:         return ToolOutcome::data([
 98:             'variant' => ['id' => $variant->id, 'sku' => $variant->sku],
 99:             'quantity' => $qty,
100:             'unit_cost' => (float) $unit,
101:             'cost_before' => (float) $variant->cost_price,
102:             'cost_after' => (float) $newAvg,
103:             'change_pct' => $pct,
104:             'on_hand_before' => (float) $onHand,
105:         ], ['type' => 'cost_impact', 'rows' => [[
106:             'sku' => $variant->sku,
107:             'quantity' => $qty,
108:             'unit_cost' => (float) $unit,
109:             'cost_before' => (float) $variant->cost_price,
110:             'cost_after' => (float) $newAvg,
111:             'change_pct' => $pct,
112:         ]]]);
113:     }
114: }
````

````php
 56:                     'sku' => ['type' => 'STRING'],
 57:                     'barcode' => ['type' => 'STRING'],
 58:                     'query' => ['type' => 'STRING'],
 59:                     'quantity' => ['type' => 'INTEGER'],

 67:     public function handle(User $actor, array $args): ToolOutcome

 70:         $resolved = InventoryArgs::resolveVariant($actor, $this->resolver, $args);
 71:         if ($resolved instanceof ToolOutcome) {
 72:             return $resolved;

 74:         try {
 75:             DiscreteQuantity::assert($args['quantity'] ?? null);

 77:             return ToolOutcome::denied($e->getMessage(), auditable: false);
 78:         }
 79:         $variant = $resolved['variant'];
 80:         $qty = (float) $args['quantity'];
 81:         $from = (int) ($args['from_branch_id'] ?? 0);
````

## File: backend/app/Services/Ai/Inventory/InventoryArgs.php
````php
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: declare(strict_types=1);
  4: 
  5: namespace App\Services\Ai\Inventory;
  6: 
  7: use App\Models\Branch;
  8: use App\Models\ProductVariant;

 12: use App\Services\BranchAccess;
 13: 
 14: final class InventoryArgs
 15: {
 16:     /**
 17:      * @param  array<string,mixed>  $args
 18:      * @return array<string,mixed>
 19:      */
 20:     public static function normalize(array $args): array
 21:     {
 22:         foreach ($args as $key => $value) {
 23:             if (is_string($value)) {
 24:                 $converted = EntityResolver::normalizeDigits($value);
 25:                 if (in_array($key, ['variant_id', 'product_id', 'branch_id', 'location_id', 'user_id', 'transfer_id', 'stocktake_id', 'limit', 'cursor', 'dead_days', 'days'], true) && is_numeric($converted)) {
 26:                     $args[$key] = (int) $converted;
 27:                 } elseif (in_array($key, ['sku', 'barcode'], true)) {
 28:                     $args[$key] = strtoupper(trim($converted));
 29:                 } else {
 30:                     $args[$key] = $value;
 31:                 }
 32:             } elseif (is_array($value)) {
 33:                 $args[$key] = self::normalize($value);
 34:             }
 35:         }
 36: 
 37:         return $args;
 38:     }
 39: 
 40:     /**
 41:      * @param  array<string,mixed>  $args
 42:      * @return array{branch: Branch|null}|ToolOutcome
 43:      */
 44:     public static function scopeBranch(User $actor, BranchAccess $branches, array $args): array|ToolOutcome
 45:     {
 46:         try {
 47:             $restricted = $branches->restrictedBranch($actor);
 48:         } catch (\Throwable) {
 49:             return ToolOutcome::denied('النطاق غير مسموح.', auditable: false);
 50:         }
 51:         $requested = isset($args['branch_id']) ? (int) $args['branch_id'] : null;
 52:         if ($restricted !== null) {
 53:             if ($requested !== null && $requested !== $restricted) {
 54:                 return ToolOutcome::denied('الفرع خارج نطاقك.', auditable: false);
 55:             }
 56: 
 57:             return ['branch' => Branch::find($restricted)];
 58:         }
 59:         if ($requested !== null) {
 60:             $branch = Branch::find($requested);
 61:             if (! $branch) {
 62:                 return ToolOutcome::denied('الفرع مش موجود.', auditable: false);
 63:             }
 64: 
 65:             return ['branch' => $branch];
 66:         }
 67:         if (isset($args['branch_query']) && trim((string) $args['branch_query']) !== '') {
 68:             $found = app(EntityResolver::class)->exactBranch($actor, (string) $args['branch_query']);
 69:             if (! $found) {
 70:                 return ToolOutcome::denied('اسم الفرع مش واضح. استخدم find_entities ثم ask_user_to_choose.', auditable: false);
 71:             }
 72: 
 73:             return ['branch' => $found];
 74:         }
 75: 
 76:         return ['branch' => null];
 77:     }
 78: 
 79:     /**
 80:      * @param  array<string,mixed>  $args
 81:      * @return array{variant: ProductVariant}|ToolOutcome
 82:      */
 83:     public static function resolveVariant(User $actor, EntityResolver $resolver, array $args): array|ToolOutcome
 84:     {
 85:         if (! empty($args['variant_id'])) {
 86:             $variant = ProductVariant::with('product:id,name_ar,code')->find((int) $args['variant_id']);
 87:             if (! $variant) {
 88:                 return ToolOutcome::denied('المتغير مش موجود.', auditable: false);
 89:             }
 90: 
 91:             return ['variant' => $variant];
 92:         }
 93:         $code = trim((string) ($args['sku'] ?? $args['barcode'] ?? ''));
 94:         if ($code !== '') {
 95:             $variant = $resolver->exactVariantByCode($code);
 96:             if (! $variant) {
 97:                 return ToolOutcome::denied('مش لاقي متغير بالكود ده. استخدم find_entities.', auditable: false);
 98:             }
 99:             $variant->loadMissing('product:id,name_ar,code');
100: 
101:             return ['variant' => $variant];
102:         }
103:         $query = trim((string) ($args['query'] ?? ''));
104:         if ($query === '') {
105:             return ToolOutcome::denied('حدد المتغير بـ variant_id أو sku أو query.', auditable: false);
106:         }
107:         $options = $resolver->variants($actor, $query, isset($args['product_id']) ? (int) $args['product_id'] : null);
108:         if (count($options) === 0) {
109:             return ToolOutcome::denied('مش لاقي متغير بالوصف ده.', auditable: false);
110:         }
111:         if (count($options) > 1) {
112:             return ToolOutcome::denied('لقيت أكتر من متغير. استخدم find_entities ثم ask_user_to_choose.', auditable: false);
113:         }
114:         $variant = ProductVariant::with('product:id,name_ar,code')->find($options[0]['id']);
115:         if (! $variant) {
116:             return ToolOutcome::denied('المتغير مش موجود.', auditable: false);
117:         }
118: 
119:         return ['variant' => $variant];
120:     }
121: }
````

````php
 5: namespace App\Services\Ai\Inventory;
 6: 
 7: use App\Enums\StockMovementType;
 8: use App\Models\StockLevel;
 9: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
10: 
11: /**
12:  * أيام التغطية = المتاح ÷ متوسط البيع اليومي (آخر 30 يوم).
13:  * null تعني بلا مبيعات (تغطية غير محدودة عمليًا).
14:  */
15: final class InventoryCoverage
16: {
17:     public static function avgDailySale(int $variantId, ?int $branchId = null, int $days = 30): float
18:     {
19:         $sold = (float) DB::table('stock_movements')
20:             ->where('product_variant_id', $variantId)
21:             ->when($branchId !== null, fn ($q) => $q->where('branch_id', $branchId))
22:             ->where('type', StockMovementType::Sale->value)
23:             ->where('created_at', '>=', now()->subDays($days))
24:             ->sum(DB::raw('-quantity'));
25: 
26:         return max(0.0, $sold / max(1, $days));
27:     }
28: 
29:     public static function available(int $variantId, int $branchId): float
30:     {
31:         return (float) StockLevel::query()
32:             ->where('product_variant_id', $variantId)
33:             ->where('branch_id', $branchId)
34:             ->sum(DB::raw('on_hand - reserved - damaged'));
35:     }
36: 
37:     /** @return float|null */
38:     public static function coverageDays(int $variantId, int $branchId, int $days = 30): ?float
39:     {
40:         $available = self::available($variantId, $branchId);
41:         $daily = self::avgDailySale($variantId, $branchId, $days);
42:         if ($daily <= 0) {
43:             return null;
44:         }
45:         if ($available <= 0) {
46:             return 0.0;
47:         }
48: 
49:         return round($available / $daily, 1);
50:     }
51: }
````

## File: backend/app/Services/Ai/Inventory/InventoryPresenter.php
````php
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: declare(strict_types=1);
 4: 
 5: namespace App\Services\Ai\Inventory;
 6: 
 7: use App\Models\User;
 8: use App\Services\Ai\ToolOutcome;
 9: use App\Services\CostAccess;
10: use App\Services\SettingService;
11: 
12: final class InventoryPresenter
13: {
14:     public function __construct(private SettingService $settings) {}
15: 
16:     /** @return array{untrusted_text: string} */
17:     public function untrusted(?string $value, int $max = 300): array
18:     {
19:         $clean = mb_substr((string) preg_replace('/[\x00-\x1F\x7F]/u', ' ', (string) $value), 0, $max);
20: 
21:         return ['untrusted_text' => $clean];
22:     }
23: 
24:     /**
25:      * @param  array<string,mixed>  $data
26:      * @param  array<string,mixed>|null  $uiBlock
27:      */
28:     public function present(User $actor, array $data, ?array $uiBlock = null, ?string $message = null): ToolOutcome
29:     {
30:         // طبقتان لحماية التكلفة: بلا صلاحية عرض تُحذف من كل مكان،
31:         // ومع الصلاحية تبقى الأرقام في كارت العرض فقط ولا تصل للنموذج.
32:         if (! CostAccess::canView($actor)) {
33:             $data = $this->stripCost($data);
34:             if ($uiBlock !== null) {
35:                 $uiBlock = $this->stripCost($uiBlock);
36:             }
37:         } elseif (! $this->settings->getBool('ai_inventory_share_cost_with_model', false)) {
38:             $data = $this->maskActuals($data);
39:             $data['cost_hidden_from_model'] = true;
40:         }
41: 
42:         $maxChars = max(1024, (int) $this->settings->get('ai_tool_result_max_chars', 16000));
43:         $encoded = json_encode($data, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
44:         if ($encoded !== false && strlen($encoded) > $maxChars) {
45:             return ToolOutcome::data([
46:                 'truncated' => true,
47:                 'message' => 'ضيّق البحث',
48:             ], $uiBlock, 'ضيّق البحث');
49:         }
50: 
51:         return ToolOutcome::data($data, $uiBlock, $message);
52:     }
53: 
54:     private const COST_KEYS = ['cost_price', 'cost', 'unit_cost', 'total_value', 'tied_value'];
55: 
56:     /** @return array<string,mixed> */
57:     public function stripCost(array $payload): array
58:     {
59:         $out = [];
60:         foreach ($payload as $key => $value) {
61:             if (in_array($key, self::COST_KEYS, true)) {
62:                 continue;
63:             }
64:             $out[$key] = is_array($value) ? $this->stripCost($value) : $value;
65:         }
66: 
67:         return $out;
68:     }
69: 
70:     /** @return array<string,mixed> */
71:     private function maskActuals(array $payload): array
72:     {
73:         $out = [];
74:         foreach ($payload as $key => $value) {
75:             if (in_array($key, self::COST_KEYS, true)) {
76:                 $out[$key] = null;
77:                 continue;
78:             }
79:             $out[$key] = is_array($value) ? $this->maskActuals($value) : $value;
80:         }
81: 
82:         return $out;
83:     }
84: }
````

## File: backend/app/Services/Ai/Inventory/InventoryWelcome.php
````php
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: declare(strict_types=1);
  4: 
  5: namespace App\Services\Ai\Inventory;
  6: 
  7: use App\Enums\StocktakeStatus;
  8: use App\Enums\TransferStatus;
  9: use App\Models\InventoryReconcileRun;
 10: use App\Models\Stocktake;
 11: use App\Models\StockTransfer;
 12: use App\Models\User;
 13: use App\Services\BranchAccess;
 14: use App\Services\ReportService;
 15: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
 16: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
 17: 
 18: /**
 19:  * 5.2: كارت الصباح للمخزون — بيتبني في PHP بالكامل، من غير أي نداء
 20:  * لـ Gemini (صفر توكنز). كل سطر جنبه زرار "اتصرف" بprompt جاهز.
 21:  */
 22: final class InventoryWelcome
 23: {
 24:     public function __construct(
 25:         private BranchAccess $branches,
 26:         private ReportService $reports,
 27:     ) {}
 28: 
 29:     /** @return array<string,mixed>|null */
 30:     public function card(User $actor): ?array
 31:     {
 32:         return Cache::remember('ai:inventory-welcome:'.$actor->id, 60, function () use ($actor): ?array {
 33:             try {
 34:                 $restricted = $this->branches->restrictedBranch($actor);
 35:             } catch (\Throwable) {
 36:                 return null;
 37:             }
 38: 
 39:             $rows = [];
 40:             $actions = [];
 41: 
 42:             $pending = StockTransfer::query()
 43:                 ->where('status', TransferStatus::Draft)
 44:                 ->where('created_at', '<', now()->subDay())
 45:                 ->when($restricted !== null, fn ($q) => $q->where(fn ($w) => $w->where('from_branch_id', $restricted)->orWhere('to_branch_id', $restricted)))
 46:                 ->count();
 47:             if ($pending > 0) {
 48:                 $rows[] = ['label' => 'تحويلات مستنية الاعتماد من أكتر من 24 ساعة', 'value' => $pending];
 49:                 $actions[] = ['label' => 'اعرض المعلقة', 'prompt' => 'اعرض التحويلات المسودة اللي مستنية الاعتماد'];
 50:             }
 51: 
 52:             $low = $this->lowCoverageCount($restricted);
 53:             if ($low > 0) {
 54:                 $rows[] = ['label' => 'أصناف هتخلص خلال 3 أيام', 'value' => $low];
 55:                 $actions[] = ['label' => 'النواقص', 'prompt' => 'ايه الأصناف اللي هتخلص خلال 3 أيام؟'];
 56:             }
 57: 
 58:             $openStocktakes = Stocktake::query()
 59:                 ->whereIn('status', [StocktakeStatus::Draft, StocktakeStatus::InProgress])
 60:                 ->where('created_at', '<', now()->subWeek())
 61:                 ->when($restricted !== null, fn ($q) => $q->where('branch_id', $restricted))
 62:                 ->count();
 63:             if ($openStocktakes > 0) {
 64:                 $rows[] = ['label' => 'جرود مفتوحة من أسبوع', 'value' => $openStocktakes];
 65:                 $actions[] = ['label' => 'الجرود المفتوحة', 'prompt' => 'ايه الجرود المفتوحة؟'];
 66:             }
 67: 
 68:             $run = InventoryReconcileRun::query()
 69:                 ->when($restricted !== null, fn ($q) => $q->where('branch_id', $restricted))
 70:                 ->orderByDesc('id')->first();
 71:             if ($run) {
 72:                 $age = $run->created_at?->diffForHumans() ?? '';
 73:                 $rows[] = ['label' => 'آخر مطابقة ('.$age.')', 'value' => $run->problem_count === 0 ? 'سليمة' : $run->problem_count.' فروقات'];
 74:                 if ($run->problem_count > 0) {
 75:                     $actions[] = ['label' => 'شوف الفروقات', 'prompt' => 'نتيجة آخر مطابقة للأرصدة'];
 76:                 }
 77:             }
 78: 
 79:             $dead = $this->deadValue($restricted);
 80:             $threshold = (float) app(\App\Services\SettingService::class)->get('ai_inventory_high_risk_value', 50000);
 81:             if ($dead !== null && $dead > $threshold) {
 82:                 $rows[] = ['label' => 'قيمة الراكد فوق الحد', 'value' => $dead];
 83:                 $actions[] = ['label' => 'الرواكد', 'prompt' => 'ايه البضاعة الراكدة وقيمتها؟'];
 84:             }
 85: 
 86:             if ($rows === []) {
 87:                 return null;
 88:             }
 89: 
 90:             return ['type' => 'welcome_card', 'title' => 'ملخص المخزون الصباحي', 'rows' => $rows, 'quick_actions' => $actions];
 91:         });
 92:     }
 93: 
 94:     private function lowCoverageCount(?int $restricted): int
 95:     {
 96:         $levels = DB::table('stock_levels as sl')
 97:             ->join('product_variants as pv', 'pv.id', '=', 'sl.product_variant_id')
 98:             ->when($restricted !== null, fn ($q) => $q->where('sl.branch_id', $restricted))
 99:             ->whereRaw('COALESCE(NULLIF(sl.reorder_level, 0), pv.reorder_level, 0) > 0')
100:             ->whereRaw('sl.available <= COALESCE(NULLIF(sl.reorder_level, 0), pv.reorder_level, 0)')
101:             ->selectRaw('sl.product_variant_id, sl.branch_id, sl.available')
102:             ->orderBy('sl.available')
103:             ->limit(200)->get();
104:         if ($levels->isEmpty()) {
105:             return 0;
106:         }
107:         $sales = DB::table('stock_movements')
108:             ->selectRaw('product_variant_id, branch_id, SUM(-quantity) AS sold')
109:             ->where('type', 'sale')
110:             ->where('created_at', '>=', now()->subDays(30))
111:             ->whereIn('product_variant_id', $levels->pluck('product_variant_id')->all())
112:             ->groupBy('product_variant_id', 'branch_id')
113:             ->get()->keyBy(fn ($r) => $r->product_variant_id.':'.$r->branch_id);
114:         $count = 0;
115:         foreach ($levels as $l) {
116:             $sold = (float) ($sales->get($l->product_variant_id.':'.$l->branch_id)?->sold ?? 0);
117:             if ($sold > 0 && (float) $l->available / ($sold / 30) <= 3) {
118:                 $count++;
119:             }
120:         }
121: 
122:         return $count;
123:     }
124: 
125:     private function deadValue(?int $restricted): ?float
126:     {
127:         try {
128:             $report = $this->reports->inventoryReport(90, $restricted);
129:         } catch (\Throwable) {
130:             return null;
131:         }
132: 
133:         return isset($report['dead_stock']) ? (float) array_sum(array_column($report['dead_stock'], 'tied_value')) : null;
134:     }
135: }
````

````php
 45:     public function __construct(private ToolRegistry $registry) {}
 46: 
 47:     /**

 49:      * @param  array<string,mixed>|null  $selection
 50:      * @param  list<string>  $attachments
 51:      * @return list<string>|null
 52:      */
 53:     public function route(
 54:         string $text,
 55:         array $mentions = [],
 56:         ?array $selection = null,
 57:         ?AiConversation $conversation = null,
 58:         array $attachments = [],
 59:     ): ?array {
 60:         $domains = [];
 61: 
 62:         if ($attachments !== []) {
 63:             $domains['catalog'] = true;
 64:         }
 65: 
 66:         $refs = $mentions;
 67:         if ($selection !== null) {
 68:             $refs[] = $selection;
 69:         }
 70:         foreach ($refs as $ref) {
 71:             $entity = (string) ($ref['entity'] ?? '');
 72:             $mapped = match ($entity) {
 73:                 'category', 'product', 'variant' => 'catalog',
 74:                 'customer', 'customer_group' => 'customers',
 75:                 'branch', 'user', 'role', 'permission', 'location' => 'admin',
 76:                 'transfer', 'stocktake', 'production_receipt' => 'inventory',
 77:                 default => null,
 78:             };
 79:             if ($mapped !== null) {
 80:                 $domains[$mapped] = true;
 81:             }
 82:         }
 83: 
 84:         $norm = EntityResolver::normalizeForSearch(EntityResolver::normalizeDigits($text));
 85:         $lower = mb_strtolower($text);
 86: 
 87:         foreach (self::KEYWORDS as $domain => $words) {
 88:             foreach ($words as $word) {
 89:                 $normWord = EntityResolver::normalizeForSearch($word);
 90:                 if (($normWord !== '' && str_contains($norm, $normWord)) || str_contains($lower, mb_strtolower($word))) {
 91:                     $domains[$domain] = true;
 92:                     break;
 93:                 }
 94:             }
 95:         }
 96: 
 97:         if ($conversation !== null) {
 98:             $lastToolName = $this->lastToolInConversation($conversation);
 99:             if ($lastToolName !== null) {
100:                 $lastDomain = $this->toolDomain($lastToolName);
101:                 if ($lastDomain !== null) {
102:                     $domains[$lastDomain] = true;
103:                 }
104:             }
105:         }
106: 
107:         if ($domains === []) {
108:             return null;
109:         }
110: 
111:         return array_keys($domains);
112:     }
113: 
114:     private function lastToolInConversation(AiConversation $conversation): ?string
115:     {
116:         $lastModelWithCall = AiMessage::query()
117:             ->where('conversation_id', $conversation->id)
118:             ->where('role', 'model')
119:             ->whereNotNull('provider_parts')
120:             ->orderByDesc('id')
121:             ->limit(5)
122:             ->get(['provider_parts']);
123: 
124:         foreach ($lastModelWithCall as $msg) {
125:             foreach ((array) $msg->provider_parts as $part) {
126:                 if (is_array($part) && isset($part['functionCall']['name']) && is_string($part['functionCall']['name'])) {
127:                     return $part['functionCall']['name'];
128:                 }
129:             }
130:         }
131: 
132:         return null;
133:     }
134: 
135:     private function toolDomain(string $toolName): ?string
136:     {
137:         if (in_array($toolName, ['find_entities', 'ask_user_to_choose', 'bulk_actions'], true)) {
138:             return null;
139:         }
140:         $def = $this->registry->definitions()[$toolName] ?? null;
141:         if (! $def) {
142:             return null;
143:         }
144:         if (isset($def['provider']) && $def['provider'] instanceof \App\Services\Ai\Contracts\ToolProvider) {
145:             return $def['provider']->domain();
146:         }
147:         if ($this->registry->isCustomerTool($toolName)) {
148:             return 'customers';
149:         }
150:         if (in_array($toolName, ['view_settings', 'view_document_numbering', 'update_settings', 'update_document_numbering'], true)) {
151:             return 'settings';
152:         }
153: 
154:         return 'admin';
155:     }
156: }
````

````php
 28:     public static function normalizeDigits(string $value): string

 30:         return strtr($value, [

 32:             '٥' => '5', '٦' => '6', '٧' => '7', '٨' => '8', '٩' => '9',
 33:             '۰' => '0', '۱' => '1', '۲' => '2', '۳' => '3', '۴' => '4',

 38:     /** @return list<string> */
 39:     public static function expandCatalogSearchTerms(string $query): array
 40:     {
 41:         $clean = trim(self::normalizeDigits($query));
 42:         if ($clean === '') {
 43:             return [];
 44:         }
 45:         $terms = [$clean];
 46:         $norm = self::normalizeForSearch($clean);
 47:         if ($norm !== '' && $norm !== $clean) {
 48:             $terms[] = $norm;
 49:         }
 50:         $synonyms = (array) config('ai_catalog_synonyms', []);
 51:         foreach ($synonyms as $phrase => $expansions) {
 52:             $normPhrase = self::normalizeForSearch((string) $phrase);
 53:             if ($normPhrase !== '' && (str_contains($norm, $normPhrase) || str_contains(mb_strtolower($clean), mb_strtolower((string) $phrase)))) {
 54:                 foreach ((array) $expansions as $exp) {
 55:                     $terms[] = (string) $exp;
 56:                 }
 57:             }
 58:         }
 59: 
 60:         return array_values(array_unique(array_filter($terms, fn ($t) => trim($t) !== '')));
 61:     }

 63:     public static function normalize(string $value): string
 64:     {
 65:         $v = mb_strtolower(trim($value));
 66:         $v = str_replace(['أ', 'إ', 'آ', 'ٱ'], 'ا', $v);
 67:         $v = str_replace(['ة'], 'ه', $v);
 68:         $v = str_replace(['ى'], 'ي', $v);
 69:         $v = preg_replace('/[\x{064B}-\x{065F}\x{0640}]/u', '', $v) ?? $v;
 70: 
 71:         return preg_replace('/\s+/u', ' ', $v) ?? $v;
 72:     }

380:     public function customers(User $actor, string $query = '', array $filters = []): array
381:     {
382:         $q = Customer::query()
383:             ->when(($filters['business_only'] ?? false), fn ($x) => $x->whereIn('type', ['wholesale', 'distributor']))
384:             ->when(isset($filters['type']), fn ($x) => $x->where('type', $filters['type']))
385:             ->when(isset($filters['status']), fn ($x) => $x->where('status', $filters['status']))
386:             ->when(isset($filters['customer_group_id']), fn ($x) => $x->where('customer_group_id', $filters['customer_group_id']))
387:             ->when(isset($filters['pending_older_than_hours']), fn ($x) => $x->where('status', 'pending')->where('created_at', '<', now()->subHours((int) $filters['pending_older_than_hours'])));
388:         if (trim($query) !== '') {
389:             // L5: حرف أو اتنين مش بيستفيدوا من trigram.

391:                 return [];

393:             if (preg_match('/^[0-9٠-٩۰-۹\s().+-]+$/u', trim($query))) {
394:                 // L5: LIKE مش ILIKE عشان يستخدم index الـ text_pattern_ops.
395:                 $q->whereLike('phone', SearchTerm::prefix(Customer::normalizePhone($query)), caseSensitive: true);

402:             ->map(fn (Customer $c) => [

575:     public function variants(User $actor, string $q = '', ?int $productId = null): array
576:     {
577:         $clean = trim(self::normalizeDigits($q));

587:                 ]];
588:             }
589:         }

591:         $terms = self::expandCatalogSearchTerms($clean);
592: 
593:         return ProductVariant::query()

597:                 $x->where(function ($w) use ($terms, $clean): void {
598:                     $w->whereRaw('LOWER(sku) = LOWER(?)', [$clean])
599:                         ->orWhereRaw('LOWER(barcode) = LOWER(?)', [$clean])

605:                             ->orWhereLike('color_name_en', $pattern, caseSensitive: false)
606:                             ->orWhereLike('size', $pattern, caseSensitive: false)
607:                             ->orWhereHas('product', fn ($p) => $p->whereLike('name_ar', $pattern, caseSensitive: false)->orWhereLike('name_en', $pattern, caseSensitive: false)->orWhereLike('code', $pattern, caseSensitive: false));
608:                     }
609:                     // صيغة "اللون + الموديل" من غير SKU ("الشنطة الكروس البني"):
610:                     // كل توكن يطابق حقلًا ما، بدل تطابق العبارة كاملة في حقل واحد.

618:                                     ->orWhereLike('color_name_ar', $pattern, caseSensitive: false)
619:                                     ->orWhereLike('color_name_en', $pattern, caseSensitive: false)
620:                                     ->orWhereLike('size', $pattern, caseSensitive: false)
621:                                     ->orWhereLike('capacity', $pattern, caseSensitive: false)
622:                                     ->orWhereHas('product', fn ($p) => $p->whereLike('name_ar', $pattern, caseSensitive: false)->orWhereLike('name_en', $pattern, caseSensitive: false)->orWhereLike('code', $pattern, caseSensitive: false)));
623:                             }
624:                         });
625:                     }
626:                 });
627:             })
628:             ->orderBy('id')
629:             ->limit(20)
630:             ->get()
631:             ->map(fn (ProductVariant $v) => [
632:                 'id' => $v->id,
633:                 'label' => ($v->product?->name_ar ?? '').' — '.$v->sku,
634:                 'meta' => trim(implode(' · ', array_filter([$v->color_name_ar ?: $v->color_name_en, $v->size, $v->capacity, $v->is_active ? 'نشط' : 'معطّل']))),

640:     public function exactVariantByCode(string $code): ?ProductVariant
641:     {
642:         $clean = trim(self::normalizeDigits($code));
643:         if ($clean === '') {
644:             return null;
645:         }
646:         $matches = ProductVariant::query()
647:             ->where(fn ($q) => $q->whereRaw('LOWER(sku) = LOWER(?)', [$clean])->orWhereRaw('LOWER(barcode) = LOWER(?)', [$clean]))
648:             ->limit(2)
649:             ->get();
650: 
651:         return $matches->count() === 1 ? $matches->first() : null;
652:     }

654:     public function reference(User $actor, array $reference): array
655:     {
656:         $type = $reference['entity'] ?? '';
657:         abort_unless(app(ToolRegistry::class)->canReadEntity($actor, $type), 403, 'المرجع خارج صلاحيات العرض.');
658:         $id = $reference['id'] ?? null;
659:         $branch = $this->restricted($actor);
660:         $model = match ($type) {
661:             'branch' => Branch::query()->when($branch !== null, fn ($q) => $q->whereKey($branch))->find($id),
662:             'user' => User::query()->where('is_system', false)->when($branch !== null, fn ($q) => $q->where('branch_id', $branch))->find($id),
663:             'role' => Role::query()->where('guard_name', 'staff')->find($id),
664:             'permission' => Permission::query()->where('guard_name', 'staff')->where('name', $id)->first(),
665:             'location' => Location::query()->when($branch !== null, fn ($q) => $q->where('branch_id', $branch))->find($id),
666:             // العملاء بلا branch scoping — زي REST بالظبط.
667:             'customer' => Customer::query()->find($id),
668:             'customer_group' => CustomerGroup::query()->find($id),
669:             'category' => Category::query()->find($id),
670:             'product' => Product::query()->find($id),
671:             'variant' => ProductVariant::query()->with('product:id,name_ar,code')->find($id),
672:             'transfer' => StockTransfer::query()->when($branch !== null, fn ($q) => $q->where(fn ($w) => $w->where('from_branch_id', $branch)->orWhere('to_branch_id', $branch)))->find($id),
673:             'stocktake' => Stocktake::query()->when($branch !== null, fn ($q) => $q->where('branch_id', $branch))->find($id),
674:             'production_receipt' => ProductionReceipt::query()->when($branch !== null, fn ($q) => $q->where('branch_id', $branch))->find($id),
675:             default => null,
676:         };
677:         abort_unless($model, 422, 'الاختيار مش موجود أو خارج نطاقك.');
678: 
679:         $rawLabel = match ($type) {
680:             'category', 'product' => (string) $model->name_ar,
681:             'variant' => (($model->product?->name_ar ?? '').' — '.$model->sku),
682:             'transfer' => (string) $model->transfer_number,
683:             'stocktake' => (string) $model->stocktake_number,
684:             'production_receipt' => (string) $model->batch_number,
685:             default => (string) $model->name,
686:         };
687:         // اسم العميل أو المنتج/القسم كتبه بشر ورايح للنموذج كمرجع: نشيل رموز التحكم ونحدّ الطول.
688:         $label = in_array($type, ['customer', 'customer_group', 'category', 'product', 'variant'], true)
689:             ? mb_substr((string) preg_replace('/[\x00-\x1F\x7F]/u', ' ', $rawLabel), 0, 120)
690:             : $rawLabel;
691: 
692:         return ['entity' => $type, 'id' => $type === 'permission' ? $model->name : $model->id, 'label' => $label];
693:     }
694: }
````

````php
215:     public function converse(array $contents, array $functionDeclarations = [], ?string $system = null, ?string $model = null): array

238:         $maxOutputTokens = max(1024, (int) config('services.gemini.max_output_tokens', 2048));

240:         if (is_string($model) && preg_match('/^gemini-2\.5/i', $model) === 1) {
241:             $generationConfig['thinkingConfig'] = ['thinkingBudget' => min(1024, (int) ($maxOutputTokens / 4))];
242:         }
243:         $payload = [
244:             'contents' => $contents,
245:             'generationConfig' => $generationConfig,
246:         ];
247:         if ($functionDeclarations) {
248:             $payload['tools'] = [['functionDeclarations' => $functionDeclarations]];
249:             $payload['toolConfig'] = ['functionCallingConfig' => ['mode' => 'AUTO']];
250:         }
251:         if ($system !== null && trim($system) !== '') {
252:             $payload['systemInstruction'] = ['parts' => [['text' => $system]]];
253:         }
254:         for ($attempt = 0; $attempt < 2; $attempt++) {
255:             try {
256:                 $response = Http::acceptJson()->asJson()->withHeaders(['x-goog-api-key' => $key])
257:                     ->withOptions(['verify' => config('services.integrations.ca_bundle') ?: true])
258:                     ->connectTimeout(5)->timeout(max(1, (int) config('services.gemini.timeout_seconds', 20)))
259:                     ->post('https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/'.rawurlencode($model).':generateContent', $payload);

263:                     // المزود — تُسجَّل هنا بدل الصمت.
264:                     logger()->warning('gemini.request_retry', ['method' => 'converse', 'reason' => 'connection_timeout']);
265: 
266:                     continue;
267:                 }
268:                 throw new GeminiException('تعذّر الاتصال بخدمة Gemini.');
269:             }
270:             if (($response->status() === 429 || $response->serverError()) && $attempt === 0) {
271:                 logger()->warning('gemini.request_retry', ['method' => 'converse', 'reason' => 'http_'.$response->status()]);
272:                 // L7: نحترم Retry-After (من ثانية لـ 5 ثواني) بدل 250ms.
273:                 usleep(min(5, max(1, (int) $response->header('Retry-After'))) * 1_000_000);
274: 
275:                 continue;
276:             }
277:             if (! $response->successful()) {
278:                 throw new GeminiException('تعذّر تنفيذ طلب Gemini.', $response->status());

288:             $measured = [
289:                 'input_tokens' => (int) ($usage['promptTokenCount'] ?? 0),
290:                 'output_tokens' => (int) ($usage['candidatesTokenCount'] ?? 0),
291:                 'total_tokens' => (int) ($usage['totalTokenCount'] ?? 0),
292:             ];

301:             $calls = [];
302:             foreach ($parts as $part) {
303:                 if (is_array($part) && isset($part['functionCall']['name'])) {
304:                     $calls[] = ['name' => (string) $part['functionCall']['name'], 'args' => is_array($part['functionCall']['args'] ?? null) ? $part['functionCall']['args'] : []];
305:                     if (isset($part['functionCall']['id']) && is_string($part['functionCall']['id'])) {
306:                         $calls[array_key_last($calls)]['id'] = $part['functionCall']['id'];
307:                     }
308:                 }
309:             }
310:             if (! $calls && trim($text) === '') {
311:                 throw GeminiException::withUsage('لم ترجع خدمة Gemini إجابة مكتملة.', $measured);
312:             }
313:             $input = $measured['input_tokens'];
314:             $output = $measured['output_tokens'];
315:             $output = max($output, $measured['total_tokens'] - $input);
316: 
317:             return ['parts' => $parts, 'text' => trim($text), 'calls' => $calls, 'finish' => $finish, 'model' => $model,
318:                 'usage' => ['input_tokens' => $input, 'output_tokens' => $output, 'total_tokens' => max($measured['total_tokens'], $input + $output)]];
319:         }
320:         throw new GeminiException('تعذّر تنفيذ طلب Gemini.');
321:     }
322: }
````

````php
361:     private function finalizeAction(AiPendingAction $action, ToolOutcome $outcome): ToolOutcome
362:     {
363:         $ok = $outcome->type === 'result';

365:         unset($storedResult['generated_password']);
366:         // الأدوات قد تحفظ مراجع أنشأتها أثناء التنفيذ (مثل مسودة تحويل)
367:         // في expected_versions — حدّث النسخة قبل حساب حالة التراجع.
368:         $action->refresh();
369:         if ($ok && $this->registry->canUndo($action)) {
370:             $storedResult['undo_state'] = $this->registry->targetState($action);
371:         }
372:         $action->forceFill(['status' => $ok ? 'executed' : 'failed', 'result' => array_merge($storedResult, ['message' => $outcome->message]), 'executed_at' => $ok ? now() : null])->save();

374:         $block = $outcome->uiBlock;
375:         if ($block) {
376:             $blocks = [$block];
377:             if ($ok && $this->registry->canUndo($action)) {
378:                 $blocks[0]['undo_available_until'] = now()->addMinutes(15)->toIso8601String();
379:                 $blocks[0]['undo_action_id'] = $action->id;
380:             }
381:         } else {
382:             $blocks = [['type' => 'result', 'ok' => $ok, 'message' => $outcome->message ?? '']];
383:             if ($ok && $this->registry->canUndo($action)) {
384:                 $blocks[0]['undo_available_until'] = now()->addMinutes(15)->toIso8601String();
385:                 $blocks[0]['undo_action_id'] = $action->id;

388:         $this->event($action, 'result', $outcome->message ?? '', $blocks, stripPassword: in_array($action->tool, ['create_staff_user', 'create_customer'], true));

390:         return ToolOutcome::wrap($outcome->type, $outcome->data, $blocks[0] ?? null, $outcome->message);
391:     }

393:     public function cancel(User $actor, AiPendingAction $action): AiPendingAction
394:     {
395:         abort_unless($action->user_id === $actor->id, 403);
396: 
397:         return DB::transaction(function () use ($actor, $action): AiPendingAction {
398:             $this->lockForAction($action->tool);
399:             $locked = AiPendingAction::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($action->id);
400:             if ($locked->status === 'pending') {
401:                 $locked->forceFill(['status' => 'cancelled'])->save();
402:                 if ($locked->tool === 'bulk_actions') {

404:                     AiPendingAction::query()->where('user_id', $actor->id)->where('conversation_id', $locked->conversation_id)->whereIn('id', $locked->args['action_ids'])->whereIn('status', ['pending', 'bulk_child'])->update(['status' => 'cancelled']);
405:                 }
406:                 $this->event($locked, 'result', 'تم إلغاء الإجراء '.$locked->id, [['type' => 'result', 'ok' => true, 'message' => 'تم إلغاء الإجراء.']]);
407:             }
408: 
409:             return $locked;
410:         });

413:     public function undo(User $actor, AiPendingAction $action): ToolOutcome
414:     {

416:         abort_unless($action->user_id === $actor->id, 403);
417: 
418:         return DB::transaction(function () use ($actor, $action) {

421:             abort_unless($locked->user_id === $actor->id, 403);
422:             $this->registry->lockTargets($locked);
423:

428:     private function undoLocked(User $actor, AiPendingAction $action): ToolOutcome
429:     {

431:         $this->authorizeTool($actor, $action);

433:         abort_unless(isset($action->result['undo_state']) && hash_equals($action->result['undo_state'], $this->registry->targetState($action)), 409, 'السجل اتعدل بعد التنفيذ؛ التراجع مش آمن.');

436:         $via = ['channel' => 'ai', 'conversation_id' => $action->conversation_id, 'action_id' => $action->id];
437:         try {
438:             $outcome = $this->registry->executeUndo($actor, $action, $via);
439:         } catch (BusinessException $e) {
440:             if ($e->status === 409) {
441:                 $this->event($action, 'result', 'التراجع اترفض عشان السجل اتعدل.', [['type' => 'result', 'ok' => false, 'message' => 'التراجع اترفض: السجل اتعدل بعد التنفيذ.']]);
442:                 abort(409, $e->getMessage());

445:         } catch (HttpExceptionInterface $e) {

449:             } throw $e;

451:         if ($outcome->type === 'result') {

459:     private function isRetryableLockFailure(QueryException $e): bool
460:     {

462:     }

464:     /**

467:      */
468:     private function markFailed(AiPendingAction $action, string $message): void
469:     {
470:         $action->forceFill(['status' => 'failed', 'result' => ['message' => $message]])->save();
471:         $this->event($action, 'result', $message, [['type' => 'result', 'ok' => false, 'message' => $message]]);
472:     }

474:     private function event(AiPendingAction $action, string $kind, string $text, array $blocks, bool $stripPassword = false): void
475:     {
476:         if ($stripPassword) {
477:             // L8: لا تعتمد على regex فوق صياغة عربية قد تتغير — المؤقتة
478:             // تُعرض مرة واحدة في رد التأكيد فقط، والمخزّن نص ثابت.
479:             $created = $action->tool === 'create_customer' ? 'العميل' : 'الموظف';
480:             $text = "تم إنشاء {$created} (الباسورد ظهر للأدمن مرة واحدة).";
481:             $blocks = array_map(function ($b) use ($created) {
482:                 if (isset($b['message'])) {
483:                     $b['message'] = "تم إنشاء {$created}.";
484:                 }
485:                 if (isset($b['generated_password'])) {
486:                     unset($b['generated_password']);
487:                 }
488: 
489:                 return $b;
490:             }, $blocks);
491:         }
492:         AiMessage::create(['conversation_id' => $action->conversation_id, 'role' => 'event', 'content' => $text, 'ui_blocks' => $blocks]);
493:     }
494: }
````

````php
 232:             'update_settings' => ['kind' => ToolKind::Write, 'permissions' => ['settings.manage'], 'risk' => 'high', 'declaration' => ['name' => 'update_settings', 'description' => 'تعديل إعدادات المؤسسة (يحتاج تأكيد). اقرأ الإعدادات الحالية أولاً بـ view_settings.', 'parameters' => $obj(['changes' => $obj(['company_name' => $str, 'company_email' => $str, 'company_phone' => $str, 'company_address' => $str, 'company_logo' => $str, 'commercial_register' => $str, 'tax_enabled' => $bool, 'tax_number' => $str, 'default_tax_rate' => ['type' => 'NUMBER'], 'prices_include_tax' => $bool, 'return_window_days' => $int])], ['changes'])]],
 233:             'update_document_numbering' => ['kind' => ToolKind::Write, 'permissions' => ['settings.manage'], 'risk' => 'high', 'declaration' => ['name' => 'update_document_numbering', 'description' => 'تعديل بادئة أو عداد أو طول ترقيم مستند (يحتاج تأكيد). العداد لا ينخفض.', 'parameters' => $obj(['type' => ['type' => 'STRING', 'enum' => ['order', 'invoice', 'purchase_order', 'quotation', 'transfer', 'stocktake', 'return', 'purchase_request', 'delivery', 'supplier_invoice', 'supplier_payment', 'shift', 'pos_invoice', 'expense', 'treasury_transfer', 'payment_notice', 'movement']], 'prefix' => $str, 'next_number' => $int, 'padding' => $int], ['type'])]],
 234:         ];
 235: 
 236:         foreach ($this->providers as $p) {
 237:             foreach ($p->tools() as $name => $tool) {
 238:                 $defs[$name] = [
 239:                     'kind' => $tool->kind(),
 240:                     'permissions' => $tool->permissions(),
 241:                     'risk' => $tool->risk(),
 242:                     'declaration' => $tool->declaration(),
 243:                     'provider' => $p,
 244:                     'tool' => $tool,
 245:                 ];
 246:             }
 247:         }
 248: 
 249:         return $defs;
 250:     }

 252:     /** @return list<array<string,mixed>> */
 253:     public function declarationsFor(User $actor, ?array $domains = null): array
 254:     {
 255:         $disabled = $this->settings->get('ai_disabled_tools', []);
 256:         if (! is_array($disabled)) {
 257:             $disabled = [];
 258:         }
 259:         $out = [];
 260:         foreach ($this->definitions() as $name => $def) {
 261:             if (in_array($name, $disabled, true) || $this->toolHiddenByFlags($name)) {
 262:                 continue;
 263:             }
 264:             if ($domains !== null && ! in_array($name, ['find_entities', 'ask_user_to_choose', 'bulk_actions'], true)) {
 265:                 $toolDomain = $this->domainOf($name, $def);
 266:                 if (! in_array($toolDomain, $domains, true)) {
 267:                     continue;
 268:                 }
 269:             }
 270:             if ($def['kind'] === ToolKind::Write && ! $actor->can('ai_agent.execute')) {
 271:                 continue;
 272:             }
 273:             if (! $this->actorHasToolPermissions($actor, $name, $def)) {
 274:                 continue;
 275:             }
 276:             $out[] = $def['declaration'];
 277:         }
 278: 
 279:         return $out;
 280:     }

 282:     /**
 283:      * M7: أدوات الكتالوج تأخذ قفل شجرة الكتالوج (CatalogLock) + أقفال
 284:      * الصفوف في الـ services، فلا تحتاج القفل الاستشاري العام — إبقاؤه
 285:      * كان يسلسل كل التأكيدات خلف أثقل عملية كتالوج.
 286:      */
 287:     public function isCatalogTool(string $name): bool
 288:     {
 289:         $def = $this->definitions()[$name] ?? null;
 290: 
 291:         return $def !== null && ($def['provider'] ?? null) instanceof CatalogToolProvider;
 292:     }

 294:     public function actorHasToolPermissions(User $actor, string $name, array $def): bool
 295:     {
 296:         if ($name === 'analyze_product_photos') {
 297:             return $actor->can('ai_agent.catalog.vision') && $actor->can('products.create');
 298:         }
 299: 
 300:         return $actor->canAny($def['permissions']);
 301:     }

 303:     private function domainOf(string $name, array $def): string
 304:     {
 305:         if (isset($def['provider']) && $def['provider'] instanceof \App\Services\Ai\Contracts\ToolProvider) {
 306:             return $def['provider']->domain();
 307:         }
 308:         if ($this->isCustomerTool($name)) {
 309:             return 'customers';
 310:         }
 311:         if (in_array($name, ['view_settings', 'view_document_numbering', 'update_settings', 'update_document_numbering'], true)) {
 312:             return 'settings';
 313:         }
 314: 
 315:         return 'admin';
 316:     }

 318:     public function isWrite(string $name): bool
 319:     {
 320:         return ($this->definitions()[$name]['kind'] ?? null) === ToolKind::Write;
 321:     }
````
