## File: backend/app/Services/IdempotencyFingerprint.php
````php
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: declare(strict_types=1);
  4: 
  5: namespace App\Services;
  6: 
  7: use App\Exceptions\BusinessException;
  8: use JsonException;
  9: 
 10: /**
 11:  * Computes deterministic request payload fingerprints for idempotency evaluation.
 12:  *
 13:  * Sorts array keys deterministically and normalizes scalar numeric representations
 14:  * so cosmetic serialization variations (e.g. "5" vs 5 vs 5.0) yield identical SHA-256 digests.
 15:  */
 16: final class IdempotencyFingerprint
 17: {
 18:     /**
 19:      * Compute SHA-256 fingerprint for a canonicalized payload array.
 20:      *
 21:      * @param  array<string, mixed>  $payload
 22:      */
 23:     public static function hash(array $payload): string
 24:     {
 25:         try {
 26:             return hash('sha256', json_encode(self::canonicalize($payload), JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_PRESERVE_ZERO_FRACTION | JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR));
 27:         } catch (JsonException) {
 28:             throw new BusinessException('بيانات الطلب تحتوي قيمة غير صالحة.');
 29:         }
 30:     }
 31: 
 32:     private static function canonicalize(mixed $value, ?string $field = null): mixed
 33:     {
 34:         if (is_float($value) && ! is_finite($value)) {
 35:             throw new BusinessException('يجب أن تكون القيم الرقمية محدودة.');
 36:         }
 37:         // M2: textual decimal normalization without precision loss — strip
 38:         // redundant zeros instead of rounding, so 10.1234 and 10.1299 never
 39:         // share a fingerprint (no silent replay of a corrected price), and no
 40:         // float rounding error is introduced by (float) casts.
 41:         if (is_numeric($value) && in_array($field, [
 42:             'amount', 'subtotal', 'tax_amount', 'unit_price', 'line_total',
 43:             'grand_total', 'discount_amount', 'total', 'total_amount', 'paid_amount',
 44:             'expected_total', 'unit_cost',
 45:         ], true)) {
 46:             return self::normalizeDecimal((string) $value);
 47:         }
 48: 
 49:         if (is_string($value) && is_numeric($value)
 50:             && ($field === 'id' || str_ends_with($field ?? '', '_id')
 51:                 || in_array($field, ['qty', 'amount', 'received_good_qty', 'received_damaged_qty', 'quantity', 'requested_qty', 'counted_qty', 'approved_qty', 'shipped_qty', 'received_qty'], true))) {
 52:             $value = $value + 0;
 53:         }
 54: 
 55:         if (is_float($value) && floor($value) === $value && abs($value) <= 9007199254740991) {
 56:             return (int) $value;
 57:         }
 58: 
 59:         if (! is_array($value)) {
 60:             return $value;
 61:         }
 62: 
 63:         $isList = array_is_list($value);
 64:         $mapped = [];
 65:         foreach ($value as $key => $item) {
 66:             $mapped[$key] = self::canonicalize($item, is_string($key) ? $key : null);
 67:         }
 68: 
 69:         if ($isList && $mapped !== [] && self::isItemList($mapped)) {
 70:             usort($mapped, self::itemSort(...));
 71:         }
 72: 
 73:         if (! $isList) {
 74:             ksort($mapped);
 75:         }
 76: 
 77:         return $mapped;
 78:     }
 79: 
 80:     /**
 81:      * Normalize a decimal string without rounding: trim sign/zeros, drop a
 82:      * trailing decimal point, keep every significant digit intact.
 83:      */
 84:     private static function normalizeDecimal(string $raw): string
 85:     {
 86:         $raw = trim($raw);
 87:         $sign = '';
 88:         if ($raw !== '' && ($raw[0] === '+' || $raw[0] === '-')) {
 89:             $sign = $raw[0] === '-' ? '-' : '';
 90:             $raw = substr($raw, 1);
 91:         }
 92: 
 93:         // Keep the coefficient compact: expanding user-supplied exponents
 94:         // could allocate gigabytes. No float conversion or rounding is needed.
 95:         if (preg_match('/\A(\d*(?:\.\d*)?)(?:[eE]([+-]?\d+))?\z/', $raw, $parts) !== 1) {
 96:             throw new BusinessException('قيمة رقمية غير صالحة.');
 97:         }
 98:         $coefficient = $parts[1];
 99:         $point = strpos($coefficient, '.');
100:         $fractionLength = $point === false ? 0 : strlen($coefficient) - $point - 1;
101:         $digits = ltrim(str_replace('.', '', $coefficient), '0');
102:         if ($digits === '') {
103:             return '0';
104:         }
105:         $significant = rtrim($digits, '0');
106:         $exponent = bcadd($parts[2] ?? '0', (string) (strlen($digits) - strlen($significant) - $fractionLength), 0);
107: 
108:         return $sign.$significant.'e'.$exponent;
109:     }
110: 
111:     /** @param list<mixed> $items */
112:     private static function isItemList(array $items): bool
113:     {
114:         foreach ($items as $item) {
115:             if (! is_array($item) || (! isset($item['id']) && ! isset($item['order_item_id']) && ! isset($item['purchase_order_item_id']) && ! isset($item['product_variant_id']))) {
116:                 return false;
117:             }
118:         }
119: 
120:         return true;
121:     }
122: 
123:     /** @param array<string, mixed> $left */
124:     private static function itemSort(array $left, array $right): int
125:     {
126:         $sortKey = static function (array $item): array {
127:             foreach (['order_item_id', 'purchase_order_item_id', 'id', 'product_variant_id'] as $rank => $key) {
128:                 if (isset($item[$key])) {
129:                     return [$rank, $item[$key], json_encode($item, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR)];
130:                 }
131:             }
132: 
133:             return [4, '', json_encode($item, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR)];
134:         };
135: 
136:         return $sortKey($left) <=> $sortKey($right);
137:     }
138: }
````

## File: backend/app/Services/InventoryService.php
````php
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: declare(strict_types=1);
  4: 
  5: namespace App\Services;
  6: 
  7: use App\Enums\StockBucket;
  8: use App\Enums\StockMovementType;
  9: use App\Events\StockLowDetected;
 10: use App\Exceptions\BusinessException;
 11: use App\Models\Branch;
 12: use App\Models\InventoryIdempotencyKey;
 13: use App\Models\Location;
 14: use App\Models\ProductVariant;
 15: use App\Models\StockLevel;
 16: use App\Models\StockMovement;
 17: use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
 18: use Illuminate\Database\UniqueConstraintViolationException;
 19: use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
 20: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
 21: 
 22: /**
 23:  * Single authority for modifying stock balances across the platform.
 24:  *
 25:  * Enforces ledger-first accounting: records a stock movement in the ledger
 26:  * before updating row balances under row-level database locks.
 27:  */
 28: class InventoryService
 29: {
 30:     public function __construct(private readonly SettingService $settings) {}
 31: 
 32:     /**
 33:      * Records an immutable stock movement and updates bucket balances.
 34:      *
 35:      * @param  array{product_variant_id: int, branch_id: int, location_id?: int|null, type: StockMovementType|string, affected_bucket: StockBucket|string, quantity: float|int|string, unit_cost?: float|null, reference_type?: string|null, reference_id?: int|null, created_by?: int|null, notes?: string|null}  $data
 36:      * @throws BusinessException If quantity is invalid, bucket balance goes negative, or available stock is insufficient.
 37:      */
 38:     public function recordMovement(array $data, ?StockLevel $prelockedLevel = null): StockMovement
 39:     {
 40:         $apply = function () use ($data, $prelockedLevel): StockMovement {
 41:             $rawQty = $data['quantity'];
 42:             if (! is_numeric($rawQty) || ! is_finite((float) $rawQty) || abs((float) $rawQty) > 99999999.9999) {
 43:                 throw new BusinessException('كمية الحركة غير صالحة.');
 44:             }
 45:             // Work in ten-thousandths to avoid floating point residues at zero.
 46:             $units = (int) round((float) $rawQty * 10000);
 47:             $qty = $units / 10000;
 48: 
 49:             if ($units === 0) {
 50:                 throw new BusinessException('كمية الحركة يجب ألا تساوي صفرًا.');
 51:             }
 52: 
 53:             $type = $data['type'] instanceof StockMovementType ? $data['type'] : StockMovementType::from($data['type']);
 54:             $bucket = $data['affected_bucket'] instanceof StockBucket ? $data['affected_bucket'] : StockBucket::from($data['affected_bucket']);
 55:             $this->assertValidMovementSemantics($type, $bucket, $units);
 56:             $locationId = $data['location_id'] ?? null;
 57: 
 58:             // Skip re-locking and location checks if caller already locked this level row.
 59:             if ($prelockedLevel !== null) {
 60:                 if ((int) $prelockedLevel->product_variant_id !== (int) $data['product_variant_id']
 61:                     || (int) $prelockedLevel->branch_id !== (int) $data['branch_id']
 62:                     || ($prelockedLevel->location_id === null ? null : (int) $prelockedLevel->location_id) !== ($locationId === null ? null : (int) $locationId)) {
 63:                     throw new \LogicException('الصف المقفول مسبقًا لا يطابق مفتاح الحركة.');
 64:                 }
 65:                 $stock = $prelockedLevel;
 66:             } else {
 67:                 if ($locationId !== null && ! Location::query()->whereKey($locationId)->where('branch_id', $data['branch_id'])->exists()) {
 68:                     throw new BusinessException('الموقع لا يتبع الفرع المحدد.');
 69:                 }
 70: 
 71:                 $stock = $this->lockLevels([[
 72:                     'product_variant_id' => $data['product_variant_id'],
 73:                     'branch_id' => $data['branch_id'],
 74:                     'location_id' => $locationId,
 75:                 ]])->first();
 76:             }
 77: 
 78:             // Only new inbound inventory requires active variant and location.
 79:             // Stock transfers, returns, and write-offs remain allowed on inactive items to liquidate stock.
 80:             $isNewInbound = in_array($type, [
 81:                 StockMovementType::AdjustmentIn,
 82:                 StockMovementType::ProductionReceipt,
 83:                 StockMovementType::PurchaseReceipt,
 84:             ], true);
 85:             if ($isNewInbound && $bucket === StockBucket::OnHand && $units > 0) {
 86:                 $variant = $stock->variant;
 87:                 if ($variant === null || $variant->trashed() || ! $variant->is_active
 88:                     || ($stock->location_id !== null && ! $stock->location?->is_active)) {
 89:                     throw new BusinessException('الإدخال يتطلب متغيرًا وموقعًا نشطين.');
 90:                 }
 91:             }
 92: 
 93:             $bucketKey = $bucket->value;
 94:             $before = (float) $stock->{$bucketKey};
 95:             $afterUnits = (int) round($before * 10000) + $units;
 96:             $after = $afterUnits / 10000;
 97:             if ($afterUnits > 999999999999) {
 98:                 throw new BusinessException('الرصيد يتجاوز الحد المسموح.');
 99:             }
100: 
101:             if ($after < 0) {
102:                 throw new BusinessException("الرصيد غير كافٍ في ({$bucketKey}) لإتمام العملية.");
103:             }
104: 
105:             // Ensure available-for-sale quantity (on_hand - reserved - damaged) does not drop below zero.
106:             $onHand = $bucket === StockBucket::OnHand ? $after : (float) $stock->on_hand;
107:             $reserved = $bucket === StockBucket::Reserved ? $after : (float) $stock->reserved;
108:             $damaged = $bucket === StockBucket::Damaged ? $after : (float) $stock->damaged;
109:             $availableAfter = (int) round($onHand * 10000) - (int) round($reserved * 10000) - (int) round($damaged * 10000);
110: 
111:             if ($availableAfter < 0) {
112:                 $availableNow = (float) $stock->on_hand - (float) $stock->reserved - (float) $stock->damaged;
113: 
114:                 throw new BusinessException("الكمية المتاحة للبيع ({$availableNow}) غير كافية لإتمام العملية.");
115:             }
116: 
117:             // Created-by is mandatory for audit trails; fails explicitly in queue/CLI contexts without auth user.
118:             $createdBy = $data['created_by'] ?? auth()->id();
119:             if ($createdBy === null) {
120:                 throw new \LogicException('recordMovement يتطلب created_by صريحًا عند غياب مستخدم مصادق.');
121:             }
122: 
123:             // Store morph alias instead of FQCN so future class renames preserve audit trail queries.
124:             $referenceType = $data['reference_type'] ?? null;
125:             if (is_string($referenceType) && class_exists($referenceType)) {
126:                 $referenceType = (new $referenceType)->getMorphClass();
127:             }
128: 
129:             // 4. تسجيل الحركة في دفتر الأستاذ (Ledger)
130:             $movement = StockMovement::query()->create([
131:                 'reference_number' => $this->settings->generateNextNumber('movement'),
132:                 'product_variant_id' => $data['product_variant_id'],
133:                 'branch_id' => $data['branch_id'],
134:                 'location_id' => $locationId,
135:                 'type' => $type,
136:                 'affected_bucket' => $bucket,
137:                 'quantity' => $qty,
138:                 'balance_before' => $before,
139:                 'balance_after' => $after,
140:                 'unit_cost' => $data['unit_cost'] ?? null,
141:                 'reference_type' => $referenceType,
142:                 'reference_id' => $data['reference_id'] ?? null,
143:                 'created_by' => $createdBy,
144:                 'notes' => $data['notes'] ?? null,
145:             ]);
146: 
147:             $stock->{$bucketKey} = $after;
148:             $stock->save();
149: 
150:             // Evaluate low stock threshold: location-specific reorder level triggers on row availability,
151:             // while variant reorder level triggers on branch-wide aggregate availability.
152:             $rowLevel = (float) $stock->reorder_level;
153:             if ($rowLevel > 0) {
154:                 $effectOnAvailable = match ($bucket) {
155:                     StockBucket::OnHand => $units,
156:                     StockBucket::Reserved, StockBucket::Damaged => -$units,
157:                     default => 0,
158:                 };
159:                 $availableBeforeUnits = $availableAfter - $effectOnAvailable;
160:                 $availableAfterQty = $availableAfter / 10000;
161:                 if ($availableBeforeUnits / 10000 > $rowLevel && $availableAfterQty <= $rowLevel) {
162:                     StockLowDetected::dispatch(
163:                         (int) $stock->product_variant_id,
164:                         (int) $stock->branch_id,
165:                         $availableAfterQty,
166:                         $rowLevel,
167:                     );
168:                 }
169:             }
170:             $variantLevel = (float) ($stock->variant?->reorder_level ?? 0);
171:             if ($variantLevel > 0) {
172:                 $effectOnAvailable = match ($bucket) {
173:                     StockBucket::OnHand => $units,
174:                     StockBucket::Reserved, StockBucket::Damaged => -$units,
175:                     default => 0,
176:                 };
177:                 // Check aggregate branch availability within the transaction to see the committed change.
178:                 $branchTotal = (float) (StockLevel::query()
179:                     ->where('product_variant_id', $stock->product_variant_id)
180:                     ->where('branch_id', $stock->branch_id)
181:                     ->selectRaw('COALESCE(SUM(on_hand - reserved - damaged), 0) AS total')
182:                     ->value('total') ?? 0);
183:                 $branchBefore = $branchTotal - ($effectOnAvailable / 10000);
184:                 if ($branchBefore > $variantLevel && $branchTotal <= $variantLevel) {
185:                     StockLowDetected::dispatch(
186:                         (int) $stock->product_variant_id,
187:                         (int) $stock->branch_id,
188:                         $branchTotal,
189:                         $variantLevel,
190:                     );
191:                 }
192:             }
193: 
194:             return $movement;
195:         };
196: 
197:         if ($prelockedLevel !== null) {
198:             if (DB::transactionLevel() === 0) {
199:                 throw new \LogicException('Prelocked stock requires an active transaction.');
200:             }
201: 
202:             return $apply();
203:         }
204: 
205:         return DB::transaction($apply);
206:     }
207: 
208:     /**
209:      * Executes multiple stock adjustments atomically with optional idempotency protection.
210:      *
211:      * @param  array{branch_id: int, location_id?: int|null, items: list<array{product_variant_id: int, adjustment_type: string, quantity: float|int|string, reason?: string|null}>}  $payload
212:      * @return list<StockMovement>
213:      */
214:     public function applyAdjustments(array $payload, int $userId, ?string $idempotencyKey = null): array
215:     {
216:         app(BranchAccess::class)->assertBranch($userId, (int) $payload['branch_id']);
217:         if ($idempotencyKey === null) {
218:             return $this->executeAdjustments($payload, $userId);
219:         }
220: 
221:         $requestHash = IdempotencyFingerprint::hash($payload);
222: 
223:         try {
224:             return DB::transaction(function () use ($payload, $userId, $idempotencyKey, $requestHash): array {
225:                 $record = InventoryIdempotencyKey::query()->create([
226:                     'user_id' => $userId,
227:                     'key' => $idempotencyKey,
228:                     'request_hash' => $requestHash,
229:                 ]);
230: 
231:                 $movements = $this->executeAdjustments($payload, $userId);
232: 
233:                 $record->update([
234:                     'response' => array_map(fn (StockMovement $movement) => $movement->id, $movements),
235:                     'status_code' => 201,
236:                 ]);
237: 
238:                 return $movements;
239:             });
240:         } catch (UniqueConstraintViolationException $e) {
241:             // Isolate idempotency key collisions from unrelated unique constraint violations.
242:             $driverMessage = (string) ($e->errorInfo[2] ?? $e->getMessage());
243:             if (! str_contains($driverMessage, 'inventory_idempotency_keys_user_id_key_unique')
244:                 && ! str_contains($e->getMessage(), 'inventory_idempotency_keys_user_id_key_unique')) {
245:                 throw $e;
246:             }
247: 
248:             $record = InventoryIdempotencyKey::query()
249:                 ->where('user_id', $userId)->where('key', $idempotencyKey)->first();
250: 
251:             if ($record === null) {
252:                 throw new BusinessException('تعارض في مفتاح عدم التكرار؛ أعد المحاولة.', [], 409);
253:             }
254: 
255:             if (! hash_equals($record->request_hash, $requestHash)) {
256:                 throw new BusinessException('مفتاح عدم التكرار هذا مستخدم مسبقًا مع بيانات مختلفة.', [], 409);
257:             }
258: 
259:             $ids = $record->response ?? [];
260:             $byId = StockMovement::query()->whereIn('id', $ids)->get()->keyBy('id');
261: 
262:             return array_values(array_filter(array_map(fn ($id) => $byId->get($id), $ids)));
263:         }
264:     }
265: 
266:     /**
267:      * @param  array{branch_id: int, location_id?: int|null, items: list<array{product_variant_id: int, adjustment_type: string, quantity: float|int|string, reason?: string|null}>}  $payload
268:      * @return list<StockMovement>
269:      */
270:     private function executeAdjustments(array $payload, int $userId): array
271:     {
272:         return DB::transaction(function () use ($payload, $userId): array {
273:             app(BranchAccess::class)->assertBranch($userId, (int) $payload['branch_id']);
274: 
275:             // Deactivation allows stock write-offs/decreases, but increases require active variants and locations.
276:             if (collect($payload['items'])->contains('adjustment_type', 'increase')) {
277:                 $variants = ProductVariant::query()->withTrashed()
278:                     ->whereIn('id', array_column($payload['items'], 'product_variant_id'))
279:                     ->get()->keyBy('id');
280:                 $location = ($payload['location_id'] ?? null) !== null ? Location::query()->find($payload['location_id']) : null;
281: 
282:                 foreach ($payload['items'] as $item) {
283:                     if ($item['adjustment_type'] !== 'increase') {
284:                         continue;
285:                     }
286:                     // Soft-deleted variants cannot receive new stock, but write-offs remain allowed.
287:                     $variant = $variants->get($item['product_variant_id']);
288:                     if ($variant === null || $variant->trashed() || ! $variant->is_active) {
289:                         throw new BusinessException('لا يمكن الإدخال على متغير معطّل؛ فعّله أولًا أو استخدم عمليات الإخراج لتصفية رصيده.');
290:                     }
291:                     if ($location !== null && ! $location->is_active) {
292:                         throw new BusinessException('لا يمكن الإدخال إلى موقع معطّل؛ فعّله أولًا.');
293:                     }
294:                 }
295:             }
296:             $levels = $this->lockLevels(array_map(fn ($item) => [
297:                 'product_variant_id' => $item['product_variant_id'],
298:                 'branch_id' => $payload['branch_id'],
299:                 'location_id' => $payload['location_id'] ?? null,
300:             ], $payload['items']));
301:             $movements = [];
302: 
303:             foreach ($payload['items'] as $item) {
304:                 // Apply adjustment directly to prelocked level instance.
305:                 $level = $levels->get($this->levelKey([
306:                     'product_variant_id' => $item['product_variant_id'],
307:                     'branch_id' => $payload['branch_id'],
308:                     'location_id' => $payload['location_id'] ?? null,
309:                 ]));
310:                 if (in_array($item['adjustment_type'], ['write_off_damaged', 'restore_damaged'], true)) {
311:                     $base = [
312:                         'product_variant_id' => $item['product_variant_id'],
313:                         'branch_id' => $payload['branch_id'], 'location_id' => $payload['location_id'] ?? null,
314:                         'created_by' => $userId, 'notes' => $item['reason'] ?? null,
315:                         'quantity' => -abs((float) $item['quantity']),
316:                     ];
317:                     $movements[] = $this->recordMovement([...$base, 'type' => StockMovementType::DamageRelease, 'affected_bucket' => StockBucket::Damaged], $level);
318:                     if ($item['adjustment_type'] === 'write_off_damaged') {
319:                         $movements[] = $this->recordMovement([...$base, 'type' => StockMovementType::DamageWriteOff, 'affected_bucket' => StockBucket::OnHand], $level);
320:                     }
321: 
322:                     continue;
323:                 }
324:                 [$type, $bucket, $sign] = match ($item['adjustment_type']) {
325:                     'increase' => [StockMovementType::AdjustmentIn, StockBucket::OnHand, 1],
326:                     'decrease' => [StockMovementType::AdjustmentOut, StockBucket::OnHand, -1],
327:                     'mark_damaged' => [StockMovementType::Damage, StockBucket::Damaged, 1],
328:                     default => throw new BusinessException('نوع تسوية غير معروف: '.$item['adjustment_type']),
329:                 };
330: 
331:                 $movements[] = $this->recordMovement([
332:                     'product_variant_id' => $item['product_variant_id'],
333:                     'branch_id' => $payload['branch_id'],
334:                     'location_id' => $payload['location_id'] ?? null,
335:                     'type' => $type,
336:                     'affected_bucket' => $bucket,
337:                     'quantity' => $sign * abs((float) $item['quantity']),
338:                     'created_by' => $userId,
339:                     'notes' => $item['reason'] ?? null,
340:                 ], $level);
341:             }
342: 
343:             return $movements;
344:         });
345:     }
346: 
347:     /**
348:      * Current stock level for a variant at a branch and location (read-only snapshot).
349:      */
350:     public function levelFor(int $variantId, int $branchId, ?int $locationId): ?StockLevel
351:     {
352:         return StockLevel::query()
353:             ->where('product_variant_id', $variantId)
354:             ->where('branch_id', $branchId)
355:             ->where('location_id', $locationId)
356:             ->first();
357:     }
358: 
359:     /**
360:      * Acquire every stock key before a multi-item operation, in one global order.
361:      *
362:      * @param  list<array{product_variant_id: int, branch_id: int, location_id?: int|null}>  $keys
363:      * @return Collection<string, StockLevel>
364:      */
365:     public function lockLevels(array $keys): Collection
366:     {
367:         if (DB::transactionLevel() === 0) {
368:             throw new \LogicException('Stock locks require an active transaction.');
369:         }
370:         // Enforce 5s lock timeout to fail fast with 409 Conflict instead of holding PHP worker threads.
371:         $keys = collect($keys)->unique(fn ($key) => $this->levelKey($key))
372:             ->sortBy(fn ($key) => [(int) $key['branch_id'], (int) ($key['location_id'] ?? 0), (int) $key['product_variant_id']]);
373:         if ($keys->isEmpty()) {
374:             return collect();
375:         }
376:         $now = now();
377:         $previousTimeout = DB::selectOne("SELECT current_setting('lock_timeout') AS value")->value;
378:         DB::statement("SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s'");
379: 
380:         try {
381:             // Lock variants before stock rows in every path, including callers
382:             // that prelock a batch of balances before recording movements.
383:             // H1: shared (FOR SHARE) lock — movements only need to block
384:             // concurrent variant edits (which take FOR UPDATE), while shared
385:             // locks don't block each other, so branches run in parallel.
386:             // The real serialization stays on stock_levels (FOR UPDATE below).
387:             $variantIds = $keys->pluck('product_variant_id')->unique()->sort()->values();
388:             $variants = ProductVariant::withTrashed()->whereIn('id', $variantIds)->orderBy('id')->sharedLock()->get();
389:             if ($variants->count() !== $variantIds->count()) {
390:                 throw new BusinessException('أحد المتغيرات لم يعد متاحًا.');
391:             }
392: 
393:             // Aggregate threshold checks must see earlier movements at other
394:             // locations in this branch. Lock only pairs with a branch threshold.
395:             $thresholdIds = $variants->filter(fn ($variant) => (float) $variant->reorder_level > 0)->modelKeys();
396:             $pairs = $keys->filter(fn ($key) => in_array((int) $key['product_variant_id'], $thresholdIds, true))
397:                 ->unique(fn ($key) => $key['branch_id'].':'.$key['product_variant_id'])
398:                 ->sortBy(fn ($key) => [(int) $key['branch_id'], (int) $key['product_variant_id']]);
399:             foreach ($pairs as $key) {
400:                 DB::statement('SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(?, 0))', [
401:                     'stock-threshold:'.$key['branch_id'].':'.$key['product_variant_id'],
402:                 ]);
403:             }
404: 
405:             // M2: batch location→branch ownership check inside the lock path,
406:             // so executeAdjustments cannot plant (branch A, location of branch
407:             // B) rows through the prelocked path. The composite FK migration
408:             // enforces the same invariant at the database level.
409:             $locationIds = $keys->pluck('location_id')->filter(fn ($id) => $id !== null)->unique()->values();
410:             if ($locationIds->isNotEmpty()) {
411:                 $branchByLocation = Location::query()->whereIn('id', $locationIds->all())->pluck('branch_id', 'id');
412:                 foreach ($keys as $key) {
413:                     if (($key['location_id'] ?? null) === null) {
414:                         continue;
415:                     }
416:                     $actual = $branchByLocation->get($key['location_id']);
417:                     if ($actual === null || (int) $actual !== (int) $key['branch_id']) {
418:                         throw new BusinessException('الموقع لا يتبع الفرع المحدد.');
419:                     }
420:                 }
421:             }
422: 
423:             // Seed missing stock level rows with insertOrIgnore before acquiring exclusive row locks.
424:             $rows = $keys->map(fn ($key) => [
425:                 'product_variant_id' => $key['product_variant_id'], 'branch_id' => $key['branch_id'],
426:                 'location_id' => $key['location_id'] ?? null, 'created_at' => $now, 'updated_at' => $now,
427:             ])->values();
428:             foreach ($rows->chunk(1000) as $chunk) {
429:                 DB::table('stock_levels')->insertOrIgnore($chunk->all());
430:             }
431: 
432:             $levels = StockLevel::query()->with(['variant:id,product_id,is_active,deleted_at,reorder_level', 'location:id,is_active'])->where(function ($query) use ($keys): void {
433:                 foreach ($keys->groupBy(fn ($key) => $key['branch_id'].':'.($key['location_id'] ?? 0)) as $group) {
434:                     $identity = $group->first();
435:                     $query->orWhere(fn ($scope) => $scope->where('branch_id', $identity['branch_id'])
436:                         ->where('location_id', $identity['location_id'] ?? null)
437:                         ->whereIn('product_variant_id', $group->pluck('product_variant_id')->all()));
438:                 }
439:             })->orderBy('branch_id')->orderByRaw('location_id ASC NULLS FIRST')->orderBy('product_variant_id')
440:                 ->lockForUpdate()->get()->keyBy(fn ($stock) => $this->levelKey($stock->getAttributes()));
441: 
442:             // M-11: بعد قفل صفوف الأرصدة يُفحص is_active للموقع والفرع تحت
443:             // قفل FOR SHARE — يقفل التعطيل (FOR UPDATE على نفس الصفوف)
444:             // فيتسلسل المساران: إما يرى المخزونُ التعطيلَ فيرفض، أو يرى
445:             // التعطيلُ الرصيدَ الجديد فيرفض. بلا هذا يدخل رصيد بين الفحص والتعطيل.
446:             $branchIds = $keys->pluck('branch_id')->map(fn ($id) => (int) $id)->unique()->values();
447:             if ($branchIds->isNotEmpty()) {
448:                 $inactiveBranches = Branch::query()->whereIn('id', $branchIds->all())->sharedLock()->pluck('is_active', 'id');
449:                 foreach ($branchIds as $branchId) {
450:                     if ($inactiveBranches->has($branchId) && ! (bool) $inactiveBranches->get($branchId)) {
451:                         throw new BusinessException('الفرع متوقف حالياً ولا يقبل حركات مخزنية.');
452:                     }
453:                 }
454:             }
455:             if ($locationIds->isNotEmpty()) {
456:                 $inactiveLocations = Location::query()->whereIn('id', $locationIds->all())->sharedLock()->pluck('is_active', 'id');
457:                 foreach ($locationIds as $locationId) {
458:                     if ($inactiveLocations->has($locationId) && ! (bool) $inactiveLocations->get($locationId)) {
459:                         throw new BusinessException('الموقع متوقف حالياً ولا يقبل حركات مخزنية.');
460:                     }
461:                 }
462:             }
463:         } catch (QueryException $e) {
464:             // Keep deadlocks as database exceptions so the outer transaction
465:             // can retry them. The API exception handler returns 409 if exhausted.
466:             if (($e->errorInfo[0] ?? $e->getCode()) === '55P03') {
467:                 throw new BusinessException('المخزون مشغول بعملية أخرى الآن؛ أعد المحاولة بعد لحظات.', [], 409);
468:             }
469: 
470:             throw $e;
471:         } catch (\Throwable $e) {
472:             DB::selectOne("SELECT set_config('lock_timeout', ?, true)", [$previousTimeout]);
473:             throw $e;
474:         }
475: 
476:         // Restore the caller's transaction-local setting, not the session default.
477:         // Failed PostgreSQL transactions must roll back before further SQL.
478:         DB::selectOne("SELECT set_config('lock_timeout', ?, true)", [$previousTimeout]);
479: 
480:         return $levels;
481:     }
482: 
483:     /**
484:      * Generates a composite key uniquely identifying a branch-location-variant level row.
485:      *
486:      * @param  array{branch_id: int|string, location_id?: int|string|null, product_variant_id: int|string}  $key
487:      */
488:     public function levelKey(array $key): string
489:     {
490:         return $key['branch_id'].':'.($key['location_id'] ?? 0).':'.$key['product_variant_id'];
491:     }
492: 
493:     /**
494:      * Resolves the primary receiving location for a branch, defaulting to designated receiving type.
495:      */
496:     public function receivingLocation(int $branchId, ?int $locationId = null): ?int
497:     {
498:         $query = Location::query()->where('branch_id', $branchId)->where('is_active', true);
499:         if ($locationId !== null) {
500:             $location = (clone $query)->whereKey($locationId)->first();
501:             if ($location === null || (string) $location->type->value === 'damaged') {
502:                 throw new BusinessException('موقع الاستلام غير نشط أو لا يتبع الفرع.');
503:             }
504: 
505:             return $locationId;
506:         }
507:         // Damaged locations are never eligible as receiving locations.
508:         $id = (clone $query)->where('type', '!=', 'damaged')
509:             ->orderByRaw("CASE WHEN type = 'receiving' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END")->orderBy('id')->value('id');
510:         if ($id === null) {
511:             throw new BusinessException('لا يوجد موقع استلام صالح للفرع.');
512:         }
513: 
514:         return (int) $id;
515:     }
516: 
517:     /**
518:      * Validates movement type compatibility with affected stock bucket and sign of quantity.
519:      */
520:     private function assertValidMovementSemantics(StockMovementType $type, StockBucket $bucket, int $units): void
521:     {
522:         // Default branch prevents unhandled match errors if new enum cases are introduced.
523:         [$allowed, $positive] = match ($type) {
524:             StockMovementType::ProductionReceipt, StockMovementType::PurchaseReceipt, StockMovementType::SaleReturn,
525:             StockMovementType::AdjustmentIn, StockMovementType::StocktakeGain, StockMovementType::TransferIn => [[StockBucket::OnHand], true],
526:             StockMovementType::Sale, StockMovementType::AdjustmentOut,
527:             StockMovementType::StocktakeLoss, StockMovementType::TransferOut,
528:             StockMovementType::DamageWriteOff => [[StockBucket::OnHand], false],
529:             StockMovementType::Damage => [[StockBucket::Damaged], true],
530:             StockMovementType::DamageRelease => [[StockBucket::Damaged], false],
531:             StockMovementType::Reserve => [[StockBucket::Reserved], true],
532:             StockMovementType::ReleaseReserve => [[StockBucket::Reserved], false],
533:             StockMovementType::TransferInTransit => [[StockBucket::InTransit], true],
534:             StockMovementType::TransferTransitRelease, StockMovementType::TransferShortage => [[StockBucket::InTransit], false],
535:             default => throw new BusinessException('نوع حركة مخزنية غير مدعوم: '.$type->value),
536:         };
537:         if (! in_array($bucket, $allowed, true) || ($units > 0) !== $positive) {
538:             throw new BusinessException('نوع حركة المخزون لا يطابق وعاء المخزون أو اتجاه الكمية.');
539:         }
540:     }
541: }
````

````php
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: declare(strict_types=1);
  4: 
  5: namespace App\Services;
  6: 
  7: use App\Exceptions\BusinessException;
  8: use App\Models\CustomerWalletTransaction;
  9: use App\Models\ProductionReceipt;
 10: use App\Models\SupplierDelivery;
 11: use App\Models\SupplierInvoice;
 12: use App\Models\SupplierPayment;
 13: use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
 14: use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\Relation;
 15: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
 16: 
 17: /**
 18:  * Scoped operation idempotency coordinator.
 19:  *
 20:  * Guarantees exactly-once execution for state-changing financial and inventory intake operations
 21:  * by tracking idempotency keys scoped to the authenticated actor and verifying request payload hashes.
 22:  */
 23: class OperationIdempotencyService
 24: {
 25:     // Result-only aliases avoid changing existing polymorphic relation queries.
 26:     private const RESULT_TYPES = [
 27:         'supplier_payment' => SupplierPayment::class,
 28:         'supplier_delivery' => SupplierDelivery::class,
 29:         'supplier_invoice' => SupplierInvoice::class,
 30:         'production_receipt' => ProductionReceipt::class,
 31:         'customer_wallet_transaction' => CustomerWalletTransaction::class,
 32:     ];
 33: 
 34:     /**
 35:      * Execute an operation idempotently or return the previously recorded result.
 36:      *
 37:      * @param  string  $operation  Unique operation identifier (e.g. purchase_receipt, supplier_payment)
 38:      * @param  Model  $actor  Authenticated user or customer instance
 39:      * @param  string|null  $key  Idempotency key supplied by the client
 40:      * @param  array<string, mixed>  $payload  Request payload for canonical hash comparison
 41:      * @param  callable(): Model  $execute  Operation execution callback
 42:      *
 43:      * @throws BusinessException
 44:      */
 45:     public function run(string $operation, Model $actor, ?string $key, array $payload, callable $execute): Model
 46:     {
 47:         if ($key === null || ! preg_match('/\A[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}\z/', $key)) {
 48:             throw new BusinessException('ترويسة Idempotency-Key مطلوبة (حتى 128 حرفًا إنجليزيًا أو رقمًا).');
 49:         }
 50:         $scope = ['operation' => $operation, 'actor_type' => $actor->getMorphClass(), 'actor_id' => $actor->getKey(), 'key' => $key];
 51:         $hash = IdempotencyFingerprint::hash($payload);
 52: 
 53:         return DB::transaction(function () use ($scope, $hash, $execute): Model {
 54:             $previousTimeout = DB::selectOne("SELECT current_setting('lock_timeout') AS value")->value;
 55:             DB::statement("SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '3s'");
 56:             $inserted = DB::table('operation_idempotency_keys')->insertOrIgnore([
 57:                 ...$scope, 'request_hash' => $hash, 'created_at' => now(),
 58:             ]);
 59:             $record = DB::table('operation_idempotency_keys')->where($scope)->lockForUpdate()->first();
 60:             DB::selectOne("SELECT set_config('lock_timeout', ?, true)", [$previousTimeout]);
 61:             if ($record === null) {
 62:                 throw new BusinessException('العملية مشغولة؛ أعد المحاولة بنفس المفتاح.', [], 409);
 63:             }
 64:             if (! $inserted) {
 65:                 if (! hash_equals($record->request_hash, $hash)) {
 66:                     throw new BusinessException('مفتاح عدم التكرار مستخدم مع بيانات مختلفة.', [], 409);
 67:                 }
 68:                 $result = self::findResult($record->result_type ?? null, $record->result_id ?? null);
 69:                 if ($result === null) {
 70:                     throw new BusinessException('العملية سبق تنفيذها ثم أزيل مستندها؛ استخدم عملية جديدة.', [], 409);
 71:                 }
 72: 
 73:                 return $result;
 74:             }
 75:             $result = $execute();
 76:             DB::table('operation_idempotency_keys')->where($scope)->update([
 77:                 // M1: store the morph alias, not the FQCN — a class rename
 78:                 // must not turn every replay into a fatal error.
 79:                 'result_type' => array_search($result::class, self::RESULT_TYPES, true) ?: $result->getMorphClass(), 'result_id' => $result->getKey(),
 80:             ]);
 81: 
 82:             return $result;
 83:             // Callbacks may upload files or invoke external services. Let the
 84:             // client retry a failed transaction instead of repeating those effects.
 85:         }, 1);
 86:     }
 87: 
 88:     /**
 89:      * Resolve a stored idempotency result via its morph alias.
 90:      *
 91:      * Legacy rows stored the FQCN; resolve those directly for BC. New rows
 92:      * store getMorphClass() and resolve through the morph map.
 93:      */
 94:     private static function findResult(mixed $type, mixed $id): ?Model
 95:     {
 96:         if (! is_string($type) || $type === '' || $id === null) {
 97:             return null;
 98:         }
 99: 
100:         $class = self::RESULT_TYPES[$type] ?? Relation::getMorphedModel($type) ?? $type;
101: 
102:         if (! is_string($class) || ! is_subclass_of($class, Model::class)) {
103:             return null;
104:         }
105: 
106:         /** @var Model $instance */
107:         $instance = new $class;
108: 
109:         if (! $instance instanceof Model) {
110:             return null;
111:         }
112: 
113:         return $instance->newQuery()->find($id);
114:     }
115: }
````

````php
 17: /**
 18:  * Handles finished goods manufacturing intake and inventory ledger posting.
 19:  *
 20:  * Recalculates weighted average cost (WAC) for manufactured variants across all branches
 21:  * and records production receipt movements into branch on-hand inventory.
 22:  */
 23: class ProductionReceiptService
 24: {
 25:     public function __construct(private readonly InventoryService $inventory) {}
 26: 
 27:     /**
 28:      * Intake a manufactured batch into branch inventory and update variant landed cost.
 29:      *
 30:      * @param  array{branch_id: int, batch_number: string, items: list<array{product_variant_id: int, quantity: int|float, unit_cost: string|float|int}>, location_id?: int|null, notes?: string|null}  $data
 31:      * @param  int  $userId
 32:      * @param  string  $key  Idempotency key for request deduplication
 33:      * @return ProductionReceipt
 34:      *
 35:      * @throws BusinessException
 36:      * @throws UniqueConstraintViolationException
 37:      */
 38:     public function receive(array $data, int $userId, string $key): ProductionReceipt
 39:     {
 40:         app(BranchAccess::class)->assertBranch($userId, (int) $data['branch_id']);
 41:         $hash = IdempotencyFingerprint::hash($data);
 42:         $existing = ProductionReceipt::where('created_by', $userId)->where('idempotency_key', $key)->first();
 43:         if ($existing) {
 44:             return $this->replay($existing, $hash);
 45:         }
 46: 
 47:         try {
 48:             return DB::transaction(function () use ($data, $userId, $key, $hash): ProductionReceipt {
 49:                 DB::statement("SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s'");
 50:                 $branch = Branch::whereKey($data['branch_id'])->sharedLock()->firstOrFail();
 51:                 if (! $branch->is_active) {
 52:                     throw new BusinessException('الفرع غير نشط.');
 53:                 }
 54:                 $variants = ProductVariant::whereIn('id', array_column($data['items'], 'product_variant_id'))
 55:                     ->with('product:id,name_ar')->orderBy('id')->lockForUpdate()->get()->keyBy('id');
 56: 
 57:                 $sortedItems = collect($data['items'])->sortBy('product_variant_id')->values()->all();
 58:                 $itemsWithLabels = [];
 59: 
 60:                 foreach ($sortedItems as $item) {
 61:                     $variant = $variants->get($item['product_variant_id']);
 62:                     if (! $variant || ! $variant->is_active || ! $variant->product) {
 63:                         throw new BusinessException('أحد أصناف الإنتاج غير متاح.');
 64:                     }
 65:                     $itemsWithLabels[] = [
 66:                         ...$item,
 67:                         'label' => $variant->product->name_ar.' / '.$variant->sku,
 68:                     ];
 69:                 }
 70: 
 71:                 $receipt = ProductionReceipt::create([
 72:                     ...$data, 'items' => $itemsWithLabels, 'created_by' => $userId, 'idempotency_key' => $key, 'request_hash' => $hash,
 73:                 ]);
 74: 
 75:                 foreach ($sortedItems as $item) {
 76:                     $variant = $variants->get($item['product_variant_id']);
 77:                     $quantity = (int) $item['quantity'];
 78:                     $unitCost = bcadd((string) $item['unit_cost'], '0', 4);
 79:                     // H4: bcmath weighted average — float loses precision once
 80:                     // on_hand * cost crosses 2^53, silently biasing landed cost.
 81:                     // F12: lock this variant's stock_levels rows before summing so
 82:                     // the average is computed on a frozen balance even if a
 83:                     // concurrent movement path ever skips the variant lock.
 84:                     $lockedLevelIds = StockLevel::where('product_variant_id', $variant->id)->orderBy('id')->lockForUpdate()->pluck('id');
 85:                     // In-transit goods are still owned inventory. Excluding them
 86:                     // would change the average merely because a transfer shipped.
 87:                     $onHandStr = (string) StockLevel::whereIn('id', $lockedLevelIds)
 88:                         ->sum(DB::raw('on_hand + in_transit'));
 89:                     $onHandStr = bccomp($onHandStr, '0', 4) < 0 ? '0' : $onHandStr;
 90:                     $costStr = (string) $variant->cost_price;
 91:                     $unitStr = $unitCost;
 92:                     $total = bcadd(bcmul($onHandStr, $costStr, 8), bcmul((string) $quantity, $unitStr, 8), 8);
 93:                     $average = bcadd(bcdiv($total, bcadd($onHandStr, (string) $quantity, 4), 5), '0.00005', 4);
 94:                     $variant->update(['cost_price' => $average, 'last_cost_price' => $unitCost]);
 95:                     $this->inventory->recordMovement([
 96:                         'product_variant_id' => $variant->id,
 97:                         'branch_id' => (int) $data['branch_id'],
 98:                         'location_id' => $data['location_id'] ?? null,
 99:                         'type' => StockMovementType::ProductionReceipt,
100:                         'affected_bucket' => StockBucket::OnHand,
101:                         'quantity' => $quantity, 'unit_cost' => $unitCost,
102:                         'reference_type' => ProductionReceipt::class, 'reference_id' => $receipt->id,
103:                         'created_by' => $userId, 'notes' => $data['notes'] ?? null,
104:                     ]);
105:                 }
106: 
107:                 return $receipt;
108:             }, 3);
109:         } catch (UniqueConstraintViolationException $exception) {
110:             $existing = ProductionReceipt::where('created_by', $userId)->where('idempotency_key', $key)->first();
111:             if ($existing) {
112:                 return $this->replay($existing, $hash);
113:             }
114:             if (ProductionReceipt::whereRaw('LOWER(batch_number) = ?', [mb_strtolower($data['batch_number'])])->exists()) {
115:                 throw new BusinessException('رقم دفعة الإنتاج مسجل بالفعل؛ راجع سجل الاستلام.', [], 409);
116:             }
117:             throw $exception;
118:         }
119:     }
120: 
121:     /**
122:      * Return previously created receipt if request payload hash matches idempotency key.
123:      */
124:     private function replay(ProductionReceipt $receipt, string $hash): ProductionReceipt
125:     {
126:         if (! hash_equals($receipt->request_hash, $hash)) {
127:             throw new BusinessException('مفتاح الطلب مستخدم مع بيانات مختلفة.', [], 409);
128:         }
129: 
130:         return $receipt;
131:     }
132: }
````

````php
119:     /**
120:      * Generates a time-series sales report grouped by period and optional dimension.
121:      *
122:      * @param  string  $from  Start date (YYYY-MM-DD)
123:      * @param  string  $to  End date (YYYY-MM-DD)
124:      * @param  string  $granularity  Aggregation bucket ('daily' or 'monthly')
125:      * @param  string|null  $groupBy  Optional breakdown dimension ('branch', 'channel', 'payment_method', 'cashier')
126:      * @param  int|null  $branchId  Branch filter
127:      * @return array{rows: list<array<string, mixed>>, totals: array<string, mixed>} Aggregated sales report
128:      */
129:     public function salesReport(string $from, string $to, string $granularity = 'daily', ?string $groupBy = null, ?int $branchId = null): array
130:     {
131:         return StatementBudget::run(150000, fn (): array => $this->calculateSalesReport($from, $to, $granularity, $groupBy, $branchId));
132:     }
133: 
134:     private function calculateSalesReport(string $from, string $to, string $granularity = 'daily', ?string $groupBy = null, ?int $branchId = null): array
135:     {
136:         [$periodStart, $periodEnd] = $this->periodBounds($from, $to);
137:         $zone = str_replace("'", "''", (string) config('app.business_timezone', 'Africa/Cairo'));
138:         $localCreated = "timezone('{$zone}', o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')";
139:         $periodExpr = $granularity === 'monthly'
140:             ? "DATE_TRUNC('month', {$localCreated})::date"
141:             : "DATE({$localCreated})";
142: 
143:         $query = $this->salesEntries($branchId, 'o')
144:             ->where('o.created_at', '>=', $periodStart)->where('o.created_at', '<', $periodEnd);
145: 
146:         $selects = [
147:             "{$periodExpr} AS period",
148:             'COALESCE(SUM(sale_count), 0) AS orders_count',
149:             'COALESCE(SUM(o.subtotal), 0) AS gross_sales',
150:             'COALESCE(SUM(o.discount_amount), 0) AS discounts',
151:             'COALESCE(SUM(o.tax_amount), 0) AS tax',
152:             'COALESCE(SUM(o.shipping_cost), 0) AS shipping',
153:             'COALESCE(SUM(o.grand_total), 0) AS net_sales',
154:         ];
155:         $groups = [$periodExpr];
156: 
157:         if ($groupBy === 'branch') {
158:             $query->leftJoin('branches as b', 'b.id', '=', 'o.allocated_branch_id');
159:             $selects[] = 'o.allocated_branch_id AS group_key';
160:             $selects[] = 'b.name AS group_label';
161:             $groups[] = 'o.allocated_branch_id';
162:             $groups[] = 'b.name';
163:         } elseif ($groupBy === 'channel') {
164:             $selects[] = 'o.channel AS group_key';
165:             $groups[] = 'o.channel';
166:         } elseif ($groupBy === 'payment_method') {
167:             $selects[] = 'o.payment_method AS group_key';
168:             $groups[] = 'o.payment_method';
169:         } elseif ($groupBy === 'cashier') {
170:             $query->join('pos_shifts as ps', 'ps.id', '=', 'o.pos_shift_id')
171:                 ->leftJoin('users as u', 'u.id', '=', 'ps.user_id');
172:             $selects[] = 'ps.user_id AS group_key';
173:             $selects[] = 'u.name AS group_label';
174:             $groups[] = 'ps.user_id';
175:             $groups[] = 'u.name';
176:         }
177: 
178:         $rows = $query
179:             ->selectRaw(implode(', ', $selects))
180:             ->groupByRaw(implode(', ', $groups))
181:             ->orderBy('period')
182:             ->get()
183:             ->map(fn ($row): array => [
184:                 'period' => (string) $row->period,
185:                 'group_key' => $row->group_key ?? null,
186:                 'group_label' => $row->group_label ?? ($row->group_key ?? null),
187:                 'orders_count' => (int) $row->orders_count,
188:                 'gross_sales' => (float) $row->gross_sales,
189:                 'discounts' => (float) $row->discounts,
190:                 'tax' => (float) $row->tax,
191:                 'shipping' => (float) $row->shipping,
192:                 'net_sales' => (float) $row->net_sales,
193:             ])->all();
194: 
195:         $totals = $this->salesEntries($branchId)
196:             ->where('created_at', '>=', $periodStart)->where('created_at', '<', $periodEnd)
197:             ->selectRaw('COALESCE(SUM(sale_count), 0) AS orders_count, COALESCE(SUM(subtotal), 0) AS gross_sales, COALESCE(SUM(discount_amount), 0) AS discounts, COALESCE(SUM(tax_amount), 0) AS tax, COALESCE(SUM(shipping_cost), 0) AS shipping, COALESCE(SUM(grand_total), 0) AS net_sales')
198:             ->first();
199: 
200:         return [
201:             'rows' => $rows,
202:             'totals' => [
203:                 'orders_count' => (int) $totals->orders_count,
204:                 'gross_sales' => (float) $totals->gross_sales,
205:                 'discounts' => (float) $totals->discounts,
206:                 'tax' => (float) $totals->tax,
207:                 'shipping' => (float) $totals->shipping,
208:                 'net_sales' => (float) $totals->net_sales,
209:             ],
210:         ];
211:     }

213:     /**
214:      * Computes inventory valuation and identifies dead stock without physical movement within a threshold.
215:      *
216:      * @param  int  $deadDays  Inactivity threshold in days
217:      * @param  int|null  $branchId  Branch filter
218:      * @return array{valuation: list<array<string, mixed>>, total_value: float, dead_stock: list<array<string, mixed>>, dead_stock_days: int}
219:      */
220:     public function inventoryReport(int $deadDays = 90, ?int $branchId = null): array
221:     {
222:         return StatementBudget::run(150000, fn (): array => $this->calculateInventoryReport($deadDays, $branchId));
223:     }
224: 
225:     private function calculateInventoryReport(int $deadDays = 90, ?int $branchId = null): array
226:     {
227:         $valuation = DB::table('stock_levels as sl')->when($branchId !== null, fn ($q) => $q->where('sl.branch_id', $branchId))
228:             ->join('product_variants as pv', 'pv.id', '=', 'sl.product_variant_id')
229:             ->leftJoin('branches as b', 'b.id', '=', 'sl.branch_id')
230:             ->selectRaw('sl.branch_id, b.name AS branch_name, COUNT(DISTINCT sl.product_variant_id) AS variants_count, COALESCE(SUM(sl.on_hand), 0) AS total_qty, COALESCE(SUM(sl.on_hand * COALESCE(pv.cost_price, 0)), 0) AS total_value')
231:             ->groupBy('sl.branch_id', 'b.name')
232:             ->orderByDesc('total_value')
233:             ->get()
234:             ->map(fn ($row): array => [
235:                 'branch_id' => (int) $row->branch_id,
236:                 'branch_name' => $row->branch_name,
237:                 'variants_count' => (int) $row->variants_count,
238:                 'total_qty' => (float) $row->total_qty,
239:                 'total_value' => (float) $row->total_value,
240:             ])->all();
241: 
242:         $totalValue = (float) (DB::table('stock_levels as sl')->when($branchId !== null, fn ($q) => $q->where('sl.branch_id', $branchId))
243:             ->join('product_variants as pv', 'pv.id', '=', 'sl.product_variant_id')
244:             ->selectRaw('COALESCE(SUM(sl.on_hand * COALESCE(pv.cost_price, 0)), 0) AS v')
245:             ->first()?->v ?? 0);
246: 
247:         $deadStock = DB::table('stock_levels as sl')->when($branchId !== null, fn ($q) => $q->where('sl.branch_id', $branchId))
248:             ->join('product_variants as pv', 'pv.id', '=', 'sl.product_variant_id')
249:             ->leftJoin('products as p', 'p.id', '=', 'pv.product_id')
250:             ->leftJoinLateral(
251:                 // Exclude reserve/release movements as temporary holds do not represent actual stock activity.
252:                 DB::table('stock_movements')->when($branchId !== null, fn ($q) => $q->where('branch_id', $branchId))
253:                     ->whereColumn('product_variant_id', 'sl.product_variant_id')
254:                     ->whereNotIn('type', ['reserve', 'release_reserve'])
255:                     ->selectRaw('MAX(created_at) AS last_movement_at'),
256:                 'lm',
257:             )
258:             ->selectRaw('sl.product_variant_id, pv.sku, p.name_ar AS product_name, SUM(sl.on_hand) AS on_hand, COALESCE(SUM(sl.on_hand * COALESCE(pv.cost_price, 0)), 0) AS tied_value, lm.last_movement_at')
259:             ->groupBy('sl.product_variant_id', 'pv.sku', 'p.name_ar', 'lm.last_movement_at')
260:             ->havingRaw('SUM(sl.on_hand) > 0')
261:             ->havingRaw('(lm.last_movement_at IS NULL OR lm.last_movement_at < NOW() - (? * INTERVAL \'1 day\'))', [$deadDays])
262:             ->orderByDesc('tied_value')
263:             ->limit(100)
264:             ->get()
265:             ->map(fn ($row): array => [
266:                 'product_variant_id' => (int) $row->product_variant_id,
267:                 'sku' => $row->sku,
268:                 'product_name' => $row->product_name,
269:                 'on_hand' => (float) $row->on_hand,
270:                 'tied_value' => (float) $row->tied_value,
271:                 'last_movement_at' => $row->last_movement_at,
272:             ])->all();
273: 
274:         return [
275:             'valuation' => $valuation,
276:             'total_value' => $totalValue,
277:             'dead_stock' => $deadStock,
278:             'dead_stock_days' => $deadDays,
279:         ];
280:     }
281: 
282:     /**
283:      * Computes gross and net profit matching recognized sales revenue against cost of goods sold and expenses.
284:      *
285:      * @param  string  $from  Start date (YYYY-MM-DD)
286:      * @param  string  $to  End date (YYYY-MM-DD)
287:      * @param  int|null  $branchId  Branch filter
288:      * @return array<string, float> Profit metrics including revenue, COGS, and expenses
289:      */
290:     public function profitReport(string $from, string $to, ?int $branchId = null): array
291:     {
292:         return StatementBudget::run(150000, fn (): array => $this->calculateProfitReport($from, $to, $branchId));
293:     }
294: 
295:     private function calculateProfitReport(string $from, string $to, ?int $branchId = null): array
296:     {
297:         [$periodStart, $periodEnd] = $this->periodBounds($from, $to);
298:         // Revenue recognition aligns with COGS ledger timestamps to prevent cross-period margin distortion.
299:         $saleDates = DB::table('stock_movements')->where('type', 'sale')
300:             ->whereIn('reference_type', array_unique([Order::class, (new Order)->getMorphClass()]))
301:             ->selectRaw('reference_id, MIN(created_at) AS recognized_at')->groupBy('reference_id');
302:         $revenue = (float) $this->salesEntries($branchId)
303:             ->leftJoinSub($saleDates, 'sales_event', 'sales_event.reference_id', '=', 'entries.id')
304:             ->where(fn ($q) => $q->where('entries.sale_count', 0)->orWhereNotNull('sales_event.recognized_at'))
305:             ->whereRaw('CASE WHEN entries.sale_count = 1 THEN sales_event.recognized_at ELSE entries.created_at END >= ?', [$periodStart])
306:             ->whereRaw('CASE WHEN entries.sale_count = 1 THEN sales_event.recognized_at ELSE entries.created_at END < ?', [$periodEnd])
307:             ->selectRaw('COALESCE(SUM(entries.subtotal - entries.discount_amount), 0) AS revenue')->value('revenue');
308: 
309:         $cogs = (float) (DB::table('stock_movements as sm')->when($branchId !== null, fn ($q) => $q->where('sm.branch_id', $branchId))
310:             ->whereIn('sm.type', ['sale', 'sale_return'])
311:             ->where('sm.created_at', '>=', $periodStart)->where('sm.created_at', '<', $periodEnd)
312:             ->selectRaw('COALESCE(SUM(-sm.quantity * sm.unit_cost), 0) AS c')
313:             ->first()?->c ?? 0);
314: 
315:         $expenses = (float) DB::table('expenses')->when($branchId !== null, fn ($q) => $q->where('branch_id', $branchId))
316:             ->whereNull('voided_at')
317:             ->whereBetween('expense_date', [$from, $to])
318:             ->sum('amount');
319: 
320:         $gross = $revenue - $cogs;
321:         $missingCosts = DB::table('stock_movements')->whereIn('type', ['sale', 'sale_return'])
322:             ->whereNull('unit_cost')->where('created_at', '>=', $periodStart)->where('created_at', '<', $periodEnd)
323:             ->when($branchId !== null, fn ($q) => $q->where('branch_id', $branchId))->count();
324: 
325:         return [
326:             'net_sales_revenue' => $revenue,
327:             'missing_cost_movements' => $missingCosts,
328:             'cogs' => $cogs,
329:             'gross_profit' => $gross,
330:             'total_expenses' => $expenses,
331:             'net_profit' => $gross - $expenses,
332:         ];
333:     }
334: 
335:     /**
336:      * Generates supplier debt balances and accounts payable aging buckets.
337:      *
338:      * @return list<array<string, mixed>> Supplier balances with aging breakdowns
339:      */
340:     public function suppliersReport(): array
341:     {
342:         return StatementBudget::run(150000, fn (): array => $this->calculateSuppliersReport());
343:     }
344: 
345:     private function calculateSuppliersReport(): array
346:     {
347:         $aging = DB::table('supplier_invoices')
348:             ->selectRaw(implode(', ', [
349:                 'supplier_id',
350:                 'COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS total_purchases',
351:                 'COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (total_amount - paid_amount) > 0 AND (due_date IS NULL OR due_date >= CURRENT_DATE) THEN total_amount - paid_amount END), 0) AS not_due',
352:                 "COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (total_amount - paid_amount) > 0 AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND due_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN total_amount - paid_amount END), 0) AS overdue_1_30",
353:                 "COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (total_amount - paid_amount) > 0 AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' AND due_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' THEN total_amount - paid_amount END), 0) AS overdue_31_60",
354:                 "COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (total_amount - paid_amount) > 0 AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' AND due_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN total_amount - paid_amount END), 0) AS overdue_61_90",
355:                 "COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (total_amount - paid_amount) > 0 AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN total_amount - paid_amount END), 0) AS overdue_90_plus",
356:             ]))
357:             ->whereIn('status', ['posted', 'partially_paid', 'paid'])
358:             ->groupBy('supplier_id');
359: 
360:         return DB::table('suppliers as s')
361:             ->leftJoinSub($aging, 'ag', 'ag.supplier_id', '=', 's.id')
362:             ->selectRaw('s.id, s.name, s.current_balance, COALESCE(ag.total_purchases, 0) AS total_purchases, COALESCE(ag.not_due, 0) AS not_due, COALESCE(ag.overdue_1_30, 0) AS overdue_1_30, COALESCE(ag.overdue_31_60, 0) AS overdue_31_60, COALESCE(ag.overdue_61_90, 0) AS overdue_61_90, COALESCE(ag.overdue_90_plus, 0) AS overdue_90_plus')
363:             ->orderBy('s.name')
364:             ->get()
365:             ->map(fn ($row): array => [
366:                 'supplier_id' => (int) $row->id,
367:                 'supplier_name' => $row->name,
368:                 'current_balance' => (float) $row->current_balance,
369:                 'total_purchases' => (float) $row->total_purchases,
370:                 'aging' => [
371:                     'not_due' => (float) $row->not_due,
372:                     'overdue_1_30' => (float) $row->overdue_1_30,
373:                     'overdue_31_60' => (float) $row->overdue_31_60,
374:                     'overdue_61_90' => (float) $row->overdue_61_90,
375:                     'overdue_90_plus' => (float) $row->overdue_90_plus,
376:                 ],
377:             ])->all();
378:     }
379: 
380:     /**
381:      * Reports POS cash drawer sessions, closing cash reconciliation, and variance tracking.
382:      *
383:      * @param  string  $from  Start date (YYYY-MM-DD)
384:      * @param  string  $to  End date (YYYY-MM-DD)
385:      * @param  bool  $onlyDifferences  Filter only shifts with non-zero cash variance
386:      * @param  int|null  $branchId  Branch filter
387:      * @return array{rows: list<array<string, mixed>>, totals: array<string, mixed>} Shift report
388:      */
389:     public function shiftsReport(string $from, string $to, bool $onlyDifferences = false, ?int $branchId = null): array
390:     {
391:         return StatementBudget::run(150000, fn (): array => $this->calculateShiftsReport($from, $to, $onlyDifferences, $branchId));
392:     }
393: 
394:     private function calculateShiftsReport(string $from, string $to, bool $onlyDifferences = false, ?int $branchId = null): array
395:     {
396:         [$periodStart, $periodEnd] = $this->periodBounds($from, $to);
397:         $base = fn () => DB::table('pos_shifts as ps')->when($branchId !== null, fn ($q) => $q->where('ps.branch_id', $branchId))
398:             ->leftJoin('users as u', 'u.id', '=', 'ps.user_id')
399:             ->leftJoin('branches as b', 'b.id', '=', 'ps.branch_id')
400:             ->where('ps.opened_at', '>=', $periodStart)->where('ps.opened_at', '<', $periodEnd)
401:             ->when($onlyDifferences, fn ($q) => $q->whereNotNull('ps.cash_difference')->where('ps.cash_difference', '!=', 0));
402: 
403:         $rows = $base()
404:             ->selectRaw('ps.id, ps.shift_number, ps.user_id, u.name AS cashier_name, ps.branch_id, b.name AS branch_name, ps.status, ps.opened_at, ps.closed_at, ps.cash_sales_total, ps.card_sales_total, ps.cash_returns_total, ps.cash_expenses_total, ps.expected_closing_cash, ps.actual_closing_cash, ps.cash_difference')
405:             ->orderByDesc('ps.opened_at')
406:             ->limit(200)
407:             ->get()
408:             ->map(fn ($row): array => [
409:                 'shift_id' => (int) $row->id,
410:                 'shift_number' => $row->shift_number,
411:                 'cashier_id' => (int) $row->user_id,
412:                 'cashier_name' => $row->cashier_name,
413:                 'branch_id' => (int) $row->branch_id,
414:                 'branch_name' => $row->branch_name,
415:                 'status' => $row->status,
416:                 'opened_at' => $row->opened_at,
417:                 'closed_at' => $row->closed_at,
418:                 'cash_sales_total' => (float) $row->cash_sales_total,
419:                 'card_sales_total' => (float) $row->card_sales_total,
420:                 'cash_returns_total' => (float) $row->cash_returns_total,
421:                 'cash_expenses_total' => (float) $row->cash_expenses_total,
422:                 'expected_closing_cash' => (float) $row->expected_closing_cash,
423:                 'actual_closing_cash' => $row->actual_closing_cash !== null ? (float) $row->actual_closing_cash : null,
424:                 'cash_difference' => $row->cash_difference !== null ? (float) $row->cash_difference : null,
425:                 'has_difference' => $row->cash_difference !== null && (float) $row->cash_difference !== 0.0,
426:             ])->all();
427: 
428:         $totals = $base()
429:             ->selectRaw('COUNT(*) AS shifts_count, COALESCE(SUM(ps.cash_sales_total), 0) AS cash_sales, COALESCE(SUM(ps.card_sales_total), 0) AS card_sales, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ps.cash_difference IS NOT NULL AND ps.cash_difference != 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS shifts_with_difference')
430:             ->first();
431: 
432:         return [
433:             'rows' => $rows,
434:             'totals' => [
435:                 'shifts_count' => (int) $totals->shifts_count,
436:                 'cash_sales' => (float) $totals->cash_sales,
437:                 'card_sales' => (float) $totals->card_sales,
438:                 'shifts_with_difference' => (int) $totals->shifts_with_difference,
439:             ],
440:         ];
441:     }
442: 
443:     // Combines original sales with POS, RMA, and manual return reversals into a unified signed ledger stream.
444:     private function salesEntries(?int $branchId, string $alias = 'entries'): Builder
445:     {
446:         $columns = 'o.id, o.channel, o.allocated_branch_id, o.pos_shift_id, o.payment_method, o.created_at, o.subtotal, o.discount_amount, o.tax_amount, o.shipping_cost, o.grand_total, 1 AS sale_count';
447:         $sales = DB::table('orders as o')->whereNull('o.return_of_order_id')
448:             ->whereIn('o.status', [...self::SALES_STATUSES, 'returned'])->selectRaw($columns);
449:         $posReturns = DB::table('orders as o')->whereNotNull('o.return_of_order_id')
450:             ->selectRaw('o.id, o.channel, o.allocated_branch_id, o.pos_shift_id, o.payment_method, o.created_at, -o.subtotal, -o.discount_amount, -o.tax_amount, -o.shipping_cost, -o.grand_total, 0 AS sale_count');
451:         $rmaReturns = DB::table('return_requests as r')->join('orders as o', 'o.id', '=', 'r.order_id')
452:             ->whereIn('r.status', ['received', 'refunded'])->whereNotNull('r.received_at')
453:             ->selectRaw('o.id, o.channel, r.branch_id AS allocated_branch_id, o.pos_shift_id, o.payment_method, r.received_at AS created_at, -r.total_refund_amount AS subtotal, 0 AS discount_amount, 0 AS tax_amount, 0 AS shipping_cost, -r.total_refund_amount AS grand_total, 0 AS sale_count');
454:         $manualReturns = DB::table('orders as o')->where('o.status', 'returned')->whereNull('o.return_of_order_id')
455:             ->whereNotExists(fn ($q) => $q->selectRaw('1')->from('orders as pos_return')->whereColumn('pos_return.return_of_order_id', 'o.id'))
456:             ->whereNotExists(fn ($q) => $q->selectRaw('1')->from('return_requests as r')->whereColumn('r.order_id', 'o.id')->whereIn('r.status', ['received', 'refunded']))
457:             ->selectRaw('o.id, o.channel, o.allocated_branch_id, o.pos_shift_id, o.payment_method, o.updated_at AS created_at, -o.subtotal, -o.discount_amount, -o.tax_amount, -o.shipping_cost, -o.grand_total, 0 AS sale_count');
458: 
459:         return DB::query()->fromSub($sales->unionAll($posReturns)->unionAll($rmaReturns)->unionAll($manualReturns), $alias)
460:             ->when($branchId !== null, fn ($q) => $q->where($alias.'.allocated_branch_id', $branchId));
461:     }
462: 
463:     private function periodBounds(string $from, string $to): array
464:     {
465:         $zone = config('app.business_timezone', 'Africa/Cairo');
466:         $start = CarbonImmutable::parse($from, $zone)->startOfDay();
467:         $end = CarbonImmutable::parse($to, $zone)->startOfDay();
468:         if ($end->lessThan($start) || $start->diffInDays($end) > 365) {
469:             throw ValidationException::withMessages(['to' => 'فترة التقرير يجب ألا تتجاوز 366 يومًا.']);
470:         }
471: 
472:         return [$start->utc()->toDateTimeString(), $end->addDay()->utc()->toDateTimeString()];
473:     }
474: }
````

````php
176:     private function staticSettings(): array

178:         $read = function (): array {
179:             return Setting::query()

181:                 ->orderBy('group')
182:                 ->orderBy('key')
183:                 ->get()
184:                 ->groupBy('group')
185:                 ->map(fn ($settings): array => $settings
186:                     ->mapWithKeys(fn (Setting $setting): array => [
187:                         $setting->key => $this->castValue($setting->value, $setting->type),
188:                     ])
189:                     ->all())
190:                 ->all();
191:         };
192: 
193:         $inTransaction = DB::transactionLevel() > 0;
194:         if ($inTransaction && $this->transactionSnapshot !== null) {
195:             return $this->transactionSnapshot;
196:         }
197:         if ($inTransaction && $this->uncommittedSettings) {
198:             return $this->transactionSnapshot = $read();
199:         }
200:         $version = Cache::get(self::CACHE_VERSION_KEY);
201:         if (! is_string($version)) {
202:             Cache::add(self::CACHE_VERSION_KEY, (string) Str::uuid());
203:             $version = Cache::get(self::CACHE_VERSION_KEY);
204:         }
205: 
206:         // M-6: خارج الـ transactions تُحفظ النتيجة في ذاكرة الطلب — كل get()

208:         if ($this->requestCache !== null) {
209:             return $this->requestCache;
210:         }
211:         $key = self::CACHE_KEY.':'.$version;
212:         if ($inTransaction) {

214:             return $this->transactionSnapshot = Cache::get($key) ?? $read();
215:         }
216: 
217:         $result = Cache::remember($key, self::CACHE_TTL_SECONDS, $read);
218:         // كاتب متأخر قد يدير النسخة أثناء القراءة — لقطة قديمة لا تُحفظ
219:         // في ذاكرة الطلب، وإلا التصقت القيمة القديمة بباقي الطلب.
220:         if (Cache::get(self::CACHE_VERSION_KEY) === $version) {

224:         return $result;

274:     private function assertNumberingDoesNotCollide(array $settings, array $after): void
275:     {
276:         foreach ($this->numberingDefinitions() as $type => $definition) {
277:             $keys = [$definition['prefix'], $definition['next'], $definition['padding']];
278:             $target = self::NUMBERING_TARGETS[$type] ?? null;
279:             if ($target === null || array_intersect($keys, array_keys($settings)) === []) {
280:                 continue;
281:             }
282: 
283:             $prefix = array_key_exists($definition['prefix'], $after)
284:                 ? (string) $after[$definition['prefix']]
285:                 : (string) $this->get($definition['prefix'], '');
286:             $padding = array_key_exists($definition['padding'], $after)
287:                 ? max(0, (int) $after[$definition['padding']])
288:                 : max(0, (int) $this->get($definition['padding'], 0));
289:             $next = array_key_exists($definition['next'], $after)
290:                 ? (int) $after[$definition['next']]
291:                 : ($type === 'movement' ? $this->nextMovementNumber() : $this->nextDocumentNumber($type));
292: 
293:             // Collision scan covers the next number AND any future number:
294:             // any existing document sharing this prefix whose numeric suffix
295:             // is >= the proposed counter would collide now or later.
296:             $escaped = addcslashes($prefix, '\\%_');
297:             $existing = DB::table($target[0])->where($target[1], 'like', $escaped.'%')->pluck($target[1]);
298:             $max = null;
299:             foreach ($existing as $number) {
300:                 // The remainder after the prefix must be purely numeric:
301:                 // that numeric suffix is what future counters would reproduce.
302:                 $tail = trim(substr((string) $number, strlen($prefix)));
303:                 if ($tail === '' || ! ctype_digit($tail)) {
304:                     continue;
305:                 }
306:                 $max = max($max ?? 0, (int) $tail);
307:             }
308: 
309:             if ($max !== null && $max >= $next) {
310:                 throw ValidationException::withMessages([
311:                     $definition['next'] => 'الرقم '.$prefix.str_pad((string) $next, $padding, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT).' مستخدم بالفعل في '.$target[0].'. غيّر البداية أو البادئة أو الطول.',
312:                 ]);
313:             }
314:         }
315:     }
````
