````php
317:     /**
318:      * Update a flat key/value map atomically and invalidate the cached settings after commit.
319:      *
320:      * @param  array<string, mixed>  $settings
321:      *
322:      * @throws JsonException
323:      */
324:     public function updateBatch(array $settings, ?array $expected = null, array $via = []): void
325:     {
326:         $this->warnings = [];
327:         DB::transaction(function () use ($settings, $expected, $via): void {
328:             $this->uncommittedSettings = true;
329:             $this->resetReadSnapshot();
330:             $movementSequenceTarget = null;
331:             /** @var array<string, int> $documentSequenceTargets */
332:             $documentSequenceTargets = [];
333:             $lockedSettings = Setting::query()
334:                 ->whereIn('key', array_keys($settings))
335:                 ->orderBy('key')
336:                 ->lockForUpdate()
337:                 ->get()
338:                 ->keyBy('key');
339: 
340:             $missingKeys = array_diff(array_keys($settings), $lockedSettings->keys()->all());
341: 
342:             if ($missingKeys !== []) {
343:                 throw new InvalidArgumentException('Settings are not initialized: '.implode(', ', $missingKeys));
344:             }
345: 
346:             $before = [];
347:             $after = [];
348:             foreach ($settings as $key => $value) {
349:                 /** @var Setting $setting */
350:                 $setting = $lockedSettings->get($key);
351:                 $current = $this->castValue($setting->value, $setting->type);
352:                 if (in_array($key, self::NUMBERING_COUNTER_KEYS, true)) {
353:                     $current = $this->get($key);
354:                 }
355:                 // M7/M8: العدادات الحية (قيم الـ sequences) بتزيد من نفسها مع
356:                 // كل فاتورة/عملية بتتنفذ — تسجيل التوقيع على القيمة الحلية
357:                 // بيورّط 409 دايمًا على الأنظمة المزدحمة. للعدادات القاعدة هي
358:                 // "الجديد ≥ الحالي" بس (فوق)، وexpected يحكم البادئة والطول
359:                 // والأنواع غير العدادية (فاتورة ضريبية مثلًا تفضل بالمساواة).
360:                 $isCounter = in_array($key, self::NUMBERING_COUNTER_KEYS, true);
361:                 if (! $isCounter && $expected !== null && (! array_key_exists($key, $expected)
362:                     || $this->comparisonValue($current, $setting->type) !== $this->comparisonValue($expected[$key], $setting->type))) {
363:                     abort(409, 'تم تغيير إعداد أو عداد منذ فتح الصفحة؛ أعد تحميل الإعدادات قبل الحفظ.');
364:                 }
365:                 $before[$key] = $current;
366: 
367:                 if (in_array($key, self::NUMBERING_COUNTER_KEYS, true)) {
368:                     $requested = $this->counterValue($value);
369:                     if ($requested > 999999999) {
370:                         throw ValidationException::withMessages([$key => 'الحد الأقصى للعداد هو 999999999.']);
371:                     }
372:                     $value = max($this->counterValue($setting->value), $requested);
373:                     if ($key === 'movement_next_number') {
374:                         $value = max($value, $this->nextMovementNumber());
375:                         $movementSequenceTarget = $value;
376:                     }
377:                     $sequenceType = array_search($key, self::SEQUENCE_TYPES, true);
378:                     if (is_string($sequenceType)) {
379:                         $value = max($value, $this->nextDocumentNumber($sequenceType));
380:                         $documentSequenceTargets[$sequenceType] = $value;
381:                     }
382:                     if ($requested < $value) {
383:                         throw ValidationException::withMessages([$key => 'لا يمكن خفض عداد الترقيم عن قيمته الحالية.']);
384:                     }
385:                 }
386: 
387:                 $setting->value = $value === null && str_ends_with($key, '_prefix')
388:                     ? ''
389:                     : $this->serializeValue($value, $setting->type);
390:                 $setting->save();
391:                 $after[$key] = $this->castValue($setting->value, $setting->type);
392:             }
393: 
394:             $this->assertNumberingDoesNotCollide($settings, $after);
395:             // M-4: تغيير البادئة أو الطول قد يعيد إصدار رقم صدر من قبل
396:             // (مثال: INV- بطول 6 أصدر INV-001000، ثم بادئة INV-00 وطول 4
397:             // يعيدان الرقم 1000 بصيغة INV-001000). التحقق الحالي يمنع
398:             // تخفيض العداد فقط. بعد تطبيق القيم الجديدة وقبل التدقيق،
399:             // نشيك أن الرقم التالي المُنسَّق غير موجود أصلًا في جدول
400:             // المستند؛ والـ unique index على عمود الرقم هو خط الدفاع
401:             // الأخير وقت التشغيل (موجود على كل أعمدة الأرقام).
402:             $this->assertNoNumberingCollision(array_keys($settings));
403: 
404:             StaffAdministration::audit(request()->user('staff'), 'settings.updated', 'settings', null, array_keys($settings),
405:                 ['settings' => $this->auditableSettings($before)], ['settings' => $this->auditableSettings($after)], $via);
406:             DB::afterCommit(fn () => $this->clearCache());
407: 
408:             // M-2: المزامنة داخل الـ transaction — الـ setval غير transactional،
409:             // ففشل لاحق (rollback) ينتج فجوة فقط، والفجوات مقبولة لهذه الأنواع.
410:             // البديل السابق (afterCommit + warning) كان يترك العداد قديمًا
411:             // فيكرر أرقام مستندات.
412:             if ($movementSequenceTarget !== null) {
413:                 DB::selectOne('SELECT inventory_movement_number(?) AS number', [$movementSequenceTarget]);
414:             }
415:             foreach ($documentSequenceTargets as $type => $minimum) {
416:                 DB::selectOne('SELECT document_next_number(?, ?) AS number', [$type, $minimum]);
417:             }
418:         }, attempts: 3);
419:     }
420: 
421:     /**
422:      * Atomically return and increment the next document number for the requested type.
423:      *
424:      * @throws JsonException
425:      */
426:     public function generateNextNumber(string $type): string
427:     {
428:         if ($type === 'movement') {
429:             [$prefix, $padding] = $this->numberingConfig('movement', 'movement_prefix', 'movement_padding');
430:             $number = DB::selectOne('SELECT inventory_movement_number() AS number')->number;
431: 
432:             return $prefix.str_pad((string) $number, $padding, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
433:         }
434:         if (isset(self::SEQUENCE_TYPES[$type])) {
435:             $definitions = $this->numberingDefinitions();
436:             $definition = $definitions[$type];
437:             [$prefix, $padding] = $this->numberingConfig($type, $definition['prefix'], $definition['padding']);
438:             $number = DB::selectOne('SELECT document_next_number(?) AS number', [$type])->number;
439: 
440:             return $prefix.str_pad((string) $number, $padding, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
441:         }
442:         $definitions = $this->numberingDefinitions();
443: 
444:         if (! isset($definitions[$type])) {
445:             throw new InvalidArgumentException("Unsupported numbering type [{$type}].");
446:         }
447: 
448:         $definition = $definitions[$type];
449:         [$prefix, $padding] = $this->numberingConfig($type, $definition['prefix'], $definition['padding']);
450: 
451:         return DB::transaction(function () use ($definition, $prefix, $padding): string {
452:             // Counter row is locked and read fresh; prefix and padding are cached in request memory
453:             $nextSetting = Setting::query()
454:                 ->where('key', $definition['next'])
455:                 ->lockForUpdate()
456:                 ->first();
457: 
458:             if ($nextSetting === null) {
459:                 throw new InvalidArgumentException("Required numbering setting [{$definition['next']}] is missing.");
460:             }
461: 
462:             $nextValue = $this->counterValue($nextSetting->value);
463: 
464:             $formatted = $prefix.str_pad((string) $nextValue, $padding, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
465:             $nextSetting->value = (string) ($nextValue + 1);
466:             $nextSetting->save();
467: 
468:             return $formatted;
469:         }, attempts: 3);
470:     }
471: 
472:     /**
473:      * Cache numbering prefix and padding per request to reduce query overhead.
474:      *
475:      * @return array{0: string, 1: int}
476:      */
477:     private function numberingConfig(string $type, string $prefixKey, string $paddingKey): array
478:     {
479:         return $this->numberingConfig[$type] ??= (function () use ($prefixKey, $paddingKey): array {
480:             $settings = Setting::query()->whereIn('key', [$prefixKey, $paddingKey])->pluck('value', 'key');
481: 
482:             foreach ([$prefixKey, $paddingKey] as $key) {
483:                 if (! $settings->has($key)) {
484:                     throw new InvalidArgumentException("Required numbering setting [{$key}] is missing.");
485:                 }
486:             }
487: 
488:             return [(string) $settings[$prefixKey], max(0, (int) $settings[$paddingKey])];
489:         })();
490:     }
491: 
492:     public function clearCache(): void
493:     {
494:         Cache::forever(self::CACHE_VERSION_KEY, (string) Str::uuid());
495:         Cache::forget(self::CACHE_KEY); // Retire the cache key used before versioning.
496:         $this->numberingConfig = [];
497:         $this->requestCache = null;
498:         $this->resetReadSnapshot();
499:     }
500: 
501:     private function comparisonValue(mixed $value, string $type): ?string
502:     {
503:         if ($type === 'float' && $value !== null && is_numeric($value)) {
504:             return (string) BigDecimal::of((string) $value)->strippedOfTrailingZeros();
505:         }
506: 
507:         return $type === 'string' ? (string) ($value ?? '') : $this->serializeValue($value, $type);
508:     }
509: 
510:     private function auditableSettings(array $settings): array
511:     {
512:         // Only the public administrative settings schema is safe to audit as values.
513:         $allowed = array_keys((new UpdateSettingsRequest)->rules());
514: 
515:         return array_intersect_key($settings, array_flip($allowed));
516:     }

518:     /**
519:      * M-4: نوع المستند → [جدول، عمود الرقم] لفحص تصادم الترقيم.
520:      * invoice وpos_invoice بلا جدول مستندات خاص (فواتير الجملة طلبات،
521:      * وفواتير POS بلا عمود رقم مستقل) فيُتجاوزان من الفحص.
522:      *
523:      * @var array<string, array{0: string, 1: string}>
524:      */
525:     private const DOCUMENT_NUMBER_TARGETS = [
526:         'order' => ['orders', 'order_number'],
527:         'purchase_order' => ['purchase_orders', 'po_number'],
528:         'quotation' => ['quotations', 'quotation_number'],
529:         'transfer' => ['stock_transfers', 'transfer_number'],
530:         'stocktake' => ['stocktakes', 'stocktake_number'],
531:         'return' => ['return_requests', 'return_number'],
532:         'purchase_request' => ['purchase_requests', 'request_number'],
533:         'delivery' => ['supplier_deliveries', 'delivery_number'],
534:         'supplier_invoice' => ['supplier_invoices', 'invoice_number'],
535:         'supplier_payment' => ['supplier_payments', 'payment_number'],
536:         'shift' => ['pos_shifts', 'shift_number'],
537:         'expense' => ['expenses', 'expense_number'],
538:         'treasury_transfer' => ['treasury_transfers', 'transfer_number'],
539:         'payment_notice' => ['wholesale_payment_notices', 'notice_number'],
540:         'movement' => ['stock_movements', 'reference_number'],
541:     ];
542: 
543:     /**
544:      * M-4: لكل نوع مستند اتعدّلت بادئته أو طوله أو عداده، تأكد أن الرقم
545:      * التالي المُنسَّق بالصيغة الجديدة غير موجود أصلًا في جدول المستند.
546:      * استعلام exists واحد لكل نوع اتعدّل.
547:      *
548:      * @param  list<string>  $changedKeys
549:      */
550:     private function assertNoNumberingCollision(array $changedKeys): void
551:     {
552:         foreach (self::DOCUMENT_NUMBER_TARGETS as $type => [$table, $column]) {
553:             // مفاتيح الترقيم بنمط ثابت {type}_prefix/_next_number/_padding
554:             // (بما فيه movement، غير الموجود في numberingDefinitions()).
555:             $keys = [$type.'_prefix', $type.'_next_number', $type.'_padding'];
556:             if (array_intersect($keys, $changedKeys) === []) {
557:                 continue;
558:             }
559:             // قراءة طازجة داخل الـ transaction: المفاتيح المتعدّلة اتحفظت
560:             // بالفعل في الحلقة أعلاه، وغيرها بقيمها الحالية.
561:             $rows = Setting::query()->whereIn('key', $keys)->get()->keyBy('key');
562:             if ($rows->count() !== count($keys)) {
563:                 continue;
564:             }
565:             $prefix = (string) $this->castValue($rows[$keys[0]]->value, $rows[$keys[0]]->type);
566:             $next = (int) $this->castValue($rows[$keys[1]]->value, $rows[$keys[1]]->type);
567:             $padding = (int) $this->castValue($rows[$keys[2]]->value, $rows[$keys[2]]->type);
568:             $candidate = $prefix.str_pad((string) $next, $padding, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
569:             if (DB::table($table)->where($column, $candidate)->exists()) {
570:                 throw ValidationException::withMessages([$keys[0] => "الرقم التالي المُنسَّق ({$candidate}) صدر من قبل لنوع {$type}؛ غيّر البادئة أو الطول أو ارفع العداد."]);
571:             }
572:         }
573:     }
574: 
575:     /**
576:      * @return array<string, array{prefix: string, next: string, padding: string}>
577:      */
578:     private function numberingDefinitions(): array
579:     {
580:         return [

582:             'order' => ['prefix' => 'order_prefix', 'next' => 'order_next_number', 'padding' => 'order_padding'],
583:             'purchase_order' => ['prefix' => 'purchase_order_prefix', 'next' => 'purchase_order_next_number', 'padding' => 'purchase_order_padding'],
584:             'quotation' => ['prefix' => 'quotation_prefix', 'next' => 'quotation_next_number', 'padding' => 'quotation_padding'],
585:             'transfer' => ['prefix' => 'transfer_prefix', 'next' => 'transfer_next_number', 'padding' => 'transfer_padding'],
586:             'stocktake' => ['prefix' => 'stocktake_prefix', 'next' => 'stocktake_next_number', 'padding' => 'stocktake_padding'],
587:             'return' => ['prefix' => 'return_prefix', 'next' => 'return_next_number', 'padding' => 'return_padding'],
588:             'purchase_request' => ['prefix' => 'purchase_request_prefix', 'next' => 'purchase_request_next_number', 'padding' => 'purchase_request_padding'],
589:             'delivery' => ['prefix' => 'delivery_prefix', 'next' => 'delivery_next_number', 'padding' => 'delivery_padding'],
590:             'supplier_invoice' => ['prefix' => 'supplier_invoice_prefix', 'next' => 'supplier_invoice_next_number', 'padding' => 'supplier_invoice_padding'],
591:             'supplier_payment' => ['prefix' => 'supplier_payment_prefix',    'next' => 'supplier_payment_next_number',    'padding' => 'supplier_payment_padding'],
592:             'movement' => ['prefix' => 'movement_prefix', 'next' => 'movement_next_number', 'padding' => 'movement_padding'],
593:             'shift' => ['prefix' => 'shift_prefix',               'next' => 'shift_next_number',               'padding' => 'shift_padding'],
594:             'pos_invoice' => ['prefix' => 'pos_invoice_prefix',      'next' => 'pos_invoice_next_number',      'padding' => 'pos_invoice_padding'],
595:             'expense' => ['prefix' => 'expense_prefix',             'next' => 'expense_next_number',             'padding' => 'expense_padding'],
596:             'treasury_transfer' => ['prefix' => 'treasury_transfer_prefix',   'next' => 'treasury_transfer_next_number',   'padding' => 'treasury_transfer_padding'],
597:             'payment_notice' => ['prefix' => 'payment_notice_prefix',      'next' => 'payment_notice_next_number',      'padding' => 'payment_notice_padding'],
598:         ];
599:     }
600: 
601:     private function nextMovementNumber(): int
602:     {
603:         $sequence = DB::selectOne('SELECT last_value, is_called FROM stock_movement_number_seq');
604: 
605:         return (int) $sequence->last_value + ($sequence->is_called ? 1 : 0);
606:     }
607: 
608:     private function nextDocumentNumber(string $type): int
609:     {
610:         if (! isset(self::SEQUENCE_TYPES[$type])) {
611:             throw new InvalidArgumentException("Unsupported numbering type [{$type}].");
612:         }
613:         $sequence = DB::selectOne("SELECT last_value, is_called FROM document_{$type}_number_seq");
614: 
615:         return (int) $sequence->last_value + ($sequence->is_called ? 1 : 0);
616:     }
617: 
618:     private function counterValue(mixed $value): int
619:     {
620:         $number = (is_int($value) || is_string($value))
621:             ? filter_var($value, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT, ['options' => ['min_range' => 1, 'max_range' => PHP_INT_MAX - 1]])
622:             : false;
623:         if ($number === false) {
624:             throw new BusinessException('قيمة عداد الترقيم يجب أن تكون عددًا صحيحًا موجبًا ضمن النطاق المسموح');
625:         }
626: 
627:         return $number;
628:     }
629: 
630:     private function castValue(?string $value, string $type): mixed
631:     {
632:         if ($value === null) {
633:             return null;
634:         }
635: 
636:         if ($type === 'json') {
637:             try {
638:                 return json_decode($value, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
639:             } catch (JsonException) {
640:                 return null;
641:             }
642:         }
643: 
644:         return match ($type) {
645:             'boolean' => filter_var($value, FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN),
646:             'integer' => (int) $value,
647:             'float' => (float) $value,
648:             default => $value,
649:         };
650:     }
651: 
652:     /** @throws JsonException */
653:     private function serializeValue(mixed $value, string $type): ?string
654:     {
655:         if ($value === null) {
656:             return null;
657:         }
658: 
659:         if ($type === 'json') {
660:             return json_encode($value, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
661:         }
662: 
663:         if ($type === 'boolean') {
664:             return filter_var($value, FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN) ? '1' : '0';
665:         }
666: 
667:         return (string) $value;
668:     }
669: }
````

````php
 9: /**
10:  * Parses spoken Arabic quantities ("اتنين وعشرين") into numbers for the
11:  * POS voice-count mode. Fractions are not supported — counts are integers.
12:  */
13: final class SpokenQuantity
14: {
15:     /** @var array<string, float> */
16:     private const WORDS = [
17:         'صفر' => 0, 'واحد' => 1, 'واحده' => 1, 'اتنين' => 2, 'اثنين' => 2,
18:         'اثنان' => 2, 'تنين' => 2, 'تلاته' => 3, 'ثلاثه' => 3, 'اربعه' => 4,
19:         'خمسه' => 5, 'سته' => 6, 'سبعه' => 7, 'تمانيه' => 8, 'ثمانيه' => 8,
20:         'تسعه' => 9, 'عشره' => 10, 'عشر' => 10, 'حداشر' => 11, 'احد عشر' => 11,
21:         'اتناشر' => 12, 'اطناشر' => 12, 'اثنا عشر' => 12, 'تلتاشر' => 13,
22:         'اربعتاشر' => 14, 'خمستاشر' => 15, 'ستاشر' => 16, 'سبعتاشر' => 17,
23:         'تمنتاشر' => 18, 'تسعتاشر' => 19, 'عشرين' => 20, 'تلاتين' => 30,
24:         'اربعين' => 40, 'خمسين' => 50, 'ستين' => 60, 'سبعين' => 70,
25:         'تمانين' => 80, 'تسعين' => 90, 'ميه' => 100, 'ميت' => 100,
26:         'مايه' => 100, 'مائه' => 100, 'ميتين' => 200, 'الف' => 1000, 'دسته' => 12,
27:     ];
28: 
29:     /** @var list<string> */
30:     private const FILLER = ['قطعه', 'قطع', 'حبه', 'حبات', 'علبه', 'علب', 'كرتونه'];
31: 
32:     public static function parse(?string $input): ?float
33:     {
34:         if ($input === null) {
35:             return null;
36:         }
37:         $clean = trim(EntityResolver::normalizeDigits($input));
38:         if ($clean === '') {
39:             return null;
40:         }
41:         if (is_numeric($clean)) {
42:             $v = (float) $clean;
43:             if ($v >= 0 && $v <= 999999 && floor($v) == $v) {
44:                 return $v;
45:             }
46: 
47:             return null;
48:         }
49: 
50:         $norm = EntityResolver::normalize($clean);
51:         if (isset(self::WORDS[$norm])) {
52:             return self::WORDS[$norm];
53:         }
54: 
55:         $spaced = str_replace(' و ', ' ', ' '.$norm.' ');
56:         $tokens = preg_split('/\s+/u', trim($spaced)) ?: [];
57:         $total = 0.0;
58:         $group = 0.0;
59:         $matched = 0;
60:         foreach ($tokens as $i => $token) {
61:             if ($token === '' || $token === 'و') {
62:                 continue;
63:             }
64:             // عطف متصل: "وعشرين" — الواو الأولى تُحذف لغير أول توكن.
65:             if ($i > 0 && mb_substr($token, 0, 1) === 'و' && mb_strlen($token) > 1 && ! isset(self::WORDS[$token])) {
66:                 $token = mb_substr($token, 1);
67:                 if ($token === '' || $token === 'و') {
68:                     continue;
69:                 }
70:             }
71:             if (in_array($token, self::FILLER, true)) {
72:                 continue;
73:             }
74:             if (! isset(self::WORDS[$token])) {
75:                 return null;
76:             }
77:             $matched++;
78:             $v = self::WORDS[$token];
79:             if ($v === 1000.0 || $v === 100.0) {
80:                 $group = ($group > 0 ? $group : 1) * $v;
81:                 $total += $group;
82:                 $group = 0.0;
83:             } elseif ($v === 200.0) {
84:                 $total += $v;
85:             } else {
86:                 $group += $v;
87:             }
88:         }
89:         if ($matched === 0) {
90:             return null;
91:         }
92: 
93:         return $total + $group;
94:     }
95: }
````

````php
 60:             ->with(['items.variant', 'branch', 'location', 'creator', 'approver'])

 62:     }

 64:     /**
 65:      * Creates a new draft stocktake session idempotently.
 66:      *
 67:      * @param array<string, mixed> $data Stocktake attributes and items
 68:      * @param int $userId Creator ID
 69:      * @param string|null $idempotencyKey Optional client request idempotency key
 70:      * @return Stocktake Created stocktake
 71:      * @throws BusinessException If location or branch scope is invalid
 72:      */
 73:     public function create(array $data, int $userId, ?string $idempotencyKey = null): Stocktake
 74:     {
 75:         app(BranchAccess::class)->assertBranch($userId, (int) $data['branch_id']);
 76: 
 77:         /** @var Stocktake */
 78:         return $this->createIdempotently(
 79:             'stocktake_store',
 80:             $data,
 81:             $userId,
 82:             $idempotencyKey,
 83:             Stocktake::class,
 84:             ['items.variant', 'branch', 'location', 'creator'],
 85:             fn (): Stocktake => $this->doCreate($data, $userId),
 86:         );
 87:     }
 88: 
 89:     private function doCreate(array $data, int $userId): Stocktake
 90:     {
 91:         return DB::transaction(function () use ($data, $userId): Stocktake {
 92:             app(BranchAccess::class)->assertBranch($userId, (int) $data['branch_id']);
 93:             $this->assertScopedLocation((int) $data['branch_id'], $data['location_id'] ?? null);
 94:             $stocktake = Stocktake::query()->create([
 95:                 'stocktake_number' => $this->settings->generateNextNumber('stocktake'),
 96:                 'branch_id' => $data['branch_id'],
 97:                 'location_id' => $data['location_id'] ?? null,
 98:                 'status' => StocktakeStatus::Draft,
 99:                 'created_by' => $userId,
100:                 'notes' => $data['notes'] ?? null,
101:             ]);
102: 
103:             $this->syncItems($stocktake, $data['items'] ?? []);
104: 
105:             return $stocktake->load(['items.variant', 'branch', 'location', 'creator']);
106:         });
107:     }
108: 
109:     /**
110:      * Updates an editable stocktake session attributes, status, and items.
111:      *
112:      * @param Stocktake $stocktake Target stocktake
113:      * @param array<string, mixed> $data Updated attributes
114:      * @param int $userId User performing update
115:      * @return Stocktake Updated stocktake instance
116:      * @throws BusinessException If stocktake is locked or transition is invalid
117:      */
118:     public function update(Stocktake $stocktake, array $data, int $userId): Stocktake
119:     {
120:         return DB::transaction(function () use ($stocktake, $data, $userId): Stocktake {
121:             $stocktake = Stocktake::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($stocktake->id);
122:             $this->assertEditable($stocktake);
123:             app(BranchAccess::class)->assertBranch($userId, $stocktake->branch_id);
124:             app(BranchAccess::class)->assertBranch($userId, (int) ($data['branch_id'] ?? $stocktake->branch_id));
125: 
126:             $branchId = $data['branch_id'] ?? $stocktake->branch_id;
127:             $locationId = array_key_exists('location_id', $data) ? $data['location_id'] : $stocktake->location_id;
128:             if ($locationId !== null && ! Location::query()->whereKey($locationId)->where('branch_id', $branchId)->exists()) {
129:                 throw new BusinessException('موقع الجرد لا يتبع الفرع المحدد.');
130:             }
131:             if ($locationId === null && ($data['status'] ?? null) !== StocktakeStatus::Cancelled->value) {
132:                 $this->assertScopedLocation((int) $branchId, null);
133:             }
134:             $scopeChanged = (int) $branchId !== $stocktake->branch_id || ($locationId === null ? null : (int) $locationId) !== $stocktake->location_id;
135:             if ($scopeChanged
136:                 && ! array_key_exists('items', $data) && $stocktake->items()->exists()) {
137:                 throw new BusinessException('تغيير نطاق الجرد يتطلب إعادة إرسال العناصر والعد الفعلي.');
138:             }
139: 
140:             if (isset($data['status'])) {
141:                 $target = StocktakeStatus::from($data['status']);
142:                 $allowed = match ($stocktake->status) {
143:                     StocktakeStatus::Draft => [StocktakeStatus::InProgress, StocktakeStatus::Cancelled],
144:                     StocktakeStatus::InProgress => [StocktakeStatus::Cancelled],
145:                     default => [],
146:                 };
147: 
148:                 if (! in_array($target, $allowed, true)) {
149:                     throw new BusinessException("لا يمكن نقل الجرد من حالة {$stocktake->status->value} إلى {$target->value}.");
150:                 }
151: 
152:                 $stocktake->status = $target;
153:             }
154: 
155:             $stocktake->fill([
156:                 'branch_id' => $data['branch_id'] ?? $stocktake->branch_id,
157:                 'location_id' => array_key_exists('location_id', $data) ? $data['location_id'] : $stocktake->location_id,
158:                 'notes' => array_key_exists('notes', $data) ? $data['notes'] : $stocktake->notes,
159:             ])->save();
160: 
161:             if (isset($data['items'])) {
162:                 if ($scopeChanged) {
163:                     $data['items'] = array_map(fn ($item) => [...$item, 'recount' => true], $data['items']);
164:                 }
165:                 $this->upsertItems($stocktake, $data['items']);
166:             }
167: 
168:             return $stocktake->load(['items.variant', 'branch', 'location', 'creator']);
169:         });
170:     }
171: 
172:     /**
173:      * Approves a stocktake session, recording inventory adjustments for non-zero count differences.
174:      *
175:      * @param Stocktake $stocktake Target stocktake
176:      * @param int $userId Approving user ID
177:      * @return Stocktake Approved and locked stocktake
178:      * @throws BusinessException If items are uncounted, stale, or stocktake cannot be approved
179:      */
180:     public function approve(Stocktake $stocktake, int $userId): Stocktake
181:     {
182:         return app(CatalogRetailPriceObserver::class)->batch(fn () => DB::transaction(function () use ($stocktake, $userId): Stocktake {
183:             $stocktake = Stocktake::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($stocktake->id);
184:             app(BranchAccess::class)->assertBranch($userId, $stocktake->branch_id);
185:             $stocktake->load('items.variant');
186: 
187:             if (! in_array($stocktake->status, [StocktakeStatus::Draft, StocktakeStatus::InProgress], true)) {
188:                 throw new BusinessException('لا يمكن اعتماد جرد بحالة '.$stocktake->status->value.'.');
189:             }
190: 
191:             $this->assertScopedLocation((int) $stocktake->branch_id, $stocktake->location_id);
192:             $this->assertItemLimit($stocktake->items->count());
193: 
194:             $uncounted = $stocktake->items->filter(fn ($item) => $item->counted_qty === null);
195: 
196:             if ($stocktake->items->isEmpty()) {
197:                 throw new BusinessException('لا يمكن اعتماد جرد بلا عناصر.');
198:             }
199: 
200:             if ($uncounted->isNotEmpty()) {
201:                 throw new BusinessException('لا يمكن الاعتماد: توجد عناصر لم تُعدّ بعد.');
202:             }
203: 
204:             $levels = $this->inventory->lockLevels($stocktake->items->map(fn ($item) => [
205:                 'product_variant_id' => $item->product_variant_id,
206:                 'branch_id' => $stocktake->branch_id, 'location_id' => $stocktake->location_id,
207:             ])->all());
208: 
209:             // Reconcile according to configured stale policy: reject on intermediate movement or apply net difference.
210:             $rejectStale = config('inventory.stocktake_stale_policy', 'reject') !== 'apply_difference';
211:             $staleItemIds = [];
212:             $staleVariantIds = [];
213:             $latestMovements = StockMovement::query()->where('branch_id', $stocktake->branch_id)
214:                 ->where('location_id', $stocktake->location_id)->where('affected_bucket', StockBucket::OnHand->value)
215:                 ->whereIn('product_variant_id', $stocktake->items->pluck('product_variant_id'))
216:                 ->when(! $rejectStale, fn ($q) => $q->whereIn('type', [StockMovementType::StocktakeGain->value, StockMovementType::StocktakeLoss->value]))
217:                 ->selectRaw('product_variant_id, MAX(id) AS last_id')->groupBy('product_variant_id')
218:                 ->pluck('last_id', 'product_variant_id');
219:             foreach ($stocktake->items as $item) {
220:                 $key = $this->inventory->levelKey([
221:                     'product_variant_id' => $item->product_variant_id,
222:                     'branch_id' => $stocktake->branch_id, 'location_id' => $stocktake->location_id,
223:                 ]);
224:                 if ((int) ($latestMovements[$item->product_variant_id] ?? 0) > (int) $item->snapshot_movement_id
225:                     || ($rejectStale && (int) round((float) $levels[$key]->on_hand * 10000) !== (int) round((float) $item->system_qty * 10000))) {
226:                     $staleItemIds[] = $item->id;
227:                     $staleVariantIds[] = $item->product_variant_id;
228:                 }
229:                 $finalQty = (float) $levels[$key]->on_hand + (float) $item->difference;
230:                 if ((int) round($finalQty * 10000) < (int) round((float) $levels[$key]->reserved * 10000) + (int) round((float) $levels[$key]->damaged * 10000)) {
231:                     throw new BusinessException('العد الفعلي أقل من المحجوز والتالف؛ راجع الحجوزات وسوِّ التالف قبل إعادة العد والاعتماد.');
232:                 }
233:             }
234: 
235:             if ($staleItemIds !== []) {
236:                 throw new BusinessException(
237:                     'توجد أصناف تغيّر رصيدها بعد عدّها وتحتاج إعادة عد قبل الاعتماد.',
238:                     ['recount_item_ids' => $staleItemIds, 'recount_variant_ids' => $staleVariantIds],
239:                 );
240:             }
241: 
242:             foreach ($stocktake->items as $item) {
243:                 $difference = (float) $item->difference;
244: 
245:                 if ($difference === 0.0) {
246:                     continue;
247:                 }
248: 
249:                 $key = $this->inventory->levelKey([
250:                     'product_variant_id' => $item->product_variant_id,
251:                     'branch_id' => $stocktake->branch_id, 'location_id' => $stocktake->location_id,
252:                 ]);
253: 
254:                 $this->inventory->recordMovement([
255:                     'product_variant_id' => $item->product_variant_id,
256:                     'branch_id' => $stocktake->branch_id,
257:                     'location_id' => $stocktake->location_id,
258:                     'type' => $difference > 0 ? StockMovementType::StocktakeGain : StockMovementType::StocktakeLoss,
259:                     'affected_bucket' => StockBucket::OnHand,
260:                     'quantity' => $difference,
261:                     'unit_cost' => $item->variant?->cost_price,
262:                     'reference_type' => Stocktake::class,
263:                     'reference_id' => $stocktake->id,
264:                     'created_by' => $userId,
265:                     'notes' => 'تسوية جرد '.$stocktake->stocktake_number,
266:                 ], $levels[$key] ?? null);
267:             }
268: 
269:             $stocktake->update([
270:                 'status' => StocktakeStatus::Approved,
271:                 'approved_by' => $userId,
272:                 'approved_at' => now(),
273:             ]);
274: 
275:             return $stocktake->load(['items.variant', 'branch', 'location']);
276:         }));
277:     }
278: 
279:     /**
280:      * Deletes a draft or cancelled stocktake session.
281:      *
282:      * @param Stocktake $stocktake Stocktake to delete
283:      * @param int $userId Requesting user ID
284:      * @throws BusinessException If session is in an undeletable status
285:      */
286:     public function delete(Stocktake $stocktake, int $userId): void
287:     {
288:         DB::transaction(function () use ($stocktake, $userId): void {
289:             $stocktake = Stocktake::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($stocktake->id);
290:             app(BranchAccess::class)->assertBranch($userId, $stocktake->branch_id);
291: 
292:             if (! in_array($stocktake->status, [StocktakeStatus::Draft, StocktakeStatus::Cancelled], true)) {
293:                 throw new BusinessException('لا يمكن حذف جرد إلا في حالة المسودة أو الملغي.');
294:             }
295: 
296:             $stocktake->delete();
297:         });
298:     }
299: 
300:     private function assertScopedLocation(int $branchId, mixed $locationId): void
301:     {
302:         if ($locationId !== null) {
303:             return;
304:         }
305: 
306:         // Prevent branch-wide unlocated stocktaking when location-specific stock exists to avoid artificial discrepancies.
307:         $hasLocatedStock = StockLevel::query()->where('branch_id', $branchId)
308:             ->whereNotNull('location_id')->hasNonZeroBalance()->exists();
309: 
310:         if ($hasLocatedStock) {
311:             throw new BusinessException('هذا الفرع يستخدم المواقع وله أرصدة عليها؛ حدد موقع الجرد بدل العدّ الإجمالي للفرع.');
312:         }
313:     }
314: 
315:     private function assertEditable(Stocktake $stocktake): void
316:     {
317:         if (in_array($stocktake->status, [StocktakeStatus::Approved, StocktakeStatus::Cancelled], true)) {
318:             throw new BusinessException('هذا الجرد مقفل ولا يقبل أي تعديل.');
319:         }
320:     }
321: 
322:     /**
323:      * @param list<array{product_variant_id: int, counted_qty?: float|int|string|null}> $items
324:      */
325:     private function syncItems(Stocktake $stocktake, array $items): void
326:     {
327:         $this->assertItemLimit(count($items));
328:         $levels = $this->snapshotLevels($stocktake, $items);
329:         $snapshotMovementId = (int) StockMovement::query()->max('id');
330:         foreach ($items as $item) {
331:             $level = $levels->get($item['product_variant_id']);
332: 
333:             $stocktake->items()->create([
334:                 'product_variant_id' => $item['product_variant_id'],
335:                 'system_qty' => $level ? (float) $level->on_hand : 0,
336:                 'snapshot_movement_id' => $snapshotMovementId,
337:                 'counted_qty' => $item['counted_qty'] ?? null,
338:             ]);
339:         }
340:     }
341: 
342:     /**
343:      * Incrementally updates a subset of stocktake items without deleting unmentioned ones.
344:      *
345:      * @param Stocktake $stocktake Target stocktake
346:      * @param list<array{product_variant_id: int, counted_qty?: float|int|string|null, recount?: bool|null}> $items Items payload
347:      * @param int $userId User ID
348:      * @return Stocktake Updated stocktake
349:      */
350:     public function upsertSomeItems(Stocktake $stocktake, array $items, int $userId): Stocktake
351:     {
352:         return DB::transaction(function () use ($stocktake, $items, $userId): Stocktake {
353:             $stocktake = Stocktake::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($stocktake->id);
354:             $this->assertEditable($stocktake);
355:             app(BranchAccess::class)->assertBranch($userId, $stocktake->branch_id);
356: 
357:             $this->upsertItems($stocktake, $items, deleteAbsent: false);
358:             $stocktake->touch();
359: 
360:             return $stocktake->load(['items.variant', 'branch', 'location', 'creator']);
361:         });
362:     }
363: 
364:     /**
365:      * Adds counted quantity to a stocktake item under row lock (e.g. for barcode scanning).
366:      *
367:      * @param Stocktake $stocktake Target stocktake
368:      * @param int $variantId Scanned variant ID
369:      * @param float $quantity Scanned quantity increment
370:      * @param int $userId Scanning user ID
371:      * @return Stocktake Updated stocktake
372:      * @throws BusinessException If session is locked or quantity is invalid
373:      */
374:     public function incrementItemCount(Stocktake $stocktake, int $variantId, float $quantity, int $userId): Stocktake
375:     {
376:         return DB::transaction(function () use ($stocktake, $variantId, $quantity, $userId): Stocktake {
377:             $stocktake = Stocktake::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($stocktake->id);
378:             $this->assertEditable($stocktake);
379:             app(BranchAccess::class)->assertBranch($userId, $stocktake->branch_id);
380: 
381:             $existing = $stocktake->items()->where('product_variant_id', $variantId)->first();
382:             $counted = (float) ($existing?->counted_qty ?? 0);
383:             $total = round($counted + $quantity, 4);
384:             if (! is_finite($quantity) || $quantity <= 0 || $total > 99999999.9999) {
385:                 throw new BusinessException('كمية العد تتجاوز النطاق المسموح.');
386:             }
387:             if ($existing !== null && $existing->counted_qty !== null) {
388:                 $existing->update(['counted_qty' => $total]);
389:             } else {
390:                 $this->upsertItems($stocktake, [['product_variant_id' => $variantId, 'counted_qty' => $total]], deleteAbsent: false);
391:             }
392:             $stocktake->touch();
393: 
394:             return $stocktake->load(['items.variant', 'branch', 'location', 'creator']);
395:         });
396:     }
397: 
398:     /**
399:      * @param list<array{product_variant_id: int, counted_qty?: float|int|string|null, recount?: bool|null}> $items
400:      */
401:     private function upsertItems(Stocktake $stocktake, array $items, bool $deleteAbsent = true): void
402:     {
403:         $existing = $stocktake->items()->get()->keyBy('product_variant_id');
404: 
405:         $payloadIds = collect($items)->map(fn ($item) => (int) $item['product_variant_id'])->unique()->values()->all();
406:         $totalItems = $deleteAbsent
407:             ? count($payloadIds)
408:             : $existing->count() + count(array_diff($payloadIds, $existing->keys()->map(fn ($id) => (int) $id)->all()));
409:         $this->assertItemLimit($totalItems);
410:         $levels = $this->snapshotLevels($stocktake, $items);
411:         $snapshotMovementId = (int) StockMovement::query()->max('id');
412: 
413:         $keepIds = [];
414:         foreach ($items as $item) {
415:             $variantId = (int) $item['product_variant_id'];
416:             $currentOnHand = $levels->get($variantId) ? (float) $levels->get($variantId)->on_hand : 0.0;
417:             $row = $existing->get($variantId);
418: 
419:             if ($row === null) {
420:                 $created = $stocktake->items()->create([
421:                     'product_variant_id' => $variantId,
422:                     'system_qty' => $currentOnHand,
423:                     'snapshot_movement_id' => $snapshotMovementId,
424:                     'counted_qty' => $item['counted_qty'] ?? null,
425:                 ]);
426:                 $keepIds[] = $created->id;
427: 
428:                 continue;
429:             }
430: 
431:             $keepIds[] = $row->id;
432:             $updates = [];
433: 
434:             if (array_key_exists('counted_qty', $item)) {
435:                 $updates['counted_qty'] = $item['counted_qty'];
436: 
437:                 $countChanged = $item['counted_qty'] !== null
438:                     && ($row->counted_qty === null || (float) $item['counted_qty'] !== (float) $row->counted_qty);
439: 
440:                 if ($countChanged || ! empty($item['recount'])) {
441:                     $updates['system_qty'] = $currentOnHand;
442:                     $updates['snapshot_movement_id'] = $snapshotMovementId;
443:                 }
444:             } elseif (! empty($item['recount'])) {
445:                 $updates['system_qty'] = $currentOnHand;
446:                 $updates['snapshot_movement_id'] = $snapshotMovementId;
447:             }
448: 
449:             if ($updates !== []) {
450:                 $row->update($updates);
451:             }
452:         }
453: 
454:         if ($deleteAbsent) {
455:             $stocktake->items()->whereNotIn('id', $keepIds)->delete();
456:         }
457:     }
458: 
459:     private function snapshotLevels(Stocktake $stocktake, array $items): Collection
460:     {
461:         return $this->inventory->lockLevels(array_map(fn ($item) => [
462:             'branch_id' => $stocktake->branch_id, 'location_id' => $stocktake->location_id,
463:             'product_variant_id' => $item['product_variant_id'],
464:         ], $items))->keyBy('product_variant_id');
465:     }
466: 
467:     private function assertItemLimit(int $count): void
468:     {
469:         $maxItems = max(1, (int) config('inventory.stocktake_max_items', 2000));
470:         if ($count > $maxItems) {
471:             throw new BusinessException("تجاوزت الجلسة الحد الأقصى للبنود ({$maxItems})؛ قسّم الجرد إلى جلسات حسب الموقع.");
472:         }
473:     }
474: }
````

````php
 28:  * All inventory ledger side effects are coordinated exclusively via InventoryService:
 29:  * - draft: No inventory side effects.
 30:  * - approve: Reserves approved quantities at source branch to prevent concurrent overselling.
 31:  * - ship: Releases source reserve, issues TransferOut from on_hand, and records TransferInTransit at destination.

 54:             ->when($filters['to_branch_id'] ?? null, fn ($q, $v) => $q->where('to_branch_id', $v))

 89:         );
 90:     }
 91: 
 92:     /**
 93:      * Persists new draft transfer and dispatches approval notification event.
 94:      *
 95:      * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data
 96:      */
 97:     private function doCreate(array $data, int $userId): StockTransfer
 98:     {
 99:         return DB::transaction(function () use ($data, $userId): StockTransfer {
100:             $this->assertCreateAccess($userId, (int) $data['from_branch_id'], (int) $data['to_branch_id']);
101:             $transfer = StockTransfer::query()->create([
102:                 'transfer_number' => $this->settings->generateNextNumber('transfer'),
103:                 'from_branch_id' => $data['from_branch_id'],
104:                 'to_branch_id' => $data['to_branch_id'],
105:                 'status' => TransferStatus::Draft,
106:                 'created_by' => $userId,
107:                 'notes' => $data['notes'] ?? null,
108:             ]);
109: 
110:             $this->syncItems($transfer, $data['items']);
111: 
112:             $created = $transfer->load(['items.variant', 'fromBranch', 'toBranch', 'creator']);
113:             TransferPendingApproval::dispatch($created);
114: 
115:             return $created;
116:         });
117:     }
118: 
119:     /**
120:      * Updates transfer header and item lines while in draft status under pessimistic row lock.
121:      *
122:      * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data
123:      */
124:     public function update(StockTransfer $transfer, array $data, int $userId): StockTransfer
125:     {
126:         return DB::transaction(function () use ($transfer, $data, $userId): StockTransfer {
127:             $transfer = StockTransfer::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($transfer->id);
128:             $this->assertStatus($transfer, TransferStatus::Draft, 'التعديل');
129:             app(BranchAccess::class)->assertBranch($userId, $transfer->from_branch_id);
130:             app(BranchAccess::class)->assertBranch($userId, (int) ($data['from_branch_id'] ?? $transfer->from_branch_id));
131: 
132:             $fromBranch = $data['from_branch_id'] ?? $transfer->from_branch_id;
133:             $toBranch = $data['to_branch_id'] ?? $transfer->to_branch_id;
134:             if ((int) $fromBranch === (int) $toBranch) {
135:                 throw new BusinessException('يجب اختلاف الفرع المرسل عن الفرع المستلم.');
136:             }
137:             $items = $data['items'] ?? $transfer->items->toArray();
138:             foreach ($items as $item) {
139:                 foreach (['from_location_id' => $fromBranch, 'to_location_id' => $toBranch] as $field => $branchId) {
140:                     if (isset($item[$field]) && ! Location::query()->whereKey($item[$field])->where('branch_id', $branchId)->exists()) {
141:                         throw new BusinessException('موقع التحويل لا يتبع الفرع المحدد.');
142:                     }
143:                 }
144:             }
145: 
146:             $transfer->update([
147:                 'from_branch_id' => $data['from_branch_id'] ?? $transfer->from_branch_id,
148:                 'to_branch_id' => $data['to_branch_id'] ?? $transfer->to_branch_id,
149:                 'notes' => array_key_exists('notes', $data) ? $data['notes'] : $transfer->notes,
150:             ]);
151: 
152:             if (isset($data['items'])) {
153:                 $transfer->items()->delete();
154:                 $this->syncItems($transfer, $data['items']);
155:             }
156: 
157:             return $transfer->load(['items.variant', 'fromBranch', 'toBranch', 'creator']);
158:         });
159:     }
160: 
161:     /**
162:      * Approves transfer lines and reserves inventory at source branch to guarantee shipment stock.
163:      *
164:      * @param  array<int, float|int|string>  $itemsPayload  Map of transfer item ID to approved quantity.
165:      */
166:     public function approve(StockTransfer $transfer, array $itemsPayload, int $userId, ?string $expectedUpdatedAt = null, ?int $expectedVersion = null): StockTransfer
167:     {
168:         return DB::transaction(function () use ($transfer, $itemsPayload, $userId, $expectedUpdatedAt, $expectedVersion): StockTransfer {
169:             $transfer = StockTransfer::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($transfer->id);
170:             $transfer->load('items.variant');
171:             app(BranchAccess::class)->assertBranch($userId, $transfer->from_branch_id);
172:             $this->assertPayloadMatchesLockedItems($transfer, $itemsPayload, $expectedUpdatedAt, $expectedVersion);
173:             $this->assertStatus($transfer, TransferStatus::Draft, 'الاعتماد');
174:             // Early validation prevents approving transfers targeted at inactive or unreceivable branches.
175:             $this->assertReceivableDestination($transfer);
176:             if ($transfer->items->sum(fn ($item) => (float) ($itemsPayload[$item->id] ?? $item->requested_qty)) <= 0) {
177:                 throw new BusinessException('يجب اعتماد كمية موجبة واحدة على الأقل؛ يمكن إلغاء التحويل بدلًا من اعتماده بصفر.');
178:             }
179:             $levels = $this->lockTransferLevels($transfer, true, false);
180:             $qtyUpdates = [];
181: 
182:             foreach ($transfer->items as $item) {
183:                 $approvedQty = (float) ($itemsPayload[$item->id] ?? $item->requested_qty);
184: 
185:                 if ($approvedQty < 0 || $approvedQty > (float) $item->requested_qty) {
186:                     throw new BusinessException('الكمية المعتمدة يجب أن تكون بين صفر والكمية المطلوبة.');
187:                 }
188: 
189:                 // Collect quantity updates into a single batch upsert to minimize lock holding duration.
190:                 $qtyUpdates[] = [...$item->only(['id', 'stock_transfer_id', 'product_variant_id', 'from_location_id', 'to_location_id', 'requested_qty', 'approved_qty', 'shipped_qty', 'received_qty', 'created_at']), 'approved_qty' => $approvedQty, 'updated_at' => now()];
191: 
192:                 if ($approvedQty > 0) {
193:                     $this->move([
194:                         'product_variant_id' => $item->product_variant_id,
195:                         'branch_id' => $transfer->from_branch_id,
196:                         'location_id' => $item->from_location_id,
197:                         'type' => StockMovementType::Reserve,
198:                         'affected_bucket' => StockBucket::Reserved,
199:                         'quantity' => $approvedQty,
200:                         'unit_cost' => $item->variant?->cost_price,
201:                         'reference_type' => StockTransfer::class,
202:                         'reference_id' => $transfer->id,
203:                         'created_by' => $userId,
204:                         'notes' => 'حجز لصالح تحويل '.$transfer->transfer_number,
205:                     ], $levels);
206:                 }
207:             }
208: 
209:             if ($qtyUpdates !== []) {
210:                 StockTransferItem::query()->upsert($qtyUpdates, ['id'], ['approved_qty', 'updated_at']);
211:             }
212: 
213:             $transfer->update(['status' => TransferStatus::Approved, 'approved_by' => $userId]);
214: 
215:             return $transfer->load(['items.variant', 'fromBranch', 'toBranch']);
216:         });
217:     }
218: 
219:     /**
220:      * Dispatch approved stock from source branch and move into destination in-transit bucket.
221:      *
222:      * Releases source reservations, deducts physical on-hand inventory, returns any unshipped
223:      * approved quantity back to available stock, and registers items as in-transit at destination.
224:      *
225:      * @param  StockTransfer  $transfer
226:      * @param  array<int, float|int|string>  $itemsPayload  Map of transfer item ID to shipped quantity
227:      * @param  int  $userId
228:      * @param  string|null  $expectedUpdatedAt
229:      * @param  int|null  $expectedVersion
230:      * @return StockTransfer
231:      *
232:      * @throws BusinessException
233:      */
234:     public function ship(StockTransfer $transfer, array $itemsPayload, int $userId, ?string $expectedUpdatedAt = null, ?int $expectedVersion = null): StockTransfer
235:     {
236:         return DB::transaction(function () use ($transfer, $itemsPayload, $userId, $expectedUpdatedAt, $expectedVersion): StockTransfer {
237:             $transfer = StockTransfer::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($transfer->id);
238:             $transfer->load('items.variant');
239:             app(BranchAccess::class)->assertBranch($userId, $transfer->from_branch_id);
240:             if (in_array($transfer->status, [TransferStatus::Shipped, TransferStatus::Received], true)) {
241:                 return $this->replayCompletedStage($transfer, $itemsPayload, 'shipped_qty');
242:             }
243:             $this->assertPayloadMatchesLockedItems($transfer, $itemsPayload, $expectedUpdatedAt, $expectedVersion);
244:             $this->assertStatus($transfer, TransferStatus::Approved, 'الشحن');
245:             // Fail early if destination branch or locations were deactivated between approval and shipping
246:             $this->assertReceivableDestination($transfer);
247:             if ($transfer->items->sum(fn ($item) => (float) ($itemsPayload[$item->id] ?? $item->approved_qty)) <= 0) {
248:                 throw new BusinessException('يجب شحن كمية موجبة واحدة على الأقل؛ يمكن إلغاء التحويل لفك الحجز.');
249:             }
250:             $levels = $this->lockTransferLevels($transfer, true, true);
251:             $qtyUpdates = [];
252: 
253:             foreach ($transfer->items as $item) {
254:                 $shippedQty = (float) ($itemsPayload[$item->id] ?? $item->approved_qty);
255: 
256:                 if ($shippedQty < 0 || $shippedQty > (float) $item->approved_qty) {
257:                     throw new BusinessException('الكمية المشحونة يجب أن تكون بين صفر والكمية المعتمدة.');
258:                 }
259: 
260:                 $qtyUpdates[] = [...$item->only(['id', 'stock_transfer_id', 'product_variant_id', 'from_location_id', 'to_location_id', 'requested_qty', 'approved_qty', 'shipped_qty', 'received_qty', 'created_at']), 'shipped_qty' => $shippedQty, 'updated_at' => now()];
261: 
262:                 if ($shippedQty <= 0) {
263:                     if ((float) $item->approved_qty > 0) {
264:                         $this->move([
265:                             'product_variant_id' => $item->product_variant_id,
266:                             'branch_id' => $transfer->from_branch_id,
267:                             'location_id' => $item->from_location_id,
268:                             'type' => StockMovementType::ReleaseReserve,
269:                             'affected_bucket' => StockBucket::Reserved,
270:                             'quantity' => -(float) $item->approved_qty,
271:                             'reference_type' => StockTransfer::class,
272:                             'reference_id' => $transfer->id,
273:                             'created_by' => $userId,
274:                             'notes' => 'فك حجز صنف غير مشحون من تحويل '.$transfer->transfer_number,
275:                         ], $levels);
276:                     }
277: 
278:                     continue;
279:                 }
280: 
281:                 $base = [
282:                     'product_variant_id' => $item->product_variant_id,
283:                     'unit_cost' => $item->variant?->cost_price,
284:                     'reference_type' => StockTransfer::class,
285:                     'reference_id' => $transfer->id,
286:                     'created_by' => $userId,
287:                 ];
288: 
289:                 // Release source reservation before recording physical deduction from on-hand
290:                 $this->move([...$base,
291:                     'branch_id' => $transfer->from_branch_id,
292:                     'location_id' => $item->from_location_id,
293:                     'type' => StockMovementType::ReleaseReserve,
294:                     'affected_bucket' => StockBucket::Reserved,
295:                     'quantity' => -$shippedQty,
296:                     'notes' => 'فك حجز عند شحن تحويل '.$transfer->transfer_number,
297:                 ], $levels);
298:                 $this->move([...$base,
299:                     'branch_id' => $transfer->from_branch_id,
300:                     'location_id' => $item->from_location_id,
301:                     'type' => StockMovementType::TransferOut,
302:                     'affected_bucket' => StockBucket::OnHand,
303:                     'quantity' => -$shippedQty,
304:                     'notes' => 'شحن تحويل '.$transfer->transfer_number,
305:                 ], $levels);
306: 
307:                 // Release approved but unshipped quantity back to available inventory
308:                 $unshipped = round((float) $item->approved_qty - $shippedQty, 4);
309:                 if ($unshipped > 0) {
310:                     $this->move([...$base,
311:                         'branch_id' => $transfer->from_branch_id,
312:                         'location_id' => $item->from_location_id,
313:                         'type' => StockMovementType::ReleaseReserve,
314:                         'affected_bucket' => StockBucket::Reserved,
315:                         'quantity' => -$unshipped,
316:                         'notes' => 'فك حجز الكمية المعتمدة غير المشحونة من تحويل '.$transfer->transfer_number,
317:                     ], $levels);
318:                 }
319: 
320:                 // Increment in-transit stock at the destination branch/location
321:                 $this->move([...$base,
322:                     'branch_id' => $transfer->to_branch_id,
323:                     'location_id' => $item->to_location_id,
324:                     'type' => StockMovementType::TransferInTransit,
325:                     'affected_bucket' => StockBucket::InTransit,
326:                     'quantity' => $shippedQty,
327:                     'notes' => 'بضاعة في الطريق من تحويل '.$transfer->transfer_number,
328:                 ], $levels);
329:             }
330: 
331:             if ($qtyUpdates !== []) {
332:                 StockTransferItem::query()->upsert($qtyUpdates, ['id'], ['shipped_qty', 'updated_at']);
333:             }
334: 
335:             $transfer->update(['status' => TransferStatus::Shipped, 'shipped_at' => now()]);
336: 
337:             return $transfer->load(['items.variant', 'fromBranch', 'toBranch']);
338:         });
339:     }
340: 
341:     /**
342:      * Intake shipped inventory at the destination branch and settle in-transit stock.
343:      *
344:      * Moves verified goods from in-transit to on-hand. Any difference between shipped
345:      * and received quantity is deducted as an explicit shortage ledger movement.
346:      *
347:      * @param  StockTransfer  $transfer
348:      * @param  array<int, float|int|string>  $itemsPayload  Map of transfer item ID to received quantity
349:      * @param  int  $userId
350:      * @param  string|null  $expectedUpdatedAt
351:      * @param  int|null  $expectedVersion
352:      * @return StockTransfer
353:      *
354:      * @throws BusinessException
355:      */
356:     public function receive(StockTransfer $transfer, array $itemsPayload, int $userId, ?string $expectedUpdatedAt = null, ?int $expectedVersion = null): StockTransfer
357:     {
358:         return DB::transaction(function () use ($transfer, $itemsPayload, $userId, $expectedUpdatedAt, $expectedVersion): StockTransfer {
359:             $transfer = StockTransfer::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($transfer->id);
360:             $transfer->load('items.variant');
361:             app(BranchAccess::class)->assertBranch($userId, $transfer->to_branch_id);
362:             // Verify destination branch remains active before accepting inbound goods
363:             $toBranch = Branch::query()->find($transfer->to_branch_id);
364:             if ($toBranch === null || ! $toBranch->is_active) {
365:                 throw new BusinessException('الفرع المستلم غير نشط؛ لا يمكن الاستلام إليه.');
366:             }
367:             if ($transfer->status === TransferStatus::Received) {
368:                 return $this->replayCompletedStage($transfer, $itemsPayload, 'received_qty');
369:             }
370:             $this->assertPayloadMatchesLockedItems($transfer, $itemsPayload, $expectedUpdatedAt, $expectedVersion);
371:             $this->assertStatus($transfer, TransferStatus::Shipped, 'الاستلام');
372:             $levels = $this->lockTransferLevels($transfer, false, true);
373: 
374:             $shortageNotes = [];
375:             $qtyUpdates = [];
376: 
377:             foreach ($transfer->items as $item) {
378:                 $receivedQty = (float) ($itemsPayload[$item->id] ?? $item->shipped_qty);
379:                 $shippedQty = (float) $item->shipped_qty;
380: 
381:                 if ($receivedQty < 0 || $receivedQty > $shippedQty) {
382:                     throw new BusinessException('الكمية المستلمة يجب أن تكون بين صفر والكمية المشحونة.');
383:                 }
384: 
385:                 $qtyUpdates[] = [...$item->only(['id', 'stock_transfer_id', 'product_variant_id', 'from_location_id', 'to_location_id', 'requested_qty', 'approved_qty', 'shipped_qty', 'received_qty', 'created_at']), 'received_qty' => $receivedQty, 'updated_at' => now()];
386: 
387:                 if ($shippedQty <= 0) {
388:                     continue;
389:                 }
390: 
391:                 $base = [
392:                     'product_variant_id' => $item->product_variant_id,
393:                     'branch_id' => $transfer->to_branch_id,
394:                     'location_id' => $item->to_location_id,
395:                     'unit_cost' => $item->variant?->cost_price,
396:                     'reference_type' => StockTransfer::class,
397:                     'reference_id' => $transfer->id,
398:                     'created_by' => $userId,
399:                 ];
400: 
401:                 // Deduct accepted quantity from in-transit and post directly to destination on-hand
402:                 if ($receivedQty > 0) {
403:                     $this->move([...$base,
404:                         'type' => StockMovementType::TransferTransitRelease,
405:                         'affected_bucket' => StockBucket::InTransit,
406:                         'quantity' => -$receivedQty,
407:                         'notes' => 'استلام تحويل '.$transfer->transfer_number,
408:                     ], $levels);
409:                     $this->move([...$base,
410:                         'type' => StockMovementType::TransferIn,
411:                         'affected_bucket' => StockBucket::OnHand,
412:                         'quantity' => $receivedQty,
413:                         'notes' => 'استلام تحويل '.$transfer->transfer_number,
414:                     ], $levels);
415:                 }
416: 
417:                 // Any shortage is deducted from in-transit as an explicit shortage movement for loss tracking
418:                 $shortage = round($shippedQty - $receivedQty, 4);
419:                 if ($shortage > 0) {
420:                     $this->move([...$base,
421:                         'type' => StockMovementType::TransferShortage,
422:                         'affected_bucket' => StockBucket::InTransit,
423:                         'quantity' => -$shortage,
424:                         'notes' => 'عجز عند استلام تحويل '.$transfer->transfer_number,
425:                     ], $levels);
426:                     $shortageNotes[] = "عجز {$shortage} وحدة في المتغير #{$item->product_variant_id}";
427:                 }
428:             }
429: 
430:             if ($qtyUpdates !== []) {
431:                 StockTransferItem::query()->upsert($qtyUpdates, ['id'], ['received_qty', 'updated_at']);
432:             }
433: 
434:             $notes = $transfer->notes;
435:             if ($shortageNotes !== []) {
436:                 $notes = trim(($notes ? $notes.' | ' : '').implode('؛ ', $shortageNotes));
437:             }
438: 
439:             $transfer->update(['status' => TransferStatus::Received, 'received_at' => now(), 'notes' => $notes]);
440: 
441:             return $transfer->load(['items.variant', 'fromBranch', 'toBranch']);
442:         });
443:     }
444: 
445:     /**
446:      * Cancel an active transfer in draft or approved status.
447:      *
448:      * Once approved, cancelling releases reserved inventory back to available stock.
449:      * Shipped transfers cannot be cancelled and must proceed to intake/settlement.
450:      *
451:      * @param  StockTransfer  $transfer
452:      * @param  int  $userId
453:      * @return StockTransfer
454:      *
455:      * @throws BusinessException
456:      */
457:     public function cancel(StockTransfer $transfer, int $userId): StockTransfer
458:     {
459:         return DB::transaction(function () use ($transfer, $userId): StockTransfer {
460:             $transfer = StockTransfer::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($transfer->id);
461:             $transfer->load('items.variant');
462:             app(BranchAccess::class)->assertBranch($userId, $transfer->from_branch_id);
463: 
464:             if ($transfer->status === TransferStatus::Approved) {
465:                 $levels = $this->lockTransferLevels($transfer, true, false);
466:                 foreach ($transfer->items as $item) {
467:                     if ((float) $item->approved_qty <= 0) {
468:                         continue;
469:                     }
470: 
471:                     $this->move([
472:                         'product_variant_id' => $item->product_variant_id,
473:                         'branch_id' => $transfer->from_branch_id,
474:                         'location_id' => $item->from_location_id,
475:                         'type' => StockMovementType::ReleaseReserve,
476:                         'affected_bucket' => StockBucket::Reserved,
477:                         'quantity' => -(float) $item->approved_qty,
478:                         'reference_type' => StockTransfer::class,
479:                         'reference_id' => $transfer->id,
480:                         'created_by' => $userId,
481:                         'notes' => 'فك حجز عند إلغاء تحويل '.$transfer->transfer_number,
482:                     ], $levels);
483:                 }
484:             } elseif ($transfer->status !== TransferStatus::Draft) {
485:                 throw new BusinessException('لا يمكن إلغاء تحويل بحالة '.$transfer->status->value.'.');
486:             }
487: 
488:             $transfer->update(['status' => TransferStatus::Cancelled]);
489: 
490:             return $transfer->load(['items.variant', 'fromBranch', 'toBranch']);
491:         });
492:     }
493: 
494:     /**
495:      * Delete a draft or cancelled transfer.
496:      *
497:      * Transfers that have associated inventory ledger movements cannot be deleted
498:      * to preserve audit trails and prevent orphaned reference records.
499:      *
500:      * @param  StockTransfer  $transfer
501:      * @param  int  $userId
502:      * @return void
503:      *
504:      * @throws BusinessException
505:      */
506:     public function delete(StockTransfer $transfer, int $userId): void
507:     {
508:         DB::transaction(function () use ($transfer, $userId): void {
509:             $transfer = StockTransfer::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($transfer->id);
510:             app(BranchAccess::class)->assertBranch($userId, $transfer->from_branch_id);
511: 
512:             if (! in_array($transfer->status, [TransferStatus::Draft, TransferStatus::Cancelled], true)) {
513:                 throw new BusinessException('لا يمكن حذف تحويل إلا في حالة المسودة أو الملغي.');
514:             }
515: 
516:             // Transfers with posted ledger movements must be preserved for financial and audit trails
517:             if (StockMovement::query()->whereIn('reference_type', [StockTransfer::class, 'stock_transfer'])->where('reference_id', $transfer->id)->exists()) {
518:                 throw new BusinessException('لا يمكن حذف تحويل له حركات مخزون مسجلة في الدفتر؛ إلغاؤه يحفظ أثر التدقيق.');
519:             }
520: 
521:             $transfer->delete();
522:         });
523:     }
524: 
525:     /**
526:      * Prevent stale submission payloads and concurrent overwrites.
527:      *
528:      * Validates item IDs against locked items to catch deletions/swaps between request parsing
529:      * and lock acquisition, and verifies optimistic concurrency controls (version and updated_at).
530:      */
531:     private function assertPayloadMatchesLockedItems(StockTransfer $transfer, array $itemsPayload, ?string $expectedUpdatedAt, ?int $expectedVersion = null): void
532:     {
533:         if ($expectedUpdatedAt !== null && $expectedVersion === null) {
534:             throw new BusinessException('أعد تحميل التحويل لإرسال رقم الإصدار قبل التنفيذ.', [], 409);
535:         }
536:         if ($expectedVersion !== null && $expectedVersion !== $transfer->version) {
537:             throw new BusinessException('تم تعديل التحويل؛ أعد تحميله وراجع الكميات.', ['current_version' => $transfer->version], 409);
538:         }
539: 
540:         $unknownIds = array_diff(array_map('intval', array_keys($itemsPayload)), $transfer->items->pluck('id')->map(fn ($id) => (int) $id)->all());
541: 
542:         if ($unknownIds !== []) {
543:             throw new BusinessException(
544:                 'توجد عناصر في الطلب لا تتبع هذا التحويل (المعرّفات: '.implode(', ', $unknownIds).'). أعد تحميل التحويل وراجع الكميات.',
545:                 ['unknown_item_ids' => array_values($unknownIds)],
546:                 409,
547:             );
548:         }
549: 
550:         if ($expectedUpdatedAt !== null
551:             && ! Carbon::parse($expectedUpdatedAt)->equalTo($transfer->updated_at)) {
552:             throw new BusinessException(
553:                 'تم تعديل هذا التحويل بعد تحميله. أعد تحميله وراجع الكميات قبل التنفيذ.',
554:                 ['current_updated_at' => $transfer->updated_at->toIso8601String()],
555:                 409,
556:             );
557:         }
558:     }
559: 
560:     private function replayCompletedStage(StockTransfer $transfer, array $itemsPayload, string $quantityField): StockTransfer
561:     {
562:         $this->assertPayloadMatchesLockedItems($transfer, $itemsPayload, null);
563:         foreach ($transfer->items as $item) {
564:             if (array_key_exists($item->id, $itemsPayload)
565:                 && (int) round((float) $itemsPayload[$item->id] * 10000) !== (int) round((float) $item->{$quantityField} * 10000)) {
566:                 throw new BusinessException('تم تنفيذ المرحلة بكميات مختلفة؛ أعد تحميل التحويل.', [], 409);
567:             }
568:         }
569: 
570:         return $transfer->load(['fromBranch', 'toBranch']);
571:     }
572: 
573:     /**
574:      * Authorize transfer initiation from either source or destination branch.
575:      *
576:      * Transfers can be initiated by source warehouse dispatchers or destination store managers.
577:      */
578:     private function assertCreateAccess(int $userId, int $fromBranchId, int $toBranchId): void
579:     {
580:         try {
581:             app(BranchAccess::class)->assertBranch($userId, $fromBranchId);
582:         } catch (AuthorizationException) {
583:             app(BranchAccess::class)->assertBranch($userId, $toBranchId);
584:         }
585:     }
586: 
587:     private function assertStatus(StockTransfer $transfer, TransferStatus $expected, string $action): void
588:     {
589:         if ($transfer->status !== $expected) {
590:             throw new BusinessException("لا يمكن تنفيذ {$action} على تحويل بحالة {$transfer->status->value}.");
591:         }
592:     }
593: 
594:     /**
595:      * Validate destination branch, locations, and variants before dispatch.
596:      *
597:      * Prevents inventory from getting trapped in transit if the destination branch
598:      * or receiving location was archived or deactivated after transfer creation.
599:      */
600:     private function assertReceivableDestination(StockTransfer $transfer): void
601:     {
602:         $toBranch = Branch::query()->sharedLock()->find($transfer->to_branch_id);
603:         if ($toBranch === null || ! $toBranch->is_active) {
604:             throw new BusinessException('الفرع الوجهة غير نشط؛ لا يمكن اعتماد أو شحن التحويل إليه.');
605:         }
606: 
607:         $variantIds = $transfer->items->map(fn ($item) => (int) $item->product_variant_id)->unique()->values()->all();
608:         $existingVariantIds = ProductVariant::withTrashed()->whereIn('id', $variantIds)
609:             ->where('is_active', true)->pluck('id')->map(fn ($id) => (int) $id)->all();
610:         $missing = array_diff($variantIds, $existingVariantIds);
611:         if ($missing !== []) {
612:             throw new BusinessException('أحد أصناف التحويل غير نشط أو لم يعد موجودًا؛ راجع البنود قبل المتابعة.');
613:         }
614: 
615:         foreach ($transfer->items as $item) {
616:             if ($item->to_location_id !== null && ! Location::query()->whereKey($item->to_location_id)
617:                 ->where('branch_id', $transfer->to_branch_id)->where('is_active', true)->exists()) {
618:                 throw new BusinessException('موقع الاستلام غير نشط أو لا يتبع الفرع الوجهة.');
619:             }
620:         }
621:     }
622: 
623:     /**
624:      * @param  list<array{product_variant_id: int, from_location_id?: int|null, to_location_id?: int|null, requested_qty: float|int|string}>  $items
625:      */
626:     private function syncItems(StockTransfer $transfer, array $items): void
627:     {
628:         $this->assertDistinctItems($items);
629:         foreach ($items as $item) {
630:             $transfer->items()->create([
631:                 'product_variant_id' => $item['product_variant_id'],
632:                 'from_location_id' => $item['from_location_id'] ?? null,
633:                 'to_location_id' => $item['to_location_id'] ?? null,
634:                 'requested_qty' => $item['requested_qty'],
635:             ]);
636:         }
637:     }
638: 
639:     private function assertDistinctItems(array $items): void
640:     {
641:         $keys = array_map(fn ($item) => $item['product_variant_id'].':'.($item['from_location_id'] ?? 0).':'.($item['to_location_id'] ?? 0), $items);
642:         if (count(array_unique($keys)) !== count($keys)) {
643:             throw new BusinessException('لا يجوز تكرار نفس الصنف وموقعي الإرسال والاستلام داخل التحويل.');
644:         }
645:     }
646: 
647:     /**
648:      * Post movement using pre-locked stock level instances to bypass re-locking overhead.
649:      */
650:     private function move(array $data, Collection $levels): void
651:     {
652:         $level = $levels->get($this->inventory->levelKey([
653:             'product_variant_id' => $data['product_variant_id'],
654:             'branch_id' => $data['branch_id'],
655:             'location_id' => $data['location_id'] ?? null,
656:         ]));
657: 
658:         $this->inventory->recordMovement($data, $level);
659:     }
660: 
661:     private function lockTransferLevels(StockTransfer $transfer, bool $source, bool $destination): Collection
662:     {
663:         $keys = [];
664:         foreach ($transfer->items as $item) {
665:             if ($source) {
666:                 $keys[] = ['branch_id' => $transfer->from_branch_id, 'location_id' => $item->from_location_id, 'product_variant_id' => $item->product_variant_id];
667:             }
668:             if ($destination) {
669:                 $keys[] = ['branch_id' => $transfer->to_branch_id, 'location_id' => $item->to_location_id, 'product_variant_id' => $item->product_variant_id];
670:             }
671:         }
672: 
673:         return $this->inventory->lockLevels($keys);
674:     }
675: }
````

````php
35:             $created[] = Permission::firstOrCreate(['name' => $permission, 'guard_name' => 'staff']);
36:         }
37: 
38:         Role::where('name', StaffRole::SuperAdmin->value)
39:             ->where('guard_name', 'staff')
40:             ->first()
41:             ?->givePermissionTo($created);
42:     }
43: }
````

````php
 1: <?php
````
