  99: function BranchesScreen({ go }) {
 100:   const { toast, can, branchesQuery, reloadBranches } = useInv();
 101:   const [q, setQ] = useState('');
 102:   const [type, setType] = useState('all');
 103:   const [form, setForm] = useState({ open: false, initial: null });
 104:   const [del, setDel] = useState(null);
 105:   const [delBusy, setDelBusy] = useState(false);
 106:   const [delErr, setDelErr] = useState(null);
 107:   const restriction = useRestrictedBranch();
 108: 
 109:   if (!canAny(can, 'branches.view', 'branches.manage')) return <NoPerm title="الفروع والمخازن" perm="branches.view" go={go} />;
 110: 
 111:   const list = (branchesQuery.data || []).filter(b => !restriction.locked || b.id === restriction.branchId);
 112:   const { phase, error } = apiPhase(branchesQuery, list.length === 0);
 113:   const rows = list.filter(b => (type === 'all' || b.type === type) && (!q || b.name.includes(q) || (b.code || '').toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()) || (b.city || '').includes(q)));
 114:   const canAdd = canAny(can, 'branches.create', 'branches.manage');
 115:   const canEdit = canAny(can, 'branches.update', 'branches.manage');
 116:   const canDelete = canAny(can, 'branches.delete', 'branches.manage');
 117: 
 118:   const payload = f => {
 119:     const p = { name: f.name.trim(), code: f.code.trim(), type: f.type, is_active: !!f.active };
 120:     if (f.phone.trim()) p.phone = f.phone.trim();
 121:     if (f.email.trim()) p.email = f.email.trim();
 122:     if (f.address.trim()) p.address = f.address.trim();
 123:     if (f.city.trim()) p.city = f.city.trim();
 124:     return p;
 125:   };
 126:   const save = async f => {
 127:     try {
 128:       if (f.id) {
 129:         const cur = list.find(b => b.id === f.id) || {};
 130:         const next = payload(f);
 131:         const diff = {};
 132:         ['name', 'code', 'type', 'is_active', 'phone', 'email', 'address', 'city'].forEach(k => {
 133:           if ((next[k] ?? null) !== (cur[k] ?? null)) diff[k] = next[k] ?? null;
 134:         });
 135:         // PUT sends only changed fields, so an untouched unique code never re-triggers 422.
 136:         if (Object.keys(diff).length) {
 137:           diff.lock_version = cur.lock_version ?? f.lock_version ?? 0;
 138:           await branchesApi.update(f.id, diff);
 139:         }
 140:       } else {
 141:         await branchesApi.create(payload(f));
 142:       }
 143:     } catch (e) {
 144:       const ne = normalizeError(e);
 145:       return { fields: ne.fields, message: ne.message };
 146:     }
 147:     setForm({ open: false, initial: null });
 148:     reloadBranches();
 149:     toast(f.id ? 'تم حفظ التعديلات' : 'تمت إضافة ' + (f.type === 'warehouse' ? 'المخزن' : 'الفرع'));
 150:     return null;
 151:   };
 152:   const doDelete = async () => {
 153:     setDelBusy(true); setDelErr(null);
 154:     try {
 155:       await branchesApi.remove(del.id);
 156:       setDel(null); reloadBranches(); toast('تم الحذف');
 157:     } catch (e) {
 158:       setDelErr(normalizeError(e).message);
 159:     } finally { setDelBusy(false); }
 160:   };
 161:   const disableInstead = async () => {
 162:     setDelBusy(true);
 163:     try {
 164:       await branchesApi.update(del.id, { is_active: false, lock_version: del.lock_version ?? 0 });
 165:       setDel(null); setDelErr(null); reloadBranches(); toast('تم تعطيل «' + del.name + '» بدلًا من الحذف');
 166:     } catch (e) {
 167:       setDelErr(normalizeError(e).message);
 168:     } finally { setDelBusy(false); }
 169:   };
 170: 
 171:   const counts = { all: list.length, branch: list.filter(b => b.type === 'branch').length, warehouse: list.filter(b => b.type === 'warehouse').length };
 172: 
 173:   return (
 174:     <section className="space-y-5">
 175:       <PageHead title="الفروع والمخازن" sub="سجل نقاط البيع والمخازن ومواقع التخزين التابعة لكل منها."
 176:         actions={canAdd && <button className="btn btn-dark" onClick={() => setForm({ open: true, initial: null })}><Icon n="plus" s={14} w={2.2} /> إضافة فرع / مخزن</button>} />
 177: 
 178:       <Card>
 179:         <CardHead title="القائمة" meta={phase === 'ready' ? `${rows.length} من ${list.length} · ${list.filter(b => b.is_active).length} نشط` : null}
 180:           right={<>
 181:             <div className="seg">
 182:               {[['all', 'الكل'], ['branch', 'فروع'], ['warehouse', 'مخازن']].map(([k, l]) => (
 183:                 <button key={k} className={type === k ? 'on' : ''} onClick={() => setType(k)}>{l} <span className="num c-muted mr-1">{counts[k]}</span></button>
 184:               ))}
 185:             </div>
 186:             <SearchPill value={q} onChange={setQ} placeholder="الاسم، الكود، المدينة" />
 187:           </>} />
 188:         <Phase phase={phase} cols={8} error={error} onRetry={reloadBranches}
 189:           empty={<EmptyState icon="store" title="لا توجد فروع أو مخازن بعد" sub="ابدأ بإضافة المخزن الرئيسي، ثم أضف مواقع التخزين بداخله."
 190:             action={canAdd && <button className="btn btn-dark btn-sm" onClick={() => setForm({ open: true, initial: null })}><Icon n="plus" s={13} /> إضافة أول فرع</button>} />}>
 191:           {rows.length === 0 ? <EmptyState icon="search" title="لا توجد نتائج" sub="جرّب كلمة بحث أخرى أو غيّر نوع الفلتر." /> : (
 192:             <div className="overflow-x-auto">
 193:               <table className="vt">
 194:                 <thead><tr>
 195:                   <th>الاسم</th><th>الكود</th><th>النوع</th><th>المدينة</th><th>الهاتف</th><th>الحالة</th><th>مواقع التخزين</th><th>الموظفون</th><th></th>
 196:                 </tr></thead>
 197:                 <tbody>
 198:                   {rows.map(b => (
 199:                     <tr key={b.id}>
 200:                       <td>
 201:                         <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
 202:                           <span className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${b.type === 'warehouse' ? '' : 'v-icon-well'}`} style={b.type === 'warehouse' ? { background: 'var(--accent-orange-light)', color: 'var(--accent-orange)' } : {}}>
 203:                             <Icon n={b.type === 'warehouse' ? 'warehouse' : 'store'} s={14} />
 204:                           </span>
 205:                           <div><div className="font-semibold c-primary">{b.name}</div><div className="text-[11px] c-muted mono">{b.email || '—'}</div></div>
 206:                         </div>
 207:                       </td>
 208:                       <td><Sku>{b.code}</Sku></td>
 209:                       <td><TypeBadge type={b.type} /></td>
 210:                       <td className="c-secondary">{b.city || '—'}</td>
 211:                       <td className="num c-secondary" dir="ltr">{b.phone || '—'}</td>
 212:                       <td><ActiveBadge on={b.is_active} /></td>
 213:                       <td>
 214:                         <button onClick={() => go('locations', { branchId: b.id })} className="flex items-center gap-2 group">
 215:                           <span className="num font-semibold c-primary">{b.locations_count ?? '—'}</span>
 216:                           <span className="text-[11.5px] c-orange font-semibold opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition">فتح ←</span>
 217:                         </button>
 218:                       </td>
 219:                       <td className="num c-secondary">{b.employees_count ?? '—'}</td>
 220:                       <td>
 221:                         <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 justify-end">
 222:                           <button className="icon-btn" title="مواقع التخزين" onClick={() => go('locations', { branchId: b.id })}><Icon n="pin" s={15} /></button>
 223:                           {canEdit && <button className="icon-btn" title="تعديل" onClick={() => setForm({ open: true, initial: b })}><Icon n="edit" s={15} /></button>}
 224:                           {canDelete && <button className="icon-btn hover:!text-[var(--badge-red-text)]" title="حذف" onClick={() => { setDel(b); setDelErr(null); }}><Icon n="trash" s={15} /></button>}
 225:                         </div>
 226:                       </td>
 227:                     </tr>
 228:                   ))}
 229:                 </tbody>
 230:               </table>
 231:             </div>
 232:           )}
 233:         </Phase>
 234:       </Card>
 235: 
 236:       <BranchForm open={form.open} initial={form.initial} onClose={() => setForm({ open: false, initial: null })} onSave={save} />
 237:       <ConfirmDialog open={!!del} onClose={() => setDel(null)} onConfirm={doDelete} danger busy={delBusy} error={delErr}
 238:         title={`حذف ${del?.type === 'warehouse' ? 'المخزن' : 'الفرع'}؟`} confirmLabel="حذف نهائي"
 239:         body={<>سيتم حذف <b className="c-primary">{del?.name}</b> (<span className="mono">{del?.code}</span>). لا يمكن التراجع عن هذا الإجراء، وسيرفض الخادم الحذف إذا كانت هناك مواقع تخزين أو أرصدة أو حركات مرتبطة.
 240:           {delErr && canEdit && <div className="mt-3"><button type="button" className="btn btn-soft btn-sm" disabled={delBusy} onClick={disableInstead}>تعطيل بدلًا من الحذف</button></div>}</>} />
 241:     </section>
 242:   );
 243: }

 245: // ---------------- Storage locations ----------------
 246: function LocationForm({ open, initial, branchId, branchName, onClose, onSave }) {
 247:   const blank = { name: '', code: '', type: 'shelf', active: true, branchId };
 248:   const [f, setF] = useState(blank);
 249:   const [err, setErr] = useState({});
 250:   const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
 251:   useEffect(() => { if (open) { setF(initial ? { id: initial.id, name: initial.name || '', code: initial.code || '', type: initial.type || 'shelf', active: initial.is_active, branchId } : { ...blank, branchId }); setErr({}); setBusy(false); } }, [open]);
 252:   const set = (k, v) => setF(p => ({ ...p, [k]: v }));
 253:   const submit = async () => {
 254:     const e = {};
 255:     if (!f.name.trim()) e.name = 'الاسم مطلوب';
 256:     if (!f.code.trim()) e.code = 'الكود مطلوب';
 257:     // Code uniqueness inside the branch is enforced by the server (422 under code).
 258:     setErr(e);
 259:     if (Object.keys(e).length) return;
 260:     setBusy(true);
 261:     const res = await onSave(f);
 262:     setBusy(false);
 263:     if (res && (res.fields || res.message)) setErr({ ...res.fields, ...(res.message ? { _form: res.message } : {}) });
 264:   };
 265:   return (
 266:     <Modal open={open} onClose={onClose} title={initial ? 'تعديل موقع التخزين' : 'إضافة موقع تخزين'} sub={`تابع لـ ${branchName || ''}`}
 267:       footer={<><button className="btn btn-dark" onClick={submit} disabled={busy}>{initial ? 'حفظ' : 'إضافة'}</button><button className="btn btn-soft" onClick={onClose}>إلغاء</button></>}>
 268:       <div className="space-y-4">
 269:         {err._form && <InlineAlert kind="red">{err._form}</InlineAlert>}
 270:         <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
 271:           <Field label="الاسم" req error={err.name}><input className={`inp ${err.name ? 'err' : ''}`} value={f.name} onChange={e => set('name', e.target.value)} placeholder="رف A-01" /></Field>
 272:           <Field label="الكود" req error={err.code} hint="فريد داخل الفرع"><input dir="ltr" className={`inp mono text-left ${err.code ? 'err' : ''}`} value={f.code} onChange={e => set('code', e.target.value.toUpperCase())} placeholder="A-01" maxLength={100} /></Field>
 273:         </div>
 274:         <div>
 275:           <span className="field-label">النوع</span>
 276:           <div className="grid grid-cols-5 gap-2">
 277:             {Object.entries(LOCATION_TYPES).map(([k, t]) => (
 278:               <button key={k} type="button" onClick={() => set('type', k)}
 279:                 className={`rounded-xl py-2.5 text-[12px] font-medium transition border ${f.type === k ? 'border-[var(--accent-orange)] c-primary font-semibold' : 'border-transparent c-secondary'}`}
 280:                 style={{ background: f.type === k ? 'var(--accent-orange-light)' : 'var(--bg-subcard)' }}>{t}</button>
 281:             ))}
 282:           </div>
 283:         </div>
 284:         <div className="v-subcard p-3.5 flex items-center justify-between">
 285:           <span className="text-[13px] font-semibold c-primary">{f.active ? 'نشط' : 'معطّل'}</span>
 286:           <Toggle on={f.active} onChange={v => set('active', v)} />
 287:         </div>
 288:       </div>
 289:     </Modal>
 290:   );
 291: }

 293: function LocationsScreen({ go, params }) {
 294:   const { toast, can, branchesQuery, reloadBranches } = useInv();
 295:   const branchId = Number(params.branchId);
 296:   const [form, setForm] = useState({ open: false, initial: null });
 297:   const [del, setDel] = useState(null);
 298:   const [delBusy, setDelBusy] = useState(false);
 299:   const [delErr, setDelErr] = useState(null);
 300:   const [tf, setTf] = useState('all');
 301: 
 302:   const shared = branchesQuery.data || [];
 303:   const br = shared.find(b => b.id === branchId);
 304:   const sharedPhase = apiPhase(branchesQuery, shared.length === 0);
 305:   const locQuery = useApi(signal => (br ? fetchAllLocations(br.id, signal) : Promise.resolve([])), [br ? br.id : 0]);
 306:   const locPhase = apiPhase(locQuery, (locQuery.data || []).length === 0);
 307: 
 308:   const restriction = useRestrictedBranch();
 309:   if (!canAny(can, 'locations.view', 'locations.manage')) return <NoPerm title="مواقع التخزين" perm="locations.view" go={go} />;
 310:   if (restriction.locked && branchId !== Number(restriction.branchId)) return <NoPerm title="مواقع التخزين" perm="inventory.all_branches" go={go} />;
 311:   const branchOptions = (restriction.locked ? shared.filter(b => b.id === restriction.branchId) : shared.filter(b => b.is_active))
 312:     .map(b => ({ value: b.id, label: `${b.name} · ${b.type === 'warehouse' ? 'مخزن' : 'فرع'}` }));
 313: 
 314:   const phase = sharedPhase.phase === 'ready' ? locPhase.phase : sharedPhase.phase;
 315:   const error = sharedPhase.phase === 'ready' ? locPhase.error : sharedPhase.error;
 316:   const onRetry = () => { reloadBranches(); locQuery.reload(); };
 317:   const onBack = () => go('branches');
 318: 
 319:   if (sharedPhase.phase === 'ready' && !br) {
 320:     return (
 321:       <section className="space-y-5">
 322:         <PageHead title="مواقع التخزين" back={{ label: 'الفروع والمخازن', onClick: onBack }} />
 323:         <Card><EmptyState icon="pin" title="الفرع غير موجود" sub="ربما تم حذفه. اختر فرعًا آخر من القائمة."
 324:           action={<button className="btn btn-dark btn-sm" onClick={onBack}>رجوع لقائمة الفروع</button>} /></Card>
 325:       </section>
 326:     );
 327:   }
 328: 
 329:   const all = locQuery.data || [];
 330:   const rows = all.filter(l => tf === 'all' || l.type === tf);
 331:   const canAdd = canAny(can, 'locations.create', 'locations.manage');
 332:   const canEdit = canAny(can, 'locations.update', 'locations.manage');
 333:   const canDelete = canAny(can, 'locations.delete', 'locations.manage');
 334: 
 335:   const payload = f => ({ name: f.name.trim(), code: f.code.trim(), type: f.type, is_active: !!f.active });
 336:   const save = async f => {
 337:     try {
 338:       if (f.id) {
 339:         const cur = all.find(l => l.id === f.id) || {};
 340:         const next = payload(f);
 341:         const diff = {};
 342:         ['name', 'code', 'type', 'is_active'].forEach(k => { if ((next[k] ?? null) !== (cur[k] ?? null)) diff[k] = next[k] ?? null; });
 343:         if (Object.keys(diff).length) await locationsApi.update(br.id, f.id, diff);
 344:       } else {
 345:         await locationsApi.create(br.id, payload(f));
 346:       }
 347:     } catch (e) {
 348:       const ne = normalizeError(e);
 349:       return { fields: ne.fields, message: ne.message };
 350:     }
 351:     setForm({ open: false, initial: null });
 352:     reloadBranches(); locQuery.reload(); toast('تم حفظ موقع التخزين');
 353:     return null;
 354:   };
 355:   const toggle = async l => {
 356:     try {
 357:       await locationsApi.update(br.id, l.id, { is_active: !l.is_active });
 358:       reloadBranches(); locQuery.reload(); toast(l.is_active ? 'تم تعطيل الموقع' : 'تم تفعيل الموقع');
 359:     } catch (e) { toast(normalizeError(e).message); }
 360:   };
 361:   const doDelete = async () => {
 362:     setDelBusy(true); setDelErr(null);
 363:     try {
 364:       await locationsApi.remove(br.id, del.id);
 365:       setDel(null); reloadBranches(); locQuery.reload(); toast('تم حذف الموقع');
 366:     } catch (e) {
 367:       setDelErr(normalizeError(e).message);
 368:     } finally { setDelBusy(false); }
 369:   };
 370: 
 371:   const typeCounts = Object.keys(LOCATION_TYPES).reduce((a, k) => ({ ...a, [k]: all.filter(l => l.type === k).length }), {});
 372: 
 373:   return (
 374:     <section className="space-y-5">
 375:       <PageHead title="مواقع التخزين" back={{ label: 'الفروع والمخازن', onClick: onBack }}
 376:         sub={br && <span className="flex items-center gap-2">{br.name} <span className="mono text-[11.5px] c-muted" dir="ltr">{br.code}</span> <TypeBadge type={br.type} /></span>}
 377:         actions={<>
 378:           <Sel value={br?.id} onChange={id => id && go('locations', { branchId: id })} options={branchOptions} placeholder="اختر الفرع" className="!rounded-full !py-2 w-56" disabled={restriction.locked} />
 379:           {canAdd && <button className="btn btn-dark" onClick={() => setForm({ open: true, initial: null })}><Icon n="plus" s={14} w={2.2} /> إضافة موقع</button>}
 380:         </>} />
 381: 
 382:       <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-5">
 383:         <Card className="lg:col-span-4" stagger={2}>
 384:           <div className="v-orange-card rounded-[18px] p-5">
 385:             <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
 386:               <span className="text-[12.5px] font-medium text-white/90">إجمالي المواقع</span>
 387:               <span className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-white/15 flex items-center justify-center"><Icon n="pin" s={14} /></span>
 388:             </div>
 389:             <div className="font-display text-[40px] font-bold num text-right mt-2">{phase === 'ready' ? all.length : '—'}</div>
 390:             <div className="text-[11.5px] text-white/80">{all.filter(l => l.is_active).length} نشط · {all.filter(l => !l.is_active).length} معطّل</div>
 391:           </div>
 392:           <div className="mt-4 space-y-1">
 393:             {Object.entries(LOCATION_TYPES).map(([k, t]) => (
 394:               <button key={k} onClick={() => setTf(tf === k ? 'all' : k)} className={`w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl transition ${tf === k ? 'bg-[var(--bg-subcard)]' : 'hover:bg-[var(--bg-subcard)]'}`}>
 395:                 <span className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-[12.5px] c-primary"><Badge cls={({ shelf: 'b-gray', zone: 'b-blue', bin: 'b-gray', damaged: 'b-red', receiving: 'b-amber' })[k]}>{t}</Badge></span>
 396:                 <span className="flex items-center gap-3">
 397:                   <span className="w-20 h-1.5 rounded-full hatched overflow-hidden"><span className="block h-full bg-[var(--accent-orange)] rounded-full" style={{ width: `${all.length ? typeCounts[k] / all.length * 100 : 0}%` }} /></span>
 398:                   <span className="num text-[12px] font-semibold c-primary w-4 text-left">{typeCounts[k]}</span>
 399:                 </span>
 400:               </button>
 401:             ))}
 402:           </div>
 403:         </Card>
 404: 
 405:         <Card className="lg:col-span-8" stagger={3}>
 406:           <CardHead title="المواقع" meta={tf === 'all' ? 'كل الأنواع' : LOCATION_TYPES[tf]}
 407:             right={tf !== 'all' && <button className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onClick={() => setTf('all')}><Icon n="x" s={12} /> إزالة الفلتر</button>} />
 408:           <Phase phase={phase} cols={5} rows={5} error={error} onRetry={onRetry} onBack={onBack}
 409:             empty={<EmptyState icon="pin" title="لا توجد مواقع تخزين في هذا الفرع" sub="أضف رفوفًا ومناطق وخانات لتحديد مكان كل صنف بدقة."
 410:               action={canAdd && <button className="btn btn-dark btn-sm" onClick={() => setForm({ open: true, initial: null })}><Icon n="plus" s={13} /> إضافة موقع</button>} />}>
 411:             {rows.length === 0 ? <EmptyState icon="pin" title="لا توجد مواقع من هذا النوع" /> : (
 412:               <table className="vt">
 413:                 <thead><tr><th>الاسم</th><th>الكود</th><th>النوع</th><th>الحالة</th><th></th></tr></thead>
 414:                 <tbody>
 415:                   {rows.map(l => (
 416:                     <tr key={l.id} className={l.is_active ? '' : 'opacity-60'}>
 417:                       <td className="font-semibold c-primary">{l.name}</td>
 418:                       <td><Sku>{l.code}</Sku></td>
 419:                       <td><Badge cls={({ shelf: 'b-gray', zone: 'b-blue', bin: 'b-gray', damaged: 'b-red', receiving: 'b-amber' })[l.type] || 'b-gray'}>{LOCATION_TYPES[l.type] || l.type}</Badge></td>
 420:                       <td>
 421:                         <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
 422:                           {canEdit && <Toggle on={l.is_active} onChange={() => toggle(l)} />}
 423:                           <span className={`text-[11.5px] font-semibold ${l.is_active ? '' : 'c-muted'}`} style={l.is_active ? { color: 'var(--badge-green-text)' } : {}}>{l.is_active ? 'نشط' : 'معطّل'}</span>
 424:                         </div>
 425:                       </td>
 426:                       <td>
 427:                         {(canEdit || canDelete) && (
 428:                           <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 justify-end">
 429:                             {canEdit && <button className="icon-btn" title="تعديل" onClick={() => setForm({ open: true, initial: l })}><Icon n="edit" s={15} /></button>}
 430:                             {canDelete && <button className="icon-btn" title="حذف" onClick={() => { setDel(l); setDelErr(null); }}><Icon n="trash" s={15} /></button>}
 431:                           </div>
 432:                         )}
 433:                       </td>
 434:                     </tr>
 435:                   ))}
 436:                 </tbody>
 437:               </table>
 438:             )}
 439:           </Phase>
 440:         </Card>
 441:       </div>
 442: 
 443:       <LocationForm open={form.open} initial={form.initial} branchId={br?.id} branchName={br?.name} onClose={() => setForm({ open: false, initial: null })} onSave={save} />
 444:       <ConfirmDialog open={!!del} onClose={() => setDel(null)} onConfirm={doDelete} danger busy={delBusy} error={delErr} title="حذف موقع التخزين؟" confirmLabel="حذف"
 445:         body={<>سيتم حذف <b className="c-primary">{del?.name}</b> (<span className="mono">{del?.code}</span>) من {br?.name}.</>} />
 446:     </section>
 447:   );
 448: }

 453: function CountsScreen({ go }) {
 454:   const { can, branchesQuery } = useInv();
 455:   const restriction = useRestrictedBranch();
 456:   const [create, setCreate] = useState(false);
 457:   const [branchF, setBranchF] = useState(null);
 458:   const [st, setSt] = useState('all');
 459:   const allowed = canAny(can, 'stocktakes.view', 'stocktakes.manage');
 460: 
 461:   // Small cardinality like branches: fetch all pages so filters run client-side.
 462:   const query = useApi(signal => (async () => {
 463:     const all = []; let page = 1; let last = 1;
 464:     do {
 465:       const res = await stocktakesApi.list({ per_page: 100, page, branch_id: (restriction.locked ? restriction.branchId : branchF) || undefined, status: st === 'all' ? undefined : st }, signal);
 466:       all.push(...(res.data || [])); last = res.meta?.last_page || 1; page += 1;
 467:     } while (page <= last);
 468:     return all;
 469:   })(), [branchF, st, restriction.branchId]);
 470:   const canCreate = canAny(can, 'stocktakes.create', 'stocktakes.manage');
 471: 
 472:   if (!allowed) return <NoPerm title="الجرد" perm="stocktakes.view" go={go} />;
 473: 
 474:   const list = query.data || [];
 475:   const { phase, error } = apiPhase(query, list.length === 0);
 476:   const effBranch = restriction.locked ? restriction.branchId : branchF;
 477:   const rows = list.filter(c => (st === 'all' || c.status === st) && (!effBranch || c.branch?.id === effBranch));
 478:   const shared = branchesQuery.data || [];
 479:   const branchOptions = shared.filter(b => b.is_active && (!restriction.locked || b.id === restriction.branchId)).map(b => ({ value: b.id, label: `${b.name} · ${b.type === 'warehouse' ? 'مخزن' : 'فرع'}` }));
 480:   const active = (branchF ? 1 : 0) + (st !== 'all' ? 1 : 0);
 481: 
 482:   return (
 483:     <section className="space-y-5">
 484:       <PageHead title="الجرد" sub="مقارنة الكميات الموجودة فعليًا بالمسجّلة في النظام، ثم اعتماد الفروق كتسويات."
 485:         actions={canCreate && <button className="btn btn-dark" onClick={() => setCreate(true)}><Icon n="plus" s={14} w={2.2} /> جرد جديد</button>} />
 486:       <Card stagger={2}>
 487:         <CardHead title="القائمة" meta={phase === 'ready' ? `${rows.length} عملية` : null} right={
 488:           <div className="seg">
 489:             <button className={st === 'all' ? 'on' : ''} onClick={() => setSt('all')}>الكل</button>
 490:             {Object.entries(STOCKTAKE_STATUS).map(([k, t]) => <button key={k} className={st === k ? 'on' : ''} onClick={() => setSt(k)}>{t}</button>)}
 491:           </div>} />
 492:         <FilterBar active={active} onReset={() => { setBranchF(null); setSt('all'); }}>
 493:           <FItem label="الفرع"><Sel small value={effBranch} disabled={restriction.locked} onChange={v => setBranchF(v || null)} placeholder="كل الفروع" options={branchOptions} className="!bg-[var(--bg-card)]" /></FItem>
 494:         </FilterBar>
 495:         <Phase phase={phase} cols={6} error={error} onRetry={() => query.reload()}
 496:           empty={<EmptyState icon="clipboard" title="لم يتم إنشاء أي جرد بعد" sub="ابدأ جردًا لفرع كامل أو لموقع تخزين محدد."
 497:             action={canCreate && <button className="btn btn-dark btn-sm" onClick={() => setCreate(true)}><Icon n="plus" s={13} /> جرد جديد</button>} />}>
 498:           {rows.length === 0 ? <EmptyState icon="filter" title="لا توجد عمليات جرد بهذه الفلاتر" /> : (
 499:           <table className="vt">
 500:             <thead><tr><th>رقم الجرد</th><th>الفرع</th><th>الموقع</th><th>البنود</th><th>الحالة</th><th>المنشئ</th><th>التاريخ</th><th></th></tr></thead>
 501:             <tbody>
 502:               {rows.map(c => (
 503:                 <tr key={c.id} className="cursor-pointer" onClick={() => go('count', { id: c.id })}>
 504:                   <td><span className="mono text-[12px] font-semibold c-primary" dir="ltr">{c.stocktake_number}</span></td>
 505:                   <td className="c-primary font-medium">{c.branch?.name || '—'}</td>
 506:                   <td className="mono text-[11.5px] c-secondary" dir="ltr">{c.location ? c.location.name : <span className="c-muted" style={{ fontFamily: 'inherit' }}>كل المواقع</span>}</td>
 507:                   <td className="num text-[11.5px] c-secondary">{c.items_count ?? '—'} بند</td>
 508:                   <td><Badge cls={({ draft: 'b-gray', in_progress: 'b-amber', approved: 'b-green', cancelled: 'b-red' })[c.status] || 'b-gray'} dot>{STOCKTAKE_STATUS[c.status] || c.status}</Badge></td>
 509:                   <td className="c-secondary">{c.creator_name || '—'}</td>
 510:                   <td className="num text-[11.5px] c-secondary">{formatDate(c.created_at)}</td>
 511:                   <td><Icon n="chevL" s={15} className="c-muted" /></td>
 512:                 </tr>
 513:               ))}
 514:             </tbody>
 515:           </table>)}
 516:         </Phase>
 517:       </Card>
 518:       <CountCreate open={create} onClose={() => setCreate(false)} go={go} onCreated={() => query.reload()} />
 519:     </section>
 520:   );
 521: }
 522: // NOTE: the stocktake list resource carries items_count but not the items, so the
 523: // old counted/total progress bar was replaced by the items total.
 524: 
 525: function CountCreate({ open, onClose, go, onCreated }) {
 526:   const { toast, can, branchesQuery, variantCache } = useInv();
 527:   const { keyFor, reset } = useIdempotencyKey();
 528:   const [branchId, setBranchId] = useState(null);
 529:   const [locId, setLocId] = useState(null);
 530:   const [note, setNote] = useState('');
 531:   const [mode, setMode] = useState('all');
 532:   const [picked, setPicked] = useState([]);
 533:   const [tried, setTried] = useState(false);
 534:   const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
 535:   const [srvErr, setSrvErr] = useState(null);
 536:   useEffect(() => { if (open) { setBranchId(null); setLocId(null); setNote(''); setMode('all'); setPicked([]); setTried(false); setBusy(false); setSrvErr(null); } }, [open]);
 537:   const restriction = useRestrictedBranch();
 538:   const effBranch = restriction.locked ? restriction.branchId : branchId;
 539: 
 540:   const scopeQuery = useApi(signal => (effBranch
 541:     ? (async () => {
 542:         const all = []; let page = 1; let last = 1;
 543:         do {
 544:           const res = await stockApi.levels({ branch_id: effBranch, location_id: locId || undefined, per_page: 100, page }, signal);
 545:           all.push(...(res.data || [])); last = res.meta?.last_page || 1; page += 1;
 546:         } while (page <= last);
 547:         return all;
 548:       })()
 549:     : Promise.resolve([])), [effBranch || 0, locId || 0]);
 550:   const scopeIds = useMemo(() => [...new Set((scopeQuery.data || []).map(s => s.product_variant_id))], [scopeQuery.data]);
 551:   useEffect(() => { cacheVariantNames(variantCache, (scopeQuery.data || []).map(s => s.variant)); }, [scopeQuery.data]);
 552: 
 553:   const locsQuery = useBranchesWithLocations(effBranch);
 554: 
 555:   const items = mode === 'all' ? scopeIds : picked;
 556:   const valid = effBranch && items.length > 0 && (mode !== 'all' || (!scopeQuery.loading && !scopeQuery.error));
 557: 
 558:   const submit = async () => {
 559:     setTried(true); if (!valid || busy) return;
 560:     setBusy(true); setSrvErr(null);
 561:     const payload = {
 562:       branch_id: effBranch, ...(locId ? { location_id: locId } : {}),
 563:       notes: note.trim() || null,
 564:       items: items.slice(0, 500).map(id => ({ product_variant_id: id, counted_qty: null })),
 565:     };
 566:     try {
 567:       // No snapshot is taken without items: a full-scope count is built by
 568:       // paging every stock level, then topping up past 500 via PATCH chunks.
 569:       const res = await stocktakesApi.create(payload, keyFor(payload));
 570:       const rest = items.slice(500);
 571:       for (let i = 0; i < rest.length; i += 500) {
 572:         await stocktakesApi.updateItems(res.data.id, rest.slice(i, i + 500).map(id => ({ product_variant_id: id, counted_qty: null })));
 573:       }
 574:       // New counts start as draft: move straight into counting like the old flow.
 575:       try { await stocktakesApi.update(res.data.id, { status: 'in_progress' }); } catch { /* detail still opens as draft */ }
 576:       reset();
 577:       toast(res.message || 'تم إنشاء الجرد'); onClose(); onCreated && onCreated(); go('count', { id: res.data.id });
 578:     } catch (e) {
 579:       setSrvErr(normalizeError(e).message);
 580:       setBusy(false);
 581:     }
 582:   };
 583: 
 584:   const shared = branchesQuery.data || [];
 585:   const branchOptions = (restriction.locked ? shared.filter(b => b.id === restriction.branchId) : shared.filter(b => b.is_active))
 586:     .map(b => ({ value: b.id, label: `${b.name} · ${b.type === 'warehouse' ? 'مخزن' : 'فرع'}` }));
 587:   const locOptions = (locsQuery.data || []).filter(l => l.is_active).map(l => ({ value: l.id, label: `${l.name} (${l.code})` }));
 588: 
 589:   return (
 590:     <Modal open={open} onClose={onClose} width="max-w-2xl" title="جرد جديد" sub="حتى 500 بند عند الإنشاء، والباقي يُستكمل تلقائيًا"
 591:       footer={<><button className="btn btn-dark" onClick={submit} disabled={busy}>{busy && <span className="w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full border-2 border-current border-t-transparent animate-spin" />} إنشاء وبدء العدّ</button><button className="btn btn-soft" onClick={onClose}>إلغاء</button></>}>
 592:       <div className="space-y-4">
 593:         {srvErr && <InlineAlert kind="red">{srvErr}</InlineAlert>}
 594:         <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
 595:           <Field label="الفرع" req error={tried && !effBranch ? 'مطلوب' : null}><Sel value={effBranch} onChange={v => { if (!restriction.locked) { setBranchId(v || null); setLocId(null); } }} placeholder="اختر…" disabled={restriction.locked} options={branchOptions} /></Field>
 596:           <Field label="الموقع" hint="اختياري"><Sel value={locId} onChange={v => setLocId(v || null)} placeholder={effBranch ? 'كل المواقع' : '—'} disabled={!effBranch} options={locOptions} /></Field>
 597:         </div>
 598:         <div>
 599:           <span className="field-label">الأصناف</span>
 600:           <div className="seg mb-3">
 601:             <button className={mode === 'all' ? 'on' : ''} onClick={() => setMode('all')}>كل الأصناف في النطاق</button>
 602:             <button className={mode === 'pick' ? 'on' : ''} onClick={() => setMode('pick')}>اختيار أصناف محددة</button>
 603:           </div>
 604:           {mode === 'all' ? (
 605:             <div className="v-subcard p-3.5 flex items-center justify-between">
 606:               <span className="text-[12.5px] c-secondary">{effBranch ? 'سيتم إدراج كل SKU له رصيد في النطاق المحدد' : 'اختر الفرع لعرض عدد الأصناف'}</span>
 607:               <span className="num font-display text-[20px] font-bold c-primary">{scopeQuery.loading ? '…' : items.length}</span>
 608:             </div>
 609:           ) : (
 610:             <div className="space-y-2">
 611:               <VariantPicker value={null} onChange={v => v && setPicked(p => p.length < 500 ? [...p, v] : p)} exclude={picked} placeholder="أضف SKU…" />
 612:               <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
 613:                 {picked.map(v => <span key={v} className="badge b-gray !py-1"><span className="mono" dir="ltr">{variantCache.get(Number(v))?.sku || `#${v}`}</span><button onClick={() => setPicked(p => p.filter(x => x !== v))}><Icon n="x" s={11} /></button></span>)}
 614:                 {picked.length === 0 && <span className="text-[11.5px] c-muted">لم تتم إضافة أصناف</span>}
 615:               </div>
 616:             </div>
 617:           )}
 618:           {tried && effBranch && items.length === 0 && <div className="text-[11px] mt-1.5" style={{ color: 'var(--badge-red-text)' }}>لا توجد أصناف للجرد</div>}
 619:           <div className="text-[11px] c-muted mt-1.5 num">{items.length} / 500</div>
 620:         </div>
 621:         <Field label="ملاحظات"><textarea maxLength={2000} className="inp" rows={2} value={note} onChange={e => setNote(e.target.value)} /></Field>
 622:       </div>
 623:     </Modal>
 624:   );
 625: }
 626: 
 627: function CountDetail({ go, params }) {
 628:   const { toast, can, variantCache } = useInv();
 629:   const id = Number(params.id);
 630:   const [vals, setVals] = useState({});
 631:   const [filter, setFilter] = useState('all');
 632:   const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState(false);
 633:   const [pendingAction, setPendingAction] = useState(null);
 634:   const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
 635:   const [err, setErr] = useState(null);
 636:   const [dirty, setDirty] = useState(false);
 637:   const [stale, setStale] = useState({ itemIds: [], variantIds: [] });
 638:   const canEdit = canAny(can, 'stocktakes.update', 'stocktakes.manage');
 639:   const canApprove = canAny(can, 'stocktakes.approve', 'stocktakes.manage');
 640:   const canDelete = canAny(can, 'stocktakes.delete', 'stocktakes.manage');
 641: 
 642:   const query = useApi(signal => stocktakesApi.show(id, signal).then(t => {
 643:     cacheVariantNames(variantCache, (t.items || []).map(it => ({ id: it.product_variant_id, sku: it.sku })));
 644:     return t;
 645:   }), [id]);
 646: 
 647:   useEffect(() => {
 648:     const t = query.data;
 649:     if (t && !dirty) {
 650:       setVals(Object.fromEntries((t.items || []).map(it => [it.product_variant_id, it.counted_qty === null ? '' : String(it.counted_qty)])));
 651:     }
 652:   }, [query.data]);
 653: 
 654:   useEffect(() => {
 655:     if (!dirty) return;
 656:     const warn = e => { e.preventDefault(); e.returnValue = ''; };
 657:     window.addEventListener('beforeunload', warn);
 658:     return () => window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', warn);
 659:   }, [dirty]);
 660:   useEffect(() => {
 661:     window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('inventory:dirty', { detail: dirty }));
 662:     return () => window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('inventory:dirty', { detail: false }));
 663:   }, [dirty]);
 664: 
 665:   if (!canAny(can, 'stocktakes.view', 'stocktakes.manage')) return <NoPerm title="تفاصيل الجرد" perm="stocktakes.view" go={go} />;
 666: 
 667:   const c = query.data;
 668:   const { phase, error } = apiPhase(query, !c);
 669:   const onRetry = () => { query.reload(); };
 670: 
 671:   // "" means "not counted yet", "0" means an actual zero — never coerce "" to 0.
 672:   const countedOf = v => (v === '' || v === undefined ? null : Number(toLatinDigits(v)));
 673:   const rows = ((c?.items) || []).map(it => {
 674:     const v = vals[it.product_variant_id];
 675:     const a = countedOf(v);
 676:     const changed = a !== (it.counted_qty == null ? null : Number(it.counted_qty));
 677:     const diff = it.system_qty == null ? null : changed ? (a === null ? null : +((a - Number(it.system_qty)).toFixed(4))) : (it.difference == null ? null : Number(it.difference));
 678:     return { ...it, a, diff, isStale: stale.itemIds.includes(it.id) || stale.variantIds.includes(it.product_variant_id) };
 679:   });
 680:   const counted = rows.filter(r => r.a !== null).length;
 681:   const bookVisible = rows.some(r => r.system_qty != null);
 682:   const shown = rows.filter(r => filter === 'all' || (filter === 'uncounted' && r.a === null) || (filter === 'diff' && r.diff) || (filter === 'match' && r.diff === 0) || (filter === 'stale' && r.isStale));
 683:   const diffs = rows.filter(r => r.diff);
 684:   const editable = c && !['approved', 'cancelled'].includes(c.status) && canEdit;
 685: 
 686:   const chunked = arr => { const out = []; for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += 500) out.push(arr.slice(i, i + 500)); return out; };
 687:   const saveCounts = async (only = null) => {
 688:     if (busy) return;
 689:     if (rows.some(r => {
 690:       const v = vals[r.product_variant_id];
 691:       return v !== '' && v !== undefined && (!QTY_RE.test(toLatinDigits(v)) || Number(toLatinDigits(v)) > QTY_MAX);
 692:     })) { setErr('الكمية يجب أن تكون صفرًا أو أكبر، وبحد أقصى أربع خانات عشرية.'); return; }
 693:     setBusy(true); setErr(null);
 694:     const targets = only ? rows.filter(r => only.includes(r.product_variant_id)) : rows.filter(r => {
 695:       const cur = c.items.find(it => it.product_variant_id === r.product_variant_id);
 696:       return r.a !== (cur?.counted_qty == null ? null : Number(cur.counted_qty));
 697:     });
 698:     try {
 699:       for (const part of chunked(targets)) {
 700:         await stocktakesApi.updateItems(id, part.map(r => ({
 701:           product_variant_id: r.product_variant_id, counted_qty: r.a,
 702:           ...(r.isStale ? { recount: true } : {}),
 703:         })));
 704:       }
 705:       const savedIds = new Set(targets.map(r => r.product_variant_id));
 706:       setDirty(rows.some(r => !savedIds.has(r.product_variant_id) && r.a !== (c.items.find(it => it.product_variant_id === r.product_variant_id)?.counted_qty == null ? null : Number(c.items.find(it => it.product_variant_id === r.product_variant_id).counted_qty))));
 707:       setStale(s => ({ itemIds: s.itemIds.filter(x => !targets.some(r => r.id === x)), variantIds: s.variantIds.filter(x => !savedIds.has(x)) }));
 708:       toast('تم حفظ العدّ'); query.reload();
 709:     } catch (e) { setErr(normalizeError(e).message); }
 710:     setBusy(false);
 711:   };
 712:   const startCounting = async () => {
 713:     setBusy(true); setErr(null);
 714:     try { await stocktakesApi.update(id, { status: 'in_progress' }); toast('بدأ العدّ'); query.reload(); }
 715:     catch (e) { setErr(normalizeError(e).message); }
 716:     setBusy(false);
 717:   };
 718:   const changeStatus = async () => {
 719:     if (busy) return;
 720:     setBusy(true); setErr(null);
 721:     try {
 722:       if (pendingAction === 'delete') {
 723:         const res = await stocktakesApi.remove(id);
 724:         setDirty(false); window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('inventory:dirty', { detail: false }));
 725:         toast(res.message || 'تم حذف الجرد'); go('counts');
 726:       } else {
 727:         await stocktakesApi.update(id, { status: 'cancelled' });
 728:         setDirty(false); query.reload(); toast('تم إلغاء الجرد');
 729:       }
 730:       setPendingAction(null);
 731:     } catch (e) { setErr(normalizeError(e).message); }
 732:     setBusy(false);
 733:   };
 734:   const approve = async () => {
 735:     setBusy(true); setErr(null);
 736:     try {
 737:       const res = await stocktakesApi.approve(id);
 738:       setConfirm(false); setStale({ itemIds: [], variantIds: [] });
 739:       toast(res.message || 'تم اعتماد الجرد وترحيل الفروق'); query.reload();
 740:     } catch (e) {
 741:       const ne = normalizeError(e);
 742:       if (/لم تُعدّ/.test(ne.message)) { setFilter('uncounted'); query.reload(); }
 743:       if (ne.fields?.recount_item_ids || ne.fields?.recount_variant_ids) {
 744:         setStale({
 745:           itemIds: (ne.fields.recount_item_ids || []).map(Number),
 746:           variantIds: (ne.fields.recount_variant_ids || []).map(Number),
 747:         });
 748:         setFilter('stale');
 749:       }
 750:       setErr(ne.message);
 751:     }
 752:     setBusy(false);
 753:   };
 754: 
 755:   return (
 756:     <section className="space-y-5">
 757:       <PageHead title={c ? <span className="mono" dir="ltr">{c.stocktake_number}</span> : 'تفاصيل الجرد'} back={{ label: 'الجرد', onClick: () => go('counts') }}
 758:         sub={c && <span className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">{c.branch?.name || '—'} <span className="c-muted">·</span> {c.location ? <span className="mono" dir="ltr">{c.location.name}</span> : 'كل المواقع'} <Badge cls={({ draft: 'b-gray', in_progress: 'b-amber', approved: 'b-green', cancelled: 'b-red' })[c.status] || 'b-gray'} dot>{STOCKTAKE_STATUS[c.status] || c.status}</Badge></span>}
 759:         actions={c && c.status !== 'approved' && <>
 760:           {canDelete && ['draft', 'cancelled'].includes(c.status) && <button className="btn btn-danger" disabled={busy} onClick={() => { setErr(null); setPendingAction('delete'); }}>حذف الجرد</button>}
 761:           {editable && <button className="btn btn-soft" disabled={busy} onClick={() => { setErr(null); setPendingAction('cancel'); }}>إلغاء الجرد</button>}
 762:           {c.status === 'draft' && canEdit && <button className="btn btn-soft" disabled={busy} onClick={startCounting}>بدء العدّ</button>}
 763:           {editable && <button className="btn btn-soft" disabled={!dirty || busy} onClick={() => saveCounts()}>{busy ? 'جارٍ الحفظ…' : 'حفظ العدّ'}</button>}
 764:           {c.status !== 'cancelled' && (canApprove
 765:             ? <button className="btn btn-orange" onClick={() => { setErr(null); setConfirm(true); }} disabled={busy || dirty || !rows.length || counted < rows.length}><Icon n="check" s={14} w={2.2} /> اعتماد الجرد</button>
 766:             : <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11.5px] c-muted px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full v-subcard"><Icon n="lock" s={12} /> الاعتماد يتطلب صلاحية</span>)}
 767:         </>} />
 768: 
 769:       {dirty && <InlineAlert kind="amber" icon="info" title="تغييرات غير محفوظة">احفظ العدّ قبل مغادرة الصفحة حتى لا تضيع الكميات المدخلة.</InlineAlert>}
 770:       {err && !confirm && <InlineAlert kind="red">{err}<button className="btn btn-soft btn-sm" disabled={busy} onClick={() => saveCounts()}>إعادة المحاولة</button></InlineAlert>}
 771: 
 772:       <Phase phase={phase} cols={5} rows={5} error={error} onRetry={onRetry} onBack={() => go('counts')} empty={<Card><EmptyState icon="clipboard" title="لا توجد بنود في هذا الجرد" /></Card>}>
 773:         {c && (<>
 774:         <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3.5 stagger-item stagger-2">
 775:           <KPI hot label="تم العدّ" icon="clipboard" value={`${counted}/${rows.length}`} sub={counted < rows.length ? `${rows.length - counted} بند لم يُعدّ بعد` : 'اكتمل العدّ'} />
 776:           <KPI label="مطابق" icon="check" value={bookVisible ? rows.filter(r => r.diff === 0).length : '—'} />
 777:           <KPI label="بفروق" icon="alert" value={bookVisible ? diffs.length : '—'} />
 778:           <KPI label="صافي الفرق" icon="sliders" value={bookVisible ? (() => { const n = diffs.reduce((a, r) => a + r.diff, 0); return (n > 0 ? '+' : '') + formatQty(n); })() : '—'} sub={bookVisible ? 'بالوحدات' : 'مخفي أثناء العدّ'} />
 779:         </div>
 780: 
 781:         <Card stagger={3}>
 782:           <CardHead title="جدول العدّ" right={
 783:             <div className="seg">
 784:               {[['all', 'الكل'], ['uncounted', 'لم يُعدّ'], ['diff', 'بفروق'], ['match', 'مطابق'], ...(stale.itemIds.length || stale.variantIds.length ? [['stale', 'يحتاج إعادة عدّ']] : [])].map(([k, l]) => <button key={k} disabled={!bookVisible && ['diff', 'match'].includes(k)} className={filter === k ? 'on' : ''} onClick={() => setFilter(k)}>{l}</button>)}
 785:             </div>} />
 786:           {counted < rows.length && c.status !== 'approved' && <div className="mb-3"><InlineAlert kind="amber" icon="info" title="الحقل الفارغ ≠ صفر">الخانة الفارغة المظللة تعني «لم يتم العدّ». إذا كان الصنف غير موجود فعليًا اكتب 0 أو اضغط «صفر».</InlineAlert></div>}
 787:           {stale.itemIds.length + stale.variantIds.length > 0 && <div className="mb-3"><InlineAlert kind="red" icon="alert" title="أصناف تحتاج إعادة عدّ">تغيّر رصيدها بعد عدّها. عدّها من جديد ثم اضغط «إعادة العدّ» على البند.</InlineAlert></div>}
 788:           {shown.length === 0 ? <EmptyState icon="filter" title="لا توجد بنود بهذا الفلتر" /> : (
 789:             <table className="vt">
 790:               <thead><tr><th>SKU</th><th>الصنف</th><th className="t-num">كمية النظام</th><th className="t-num" style={{ width: 200 }}>الكمية الفعلية</th><th className="t-num">الفرق</th><th>الحالة</th></tr></thead>
 791:               <tbody>
 792:                 {shown.map(r => (
 793:                   <tr key={r.product_variant_id} className={r.isStale ? 'ring-1 ring-inset' : ''} style={r.isStale ? { background: 'var(--badge-red-bg)' } : {}}>
 794:                     <td><Sku>{r.sku || `#${r.product_variant_id}`}</Sku></td>
 795:                     <td><div className="font-medium c-primary truncate">{variantDisplayName(variantCache, r.product_variant_id, r.sku)}</div></td>
 796:                     <td className="t-num num c-secondary">{r.system_qty == null ? '—' : formatQty(r.system_qty)}</td>
 797:                     <td className="t-num">
 798:                       {editable ? (
 799:                         <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 justify-end">
 800:                           {r.a === null && <button className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm !px-2 !py-1 text-[11px]" onClick={() => { setVals(v => ({ ...v, [r.product_variant_id]: '0' })); setDirty(true); }}>صفر</button>}
 801:                           <div className={`rounded-[10px] w-28 ${r.a === null ? 'uncounted' : ''}`}>
 802:                             <NumInput small value={vals[r.product_variant_id] ?? ''} placeholder="لم يُعدّ" onChange={v => { setVals(x => ({ ...x, [r.product_variant_id]: v })); setDirty(true); }} className={r.a === null ? '!bg-transparent' : ''} />
 803:                           </div>
 804:                           {r.a !== null && <button className="icon-btn !w-6 !h-6" title="مسح (لم يُعدّ)" onClick={() => { setVals(v => ({ ...v, [r.product_variant_id]: '' })); setDirty(true); }}><Icon n="x" s={11} /></button>}
 805:                           {r.isStale && <button className="btn btn-soft btn-sm" disabled={busy} onClick={() => saveCounts([r.product_variant_id])}>إعادة العدّ</button>}
 806:                         </div>
 807:                       ) : <span className="num font-semibold c-primary">{r.a === null ? <span className="c-muted font-normal">لم يُعدّ</span> : formatQty(r.a)}</span>}
 808:                     </td>
 809:                     <td className="t-num num font-bold" style={{ color: r.diff === null ? 'var(--text-muted)' : r.diff > 0 ? 'var(--badge-green-text)' : r.diff < 0 ? 'var(--badge-red-text)' : 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
 810:                       {r.diff === null ? '—' : r.diff === 0 ? '0' : (r.diff > 0 ? '+' : '−') + formatQty(Math.abs(r.diff))}
 811:                     </td>
 812:                     <td>{r.isStale ? <Badge cls="b-red">تحتاج إعادة عدّ</Badge> : r.a === null ? <Badge cls="b-gray">لم يُعدّ</Badge> : r.diff === null ? <Badge cls="b-gray">تم العدّ</Badge> : r.a === 0 ? <Badge cls={r.diff ? 'b-red' : 'b-green'}>صفر فعلي</Badge> : r.diff === 0 ? <Badge cls="b-green">مطابق</Badge> : <Badge cls={r.diff > 0 ? 'b-blue' : 'b-red'}>{r.diff > 0 ? 'زيادة' : 'عجز'}</Badge>}</td>
 813:                   </tr>
 814:                 ))}
 815:               </tbody>
 816:             </table>
 817:           )}
 818:         </Card>
 819:         </>)}
 820:       </Phase>
 821: 
 822:       <ConfirmDialog open={confirm} onClose={() => setConfirm(false)} onConfirm={approve} busy={busy} error={err} title="اعتماد الجرد" confirmLabel="اعتماد وترحيل الفروق"
 823:         body={<>سيتم ترحيل <b className="num c-primary">{diffs.length}</b> فرق كحركات «فرق جرد» وتحديث الأرصدة. لا يمكن تعديل العدّ بعد الاعتماد.</>} />
 824:       <ConfirmDialog open={!!pendingAction} onClose={() => setPendingAction(null)} onConfirm={changeStatus} busy={busy} error={err} danger
 825:         title={pendingAction === 'delete' ? 'حذف الجرد؟' : 'إلغاء الجرد؟'} confirmLabel={pendingAction === 'delete' ? 'حذف الجرد' : 'إلغاء الجرد'}
 826:         body="سيُقفل الجرد وتُفقد أي تغييرات غير محفوظة. لن تتغير الأرصدة بهذه العملية." />
 827:     </section>
 828:   );
 829: }

 832: // ---------------- 8. Production receipt ----------------
 833: const PRD_MAX = 50;
 834: let __prKey = 1;
 835: const newPrLine = () => ({ key: __prKey++, variantId: null, qty: '', cost: '' });
 836: 
 837: function ProductionScreen({ go }) {
 838:   const { toast, can, variantCache } = useInv();
 839:   const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
 840:   const [view, setView] = useState(null);
 841:   const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
 842:   const canEnter = can('inventory.adjust') && can('products.view_cost');
 843:   const showCost = can('products.view_cost');
 844: 
 845:   const history = useApi(signal => productionApi.list({ per_page: 15, page }, signal), [page]);
 846:   const optsQuery = useApi(signal => productionApi.options('', signal), []);
 847:   useEffect(() => {
 848:     const d = optsQuery.data;
 849:     if (d) {
 850:       (d.variants || []).forEach(v => {
 851:         cacheVariantOptions(variantCache, [v]);
 852:       });
 853:     }
 854:   }, [optsQuery.data]);
 855: 
 856:   const branchName = useMemo(() => {
 857:     const m = new Map();
 858:     (optsQuery.data?.branches || []).forEach(b => m.set(b.id, b.name));
 859:     return id => m.get(id) || `#${id}`;
 860:   }, [optsQuery.data]);
 861:   const locName = useMemo(() => {
 862:     const m = new Map();
 863:     (optsQuery.data?.branches || []).forEach(b => (b.locations || []).forEach(l => m.set(l.id, l.name)));
 864:     return id => (id ? m.get(id) || `#${id}` : '—');
 865:   }, [optsQuery.data]);
 866: 
 867:   const rows = history.data?.data || [];
 868:   if (!can('inventory.view')) return <NoPerm title="استلام الإنتاج" perm="inventory.view" go={go} />;
 869:   const { phase, error } = apiPhase(history, rows.length === 0);
 870:   // Raw Laravel paginator (data/current_page/last_page/…) — NOT under meta, so it
 871:   // gets its own small mapper instead of the ResourceCollection one.
 872: 
 873:   return (
 874:     <section className="space-y-5">
 875:       <PageHead title="استلام الإنتاج" sub="تسجيل المنتجات التامة الواردة من التصنيع إلى المخزن مع تكلفة الوحدة."
 876:         actions={canEnter ? <button className="btn btn-dark" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}><Icon n="plus" s={14} w={2.2} /> تسجيل استلام</button>
 877:           : <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[12px] c-muted px-3.5 py-2 rounded-full v-pill-surface"><Icon n="lock" s={12} /> يتطلب صلاحية تسوية المخزون وعرض التكلفة</span>} />
 878:       <Card stagger={2}>
 879:         <CardHead title="سجل الاستلامات" meta={phase === 'ready' ? `${rows.length} استلام` : null} />
 880:         <Phase phase={phase} cols={6} error={error} onRetry={() => history.reload()}
 881:           empty={<EmptyState icon="factory" title="لا توجد استلامات إنتاج" sub="عند وصول دفعة من التصنيع سجّلها هنا لتُضاف إلى رصيد المخزن." action={canEnter && <button className="btn btn-dark btn-sm" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}><Icon n="plus" s={13} /> تسجيل استلام</button>} />}>
 882:           <table className="vt">
 883:             <thead><tr><th>رقم الدفعة</th><th>الفرع</th><th>الموقع</th><th className="t-num">البنود</th><th className="t-num">إجمالي الكمية</th>{showCost && <th className="t-num">إجمالي التكلفة</th>}<th>التاريخ</th></tr></thead>
 884:             <tbody>
 885:               {rows.map(p => (
 886:                 <tr key={p.id} className="cursor-pointer" onClick={() => setView(p)}>
 887:                   <td><Sku>{p.batch_number}</Sku></td>
 888:                   <td className="c-primary font-medium">{branchName(p.branch_id)}</td>
 889:                   <td className="mono text-[11.5px] c-secondary" dir="ltr">{locName(p.location_id)}</td>
 890:                   <td className="t-num num c-secondary">{(p.items || []).length}</td>
 891:                   <td className="t-num num font-semibold c-primary">{(p.items || []).reduce((a, l) => a + Number(l.quantity || 0), 0)}</td>
 892:                   {showCost && <td className="t-num num c-primary">{formatCurrency((p.items || []).reduce((a, l) => a + Number(l.quantity || 0) * Number(l.unit_cost || 0), 0))}</td>}
 893:                   <td className="num text-[11.5px] c-secondary">{formatDate(p.created_at, { includeTime: true })}</td>
 894:                 </tr>
 895:               ))}
 896:             </tbody>
 897:           </table>
 898:           {history.data && history.data.last_page > 1 && (
 899:             <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-4">
 900:               <button className="btn btn-soft btn-sm" disabled={page <= 1} onClick={() => setPage(p => Math.max(1, p - 1))}>السابق</button>
 901:               <span className="text-[12px] c-muted num">صفحة {history.data.current_page} من {history.data.last_page}</span>
 902:               <button className="btn btn-soft btn-sm" disabled={page >= history.data.last_page} onClick={() => setPage(p => p + 1)}>التالي</button>
 903:             </div>
 904:           )}
 905:         </Phase>
 906:       </Card>
 907:       <ProductionForm open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} branches={optsQuery.data?.branches || []} onSaved={() => { history.reload(); }} />
 908:       <Modal open={!!view} onClose={() => setView(null)} width="max-w-xl" title={view ? <span className="mono" dir="ltr">{view.batch_number}</span> : ''} sub={view && `${branchName(view.branch_id)} · ${locName(view.location_id)}`}>
 909:         {view && <table className="vt mb-4"><thead><tr><th>SKU</th><th>الصنف</th><th className="t-num">الكمية</th>{showCost && <th className="t-num">تكلفة الوحدة</th>}</tr></thead>
 910:           <tbody>{(view.items || []).map((l, i) => <tr key={i}><td><Sku>{variantCache.get(Number(l.product_variant_id))?.sku || `#${l.product_variant_id}`}</Sku></td><td><div className="font-medium c-primary truncate">{variantDisplayName(variantCache, l.product_variant_id, null)}</div></td><td className="t-num num font-semibold">{formatQty(l.quantity)}</td>{showCost && <td className="t-num num">{l.unit_cost != null ? formatCurrency(l.unit_cost) : '—'}</td>}</tr>)}</tbody></table>}
 911:       </Modal>
 912:     </section>
 913:   );
 914: }

 916: function ProductionForm({ open, onClose, branches, onSaved }) {
 917:   const { toast, variantCache } = useInv();
 918:   const { keyFor, reset } = useIdempotencyKey();
 919:   const restriction = useRestrictedBranch();
 920:   const [f, setF] = useState({ batch: '', branchId: null, locId: null, note: '' });
 921:   const [lines, setLines] = useState([newPrLine()]);
 922:   const [tried, setTried] = useState(false);
 923:   const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
 924:   const [err, setErr] = useState(null);
 925:   const [rowErrs, setRowErrs] = useState({});
 926:   useEffect(() => { if (open) { setF({ batch: '', branchId: restriction.locked ? restriction.branchId : null, locId: null, note: '' }); setLines([newPrLine()]); setTried(false); setErr(null); setRowErrs({}); setBusy(false); } }, [open]);
 927:   const upd = (k, p) => { setLines(ls => ls.map(l => l.key === k ? { ...l, ...p } : l)); setRowErrs({}); };
 928:   const bad = l => {
 929:     if (!l.variantId) return true;
 930:     const qv = toLatinDigits(l.qty);
 931:     if (!/^\d+$/.test(qv) || !(Number(qv) >= 1) || Number(qv) > 99999999) return true;
 932:     const cv = toLatinDigits(l.cost);
 933:     if (cv === '' || !QTY_RE.test(cv) || Number(cv) < 0 || Number(cv) > QTY_MAX) return true;
 934:     return false;
 935:   };
 936:   const valid = f.batch.trim() && f.batch.trim().length <= 100 && f.branchId && lines.length && lines.length <= PRD_MAX && lines.every(l => !bad(l));
 937:   const dupes = lines.filter((l, i) => l.variantId && lines.findIndex(x => x.variantId === l.variantId) !== i).length;
 938:   const total = lines.reduce((a, l) => a + (Number(toLatinDigits(l.qty)) || 0) * (Number(toLatinDigits(l.cost)) || 0), 0);
 939:   const locOpts = ((branches.find(b => b.id === f.branchId)?.locations) || []).map(l => ({ value: l.id, label: l.name }));
 940:   const submit = async () => {
 941:     setTried(true); if (!valid || dupes || busy) return;
 942:     setBusy(true); setErr(null); setRowErrs({});
 943:     const payload = {
 944:       batch_number: f.batch.trim(), branch_id: f.branchId,
 945:       ...(f.locId ? { location_id: f.locId } : {}),
 946:       notes: f.note.trim() ? f.note.trim().slice(0, 1000) : null,
 947:       items: lines.map(l => ({ product_variant_id: l.variantId, quantity: Number(toLatinDigits(l.qty)), unit_cost: Number(toLatinDigits(l.cost)) })),
 948:     };
 949:     try {
 950:       // Idempotency-Key is REQUIRED here (422 without it); same payload reuses
 951:       // the same key so a double-click records one receipt only.
 952:       const res = await productionApi.create(payload, keyFor(payload));
 953:       reset();
 954:       toast(res.message || 'تم تسجيل استلام الإنتاج');
 955:       onClose(); onSaved();
 956:     } catch (e) {
 957:       const ne = normalizeError(e);
 958:       setRowErrs({ ...ne.fields, ...groupItemsErrors(ne.fields) });
 959:       setErr(ne.message);
 960:       setBusy(false);
 961:     }
 962:   };
 963:   return (
 964:     <Modal open={open} onClose={onClose} width="max-w-4xl" title="تسجيل استلام إنتاج" sub={`حتى ${PRD_MAX} بندًا · الكميات أعداد صحيحة · المتغيرات مميزة`}
 965:       footer={<>
 966:         <button className="btn btn-orange" onClick={submit} disabled={busy}>{busy && <span className="w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full border-2 border-current border-t-transparent animate-spin" />} تسجيل الاستلام</button>
 967:         <button className="btn btn-soft" onClick={onClose}>إلغاء</button>
 968:         <span className="flex-1" />
 969:         <span className="text-[12px] c-secondary">إجمالي التكلفة <span className="num font-display text-[18px] font-bold c-primary mr-1">{formatCurrency(total)}</span></span>
 970:       </>}>
 971:       <div className="space-y-4">
 972:         {err && <InlineAlert kind="red" title="رفض الخادم العملية">{err}</InlineAlert>}
 973:         {dupes > 0 && <InlineAlert kind="amber" title="بنود مكررة">يوجد {dupes} بند مكرر — المتغيرات يجب أن تكون مميزة، احذف التكرار قبل التسجيل.</InlineAlert>}
 974:         <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
 975:           <Field label="رقم الدفعة" req error={tried && !f.batch.trim() ? 'مطلوب' : rowErrs.batch_number}><input dir="ltr" className={`inp mono text-left ${tried && !f.batch.trim() ? 'err' : ''}`} maxLength={100} value={f.batch} onChange={e => setF({ ...f, batch: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })} placeholder="B-2610-08" /></Field>
 976:           <Field label="الفرع / المخزن" req error={tried && !f.branchId ? 'مطلوب' : rowErrs.branch_id}><Sel value={f.branchId} disabled={restriction.locked} onChange={v => setF({ ...f, branchId: v || null, locId: null })} placeholder="اختر…" options={branches.filter(b => !restriction.locked || b.id === restriction.branchId).map(b => ({ value: b.id, label: b.name }))} /></Field>
 977:           <Field label="الموقع" hint="اختياري"><Sel value={f.locId} onChange={v => setF({ ...f, locId: v || null })} placeholder={f.branchId ? 'الموقع الافتراضي' : '—'} disabled={!f.branchId} options={locOpts} /></Field>
 978:         </div>
 979:         <div>
 980:           <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
 981:             <span className="field-label !mb-0">البنود <span className="num c-muted">{lines.length}/{PRD_MAX}</span></span>
 982:             <button className="btn btn-soft btn-sm" disabled={lines.length >= PRD_MAX} onClick={() => setLines(ls => [...ls, newPrLine()])}><Icon n="plus" s={13} /> إضافة بند</button>
 983:           </div>
 984:           <table className="vt">
 985:             <thead><tr><th className="w-8">#</th><th style={{ minWidth: 300 }}>المتغير / SKU</th><th style={{ width: 120 }}>الكمية</th><th style={{ width: 140 }}>تكلفة الوحدة</th><th className="t-num">الإجمالي</th><th></th></tr></thead>
 986:             <tbody>
 987:               {lines.map((l, i) => {

 990:                 <tr key={l.key}>

 992:                   <td><div className={(tried && !l.variantId) || re.product_variant_id ? 'rounded-[12px] ring-1 ring-[var(--badge-red-text)]' : ''}><VariantPicker small value={l.variantId} onChange={v => upd(l.key, { variantId: v })} /></div>
 993:                     {re.product_variant_id && <div className="text-[10.5px] mt-1" style={{ color: 'var(--badge-red-text)' }}>{re.product_variant_id}</div>}</td>

 996:                   <td><NumInput small decimals={4} value={l.cost} onChange={v => upd(l.key, { cost: v })} err={(tried && bad(l)) || re.unit_cost} placeholder="0.00" />

 998:                   <td className="t-num num c-primary font-semibold">{formatCurrency((Number(toLatinDigits(l.qty)) || 0) * (Number(toLatinDigits(l.cost)) || 0))}</td>

1015: function FilterBar({ children, onReset, active }) {
1016:   return (
1017:     <div className="v-subcard p-3 flex flex-wrap items-end gap-2.5 mb-4">
1018:       {children}

1020:     </div>

1022: }
1023: const FItem = ({ label, w = 'w-44', children }) => (
1024:   <div className={w}><div className="text-[10.5px] font-medium c-muted mb-1 pr-1">{label}</div>{children}</div>

1027: // Product-level then variant-level filter (product narrows the variant list)
1028: 
1029: // ---------------- 3. Stock balances ----------------
1030: function StockScreen({ go, params }) {
1031:   const { toast, can, branchesQuery, variantCache } = useInv();
1032:   const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
1033:   const restriction = useRestrictedBranch();
1034:   const allowed = canAny(can, 'inventory.view');
1035: 
1036:   const f = {
1037:     branchId: params.branchId ? Number(params.branchId) : null,
1038:     locationId: params.locationId ? Number(params.locationId) : null,
1039:     variantId: params.variantId ? Number(params.variantId) : null,
1040:     low: params.low === '1',
1041:   };
1042:   // A restricted user is pinned to their branch (the backend scopes them anyway).
1043:   const effBranch = restriction.locked ? restriction.branchId : f.branchId;
1044:   const set = p => {
1045:     const n = { branchId: f.branchId, locationId: f.locationId, variantId: f.variantId, low: f.low ? '1' : undefined, ...p };
1046:     if (n.branchId !== f.branchId) n.locationId = undefined;
1047:     if (!n.low) delete n.low;
1048:     go('stock', n);
1049:   };
1050: 
1051:   const locsQuery = useBranchesWithLocations(effBranch);
1052:   const query = useApi(signal => stockApi.levels({
1053:     branch_id: effBranch || undefined, location_id: f.locationId || undefined,
1054:     product_variant_id: f.variantId || undefined, low_stock: f.low || undefined,
1055:     per_page: 15, page,
1056:   }, signal).then(res => { cacheVariantNames(variantCache, (res.data || []).map(r => r.variant)); return res; }),
1057:   [effBranch || 0, f.locationId || 0, f.variantId || 0, f.low, page]);
1058: 
1059:   if (!allowed) return <NoPerm title="أرصدة المخزون" perm="inventory.view" go={go} />;
1060: 
1061:   const rows = query.data?.data || [];
1062:   const meta = query.data?.meta;
1063:   const { phase, error } = apiPhase(query, rows.length === 0);
1064:   const onRetry = () => query.reload();
1065:   const shared = branchesQuery.data || [];
1066:   const branchOptions = (restriction.locked ? shared.filter(b => b.id === restriction.branchId) : shared.filter(b => b.is_active))
1067:     .map(b => ({ value: b.id, label: `${b.name} · ${b.type === 'warehouse' ? 'مخزن' : 'فرع'}` }));
1068:   const locOptions = (locsQuery.data || []).filter(l => l.is_active).map(l => ({ value: l.id, label: `${l.name} (${l.code})` }));
1069:   const active = (effBranch ? 1 : 0) + (f.locationId ? 1 : 0) + (f.variantId ? 1 : 0) + (f.low ? 1 : 0);
1070:   const sum = k => rows.reduce((a, s) => a + Number(s[k] || 0), 0);
1071:   const canAdjust = canAny(can, 'inventory.adjust');
1072: 
1073:   return (
1074:     <section className="space-y-5">
1075:       <PageHead title="أرصدة المخزون" sub="الكميات الحالية لكل SKU في كل فرع وموقع. لتغيير أي كمية استخدم عملية مخزنية."
1076:         actions={canAdjust && <button className="btn btn-dark" onClick={() => go('adjust')}><Icon n="sliders" s={14} /> تسوية جديدة</button>} />
1077: 
1078:       <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3.5 stagger-item stagger-2">
1079:         <KPI hot label="المتاح" icon="box" value={phase === 'ready' ? formatQty(sum('available')) : '—'} sub={`${rows.length} سطر رصيد · في الصفحة الحالية`} />
1080:         <KPI label="المحجوز" icon="lock" value={phase === 'ready' ? formatQty(sum('reserved')) : '—'} sub="لطلبات مفتوحة" />
1081:         <KPI label="قيد النقل" icon="truck" value={phase === 'ready' ? formatQty(sum('in_transit')) : '—'} sub="في تحويلات مشحونة" />
1082:         <button onClick={() => set({ low: f.low ? undefined : '1' })} className="text-right">
1083:           <KPI label="تحت حد إعادة الطلب" icon="alert" value={phase === 'ready' ? rows.filter(r => r.is_low_stock).length : '—'} sub={f.low ? 'الفلتر مفعّل · اضغط للإلغاء' : 'اضغط لعرضها فقط'} />
1084:         </button>
1085:       </div>
1086: 
1087:       <Card stagger={3}>
1088:         <CardHead title="الأرصدة" meta={phase === 'ready' ? `${rows.length} سطر` : null}
1089:           right={<span className="text-[11.5px] c-muted flex items-center gap-1.5"><Icon n="eye" s={13} /> للعرض فقط</span>} />
1090:         <FilterBar active={active} onReset={() => go('stock', {})}>
1091:           <FItem label="الفرع"><Sel small value={effBranch} onChange={v => set({ branchId: v || undefined })} placeholder="كل الفروع" disabled={restriction.locked} options={branchOptions} className="!bg-[var(--bg-card)]" /></FItem>
1092:           <FItem label="الموقع" w="w-40"><Sel small value={f.locationId} onChange={v => set({ locationId: v || undefined })} placeholder={effBranch ? 'كل المواقع' : 'اختر فرعًا أولًا'} disabled={!effBranch} options={locOptions} className="!bg-[var(--bg-card)]" /></FItem>
1093:           <FItem label="الصنف / SKU" w="w-64"><VariantPicker small value={f.variantId} onChange={v => set({ variantId: v || undefined })} placeholder="كل الأصناف" allowClear /></FItem>
1094:           <label className="flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-full cursor-pointer mb-0.5" style={{ background: f.low ? 'var(--accent-orange-light)' : 'var(--bg-card)' }}>
1095:             <Toggle on={f.low} onChange={v => set({ low: v ? '1' : undefined })} />
1096:             <span className="text-[12px] font-medium c-primary">المخزون المنخفض فقط</span>
1097:           </label>
1098:         </FilterBar>
1099:         <Phase phase={phase} cols={10} rows={7} error={error} onRetry={onRetry}
1100:           empty={<EmptyState icon="box" title="لا توجد أرصدة مسجّلة بعد" sub="سجّل الكميات الافتتاحية عن طريق تسوية زيادة مع سبب واضح مثل «رصيد افتتاحي»."
1101:             action={canAdjust && <button className="btn btn-dark btn-sm" onClick={() => go('adjust')}><Icon n="plus" s={13} /> إدخال رصيد افتتاحي</button>} />}>
1102:           {rows.length === 0 ? <EmptyState icon="filter" title="لا توجد أرصدة تطابق الفلاتر" sub="غيّر الفلاتر أو امسحها لعرض كل الأرصدة." /> : (
1103:             <div className="overflow-x-auto -mx-1 px-1">
1104:               <table className="vt">
1105:                 <thead><tr>
1106:                   <th>المنتج</th><th>SKU</th><th>الفرع</th><th>الموقع</th>
1107:                   <th className="t-num">الموجود</th><th className="t-num">المحجوز</th><th className="t-num">التالف</th><th className="t-num">قيد النقل</th><th className="t-num">المتاح</th><th className="t-num">حد الطلب</th><th>آخر تحديث</th><th></th>
1108:                 </tr></thead>
1109:                 <tbody>
1110:                   {rows.map(s => {
1111:                     const low = !!s.is_low_stock;
1112:                     const pct = Math.min(100, Number(s.reorder_level) ? Number(s.available) / (Number(s.reorder_level) * 2) * 100 : 100);
1113:                     const v = s.variant || variantCache.get(Number(s.product_variant_id)) || {};
1114:                     return (
1115:                       <tr key={s.id}>
1116:                         <td><div className="min-w-0"><div className="font-medium c-primary truncate">{pickName({ product_name_ar: v.product_name_ar, product_name_en: v.product_name_en, sku: v.sku || s.product_variant_id })}</div></div></td>
1117:                         <td><Sku>{v.sku || `#${s.product_variant_id}`}</Sku></td>
1118:                         <td className="c-secondary">{s.branch?.name || '—'}</td>
1119:                         <td>{s.location ? <span className="text-[11.5px] c-secondary">{s.location.name}</span> : <span className="text-[11.5px] c-muted">بدون موقع</span>}</td>
1120:                         <td className="t-num num font-semibold c-primary">{formatQty(s.on_hand)}</td>
1121:                         <td className="t-num num c-secondary">{formatQty(s.reserved)}</td>
1122:                         <td className="t-num num" style={{ color: Number(s.damaged) ? 'var(--badge-red-text)' : 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{formatQty(s.damaged)}</td>
1123:                         <td className="t-num num" style={{ color: Number(s.in_transit) ? 'var(--badge-blue-text)' : 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{formatQty(s.in_transit)}</td>
1124:                         <td className="t-num">
1125:                           <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-1">
1126:                             <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><span className={`num font-bold ${low ? '' : 'c-primary'}`} style={low ? { color: 'var(--accent-orange)' } : {}}>{formatQty(s.available)}</span>{low && <Badge cls="b-amber" dot>منخفض</Badge>}</span>
1127:                             <span className="w-16 h-1 rounded-full hatched overflow-hidden flex justify-end" style={{ direction: 'ltr' }}>
1128:                               <span className="block h-full rounded-full" style={{ width: pct + '%', background: low ? 'var(--accent-orange)' : 'var(--text-primary)' }} />
1129:                             </span>
1130:                           </div>
1131:                         </td>
1132:                         <td className="t-num num c-muted">{formatQty(s.reorder_level)}</td>
1133:                         <td className="num text-[11.5px] c-muted">{formatDate(s.updated_at)}</td>
1134:                         <td>
1135:                           <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 justify-end">
1136:                             <button className="icon-btn" title="حركات الصنف" onClick={() => go('moves', { variantId: s.product_variant_id, branchId: s.branch?.id, locationId: s.location?.id })}><Icon n="history" s={15} /></button>
1137:                             {canAdjust && <button className="icon-btn" title="تسوية" onClick={() => go('adjust', { branchId: s.branch?.id, locId: s.location?.id, variantId: s.product_variant_id })}><Icon n="sliders" s={15} /></button>}
1138:                           </div>
1139:                         </td>
1140:                       </tr>
1141:                     );
1142:                   })}
1143:                 </tbody>
1144:               </table>
1145:             </div>
1146:           )}
1147:         </Phase>
1148:         {meta && (meta.last_page > 1) && (
1149:           <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-4">
1150:             <button className="btn btn-soft btn-sm" disabled={page <= 1} onClick={() => setPage(p => Math.max(1, p - 1))}>السابق</button>
1151:             <span className="text-[12px] c-muted num">صفحة {page} من {meta.last_page}</span>
1152:             <button className="btn btn-soft btn-sm" disabled={page >= meta.last_page} onClick={() => setPage(p => p + 1)}>التالي</button>
1153:           </div>
1154:         )}
1155:       </Card>
1156:     </section>
1157:   );
1158: }
1159: // NOTE: "المتاح" KPI is page-scoped on purpose — GET inventory returns one page
1160: // and there is no summary endpoint, so a global total cannot be shown honestly.
