````javascript
1162: // ---------------- 4. Adjustment ----------------
1163: const ADJ_MAX = 100;
1164: let __adjLineId = 1;
1165: const newAdjLine = (p = {}) => ({ key: __adjLineId++, variantId: null, type: 'increase', qty: '', reason: '', ...p });
1166: 
1167: const ADJ_API_TYPES = {
1168:   increase:         { label: 'زيادة',              cls: 'b-green' },
1169:   decrease:         { label: 'نقصان',              cls: 'b-red'   },
1170:   mark_damaged:     { label: 'تسجيل تالف',         cls: 'b-amber' },
1171:   write_off_damaged:{ label: 'إعدام تالف',         cls: 'b-red'   },
1172:   restore_damaged:  { label: 'استرجاع من التالف',  cls: 'b-blue'  },
1173: };
1174: 
1175: function AdjustScreen({ go, params }) {
1176:   const { toast, can, branchesQuery, variantCache } = useInv();
1177:   const { keyFor, reset } = useIdempotencyKey();
1178:   const [branchId, setBranchId] = useState(params.branchId ? Number(params.branchId) : null);
1179:   const [locId, setLocId] = useState(params.locId ? Number(params.locId) : (params.locationId ? Number(params.locationId) : null));
1180:   const [lines, setLines] = useState(() => [newAdjLine(params.variantId ? { variantId: Number(params.variantId) } : {})]);
1181:   const [tried, setTried] = useState(false);
1182:   const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState(false);
1183:   const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
1184:   const [srvErr, setSrvErr] = useState(null);
1185:   const [rowErrs, setRowErrs] = useState({});
1186:   const [opening, setOpening] = useState(false);
1187:   const allowed = can('inventory.adjust');
1188:   const restriction = useRestrictedBranch();
1189:   const effBranch = restriction.locked ? restriction.branchId : branchId;
1190: 
1191:   const locsQuery = useBranchesWithLocations(effBranch);
1192: 
1193:   if (!allowed) return <NoPerm title="تسوية المخزون" perm="inventory.adjust" go={go} />;
1194: 
1195:   const upd = (key, p) => { setLines(ls => ls.map(l => l.key === key ? { ...l, ...p } : l)); setRowErrs({}); };
1196:   const lineErr = l => {
1197:     const e = {};
1198:     if (!l.variantId) e.variantId = true;
1199:     const qv = toLatinDigits(l.qty);
1200:     if (!qv || !QTY_RE.test(qv) || !(Number(qv) > 0) || Number(qv) > QTY_MAX) e.qty = 'كمية موجبة حتى 4 منازل عشرية';
1201:     if (!l.reason.trim()) e.reason = true;
1202:     else if (l.reason.trim().length > 1000) e.reason = true;
1203:     return e;
1204:   };
1205:   const clientErrs = lines.map(lineErr);
1206:   const valid = effBranch && clientErrs.every(e => !Object.keys(e).length);
1207:   const dupes = lines.filter((l, i) => l.variantId && lines.findIndex(x => x.variantId === l.variantId && x.type === l.type) !== i).length;
1208: 
1209:   const applyOpening = on => {
1210:     setOpening(on);
1211:     setLines(ls => ls.map(l => on ? { ...l, type: 'increase', reason: l.reason || 'رصيد افتتاحي' } : l));
1212:   };
1213: 
1214:   const execute = async () => {
1215:     if (busy) return; // double-click guard: one movement per key
1216:     setBusy(true); setSrvErr(null); setRowErrs({});
1217:     const payload = {
1218:       branch_id: effBranch,
1219:       ...(locId ? { location_id: locId } : {}),
1220:       items: lines.map(l => ({ product_variant_id: l.variantId, adjustment_type: l.type, quantity: Number(toLatinDigits(l.qty)), reason: l.reason.trim() || null })),
1221:     };
1222:     try {
1223:       const res = await adjustmentsApi.create(payload, keyFor(payload));
1224:       reset(); // new key only after success
1225:       setConfirm(false); setLines([newAdjLine()]); setTried(false);
1226:       toast(res.message || `تم تنفيذ التسوية · ${lines.length} بند`);
1227:       go('moves', { branchId: effBranch });
1228:     } catch (e) {
1229:       const ne = normalizeError(e);
1230:       setRowErrs({ ...ne.fields, ...groupItemsErrors(ne.fields) });
1231:       // Server messages are Arabic — shown verbatim. 409 busy-lock keeps the
1232:       // dialog open so retry reuses the SAME key (no duplicate movement).
1233:       setSrvErr(ne.message);
1234:       setBusy(false);
1235:     }
1236:   };
1237: 
1238:   const totals = Object.keys(ADJ_API_TYPES).map(k => ({ k, n: lines.filter(l => l.type === k && l.variantId).length })).filter(x => x.n);
1239:   const shared = branchesQuery.data || [];
1240:   const branchOptions = (restriction.locked ? shared.filter(b => b.id === restriction.branchId) : shared.filter(b => b.is_active))
1241:     .map(b => ({ value: b.id, label: `${b.name} · ${b.type === 'warehouse' ? 'مخزن' : 'فرع'}` }));
1242:   const locOptions = (locsQuery.data || []).filter(l => l.is_active).map(l => ({ value: l.id, label: `${l.name} (${l.code})` }));
1243:   const brName = shared.find(b => b.id === effBranch)?.name || '';
1244:   const locCode = (locsQuery.data || []).find(l => l.id === locId)?.code || '';
1245: 
1246:   return (
1247:     <section className="space-y-5">
1248:       <PageHead title="تسوية المخزون" back={{ label: 'أرصدة المخزون', onClick: () => go('stock') }}
1249:         sub="زيادة أو خصم كميات، أو نقلها من وإلى التالف. التسوية تُنفَّذ كعملية واحدة وتنعكس فورًا على الأرصدة والحركات." />
1250: 
1251:       <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-5 items-start">
1252:         <div className="lg:col-span-9 space-y-5">
1253:           <Card stagger={2}>
1254:             <CardHead title="بيانات العملية" />
1255:             <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
1256:               <Field label="الفرع / المخزن" req error={tried && !effBranch ? 'اختر الفرع' : rowErrs.branch_id}>
1257:                 <Sel value={effBranch} onChange={v => { if (!restriction.locked) { setBranchId(v || null); setLocId(null); } }} placeholder="اختر…" disabled={restriction.locked} options={branchOptions} className={tried && !effBranch ? 'err' : ''} />
1258:               </Field>
1259:               <Field label="موقع التخزين" hint="اختياري — يطبَّق على كل البنود" error={rowErrs.location_id}>
1260:                 <Sel value={locId} onChange={v => setLocId(v || null)} placeholder={effBranch ? 'بدون موقع محدد' : 'اختر الفرع أولًا'} disabled={!effBranch} options={locOptions} />
1261:               </Field>
1262:               <div>
1263:                 <span className="field-label">إدخال رصيد افتتاحي</span>
1264:                 <label className="v-subcard px-3.5 py-2 flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer" style={{ borderRadius: 12 }}>
1265:                   <span className="text-[12px] c-secondary">كل البنود = زيادة</span>
1266:                   <Toggle on={opening} onChange={applyOpening} />
1267:                 </label>
1268:               </div>
1269:             </div>
1270:             {opening && <div className="mt-4"><InlineAlert kind="blue" icon="info" title="رصيد افتتاحي">تُسجَّل الكميات الافتتاحية حاليًا كتسوية زيادة. اكتب سببًا واضحًا لكل بند حتى يسهل تتبّعها في سجل الحركات.</InlineAlert></div>}
1271:           </Card>
1272: 
1273:           <Card stagger={3}>
1274:             <CardHead title="البنود" meta={<span className="num">{lines.length} / {ADJ_MAX}</span>}
1275:               right={<button className="btn btn-soft btn-sm" disabled={lines.length >= ADJ_MAX} onClick={() => setLines(ls => [...ls, newAdjLine(opening ? { reason: 'رصيد افتتاحي' } : {})])}><Icon n="plus" s={13} /> إضافة بند</button>} />
1276:             {dupes > 0 && <div className="mb-3"><InlineAlert kind="amber" title="بنود مكررة">يوجد {dupes} بند مكرر بنفس SKU ونفس نوع التسوية — سيتم دمجها عند التنفيذ.</InlineAlert></div>}
1277:             <div className="overflow-x-auto">
1278:               <table className="vt">
1279:                 <thead><tr><th className="w-8">#</th><th style={{ minWidth: 280 }}>المنتج / المتغير</th><th style={{ minWidth: 170 }}>نوع التسوية</th><th style={{ minWidth: 120 }}>الكمية</th><th style={{ minWidth: 200 }}>السبب</th><th></th></tr></thead>
1280:                 <tbody>
1281:                   {lines.map((l, i) => {
1282:                     const e = { ...(tried ? clientErrs[i] : {}), ...(rowErrs[i] || {}) };
1283:                     return (
1284:                       <tr key={l.key} className="align-top">
1285:                         <td className="num c-muted pt-4">{i + 1}</td>
1286:                         <td>
1287:                           <div className={e.variantId ? 'rounded-[12px] ring-1 ring-[var(--badge-red-text)]' : ''}><VariantPicker small value={l.variantId} onChange={v => upd(l.key, { variantId: v })} /></div>
1288:                           {e.product_variant_id && <div className="text-[10.5px] mt-1" style={{ color: 'var(--badge-red-text)' }}>{e.product_variant_id}</div>}
1289:                         </td>
1290:                         <td><Sel small value={l.type} onChange={v => upd(l.key, { type: v || 'increase' })} options={Object.entries(ADJ_API_TYPES).map(([k, t]) => ({ value: k, label: t.label }))} /></td>
1291:                         <td>
1292:                           <NumInput small value={l.qty} onChange={v => upd(l.key, { qty: v })} err={e.qty || e.quantity} placeholder="0.0000" />
1293:                           {(e.qty || e.quantity) && <div className="text-[10.5px] mt-1" style={{ color: 'var(--badge-red-text)' }}>{e.qty || e.quantity}</div>}
1294:                         </td>
1295:                         <td><input maxLength={1000} className={`inp inp-sm ${e.reason ? 'err' : ''}`} value={l.reason} onChange={ev => upd(l.key, { reason: ev.target.value })} placeholder="مثال: كسر أثناء التفريغ" />
1296:                           {e.reason && typeof e.reason === 'string' && <div className="text-[10.5px] mt-1" style={{ color: 'var(--badge-red-text)' }}>{e.reason}</div>}</td>
1297:                         <td className="pt-3"><button className="icon-btn" disabled={lines.length === 1} onClick={() => setLines(ls => ls.filter(x => x.key !== l.key))}><Icon n="trash" s={14} /></button></td>
1298:                       </tr>
1299:                     );
1300:                   })}
1301:                 </tbody>
1302:               </table>
1303:             </div>
1304:             <div className="mt-3 text-[11px] c-muted flex items-center gap-1.5"><Icon n="info" s={12} /> الكميات موجبة دائمًا وتقبل حتى 4 منازل عشرية. اتجاه الحركة يحدده نوع التسوية.</div>
1305:           </Card>
1306:         </div>
1307: 
1308:         <div className="lg:col-span-3 lg:sticky lg:top-5">
1309:           <Card stagger={4}>
1310:             <h3 className="font-display text-[15px] font-semibold c-primary mb-3">ملخص</h3>
1311:             <div className="space-y-2 text-[12.5px]">
1312:               <div className="flex justify-between"><span className="c-secondary">الفرع</span><span className="font-medium c-primary">{brName || '—'}</span></div>
1313:               <div className="flex justify-between"><span className="c-secondary">الموقع</span><span className="mono c-primary" dir="ltr">{locCode || '—'}</span></div>
1314:               <div className="flex justify-between"><span className="c-secondary">عدد البنود</span><span className="num font-semibold c-primary">{lines.length}</span></div>
1315:             </div>
1316:             <div className="h-px my-4" style={{ background: 'var(--divider-color)' }} />
1317:             <div className="space-y-1.5">
1318:               {totals.length === 0 && <div className="text-[11.5px] c-muted">لم يتم اختيار أصناف بعد</div>}
1319:               {totals.map(t => <div key={t.k} className="flex items-center justify-between"><Badge cls={ADJ_API_TYPES[t.k].cls}>{ADJ_API_TYPES[t.k].label}</Badge><span className="num text-[12px] c-primary font-semibold">{t.n}</span></div>)}
1320:             </div>
1321:             <div className="mt-5 space-y-2">
1322:               <button className="btn btn-orange w-full" onClick={() => { setTried(true); if (valid) { setSrvErr(null); setRowErrs({}); setConfirm(true); } }}>
1323:                 <Icon n="check" s={14} w={2.2} /> تنفيذ التسوية
1324:               </button>
1325:               <button className="btn btn-soft w-full" onClick={() => go('stock')}>إلغاء</button>
1326:             </div>
1327:             {tried && !valid && <div className="text-[11px] mt-3" style={{ color: 'var(--badge-red-text)' }}>أكمل الحقول المطلوبة المظللة بالأحمر.</div>}
1328:           </Card>
1329:         </div>
1330:       </div>
1331: 
1332:       <ConfirmDialog open={confirm} onClose={() => setConfirm(false)} onConfirm={execute} busy={busy} error={srvErr}
1333:         title="تأكيد تنفيذ التسوية" confirmLabel="تنفيذ الآن"
1334:         body={<div className="space-y-3">
1335:           <p>سيتم تنفيذ <b className="c-primary num">{lines.length}</b> بند على <b className="c-primary">{brName}</b>{locCode && <> — موقع <span className="mono" dir="ltr">{locCode}</span></>}. لا يمكن تعديل أو حذف الحركات بعد التنفيذ؛ للتصحيح أنشئ تسوية عكسية.</p>
1336:           <div className="v-subcard p-3 space-y-1.5 max-h-40 overflow-y-auto">
1337:             {lines.filter(l => l.variantId).map((l, fi) => (
1338:               <div key={l.key}>
1339:                 <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[12px]">
1340:                   <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><Sku>{variantCache.get(Number(l.variantId))?.sku || `#${l.variantId}`}</Sku><Badge cls={ADJ_API_TYPES[l.type].cls}>{ADJ_API_TYPES[l.type].label}</Badge></span>
1341:                   <span className="num font-semibold c-primary">{formatQty(toLatinDigits(l.qty))}</span>
1342:                 </div>
1343:                 {(rowErrs[fi]?.quantity || rowErrs[fi]?.product_variant_id) && <div className="text-[11px] mt-1 text-right" style={{ color: 'var(--badge-red-text)' }}>{rowErrs[fi]?.quantity || rowErrs[fi]?.product_variant_id}</div>}
1344:               </div>
1345:             ))}
1346:           </div>
1347:         </div>} />
1348:     </section>
1349:   );
1350: }

1352: // ---------------- 5. Movements ----------------
1353: function MovesScreen({ go, params }) {
1354:   const { can, branchesQuery, variantCache } = useInv();
1355:   const [f, setF] = useState({ branchId: params.branchId ? Number(params.branchId) : null, locId: params.locationId ? Number(params.locationId) : null, variantId: params.variantId ? Number(params.variantId) : null, type: null, from: '', to: '' });
1356:   const [cursor, setCursor] = useState(null);
1357:   const [prevCursors, setPrevCursors] = useState([]);
1358:   const allowed = canAny(can, 'inventory.view');
1359:   const set = p => { setF(x => {
1360:     const next = { ...x, ...p };
1361:     if (next.from && next.to && next.to < next.from) next.to = next.from;
1362:     return next;
1363:   }); setCursor(null); setPrevCursors([]); };
1364:   const showCost = can('inventory.view_cost');
1365:   const restriction = useRestrictedBranch();
1366:   const effBranch = restriction.locked ? restriction.branchId : f.branchId;
1367: 
1368:   const apiParams = {
1369:     branch_id: effBranch || undefined, location_id: f.locId || undefined,
1370:     product_variant_id: f.variantId || undefined,
1371:     type: f.type || undefined, from_date: f.from || undefined, to_date: f.to || undefined,
1372:     per_page: 15, ...(cursor ? { cursor } : {}),
1373:   };
1374:   const query = useApi(signal => movementsApi.list(apiParams, signal), [JSON.stringify(apiParams)]);
1375:   const locsQuery = useBranchesWithLocations(effBranch);
1376: 
1377:   if (!allowed) return <NoPerm title="حركات المخزون" perm="inventory.view" go={go} />;
1378: 
1379:   const rows = query.data?.data || [];
1380:   const { phase, error } = apiPhase(query, rows.length === 0);
1381:   const onRetry = () => query.reload();
1382:   const shared = branchesQuery.data || [];
1383:   const branchOptions = (restriction.locked ? shared.filter(b => b.id === restriction.branchId) : shared.filter(b => b.is_active))
1384:     .map(b => ({ value: b.id, label: `${b.name} · ${b.type === 'warehouse' ? 'مخزن' : 'فرع'}` }));
1385:   const locOptions = (locsQuery.data || []).filter(l => l.is_active).map(l => ({ value: l.id, label: `${l.name} (${l.code})` }));
1386:   const active = (effBranch ? 1 : 0) + (f.locId ? 1 : 0) + (f.variantId ? 1 : 0) + (f.type ? 1 : 0) + (f.from ? 1 : 0) + (f.to ? 1 : 0);
1387:   const nextCursor = query.data?.meta?.next_cursor || null;
1388:   const prevCursor = query.data?.meta?.prev_cursor || null;
1389:   const goNext = () => { if (nextCursor) { setPrevCursors(p => [...p, cursor]); setCursor(nextCursor); } };
1390:   const goPrev = () => { const p = [...prevCursors]; const c = p.pop(); setPrevCursors(p); setCursor(prevCursor || c || null); };
1391: 
1392:   return (
1393:     <section className="space-y-5">
1394:       <PageHead title="حركات المخزون" sub="سجل غير قابل للتعديل لكل عملية أثّرت على الكميات." />
1395:       <Card stagger={2}>
1396:         <CardHead title="السجل" meta={<span className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><Icon n="lock" s={11} /> عرض فقط</span>}
1397:           right={!showCost && <span className="text-[11px] c-muted flex items-center gap-1"><Icon n="lock" s={11} /> تكلفة الوحدة مخفية حسب صلاحيتك</span>} />
1398:         <FilterBar active={active} onReset={() => { setF({ branchId: null, locId: null, variantId: null, type: null, from: '', to: '' }); setCursor(null); setPrevCursors([]); }}>
1399:           <FItem label="الفرع"><Sel small value={effBranch} onChange={v => set({ branchId: v || null, locId: null })} placeholder="كل الفروع" disabled={restriction.locked} options={branchOptions} className="!bg-[var(--bg-card)]" /></FItem>
1400:           <FItem label="الموقع" w="w-40"><Sel small value={f.locId} onChange={v => set({ locId: v || null })} placeholder={effBranch ? 'كل المواقع' : 'اختر فرعًا أولًا'} disabled={!effBranch} options={locOptions} className="!bg-[var(--bg-card)]" /></FItem>
1401:           <FItem label="الصنف / SKU" w="w-64"><VariantPicker small value={f.variantId} onChange={v => set({ variantId: v || null })} placeholder="كل الأصناف" allowClear /></FItem>
1402:           <FItem label="نوع الحركة" w="w-40"><Sel small value={f.type} onChange={v => set({ type: v || null })} placeholder="كل الأنواع" options={Object.entries(MOVE_TYPE_LABELS).map(([value, t]) => ({ value, label: t.ar }))} className="!bg-[var(--bg-card)]" /></FItem>
1403:           <FItem label="من تاريخ" w="w-36"><input type="date" value={f.from} onChange={e => set({ from: e.target.value })} className="inp inp-sm num !bg-[var(--bg-card)]" /></FItem>
1404:           <FItem label="إلى تاريخ" w="w-36"><input type="date" value={f.to} onChange={e => set({ to: e.target.value })} min={f.from || undefined} className="inp inp-sm num !bg-[var(--bg-card)]" /></FItem>
1405:         </FilterBar>
1406: 
1407:         <Phase phase={phase} cols={9} rows={8} error={error} onRetry={onRetry}
1408:           empty={<EmptyState icon="history" title="لا توجد حركات بعد" sub="ستظهر هنا كل عمليات التسوية والتحويل والجرد واستلام الإنتاج بمجرد تنفيذها." />}>
1409:           {rows.length === 0 ? <EmptyState icon="filter" title="لا توجد حركات تطابق الفلاتر" sub="وسّع نطاق التاريخ أو امسح بعض الفلاتر." /> : (
1410:             <>
1411:               <div className="overflow-x-auto">
1412:                 <table className="vt">
1413:                   <thead><tr>
1414:                     <th>التاريخ</th><th>المرجع</th><th>SKU</th><th>الفرع</th><th>الموقع</th><th>نوع الحركة</th>
1415:                     <th className="t-num">الكمية</th><th className="t-num">الرصيد قبل ← بعد</th>{showCost && <th className="t-num">تكلفة الوحدة</th>}<th>المنفّذ</th><th>ملاحظات</th>
1416:                   </tr></thead>
1417:                   <tbody>
1418:                     {rows.map(m => {
1419:                       const t = MOVE_TYPE_LABELS[m.type] || { ar: m.type, cls: 'b-gray' };
1420:                       const qty = Number(m.quantity);
1421:                       return (
1422:                         <tr key={m.id}>
1423:                           <td className="num text-[11.5px] c-secondary">{formatDate(m.created_at, { includeTime: true })}</td>
1424:                           <td><span className="mono text-[11.5px] font-semibold c-orange" dir="ltr">{m.reference_number}</span></td>
1425:                           <td><div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5"><Sku>{m.variant?.sku || `#${m.product_variant_id}`}</Sku><span className="text-[10.5px] c-muted">{variantDisplayName(variantCache, m.product_variant_id, null)}</span></div></td>
1426:                           <td className="c-secondary">{m.branch?.name || '—'}</td>
1427:                           <td className="mono text-[11.5px] c-secondary" dir="ltr">{m.location?.name || '—'}</td>
1428:                           <td><Badge cls={t.cls}>{t.ar}</Badge></td>
1429:                           <td className="t-num num font-bold" style={{ color: qty > 0 ? 'var(--badge-green-text)' : qty < 0 ? 'var(--badge-red-text)' : 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{qty > 0 ? '+' : qty < 0 ? '−' : ''}{formatQty(Math.abs(qty))}</td>
1430:                           <td className="t-num num text-[12px]"><span className="c-muted">{formatQty(m.balance_before)}</span> <span className="c-muted mx-1">→</span> <span className="font-semibold c-primary">{formatQty(m.balance_after)}</span></td>
1431:                           {showCost && <td className="t-num num c-secondary">{m.unit_cost != null ? formatCurrency(m.unit_cost) : '—'}</td>}
1432:                           <td className="c-secondary">{m.creator_name || '—'}</td>
1433:                           <td className="text-[11.5px] c-muted max-w-[160px] truncate">{m.notes || '—'}</td>
1434:                         </tr>
1435:                       );
1436:                     })}
1437:                   </tbody>
1438:                 </table>
1439:               </div>
1440:               <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-4 pt-4" style={{ borderTop: '1px solid var(--divider-color)' }}>
1441:                 <span className="text-[11.5px] c-muted">عرض <span className="num">{rows.length}</span> حركة · التنقل بالمؤشر</span>
1442:                 <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
1443:                   <button className="btn btn-soft btn-sm" disabled={!prevCursor && prevCursors.length === 0 && !cursor} onClick={goPrev}><Icon n="chevR" s={13} /> السابق</button>
1444:                   <button className="btn btn-dark btn-sm" disabled={!nextCursor} onClick={goNext}>التالي <Icon n="chevL" s={13} /></button>
1445:                 </div>
1446:               </div>
1447:             </>
1448:           )}
1449:         </Phase>
1450:       </Card>
1451:     </section>
1452:   );
1453: }

1455: function NoPerm({ title, perm, go, message }) {
1456:   return (
1457:     <section className="space-y-5">
1458:       {title && <PageHead title={title} />}
1459:       <Card><EmptyState icon="lock" title="لا تملك صلاحية الوصول لهذه الشاشة" sub={message || `تتطلب هذه العملية صلاحية «${perm}». تواصل مع مدير النظام لمنحك الصلاحية.`}
1460:         action={go && <button className="btn btn-soft btn-sm" onClick={() => go('stock')}>العودة لأرصدة المخزون</button>} /></Card>
1461:     </section>
1462:   );
1463: }

1465: // ============ 6. Stock transfers ============
1466: 
1467: const TR_FLOW = ['draft', 'approved', 'shipped', 'received'];
1468: let __trKey = 1;
1469: const newTrLine = (p = {}) => ({ key: __trKey++, variantId: null, fromLoc: null, toLoc: null, req: '', ...p });
1470: 
1471: 
1472: function TrStatus({ s }) { const t = TRANSFER_STATUS[s]; return <Badge cls={({ draft: 'b-gray', approved: 'b-blue', shipped: 'b-amber', received: 'b-green', cancelled: 'b-red' })[s] || 'b-gray'} dot>{t || s}</Badge>; }

1474: function TransfersScreen({ go }) {
1475:   const { can, branchesQuery } = useInv();
1476:   const [st, setSt] = useState('all');
1477:   const [q, setQ] = useState('');
1478:   const [fromF, setFromF] = useState(null);
1479:   const [toF, setToF] = useState(null);
1480:   const allowed = canAny(can, 'transfers.view', 'transfers.manage');
1481: 
1482:   // Small cardinality like branches: fetch all pages once (per_page=100) so the
1483:   // KPIs are exact and status/branch/search filters run client-side.
1484:   const query = useApi(signal => (async () => {
1485:     const all = []; let page = 1; let last = 1;
1486:     do {
1487:       const res = await transfersApi.list({ per_page: 100, page, from_branch_id: fromF || undefined, to_branch_id: toF || undefined, status: st === 'all' ? undefined : st }, signal);
1488:       all.push(...(res.data || [])); last = res.meta?.last_page || 1; page += 1;
1489:     } while (page <= last);
1490:     return all;
1491:   })(), [fromF, toF, st]);
1492: 
1493:   if (!allowed) return <NoPerm title="التحويلات المخزنية" perm="transfers.view" go={go} />;
1494: 
1495:   const list = query.data || [];
1496:   const { phase, error } = apiPhase(query, list.length === 0);
1497:   const onRetry = () => query.reload();
1498:   const ql = q.trim().toLowerCase();
1499:   const rows = list.filter(t => (st === 'all' || t.status === st)
1500:     && (!fromF || t.from_branch?.id === fromF) && (!toF || t.to_branch?.id === toF)
1501:     && (!ql || (t.transfer_number || '').toLowerCase().includes(ql)));
1502:   const cnt = k => list.filter(t => t.status === k).length;
1503:   const active = (fromF ? 1 : 0) + (toF ? 1 : 0) + (ql ? 1 : 0) + (st !== 'all' ? 1 : 0);
1504:   const shared = branchesQuery.data || [];
1505:   const branchOptions = shared.filter(b => b.is_active).map(b => ({ value: b.id, label: `${b.name} · ${b.type === 'warehouse' ? 'مخزن' : 'فرع'}` }));
1506:   const canCreate = canAny(can, 'transfers.create', 'transfers.manage');
1507: 
1508:   return (
1509:     <section className="space-y-5">
1510:       <PageHead title="التحويلات المخزنية" sub="نقل البضاعة بين فرعين أو مخزنين عبر مراحل: مسودة ← اعتماد ← شحن ← استلام."
1511:         actions={canCreate && <button className="btn btn-dark" onClick={() => go('transfer-edit', {})}><Icon n="plus" s={14} w={2.2} /> تحويل جديد</button>} />
1512: 
1513:       <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3.5 stagger-item stagger-2">
1514:         <KPI label="مسودات" icon="edit" value={phase === 'ready' ? cnt('draft') : '—'} sub="بانتظار الاعتماد" />
1515:         <KPI label="معتمدة" icon="check" value={phase === 'ready' ? cnt('approved') : '—'} sub="جاهزة للشحن" />
1516:         <KPI hot label="في الطريق" icon="truck" value={phase === 'ready' ? cnt('shipped') : '—'} sub="بانتظار الاستلام" />
1517:         <KPI label="مستلمة" icon="inbox" value={phase === 'ready' ? cnt('received') : '—'} sub="تحويلات مستلمة" />
1518:       </div>
1519: 
1520:       <Card stagger={3}>
1521:         <CardHead title="القائمة" right={<>
1522:           <div className="seg">
1523:             <button className={st === 'all' ? 'on' : ''} onClick={() => setSt('all')}>الكل</button>
1524:             {Object.entries(TRANSFER_STATUS).map(([k, t]) => <button key={k} className={st === k ? 'on' : ''} onClick={() => setSt(k)}>{t}</button>)}
1525:           </div>
1526:           <SearchPill value={q} onChange={setQ} placeholder="رقم التحويل" w="w-32" />
1527:         </>} />
1528:         <FilterBar active={active} onReset={() => { setFromF(null); setToF(null); setQ(''); setSt('all'); }}>
1529:           <FItem label="من فرع"><Sel small value={fromF} onChange={v => setFromF(v || null)} placeholder="كل الفروع" options={branchOptions} className="!bg-[var(--bg-card)]" /></FItem>
1530:           <FItem label="إلى فرع"><Sel small value={toF} onChange={v => setToF(v || null)} placeholder="كل الفروع" options={branchOptions} className="!bg-[var(--bg-card)]" /></FItem>
1531:         </FilterBar>
1532:         <Phase phase={phase} cols={6} error={error} onRetry={onRetry}

'err' : ''} />
1665:               </Field>

1667:                 <Icon n="swap" s={16} />

1671:               </Field>

1675:           </Card>
1676: 
1677:           <Card stagger={3}>
1678:             <CardHead title="البنود" meta={<span className="num">{lines.length} / 100</span>} right={<button className="btn btn-soft btn-sm" disabled={lines.length >= 100} onClick={() => setLines(ls => [...ls, newTrLine()])}><Icon n="plus" s={13} /> إضافة بند</button>} />
1679:             {srvErr && <div className="mb-3"><InlineAlert kind="red">{srvErr}</InlineAlert></div>}
1680:             <div className="overflow-x-auto">
1681:               <table className="vt">
1682:                 <thead><tr><th className="w-8">#</th><th style={{ minWidth: 280 }}>المتغير / SKU</th><th style={{ minWidth: 170 }}>موقع المصدر</th><th style={{ minWidth: 170 }}>موقع الوجهة</th><th style={{ minWidth: 130 }}>الكمية المطلوبة</th><th></th></tr></thead>
1683:                 <tbody>

1691:                           {re.product_variant_id && <div className="text-[10.5px] mt-1" style={{ color: 'var(--badge-red-text)' }}>{re.product_variant_id}</div>}

1694:                         <td><Sel small value={l.toLoc} onChange={v => upd(l.key, { toLoc: v || null })} placeholder={to ? 'موقع الاستلام الافتراضي' : '—'} disabled={!to} options={toLocOpts} /></td>
1695:                         <td>

1713: function TransferDetail({ go, params }) {
1714:   const { toast, can, variantCache } = useInv();
1715:   const restriction = useRestrictedBranch();
1716:   const id = Number(params.id);
1717:   const [stage, setStage] = useState(null); // 'approve' | 'ship' | 'receive'
1718:   const [qtys, setQtys] = useState({});
1719:   const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState(null);
1720:   const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
1721:   const [err, setErr] = useState(null);
1722:   const [conflict, setConflict] = useState(null);
1723:   const [stageErrors, setStageErrors] = useState({});
1724:   const [delBusy, setDelBusy] = useState(false);
1725:   const canView = canAny(can, 'transfers.view', 'transfers.manage');
1726: 
1727:   const query = useApi(signal => transfersApi.show(id, signal).then(t => {
1728:     cacheVariantNames(variantCache, (t.items || []).map(it => ({ id: it.product_variant_id, sku: it.sku })));
1729:     return t;
1730:   }), [id]);
1731: 
1732:   if (!canView) return <NoPerm title="تفاصيل التحويل" perm="transfers.view" go={go} />;
1733: 
1734:   const t = query.data;
1735:   const { phase, error } = apiPhase(query, !t);
1736:   const onRetry = () => { setConflict(null); query.reload(); };
1737: 
1738:   const stageMeta = {
1739:     approve: { col: 'approved_qty', srcCol: 'requested_qty', label: 'اعتماد', perm: 'transfers.approve', hint: 'حدّد الكمية المعتمدة لكل بند. البند الغائب يأخذ الكمية المطلوبة تلقائيًا.' },
1740:     ship:    { col: 'shipped_qty', srcCol: 'approved_qty', label: 'شحن', perm: 'transfers.ship', hint: 'أدخل الكمية المشحونة فعليًا. سيتم خصمها من المصدر وتظهر «قيد النقل».' },
1741:     receive: { col: 'received_qty', srcCol: 'shipped_qty', label: 'استلام', perm: 'transfers.receive', hint: 'أدخل الكمية المستلمة فعليًا في الوجهة. أي فرق يُسجَّل كعجز تحويل.' },
1742:   };
1743:   const startStage = s => { const m = stageMeta[s]; setStageErrors({}); setErr(null); setStage(s); setQtys(Object.fromEntries((t.items || []).map((l, i) => [i, String(l[m.srcCol] ?? '')]))); };
1744:   const idx = t ? TR_FLOW.indexOf(t.status) : -1;
1745: 
1746:   const stagePayload = () => {
1747:     const m = stageMeta[stage];
1748:     return {
1749:       expected_version: t.version,
1750:       items: (t.items || []).map((l, i) => ({ id: l.id, [m.col]: Number(toLatinDigits(qtys[i])) })),
1751:     };
1752:   };
1753:   const commit = async () => {
1754:     if (busy) return;
1755:     setBusy(true); setErr(null);
1756:     try {
1757:       const res = await transfersApi[stage](id, stagePayload());
1758:       setConfirm(null); setStage(null);
1759:       toast(res.message || `تم ${stageMeta[stage].label} التحويل`);
1760:       query.reload(); // the resource carries the new version
1761:     } catch (e) {
1762:       const ne = normalizeError(e);
1763:       setStageErrors(groupItemsErrors(ne.fields));
1764:       if (ne.status === 409) {
1765:         // Version conflict: reload first, never auto-resend.
1766:         setConfirm(null); setStage(null); setConflict(ne.message); setBusy(false); return;
1767:       }
1768:       setErr(ne.message);
1769:     }
1770:     setBusy(false);
1771:   };
1772:   const cancel = async () => {
1773:     if (busy) return;
1774:     setBusy(true); setErr(null);
1775:     try {
1776:       const res = await transfersApi.cancel(id);
1777:       setConfirm(null); toast(res.message || 'تم إلغاء التحويل'); query.reload();
1778:     } catch (e) { setErr(normalizeError(e).message); }
1779:     setBusy(false);
1780:   };
1781:   const doDelete = async () => {
1782:     if (delBusy) return;
1783:     setDelBusy(true); setErr(null);
1784:     try {
1785:       await transfersApi.remove(id);
1786:       toast('تم حذف التحويل'); go('transfers');
1787:     } catch (e) { setErr(normalizeError(e).message); setDelBusy(false); }
1788:   };
1789: 
1790:   const actions = [];
1791:   const canSend = !restriction.locked || t?.from_branch?.id === restriction.branchId;
1792:   const canReceive = !restriction.locked || t?.to_branch?.id === restriction.branchId;
1793:   if (t && !stage) {
1794:     if (t.status === 'draft' && canSend) {
1795:       if (canAny(can, 'transfers.update', 'transfers.manage')) actions.push(<button key="e" className="btn btn-soft" onClick={() => go('transfer-edit', { id: t.id })}><Icon n="edit" s={14} /> تعديل</button>);
1796:       if (can('transfers.approve')) actions.push(<button key="a" className="btn btn-dark" onClick={() => startStage('approve')}><Icon n="check" s={14} /> اعتماد</button>);
1797:     }
1798:     if (t.status === 'approved' && canSend && can('transfers.ship')) actions.push(<button key="s" className="btn btn-dark" onClick={() => startStage('ship')}><Icon n="truck" s={14} /> شحن</button>);
1799:     if (t.status === 'shipped' && canReceive && can('transfers.receive')) actions.push(<button key="r" className="btn btn-orange" onClick={() => startStage('receive')}><Icon n="inbox" s={14} /> استلام</button>);
1800:     if (canSend && ['draft', 'approved'].includes(t.status) && canAny(can, 'transfers.update', 'transfers.manage')) actions.unshift(<button key="c" className="btn btn-danger" onClick={() => { setErr(null); setConfirm('cancel'); }}>إلغاء التحويل</button>);
1801:     if (canSend && t.status === 'draft' && canAny(can, 'transfers.delete', 'transfers.manage')) actions.push(<button key="d" className="btn btn-soft hover:!text-[var(--badge-red-text)]" disabled={delBusy} onClick={() => { setErr(null); setConfirm('delete'); }}><Icon n="trash" s={14} /> حذف</button>);
1802:   }
1803:   const nextNeedsPerm = t && !stage && actions.length === 0 && !['received', 'cancelled'].includes(t.status);
1804: 
1805:   const steps = [['draft', 'مسودة', 'edit'], ['approved', 'معتمد', 'check'], ['shipped', 'مشحون', 'truck'], ['received', 'مستلم', 'inbox']];
1806:   const shortage = stage === 'receive' && t ? (t.items || []).reduce((a, l, i) => a + (Number(l.shipped_qty || 0) - (Number(toLatinDigits(qtys[i])) || 0)), 0) : 0;
1807: 
1808:   return (
1809:     <section className="space-y-5">
1810:       <PageHead title={t ? <span className="mono" dir="ltr">{t.transfer_number}</span> : 'تفاصيل التحويل'} back={{ label: 'التحويلات المخزنية', onClick: () => go('transfers') }}
1811:         sub={t && <span className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">{t.from_branch?.name || '—'} <Icon n="arrowL" s={14} className="c-orange" /> {t.to_branch?.name || '—'} <span className="c-muted">·</span> <TrStatus s={t.status} /></span>}
1812:         actions={actions.length ? actions : nextNeedsPerm ? <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[12px] c-muted px-3.5 py-2 rounded-full v-subcard"><Icon n="lock" s={12} /> الخطوة التالية تتطلب صلاحية أخرى</span> : null} />
1813: 
1814:       {conflict && <InlineAlert kind="amber" title="تعارض — تم تعديل التحويل" onClose={() => setConflict(null)}>{conflict}<div className="mt-2"><button className="btn btn-dark btn-sm" onClick={onRetry}><Icon n="refresh" s={13} /> إعادة تحميل وراجعة الكميات</button></div></InlineAlert>}
1815: 
1816:       {err && !confirm && <InlineAlert kind="red">{err}</InlineAlert>}
1817:       <Phase phase={phase} cols={6} rows={3} error={error} onRetry={onRetry} onBack={() => go('transfers')} empty={<Card><EmptyState icon="swap" title="لا توجد بنود" /></Card>}>
1818:         {t && (<div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-5 items-start">
1819:           <div className="lg:col-span-8 space-y-5">
1820:             <Card stagger={2} pad="p-6">
1821:               {t.status === 'cancelled' ? (
1822:                 <InlineAlert kind="red" icon="x" title="تم إلغاء هذا التحويل">{t.notes || 'لا يمكن تنفيذ أي إجراء على تحويل ملغي.'}</InlineAlert>
1823:               ) : (
1824:                 <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
1825:                   {steps.map(([k, l, ic], i) => (
1826:                     <Fragment key={k}>
1827:                       <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
1828:                         <span className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center ${i <= idx ? 'text-white' : 'c-muted'}`} style={{ background: i < idx ? 'var(--pill-active-bg)' : i === idx ? 'var(--accent-orange)' : 'var(--bg-subcard)', color: i < idx ? 'var(--pill-active-text)' : undefined }}>
1829:                           <Icon n={i < idx ? 'check' : ic} s={16} w={2} />
1830:                         </span>
1831:                         <span className={`text-[11.5px] ${i === idx ? 'font-semibold c-primary' : 'c-secondary'}`}>{l}</span>
1832:                       </div>
1833:                       {i < steps.length - 1 && <div className={`step-line mb-5 ${i < idx ? 'done' : ''}`} />}
1834:                     </Fragment>
1835:                   ))}
1836:                 </div>

1838:             </Card>

1840:             <Card stagger={3}>
1841:               <CardHead title="البنود" meta={stage ? `وضع ${stageMeta[stage].label}` : `${(t.items || []).length} بند`} />
1842:               {stage && <div className="mb-3"><InlineAlert kind="blue" icon="info" title={`${stageMeta[stage].label} التحويل`}>{stageMeta[stage].hint}</InlineAlert></div>}
1843:               <div className="overflow-x-auto">
1844:                 <table className="vt">
1845:                   <thead><tr><th>المتغير</th><th>من ← إلى</th><th className="t-num">المطلوبة</th><th className="t-num">المعتمدة</th><th className="t-num">المشحونة</th><th className="t-num">المستلمة</th></tr></thead>
1846:                   <tbody>
1847:                     {(t.items || []).map((l, i) => {
1848:                       const cell = (col) => {
1849:                         if (stage && stageMeta[stage].col === col) {
1850:                           const max = Number(l[stageMeta[stage].srcCol]);
1851:                           const over = !QTY_RE.test(toLatinDigits(qtys[i])) || Number(toLatinDigits(qtys[i])) > Math.min(max, QTY_MAX);
1852:                           const fieldError = stageErrors[i]?.[col];
1853:                           return <td className="t-num" style={{ width: 110 }}><NumInput small value={qtys[i]} onChange={v => { setStageErrors({}); setQtys(q => ({ ...q, [i]: v })); }} err={over || fieldError} className="!bg-[var(--accent-orange-light)]" />{(over || fieldError) && <div className="text-[10px] mt-0.5" style={{ color: 'var(--badge-red-text)' }}>{fieldError || `الكمية من صفر إلى ${formatQty(max)} وبحد أقصى أربع خانات عشرية`}</div>}</td>;
1854:                         }
1855:                         const v = l[col]; const diff = col === 'received_qty' && v != null && l.shipped_qty != null && Number(v) !== Number(l.shipped_qty);
1856:                         return <td className="t-num num" style={{ color: v == null ? 'var(--text-muted)' : diff ? 'var(--badge-red-text)' : 'var(--text-primary)', fontWeight: v == null ? 400 : 600 }}>{v == null ? '—' : formatQty(v)}{diff && <span className="text-[10px] block font-normal">عجز {formatQty(Number(l.shipped_qty) - Number(v))}</span>}</td>;
1857:                       };
1858:                       return (
1859:                         <tr key={l.id}>
1860:                           <td><div className="flex items-center gap-2.5"><Sku>{l.sku || `#${l.product_variant_id}`}</Sku><div className="min-w-0"><div className="font-medium c-primary truncate">{variantDisplayName(variantCache, l.product_variant_id, l.sku)}</div></div></div></td>
1861:                           <td className="mono text-[11px] c-secondary" dir="ltr">{l.from_location ? l.from_location.name : '—'} → {l.to_location ? l.to_location.name : '—'}</td>
1862:                           <td className="t-num num font-semibold c-primary">{formatQty(l.requested_qty)}</td>
1863:                           {cell('approved_qty')}{cell('shipped_qty')}{cell('received_qty')}
1864:                         </tr>
1865:                       );
1866:                     })}
1867:                   </tbody>
1868:                 </table>
1869:               </div>
1870:               {stage && (
1871:                 <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 mt-4 pt-4" style={{ borderTop: '1px solid var(--divider-color)' }}>
1872:                   <button className="btn btn-orange" onClick={() => {
1873:                     const m = stageMeta[stage];
1874:                     if ((t.items || []).some((l, i) => !QTY_RE.test(toLatinDigits(qtys[i])) || Number(toLatinDigits(qtys[i])) > Math.min(QTY_MAX, Number(l[m.srcCol])))) {
1875:                       setErr('راجع الكميات: مطلوب صفر أو أكثر، حتى كمية المرحلة السابقة وبحد أقصى أربع خانات عشرية.'); return;
1876:                     }
1877:                     setErr(null); setConfirm('stage');
1878:                   }}><Icon n="check" s={14} w={2.2} /> تأكيد ال{stageMeta[stage].label}</button>
1879:                   <button className="btn btn-soft" onClick={() => setStage(null)}>تراجع</button>
1880:                 </div>
1881:               )}
1882:             </Card>
1883:           </div>
1884: 
1885:           <Card className="lg:col-span-4" stagger={4}>
1886:             <h3 className="font-display text-[15px] font-semibold c-primary mb-3">التفاصيل</h3>
1887:             <div className="space-y-3 text-[12.5px]">
1888:               {[['المصدر', t.from_branch?.name || '—'], ['الوجهة', t.to_branch?.name || '—'], ['التاريخ', <span className="num">{formatDate(t.created_at)}</span>], ['أنشأه', t.creator_name || '—'], ['إصدار التحويل', <span className="num">v{t.version}</span>]].map(([k, v]) => (
1889:                 <div key={k} className="flex justify-between"><span className="c-secondary">{k}</span><span className="font-medium c-primary">{v}</span></div>
1890:               ))}
1891:             </div>
1892:             <div className="v-subcard p-3.5 mt-4 text-[12px] c-secondary">{t.notes || <span className="c-muted">لا توجد ملاحظات</span>}</div>
1893:             <div className="mt-4 space-y-2">
1894:               {[['requested_qty', 'المطلوب'], ['approved_qty', 'المعتمد'], ['shipped_qty', 'المشحون'], ['received_qty', 'المستلم']].map(([k, l]) => {
1895:                 const total = (t.items || []).reduce((a, x) => a + Number(x[k] || 0), 0); const req = (t.items || []).reduce((a, x) => a + Number(x.requested_qty || 0), 0);
1896:                 return (
1897:                   <div key={k}>
1898:                     <div className="flex justify-between text-[11.5px] mb-1"><span className="c-secondary">{l}</span><span className="num font-semibold c-primary">{formatQty(total)}</span></div>
1899:                     <div className="h-1.5 rounded-full hatched overflow-hidden"><div className="h-full rounded-full bar-hatched-orange" style={{ width: (req ? total / req * 100 : 0) + '%' }} /></div>
1900:                   </div>
1901:                 );
1902:               })}
1903:             </div>
1904:           </Card>
1905:         </div>)}
1906:       </Phase>

1908:       <ConfirmDialog open={confirm === 'stage'} onClose={() => setConfirm(null)} onConfirm={commit} busy={busy} error={err}
1909:         title={stage ? `تأكيد ${stageMeta[stage].label} ${t?.transfer_number || ''}` : ''} confirmLabel="تأكيد"
1910:         body={<div className="space-y-2">
1911:           <p>{stage === 'ship' ? 'سيتم خصم الكميات المشحونة من رصيد المصدر وإضافتها كـ«قيد النقل» حتى يتم الاستلام.' : stage === 'receive' ? 'سيتم إضافة الكميات المستلمة إلى رصيد الوجهة وإغلاق التحويل.' : 'بعد الاعتماد لا يمكن تعديل بنود التحويل.'}</p>
1912:           {shortage > 0 && <InlineAlert kind="amber" title="يوجد عجز في الاستلام">الفرق بين المشحون والمستلم {formatQty(shortage)} — سيُسجَّل كعجز تحويل.</InlineAlert>}
1913:         </div>} />
1914:       <ConfirmDialog open={confirm === 'cancel'} onClose={() => setConfirm(null)} onConfirm={cancel} busy={busy} error={err} danger title="إلغاء التحويل؟" confirmLabel="إلغاء التحويل"
1915:         body={<>سيتم إلغاء <span className="mono c-primary" dir="ltr">{t?.transfer_number}</span> نهائيًا ولن يمكن إعادة تفعيله.</>} />
1916:       <ConfirmDialog open={confirm === 'delete'} onClose={() => setConfirm(null)} onConfirm={doDelete} busy={delBusy} error={err} danger title="حذف مسودة التحويل؟" confirmLabel="حذف نهائي"
1917:         body={<>سيتم حذف <span className="mono c-primary" dir="ltr">{t?.transfer_number}</span> نهائيًا. الحذف مسموح للمسودة فقط.</>} />
1918:     </section>
1919:   );
1920: }

1922: // ============ Shared Vortix UI primitives (RTL) ============

1925: const InvCtx = createContext(null);
1926: const useInv = () => useContext(InvCtx);
1927: 
1928: // Dropdowns share successful location reads for this authenticated inventory
1929: // session. Branch/location writes invalidate the context cache before reloading.
1930: export function useBranchesWithLocations(branchId) {
1931:   const { branchesQuery, locationCache } = useInv();
1932:   const query = useApi(async signal => {
1933:     if (!branchId) return [];
1934:     if (locationCache.has(Number(branchId))) return locationCache.get(Number(branchId));
1935:     const rows = await fetchAllLocations(Number(branchId), signal);
1936:     if (!signal.aborted) locationCache.set(Number(branchId), rows);
1937:     return rows;
1938:   }, [branchId || 0, branchesQuery.data]);
1939:   return { ...query, branches: (branchesQuery.data || []).filter(b => b.is_active) };
1940: }

1942: 
1943: // ---------- Inventory API layer (Phases 1-2) ----------
1944: // All inventory screens are API-backed. Screens
1945: // use catalog/useApi + @alfarid/api-client with the shared context cache below.
1946: 
1947: // Branch-scoped users (branch_id set, not super admin, no inventory.all_branches)
1948: // are locked to their branch: the backend rejects anything else, and the UI
1949: // hides other branches from dropdowns and disables the branch switcher.
1950: function useRestrictedBranch() {
1951:   const user = useAuthStore(s => s.user);
1952:   const perms = user?.permissions;
1953:   const elevated = hasPermission(perms, 'inventory.all_branches')
1954:     || (user?.roles || []).includes('Super Admin');
1955:   const branchId = user?.branch_id ?? null;
1956:   if (branchId == null || elevated) return { branchId: null, locked: false };
1957:   return { branchId: Number(branchId), locked: true };
1958: }
1959: 
1960: // Variant name cache: list endpoints (movements/transfers/stocktakes) return SKU
1961: // only, so every variant seen from any source (options, StockLevel.variant) is
1962: // cached here and reused for display. Never one request per row.
1963: function cacheVariantNames(cache, list) {
1964:   (list || []).forEach(v => {
1965:     if (v && v.id != null) {
1966:       const old = cache.get(Number(v.id)) || {};
1967:       cache.set(Number(v.id), { ...old, name_ar: v.product_name_ar ?? v.name_ar ?? old.name_ar, name_en: v.product_name_en ?? v.name_en ?? old.name_en, sku: v.sku ?? old.sku });
1968:     }
1969:   });
1970: }
1971: function cacheVariantOptions(cache, options) {
1972:   options.forEach(v => {
1973:     const old = cache.get(Number(v.id)) || {};
1974:     const parts = (v.label || '').split(' / ');
1975:     const sku = parts.pop();
1976:     cache.set(Number(v.id), { ...old, label: v.label, name_ar: old.name_ar || parts.join(' / '), sku: old.sku || sku });
1977:   });
1978: }
1979: function variantDisplayName(cache, id, sku) {
1980:   const hit = cache.get(Number(id));
1981:   if (hit) return hit.name_ar || hit.name_en || hit.sku || sku || '—';
1982:   return sku || '—';
1983: }

2136: function ErrorState({ msg = 'تعذّر الاتصال بالخادم. تحقّق من الاتصال وحاول مرة أخرى.', code = 'HTTP 503', onRetry }) {
2137:   const { reload } = useInv();
2138:   const retry = onRetry || reload;
2139:   return (
2140:     <div className="py-12 px-6 flex flex-col items-center text-center rounded-2xl fade-in" style={{ background: 'var(--badge-red-bg)' }}>
2141:       <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mb-3" style={{ background: 'var(--bg-card)', color: 'var(--badge-red-text)' }}>
2142:         <Icon n="alert" s={20} />
2143:       </div>
````

````typescript
 84:   const adminActive = route === '/users' ? 'users' : route === '/roles' ? 'roles' : (route === '/settings' || isStoreRoute) ? 'settings' : null;
 85:   const catalogActive = route === '/assistant' ? 'assistant' : isOperation
 86:     ? operationsActive
 87:     : inventoryActive
 88:     ? 'inventory'
 89:     : route.startsWith('/products')
 90:     ? 'products'
 91:     : route === '/dealers'
 92:     ? 'dealers'
 93:     : route === '/production'
 94:     ? 'production'
 95:     : adminActive;
 96: 
 97:   // 4.4: seed جاهز من شاشة التجار — #/assistant?seed=…&mention_entity=customer&mention_id=…&mention_label=…
 98:   const assistantPrompt = (() => {
 99:     if (route !== '/assistant') return undefined;
100:     const params = new URLSearchParams(routeWithQuery.split('?')[1] ?? '');
101:     const text = params.get('seed');
102:     if (!text) return undefined;
103:     const id = Number(params.get('mention_id'));
104:     const entity = params.get('mention_entity');
105:     const label = params.get('mention_label');
106:     return { text, mentions: (entity === 'customer' || entity === 'transfer' || entity === 'stocktake') && Number.isInteger(id) && id > 0 ? [{ entity, id, label: label || text }] : undefined };
107:   })();
108:   const assistantNav = can('ai_agent.use') ? [{ id: 'assistant', label: 'المساعد الذكي', onOpen: () => { window.location.hash = '/assistant'; } }] : [];
109:   return <FinancialDashboard
110:     onLogout={logoutRemote}
111:     catalogActive={catalogActive}
112:     catalogPage={
113:       route === '/assistant' ? <Suspense fallback={<div dir="rtl">جارٍ تحميل المساعد…</div>}><AssistantPage can={can} initialPrompt={assistantPrompt} /></Suspense> : isOperation && operationsActive ? (
114:         !canViewOperation(operationsActive, can) ? (
115:           <div dir="rtl" className="p-6">ليس لديك صلاحية عرض هذه الصفحة.</div>
116:         ) : (
117:         <OperationsMockPage
118:           key={`${operationsActive}-${operationsId || ''}-${operationsSub || ''}`}
119:           page={operationsActive}
120:           id={operationsId}
121:           sub={operationsSub}
122:           can={can}
123:         />
124:         )
125:       ) : inventoryActive ? (
126:         can('inventory.view') ? (
127:           <Suspense fallback={<div dir="rtl" className="p-6">جارٍ تحميل المخزون…</div>}>
128:             <InventoryPage can={can}/>
129:           </Suspense>
130:         ) : (
131:           <div dir="rtl" className="p-6">ليس لديك صلاحية عرض المخزون.</div>
132:         )
133:       ) : adminActive ? (
134:         <AdminMockPage
135:           key={adminActive}
136:           page={adminActive}
137:           can={can}
138:           initialTab={isStoreRoute ? 'store' : undefined}
139:         />
140:       ) : (
141:         catalogActive && <CatalogMockPage key={catalogActive} can={can} page={catalogActive} />
142:       )
143:     }
144:     catalogNav={!cashierOnly ? [
145:       { id: 'orders', label: 'الطلبات', onOpen: () => { window.location.hash = '/orders'; } },
146:       ...(can('inventory.view') ? [{ id: 'inventory', label: 'المخزون', onOpen: () => { window.location.hash = '/inventory/stock'; } }] : []),
147:       ...(can('products.view') ? [{ id: 'products', label: 'المنتجات', onOpen: () => { window.location.hash = '/products'; } }] : []),
148:       ...(can('customers.view') ? [{ id: 'dealers', label: 'التجار والموزعون', onOpen: () => { window.location.hash = '/dealers'; } }] : []),
149:       ...(can('inventory.view') ? [{ id: 'production', label: 'استلام الإنتاج', onOpen: () => { window.location.hash = '/production'; } }] : []),
150:       ...(canViewOperation('finance', can) ? [{ id: 'finance', label: 'المالية', onOpen: () => { window.location.hash = '/finance'; } }] : []),
151:       ...(can('reports.view') ? [{ id: 'reports', label: 'التقارير', onOpen: () => { window.location.hash = '/reports'; } }] : []),
152:       ...((can('users.view') || can('users.manage')) ? [{ id: 'users', label: 'المستخدمون', onOpen: () => { window.location.hash = '/users'; } }] : []),
153:       ...((can('roles.view') || can('roles.manage')) ? [{ id: 'roles', label: 'الأدوار', onOpen: () => { window.location.hash = '/roles'; } }] : []),
154:       ...((can('settings.view') || can('settings.manage')) ? [{ id: 'settings', label: 'الإعدادات', onOpen: () => { window.location.hash = '/settings'; } }] : []),
155:       ...assistantNav,
156:     ] : assistantNav}
157:     onCloseCatalog={() => { window.location.hash = '/dashboard'; }}
158:     onOpenNotifications={() => { window.location.hash = '/notifications'; }}
159:     categoriesActive={categoriesActive}
160:     categoriesPage={<CategoriesMockPage can={can} embedded />}
161:     onOpenCategories={!cashierOnly && can('categories.view')
162:       ? () => { window.location.hash = '/categories'; }
163:       : undefined}
164:     onCloseCategories={() => { window.location.hash = '/dashboard'; }}
165:   />;
166: }
167: 
168: export default App;
````
